name: Gary Lukitsch
text: This used to be the gem that all other dog parks would aspire to - used to. Since a few years ago the county park system has basically ignored this park. This is a huge park with lots of wooded trails, but someone has decided to take a weedwacker and slash bushes and trees next to the trails. The trees and branches are left there for weeks, with many of the branches containing large thorns. There are no longer trash cans on the trails to put your pet waste in, empty stands. Many parts of the trails are lower than the surounding areas, so everytime it rains, mamy areas remaining muddy for days. Many other parks combat this problem by building up the trails or at least putting down wood chips. There niw is a posted notice at the park to contact a parks rep to complain about current conditions.

text: This is simply the best dog park anywhere. This is different from what you may expect of most dog parks, as it is truly a park and not a fenced in corral where you let your dog offleash. text: The general chaos of this store keeps me away.  I try to limit my runs to super runs instead of frequent small trips because the parking lot layout is so terrible that I feel like someone almost always is about to get in an accident there.  There's never really a time this costco isn't super busy either, so if I can I try to hit up the sun prairie one instead.

name: Lowell Huckleberry
text: Costco is always an experience. Every year I debate the value of the Executive Gold Star Membership and every year I do it again because I am there. Next I cruise the aisles knowing that something I want is no longer carried or it has been moved far from its usual location. The result of course is that I spend far longer in the store than I want to and I buy "organic substitutes that I don't particularly need. Afterwards I am annoyed because I must go to other stores to get the remaining items on my list. If I had skipped Costco I could have shopped at one store, my purchases could have been in quantities that actually fit in my pantry and I could be home having a beer. The Costco novelty is wearing off. Maybe I will make a different decision next year. Probably not.

text: I enjoyed my experience at Costco but found the store to be slightly difficult to navigate. The grocery section isn’t very intuitively organized. This made the whole experience a bit overwhelming, in my opinion.

We are not members and went to see if it would be worth it to shop at Costco.

I liked that they had lots of organic produce at decent prices. I liked many of the clothes, rugs, towels, sheets, and blankets that I saw. The problem is that everything is in bulk and I would be concerned that the produce would spoil before we got to it. Another issue is that it was very crowded (we went on Saturday afternoon).

We spoke to an employee and he said that it was best to come on a Tuesday,  Wednesday,  or Thursday. Monday was supposedly busy because people returned items they bought over the weekend.

Since we work during the week, the only time we could go would be over the weekend.  So basically it would always be a zoo.

We will think on it but I don't think it will be worth the membership fee. It would be great for large families or for people who could go during the week.

text:
This is a clean location and all interactions with staff have been excellent, if you like Costco this one does just fine.

On Costco generally speaking: I'm somewhat pleased with my membership so far, and the place no doubt provides great value for certain things (liquor, wine, diapers/baby products, paper products, cleaning products, soda, snacks), but I've been roundly disappointed with some of the food I've purchased there. Basically, you have to watch the prices of things - you are NOT always getting a good value, nor always the best quality, especially regarding pre-made foods/meals. I think there's some degree of "drinking the Kool-Aid," where members convince themselves that the one product of a certain foodstuff Costco sells is of the highest quality when that simply isn't the case, and really you're just shelling out extra money because you have to (because they don't offer any other options).

Besides limited options of everything, essentially nothing comes in small quantities either, so it just isn't a good place to shop for groceries. If you have a large family, it probably overall makes more sense, but you'll have a tough time eating certain things fast enough if you don't have a bunch of hungry mouths to feed at home.

The truth is, to be a smart shopper and/or to eat healthful meals during the week, you'd have to make at least another stop at another grocery store - and sometimes that's just too inconvenient a truth to justify a Costco visit in the first place. So, I find myself going there maybe once a month, and only to buy a short list of things.

text:
A star employee during this crisis has made me feel unwelcome at the store.

When approaching the doorway to the auto center I was told that I couldn't enter there, I showed my membership card and explained I was dropping off my keys at the auto center for a scheduled appointment.

I got a "Doesn't matter, you can't come through here." Fair enough, it's not like I pay a membership that you could show as much courtesy as a Kwik Trip clerk.

I went through the proper entrance and heard the employee groan out loud about how I was the third person in a row that tried to go through there and asking what was wrong with people.

I am an essential employee engaging with hundreds of people per week, I understand the stress... but that was enough.

I walked over and asked his name "Ross" is what he told me. I then walked to the auto center to drop off my keys.

Ross yelled after me "What are you going to report me to my manager or what?!" I ignored him and waited for the auto center clerk.

I heard him talking to the customer service associate. He then yelled after me "I'm just doing my job!!!!" as I was working with the auto center employee.

Walking out, I nodded to him and was just going to leave it be. He let out a smirk and a laugh saying after me "Aaaaaand awaaaaaaay we goooo!"

Obviously, Ross does not belong in customer service. I have to give him my thanks for making me feel extremely unwelcome at this Middleton location. I don't even want to shop here after being treated like this as a paying member.

If I did not calculate my items, I would not know that he still charged me for the other customer's products. I went to the customer service desk who acted as if there was nothing wrong. Yes, people make mistakes but as customers who pay executive membership and shop regularly at costco, we should not have to experience poor customer service at this level. Even if the worker was new, Costco should not be hiring people who have no customer service skills and work ethic. Dividers were designed to prevent these things from happening. If employees cant even do that, its best they work somewhere else. What would have made the experience better  was if the cashier apologized and truly removed those transactions. To that end, there's not much to really review about Costco itself. You'll find good deals, the cafeteria there is great (affordably priced), and you can pretty much find everything you need.

The only downside here is the parking situation. Madison drivers accelerate way too fast and getting in and out of this location is a nightmare if you're approaching it from the highway 14 side. If you go to either side entrance it's not a problem, but head-on you're going to have regrets.

Aside from this, it's important to get there RIGHT at open (10am) if you don't want to fight your way in and out. This isn't the fault of Costco itself, they just have a good model and there are thousands of people that buy in.

name: Ryan Olson
text:
A lot of people assume that Costco is just about bulk purchases, but it's really about getting high-quality stuff in higher quantities so that it's much more affordable. This is the biggest reason why I love Costco. I'm the type of shopper that, for the most part, sticks to sales, and Costco's sales are generally good. As an example I bought 144 Nature Valley trail mix bars on sale for ~$24, or about $0.17/bar. Good luck getting that kind of price in any other grocery store.

Most everyone is aware that the hot dog/soda combo is $1.50 and their rotisserie chicken is $4.99. And free samples are usually available. That alone should bring you in for a visit.

I can't speak for the vision and pharmacy services yet since I've been blessed with good health so far. But if they are as good as the main store, then I would certainly go.

Costco also has a super generous return policy. So say if an item spoiled faster than expected or you didn't like the flavor of the chapstick 6-pack you bought, you can return it for a full refund at any time. Electronics have a 90-day window though.

Finally, the staff are friendly and well-compensated. All in all, I believe Costco is a place well worth the annual $60 membership.

text:
(Translated by Google) Huge store where they sell pretty much everything in very large quantities. For example, muffins sell in packs of 12 (and they are 200g each) and the best before date is just under a week. I would say it is more suitable for large families. Membership card required to enter ($ 60 per year)
I don't find that the prices of electronics like televisions, computers, printers, vacuum cleaners ... are cheaper. I would even say that it seems expensive to me compared to other stores like target.
There were a lot of people but the wait at the checkout was not that great.

Énorme magasin où il vendent à peu près de tout en très grande quantité. Par exemple, les muffins se vendent par 12 (et ils font 200g chacun) et la date limite de consommation est d'un peu moins d'une semaine. Je dirais que c'est plutôt adapté aux familles nombreuses. Carte de membre obligatoire pour pouvoir y rentrer (60$ par an)
Je ne trouve pas que les prix de l'électronique comme les télévisions, ordinateurs, imprimantes, aspirateur... sont moins chers. Je dirais même que ça me paraît cher comparé à d'autres magasins comme target.
Il y avait beaucoup de monde mais l'attente en caisse n'était pas énorme.

name: Kirstin McMillen
text: History and foodie buffs alike will appreciate this unique Milwaukee coffee house.  Come for the fun historical sights and stay for the delicious food and drink.  Afterwards you can get your steps in on the shore.  A true Milwaukee gem!

name: Paula Rein
text: Well. Coffee and staff are amazing BUT you are surrounded by Dems, snowflakes and well you get it.

name: Linda Hoernke
text: Located in a historical building along Milwaukee's lakefront, this shop has by far, the best coffee in town. I had a lemon lavender scone to go with my lattee and my husband had a wonderful cinnamon roll to go with his lemonade. Seating inside or outside and the outside seating is more of a relaxing beer garden. I really loved this place! Parking can be limited.

name: SJ Bey
text: Very nice coffee shop on lakefront. The building still has the old pump that used to be the largest water pump in the world when it was built. Coffee tea and small bites are served here. Outdoor seating is also available. Pumpkin cranberry muffin is my favorite there.

name: Brandon Williams
text: Super cool coffee shop in a very unique building. The salted Carmel latte is amazing and so is the food they offer. The environment is both calm and outgoing at the same time and it calls for a great time.

name: Crystal Keller
text: My faaaaave place in the world to get coffee. I can't wait for COVID to be over so I can hang out, study, and work from here again. <3

name: Glenna Gunderson
text: Fun place to visit.  Great coffee, food and service

name: Jonathan Sieberg
text: Cool little place with some history staff are nice there

name: Lex Rosemine
text: Amazing Chai tea, fabulous staff, great coffee. If it is nice out parking can be difficult so you may have to park at the marina across the street. Plenty of coffee shops have problems bringing in customers during the summer but this place is the exception. When the weather is nice it is packed. Even so the staff take care of you and really make it feel like short wait. Worth the wait given the atmosphere.

name: Tom Forness
text: Had a Peppermint fluff latte with coconut milk.  Very tasty

name: Denise P
text: Amazing coffee shop in an amazing location! You cannot beat the ambience at the lakefront and the beverages and food are great. I love the green hornet smoothies and all the breakfast burritos. The baked oatmeal is also fantastic. The cauliflower bahn mi is a delicious sandwich option. They use local and fresh ingredients.

name: Russ Gladchenko
text: Clean and friendly coffee shop with excellent coffee and pastries. Nice atmosphere by the lake.

name: Nick Fallucca
text: Great place to get coffee, bakery items and breakfast or lunch. The outside area has a great view of the lake. It’s a great place to bring the dogs and family.

name: Elizabeth Beres
text: Absolutely Fantastic day to be out and at the Lakefront.  The staff was very helpful and kind to take our order, guide us safely through the property and then be able to have space awaiting our orders to be called. Many people were out and making sure everything was good with the customers as well as cleaning and disinfecting. My children and I will be a returning customer group ;)

name: C. Ernest
text: This cool, hip coffee joint near Bradford Beach is perfect stop for morning latte or evening horchata. Ample seating both inside and out, it is a great way to sip and enjoy the day! Parking is a bit of a struggle so come prepared to search for a spot but the old converted water works building is well worth a visit!

name: Jake Dziegielewski
text: My favorite place to go for coffee and tasty treats

name: Mel Brousseau
text: Tried the Cold Brew Peanut Butter Banana Power Smoothie and found it delicious! This is a great spot to sit outside and have coffee, and the inside is beautiful, but seats fill up fast!

name: Emily Stodola
text: Nice social distancing procedures. Well organized and thoughtful. Just a cautionary not- bathrooms are currently not available for use.

name: Denise W.
text: My friend and I stopped there this morning before walking on the lakefront.  The service was excellent, everyone was really friendly.   I really liked the fact that they made sure their customers were safe with this virus situation going on.  I'll definitely be returning.

name: Mars Land
text: Great Coffee. Very fast and friendly barristers. 😊☺️👍

name: Mike Bennett
text: Best coffee location in the city. Amazing outdoor seating with views of the marina and lakefront parks. Two minute walk to beaches and the water.

name: Liam Theo Creative
text: Awesome food and coffee. The building is super cool.

name: Amin Zarandi
text: The most lovely coffee shop in Milwaukee to study, chill out, hang out with friends and meet your friends. I love this place more than any other places.

name: Kristian Perez
text: Colectivo is not my favorite coffee shop in Milwaukee, there are better options in my opinion. This location I love though, right by the lake, really fun in the summer (or any weather to be honest). It does get really crowded especially in the nicer weather but I usually take my coffee to-go and go for a walk around the lakefront.

name: Shanti Sharma
text: Great coffee great indoor and outdoor ambiance !

name: 許志忠
text: Popular coffee shop in Milwaukee downtown, I like it than Starbucks. Just nearby the Michigan lake, a cup of coffee and walk along the lake is very comfortable in daily life.

name: juli gupton
text: Great chai. Beautiful architecture.  Great service.

name: Aaron Quam
text: Great place to sit outside and drink coffee.  Plenty of room to social distance .

name: R H
text: Good food, atmosphere, service. Dog friendly patio. Cant go wrong.

name: Joshua DeGrasse-Baumann
text: Probably the best coffee shop patio in Milwaukee. Great views for people watching, spacious, plenty of shade or sun, and dog-friendly. Will definitely be a regular.

name: Margaret Larkin
text: Get the Avocado BLT--the bacon was the best, better than any bacon I've had on a BLT. I also had coffee and a smoothie, which were also good. Very interesting building. It's obvious the owners really care about the coffee as well as the customer experience. Definitely a cut above coffee shops I encounter in Chicago (though they just opened one there--they're upping the game). The majority of customers were students, probably because it's near a lot of schools. Also friendly customer service.

name: Brian Vande Zande
text: Possibly our family's favorite restaurant and place on the planet. Great food and coffee and beautiful location.

name: Jorge Arciniegas
text: Very nice coffee shop right by the lake. A ton of space so you get a comfortable feel but not overcrowded atmosphere like so many other coffee shops. Pretty good food selection as well! They're in the process of remodeling the outdoor seating area as well so I'd recommend visiting in the summer!

name: Doug C
text: Best location fastest and most professional service. Kudos to the management and staff

name: Steve Reupert
text: This is a great spot with an amazing patio. When the weather is nice it’s busy but still worth it.

name: Tracey Sperko
text: There coffee depends on what they are brewing, as they have so many different roasts, beans ect. This location is premier on the lake with an awesome courtyard for chilling. Sometimes they have music. Inside is so unique. A great place alone or in a small group. It is very busy. There is parking across the street.

name: Jill Kirchner
text: My first time ordering online. They have parking for curbside pickup! FYI!

name: Laura Williams
text: What could be better than coffee by the lake?!

name: Hannibal Robinson
text: I was told to go to another location to get coffee and did not let me in but let others in mask was on don’t know why but stone creek let me in 👌🏾

name: Eric O'Dell
text: My wife and I stopped here for breakfast on an overnight in Milwaukee. Staff was friendly and the location on the lake is impressive. Food was very good and the unique choices of coffee mixed in with the classics made this a place we will most likely be returning to the next time we find ourselves in the Brew City.

name: Dan Giampetroni
text: Great location for after a run or walk. Beautiful building repurpose of old Lake Michigan pump house. Better bakery than coffee.

name: Ana Beard
text: Yum! Cute little place to eat at. I had broccoli cauliflower soup and a turkey club! Oh and the chai tea.

name: Mike Norris
text: One of the best Colectivo locations in Milwaukee. Nice views and lots of activity happening in warmer months. The old pump building it is housed in has na cool industrial vibe. Plenty of places to sit and work thanks to wifi and decent selection of power outlets for road warriors.

name: Elisabeth Arlt
text: Loved the food!  Outdoor seating was wonderful 😊

name: John Weber
text: Orered by phone. Took 20 minutes for three drinks and 2 bakery items. But soo good.

name: Jessica Bookwater
text: This is a really nice place to go to. It is a repurposed old water pump station turned into a coffee shop. It has kept the inside as it was as a pump station with tables and chairs nestled around the historic place. Also, posted around the building are captions to educate the customers about the pump station and history of Milwaukee. The food is amazing, the coffee is amazing and it is just across the street from lake Michigan.

name: Kristopher Purzycki
text: Bumped this review up to 5 because of the awesome way Colectivo has handled the coronavirus.

name: Micheal Harrington
text: Awesome coffee, wait times were a bit up there but we also went during prime time. Only been to this location once but the whole area is beautiful. Easily once of the best coffee shops to visit with friends 🙂

name: Charlie White
text: We like to visit here during our long lakeside hikes. We usually get the cold-brewed coffee, and then we sit outside in Colectivo’s sidewalk café setting for a wonderful afternoon of small talk and conversation. At one point I gave the barista a little tip of an origami-folded dollar bill, and he was simply delighted. The whole experience at this well-placed café is always superb. We all recommend it, have returned here several times, and will continue to do so.

name: jean kies
text: Great place to socially distance and have a coffee with friends!!

name: Joey Crowley
text: Lovely joint to get coffee, do work, hang out with friends, grab a quick snack, and just straight-up enjoy yourself. I would recommend this place to just about anybody

name: Tom Blair
text: Tasty food and friendly service. Quite efficient for how busy.

name: Jennifer Rahn
text: Used to be you could get a wrap or sandwich that actually was more than a bun. Colectivo has become the home of the 4 ounce bun with a 2 ounce filling. No salads or wraps anymore. Great you feature your bread, but the lack of offerings for those of us with dietary restrictions is appalling.

name: Kate Mackay
text: Very charming! In an old pumping station with most of the architecture intact. Excellent hot chocolate and mocha, and excellent service.

name: Susan Montey
text: Was good i had fruit smoothies mango I didn't like but the berry one was really good!

name: Jonathan Branski
text:
Went here for a meeting today. While it was fairly busy at the time of me going the volume levels were still more than great.

Had a very fun and energetic staff behind the counter today as well. Even though interaction time was at a minimal it was still a great experience.

The mocha shake and cinnamon roll were both amazing! I think the only downside of the visit was slightly slow internet, though I can't blame them when they were that busy!

name: Your Time is Now
text: Best place to have great coffee, hang out with friends and relax. Food is limited but delicious. Great spot any time of year.

name: Ann K
text: One of my favorite places! The staff are so friendly and helpful if you have questions! I love coffee. Every coffee drink I have tried from this location has been amazing.

name: Jim O'Keeffe
text: Great place for coffee and bakery snacks/sandwich. Friendly, knowledgable staff and the best baristas in town. Great espresso drinks fantastic quality and large outdoor seating area looking out on Lake Drive and Lake Michigan.

name: Janice Lynch
text: I really enjoyed this place. I'm a huge coffee fan (been drinking coffee for about ten years now) and I will attest that their coffee is GOOD. I just had their regular house blend and it's smooth and flavorful and not bitter or burnt tasting or watery. I also had their veggie pesto burrito, sunrise sandwich, and sesame sweet potato bowl. So about their food- it's good but I found the portions tiny especially for the price you pay for them. It's okay but I think there is definitely better breakfast/brunch food out there for better pricing.

name: Élysse
text: Love hanging out here. Good food, good coffee drinks and free WiFi. They have a lovely outdoor seating area right across from the marina. I have many times enjoyed working remotely here, then taking a walk along the pier to take in the power of such a Great Lake.  I recommend the grilled cheese sandwich, baked oatmeal and potato bacon burritos. My kids can never get enough of their pumpkin chocolate chip tea bread.

name: Patriot log home Builders
text: My cappuccino was nearly all milk. Had to wait nearly 10 minutes for it as well. Nice environment but not good brew.

name: Hal A
text: A good amount of parking and outdoor tables.

name: Carla Fuentes
text: Great place! I wish prices were not that high.

name: Jo Ellen Burkholder
text: One of my favorite places for coffee in Milwaukee.  Great coffee, the food is always interesting and delicious and I love the reclaimed space.

name: Anthony Henderson
text: One of the best coffee spots in Milwaukee. Vibe is always great here, perfect for grabbing a coffee and working or reading a book or just relaxing. Everything they have is great, but I do highly recommend the cauliflower bahn mi and the chorizo breakfast burrito, depending on if you eat meat or not

name: Talea Bloom
text:
This charming campus on the shores of lake Michigan is just the spot for a quick bite as well as to linger and people watch.
Grab a seat outside under the trees or at a table inside to work.
Relax and enjoy your coffee, tea or beer.
Cheers.

name: Robert Walker
text: Coffee was mediocre at best but overpriced. Service not good .

name: Anurag Vutukuri
text: The BEST place in Milwaukee to hangout for a coffee or a beer. The concept of converting an old water pump station into a coffee shop is really amazing. Great ambiance and always lively.

name: Susan Scarbro
text: Colectivo Cofgee Lakefront is a perfect place for me to enjoy a delicious cup of coffee along with a perfectly toasted sesame seed bagle with lushes whipped creamy cream cheese and. I just live up the hill on Summit. Also a perfect way to start your day as you watch the sunrise up over the lake.😊☕🌞

name: Joseph Fasi
text: What a fantastic place to experience Milwaukee and the Lakefront at the same time with excellent coffee and food. We love to walk to Colectivo after playing tennis immediately across the street at the city courts (free). Get a coffee and baked oatmeal or a breakfast burrito, sit in the adironack Chairs facing the lake or at a table outside.  A restored former pump house, the inside seating is excellent as well. Can't go to Milwaukee and miss this place.

name: Debra Lynn
text:
Beautiful coffee house in historic building on Lake Michigan. Great drinks and food. Beer garden outside, open certain hours.
Can't beat the view from the ample outside seating. Dog friendly. ❤

name: Christie Porter
text: This is one of my favorite places to go on a weekend morning in Milwaukee. An expansive patio in the summer and extensive seating inside as well.

name: Enoch Rasmussen
text: Amazing historic location with beautiful exposed brick walls. Friendly staff and delicious coffee.

name: Susan Taddey
text: Cute coffee shop by the lake!

name: Mari Tomizawa
text: I love the atmosphere at this Collectivo. The old buildings is historic and really neat to check out! Also, their cinnamon rolls are excellent (get them heated up!) Their Christmas tree this year was phenomenal.

name: Cristiano Caiado De Acioli
text: It is a very cozy place to chill and drink a coffee. Great ambience and service.

name: MikƏ OŇƏ
text: My favorite place to be in the summer.

name: Mazen Seddick
text: One of my favorite spots in town!

name: Natalie Huertas
text: I've lived in Milwaukee my entire life, visited this Colectivo growing up, and it was until I had a drink with a new Milwaukeean that I sat outside. It's calm, inviting, and everyone is mindful of their space. It really is a beautiful place to wind down.

name: Jaren Singh
text: Love this place. In my opinion it's the best Colectivo to study at. A lot of seating

name: A Maiers
text: Beautiful space and great coffee and drinks!

name: Taylor Wetley
text: Incredible establishment located right off Lake Michigan. Some of the best coffee in Milwaukee with great pricing and an excellent staff. Must visit if you're a coffee lover or enjoy a great view of the lake.

name: Amanda Horejsfield
text: Very beautiful scenery, even in winter. Great place to stop and chill for a bit, or bring a book to read outside. Their coffee is great, service is always fast even in a rush time, and their bakery is pretty fantastic. The cranberry pumpkin muffins are to die for. The converted and restored building is very cool to just stop and check out while you wait for your drinks.

name: Rob williams
text: My favorite place to relax with friends during a Sunday in Milwaukee. Great coffee and beer. Awesome beer/coffee garden.

name: James Heck
text: An amazing example of a coffee shop. Probably one of the coolest venues in Milwaukee to sit down and work.

name: Stacy L. Steele
text: This is my favorite Colectivo. Historical building right on the lakefront, lots of outdoor seating in the summer months with live entertainment sometimes. Of course, the coffee is fantastic and so is the food. My only complaint is that it seems to be ALWAYS busy, which is a good thing for them. Apparently it's a lot of people's favorite, too!

name: Tamie Bebo
text: Super cool place for coffee and a Danish or my favorite a brownie.  If you ask them they will warm it for you.  That's Awesome!!  Great views of the lake as well.  Lots going on in the summer.  I like the kite show.pretty impressive☺

name: Annette Lucchesi
text: I always have a good experience going to this Collectivo. Even when they are in the heart of the morning rush, they are always courteous and pleasant. Everything is always fresh, both food and beverages. Thanks for making it a good morning.

name: Soren Stauss
text: The best think I can say about this location is...the location. The building is cool, and it's in a great spot near the lake. The service is hot or miss, and it's almost always crowded. Good luck finding a table... or a parking spot.

name: Emma Erdman
text: My favorite location to go to for colectivo, right by the lake  but can get noisy due to all the traffic

name: Jacqueline Hannah
text: The location could not be more beautiful, we make a point to go every time we're in Milwaukee. Both the indoor and outdoor seating are lovely. The drinks are very good, the staff fast and friendly. I've never ordered food, but my partner very much enjoyed his egg sandwich last time we were there.

name: harvey agee
text: Always a cozy and laid back/social environment staff always friendly and very helpful with suggestions as far as recommendation on different coffee and teas to try. My favorite coffee shop so far.

name: Georges Hanna
text: Their covid plan is not working and their inside sitting is not open

name: Dana Johnson
text: Location Location Location  —you know if it's a nice day it'll be busier, in any season. But why this place isn't a zoo every day of the year, I don't know.  Their slogan- strong coffee -holds true. Don't know how they pull out blueberry flavors by roasting a bean, but they do. Don't miss crowded but lively Latin Thursdays, always draws the whole community during good weather.

name: Starr Price
text: Always great coffee and food!

name: Hope Polak
text: Unique flavored coffee... not your average cup of Joe! Huge variety also! I highly recommend getting a coffee and taking that coffee to go for a nice walk on the lake or staying at the restaurant and enjoying their cozy courtyard.

name: Ian Carroll
text: Great location, good coffee and wonderful staff. The only downside is it's almost always packed (annoying but not really something that they can help). They have an amazing outdoor patio when the weather is nice and they allow dogs out there too. Overall a good coffee joint on the lakefront

name: Caleb Hein
text: The building is super cool, I believe it used to be a municipal water pump. It's in proximity to a lot of MKE things to do, so it's a great place to meet up with friends or do people watching. Coffee is par for the course for chains, but not bad.

name: Diana Dreger
text: Collectivo lakefront is the perfect spot to work alone or chat with friends...the staff is always welcoming and great!

name: William Aulgur
text: Large coffee shop,  fishing the summer the outside is a must.  Durning the winter two floors, plenty of space.

name: Rich Ball
text:
A nice spot for coffee, a craft beer or a bite to eat.  There's dining inside or outside with nice food and drink options.  We enjoyed our visit and look forward to dining again.

A few thoughts on logistics.  Parking can be tough when it is busy.  The restaurant is handicap accessible but entering and navigating the restaurant with a wheelchair is a little challenging but is possible.

name: Chriz Da Bizz
text: Great local place to grab a cup of joe and an awesome place to hang out with friends or coworkers. On a great part of Milwaukee's lakefront could spend hours here if the weather allows it. Coffee is just as good as the experience

name: Sabrina Brown
text: Great atmosphere and a quick walk from multiple places.

name: Payal Sanghani
text: This is a great location right near the lakefront.  Love the outdoor seating to enjoy a drink and the view.  I don't usually get a coffee drink here because of my caffeine aversion, but their teas are nice and the beer they serve is pretty good.  I like breakfast food here, too.  I usually order the southwest burrito or the pesto burrito.  Both are pretty tasty.

name: Tyler W
text: Rude employees, don’t take cash

name: Aaron Campbell
text: Coffee is always great and my daughter loved the kid's hot chocolate

name: Papa Fred
text: This is a great place for coffee. They also make sandwiches and have some bakery etc. Food is very good. Parking can be a challenge at times. Atmosphere is cozy and is a great place to go during the summertime being it is on the lake front. Worth the trip.

name: Brad Ehlert
text: Beautiful location and historic building. Best to visit in the warmer months when you can sit outside. Limited seating during the colder months. In addition to the coffee, there is a fun beer selection.

name: Johnny V Nelson
text: 4 stars. Coffee goodly. Always room for improvement. No place to park so...

name: Ellery R
text: Great food, great service, lovely patio and clean bathrooms. I took a nice walk from there on this pier nearby. Great day.

name: Tyler Goeckner
text: Super cool how they converted this building to a coffee shop. Great coffee and an even cooler environment

name: Barrett McCormick
text: The location (on the lakefront) and the architecture (an old pump house) make this a Colectivo that everyone in Milwaukee should visit, not least for the outdoor concerts in summer, but there are actually other Colectivos that offer better spaces for work and conversation.

name: Mo Paradise
text: A Milwaukee Institution. A wonderful place for regulars to get their favorite caffeine fix and a delight for visitors of MKE to get tasty munchables along with expected (and not) caffeinated drinks. In the summer they serve beer and the occasional live music on the patio ... all right across the street from Lake Michigan. Milwaukee's lakefront is *way* better than Chicago's, hands down. This is just one of the many reasons.

name: Cheryl Carstens
text: Always  excellent lattes and hot tea. Try rice krispie treat dipped in chocolate on on side. So good.

name: Andy Nordin
text: Awesome place in the old river pump house. Lots of turn of the 20th century electrical equipment and the whole place smells of transformer oil too. They really made a good use of the space. You don’t feel stacked on top of your neighbors and as such it’s popular with students doing work. It might be hard to find a parking spot not to mention a table. But it’s definitely a must stop location here if for no other reason than to check out the old equipment. Like taking your coffee in a museum.

name: Carl O'Neil
text: Very busy and long wait but that's what you get on a summer weekend. Beautiful building in a beautiful area next to lots of walking /running / biking paths by the lake. If the parking lot is full there is lots of parking across the street by the marina.

name: Vincent Wartenweiler
text: Parking is sometimes the biggest challenge here. Everything else is great! The environment is welcoming with great drinks and tons of indoor/outdoor space for working, chatting, or chilling.

name: barry garner
text: Great place for coffee

name: Abigail Moore
text: Beautiful location! They also have live music in the summers. The only down side is limited indoor seating during colder months.

name: Deep Chatterjee
text: Great location. They have lots of space to sit and work. But it can be busy specially on weekends. Plus their patio is really nice. And they do live shows in the summer outside.

name: Tasha Sorenson
text: Good coffee, nice atmosphere, excellent patio.

name: J
text: Best Colectivo location. Looks great, inside and out.

name: Marty Christensen
text: Best coffee best scenic atmosphere and the most interesting people can all be found here. Soon to be you favorite destination.

name: Danny Clayton
text: Cool building. Fun in good weather. Gets crowded in line for drinks.

name: Sawyer Stewart
text: This was a pretty cool coffee shop! It was huge, with lots of indoor and outdoor seating, right on the lakefront. The architecture was beautiful. I ordered a tea - and the coffee was well roasted. Despite the large amount of seating, we still couldn't find anywhere to sit inside, which was a bummer.

name: Brian Spilker
text: Great place to watch people

name: Alexa Wild
text: Amazing revitalization of a historic Milwaukee building. The location, employees, coffee and food always puts me in a good mood when I need to study or meet up with friends.

name: Al Roth
text: If you didn't know it was their, you missed some.

name: Ana Koepke
text: I was surprised when my total for 2 breakfast sandwiches and a fruit salad came out to over $22. Then I was frustrated when I took a bite of my sandwich and it was bland and frankly had a weird after taste. The fruit salad tasted like it had been frozen then thawed and placed on display for too long. They did earn 1 star back because the outdoor seating has a great view and the building itself is very pretty... otherwise it would have been 1 star.

name: Armando Garcia
text: Still outside seating during the pandemic with social distancing with most of their menu.

name: Tony Krause
text: Parking could be better as it is a crowded place. But overall, good coffee and nice staff and a nice atmosphere. Ordered the Mocha Mexicana, had a nice kick to it, would order it again when I sample the rest of the coffee menu

name: Jeremy Poling
text: The atmosphere is nearly unbeatable, being located in a very nicely renovated pumping station along the lakefront. The baristas are talented and I've never had a bad order here. They exceed my expectations consistently.

name: S D
text:
So expensive—I usually end up spending $12-15 for two drinks after tip—but it’s really worth it. The servers have charm and personality like no other venue, and the drink menu features not just classic beverages but also a rotating selection of original drinks unlike anything you’ll drink anywhere else. Even other local coffee venues have nothing on Colevtivo’s originality and cool vibe.

There’s two gender neutral bathrooms and plenty of seating options on the ground floor as well as upstairs. The closest parking lot is free and long. However, it tends to be crowded, so it can sometimes be a little tricky finding a spot (especially if you need an outlet).

They offer cups to pour your own water for free.

name: Doris Rogge
text: Ultra-trendy, IMHO, with a bit of a view of North Marina on Lake Michigan.  Very good Avocado Toast, and other sandwiches available!

name: Janet F
text: Good but always crowded. Had to park across the road very busy Lake Drive. They have good items pretty good service but not enough parking. Where there's a will, there's a way.

name: Mart Mart
text: Beautiful place to sit, enjoy your coffee or socialize.  Lots of shade and seating both in and out.   You can sit in or out.  Old water pump building I believe.   Right across from the lake path.  They also have food, sandwiches or decadent desserts.  There are always a lot of people sitting out.  Parking is tough sometimes but you can park across the street.

name: Paul Barnes
text: Yup. Go here.

name: Jade Bilkey
text:
Great for laptop warriors or studying. If you're looking for a change of pace, this place has eclectic atmosphere to spare.
There are lots of quiet alcoves and small tables where you won't get disturbed. Quiet area with a great view.
A good mix of food, both light and a bit heartier, and standard cafe drink here.
The staff are busy but efficient, not much chitchat.
Busy but there's plenty of seating so it never felt cramped.

name: Mary Baker
text: Busy little place with good food fair prices great service and a wonderful view of the lakefront! Family friendly too!

name: Kavita Mahendra
text: We love the smooth coffee ☕

name: Jeff Waters
text: My first time here. It's a really nice location near the lake and in good weather they have just enough parking and you can get a table to sit under some trees and relax or work. Coffee was good and so was my muffin. I really enjoyed it here. Also easy in-out road access to the parking area.

name: Misha Tyler
text: Out of all of the coffee shops for colectivo this one might be my favorite. On the odd chance I am not at Stone Creek or anodyne I don't mind that I stopped in.

name: fuad ahmad
text: Overpriced coffee. Long waits overrated more of trendy spot then actual good food or coffee

name: Julia Micke
text: One of my favorite places in Milwaukee. This coffee house is perfect inside and outside and its surroundings!

name: Alaina Applewhite
text:
I gave them a three because they were kind though they could use a customer service training or two, not a five because they aren't dining in or accepting cash.

Other than that, they're alright.

name: Genny Zauhar
text: It gets a little crowded, but the service is quick and super friendly. Wide selection of drinks and food on the menu

name: Kristen Potter
text: Great spot and tasty dependable coffee.

name: Liz Pollock
text: Loved the Mexican mocha latte.

name: Nicole Marie Miller
text: Colectivo has the best coffee!  I stopped in the other day after the air show, go Thunderbirds!  The coffee was great, no surprise there.  I was amazed how quickly I got my order considering how crazy busy they were.  I love how they have colorful tables outside to sit and relax at, while people watching or just looking out at lake Michigan.   I took one star off because there is never anywhere to park!  Even on a day that isn't busy you can't find parking.  I have had to skip going there just because of the parking.  The coffee and staff get five stars!

name: Alessandro Picasso
text: Beautiful location. Not sold on their drink selections and size of their cups. Pricey for what you get. Probably won't be ack unless I really have to stop or a business meeting

name: Katie Kohl
text: Great coffee nice setting..

name: Joe D
text: The lakefront location has both the usual high standards of delicious Collectivo coffee with the added benefit of the delightful venue on Milwaukee's lakefront.  You're directly in front of the Marina and just minutes from the beach. You'll often find students and business people working on the free WiFi.  The only drawback is that parking is limited on busy days.

name: Yonggon Lee
text: Located in the old water pump building, it is beautiful, graceful and classy. I usually like to sit on the second floor to get a view of the entire coffee shop. Strongly recommend! Parking can be challenging during peak hour though.

name: Nancy
text: Ordered a blt sandwich on multigrain bread and it was delicious!!  Seating is limited I wouldn't recommend it for large groups. they do have outside seating.

name: Ray Forgianni
text: Best outdoor sitting for a cafe in Milwaukee. Great selection of drinks. Beer garden. Parking lot that is always fill.

name: Robert Whitney
text:
Classic yuppie venue.
Prices not cheap.
Good decor & ambiance.

name: Alicia Cera
text: It is always so fun to visit Colectivo and this location on the lakefront is my personal favorite. The service is always delightful and they are consistently featuring new items to try, such as the Piña Colada smoothie or Sparkling Cherry Cold Brew. No matter how busy it is, the wait for your beverage or food is never too long. Can't wait to come back!

name: Elizabeth Fisher
text: It's a very popular location and fast service.

name: Charlene Gavin
text: Always busy.. Great place to stop have a bite or coffee n now serving beer

name: D'Lacey Eichinger
text: Beautiful lakeside location with plenty of indoor/outdoor seating and quick service even when busy! Parking can be a challenge, especially in the summer. Many Colectivo locations offer live music on different nights throughout the year, including members from the Milwaukee Symphony Orchestra. As a roastery, Colectivo offers many unique and original blends for the coffee enthusiast. A great place to enjoy a coffee, or delicious gourmet food with healthy options.

name: Emily Jones
text: Loved being able to be outside in October, but the bees were ridiculous! I saw bee traps, but maybe consider moving/consolidating the busing/garbage.

name: Pete Dorn
text: Went for the Thursday night concert. That was fun! But parking sucked! And got a parking ticket!😒

name: Craig Risser
text: I think they could open the restrooms.

name: Colin Stuart
text: Tasty, powerful, affordable espresso. And every other drink too obviously. Better than chain coffee places. The building they're in is also very interesting. Lots of outdoor seating which is great in the summer/warm seasons. Building used to be a pump house, they have some of that old machinery in tact, it is interesting to look at and drink/sit around it.

name: Matt Glazier
text: Great coffee and outdoor seating!

name: John Teevan
text: Overrun.   Rude staff.  Long waits.   Use their app helps a bit.  Overrated.

name: Ashley
text: Although it is rather expensive, the nitro cold brew is a must have. It comes in a small cup, but that's only because the brew is so strong! It is delicious and smooth. Also, the atmosphere and the service is great at this location. It is my go to whenever I am in the area!

name: Sandra Valdovinos
text: Nice atmosphere. Great stop while visiting lake front.

name: Daniel Annear
text: Best coffee in Milwaukee at the best coffee shop in Milwaukee

name: Thomas Ostergaard
text: Great atmosphere, good coffee, and solid sandwiches if you're peckish. Parking in the snow can be a bit tricky, but when isn't it in Milwaukee? Great place for a first date or lunch meeting.

name: Don Rach Schaeffer
text: This is our favorite lunch spot in Milwaukee. There is a great selection of lunch and breakfast options, including vegetarian. Not to mention baked goods if you want something quick and sweet. The staff is very kind and helpful. Both inside and outside seating are picturesque. Oh and did I mention, best coffee in Milwaukee. Thank you Colectivo.

name: Aide Cano
text: Big line we have to wait 1 hour for are order.

name: Stan Stubblefield
text: Near the lake & good views. At this one, unfortunately, the employees don't seem to want to come out and clean anything until closing time.

name: B D
text: Definite stop if visiting Milwaukee.  The old pump room in the back is pretty cool.

name: Katie Gardipee
text: Mmmm white chocolate pumpkin spice latte! Best ever!

name: Brad Schimian
text: Nice place, but 45 minute wait for a cold sandwich. Definitely not worth it.

name: Cameron Bentrott
text: Good food and atmosphere. I interacted with a condescending staff member though.

name: Scott Wood
text: I love, love, love this coffee shop.  I travel on business every week. While on the road, I work out of coffee shops or libraries. This coffee shop is definitely on the top of my list because of the building, the many nooks and crannies for you to work from, and that the coffee shop is opened till 10pm on Sundays. The thing that really makes this place stand out is the historic building and the old water treatment equipment. I will definitely come back to this coffee shop whenever I am in town.

name: Ixtab Media
text: Went here by complete accident recently and was really impressed by how nice the place it. I remember it back when it was a flushing station. How time has changed. Anyway, Gabby or Debbie or something is an absolute rockstar for this location and if I ever open my own coffee store I would definitely make her my third or fifth hire.

name: Jacob Glisch
text: I fell in love with Colectivo by first visiting their Madison area location. I’ve always lived in Milwaukee and known of this spot. I’ve held out for some reason and I’m glad I’m converting from Starbucks. BOTH locations gave amazing drink recommendations and the atmosphere is outstanding inside and OUT! Beautiful patio area too! BRAVO!

name: Paul Marren
text: Enjoyable, though you can put a "hipster clock" on the service. But I don't mind that. It's not fast food.

name: Corrie Christiaansen
text: The macaroons and espresso shakes are delicious! It gets very busy during the day. They have two levels of seating. The atmosphere is very iconic and interesting since it used to be the water pump building.

name: Jon Decker
text: Parking is difficult at times... but the staff is very quick to get to your order... even when busy

name: Mariam Maroof
text:
Coffee by the lake, who wouldn't like it and if the coffee and food is amazing, who wouldn't like to visit this place.
I love this place
This is our go to place on the weekends on the weekends.
Their dulce de leche coffee and curry wrap are my favorite.
The ambiance and food are both amazing. Nice place to relax and enjoy the beautiful view.

name: Joshua Coolidge
text: Pay the employees more- UNIONIZE

name: John Mellinger
text: Love this place! It was a great place for our first date! Great food too

name: Taylor Soderling
text: Great historic coffee shop by the lakefront. Parking may be scarce and crowds may be abundant - especially in the warm months - but if you live nearby and enjoy coffee, you should try and visit this place at least once. The food is generally pretty good, the coffee is great, iced drinks are always done right, and the variety of places to sit and enjoy is great - whether outside, in the main hall, or upstairs. Only issue has been that many have wished they had more bathrooms. Overall, a very nice coffee house.

name: Merriel
text: Colectivo has the best coffee.  This one has a wonderful view and ambience.

name: Porter
text: One of the hippest coffee shops on the planet. Carved out of a 19th century City Of Milwaukee water flushing station - another example of Milwaukee entrepreneurs recycling funky old municipal buildings (see Lakefront and City Lights breweries) - this huge yet still cozy hangout place has a unique ambience. Terrific teas and coffees, tasty sandwiches, friendly service, and myriad places to sit and chill and people-watch or whatever. An absolute must in the summer, when you can sit on the large outdoor patio and look out over Lake Michigan. A+ bike friendly, too.

name: Mr.mont Mwg
text: When I go to colectivo lakefront I enjoy it because it's a history point to lake is a pumping house that pumps water from the lake to the river Milwaukee River and it's a beautiful sight if somebody wants to know history about Milwaukee

name: Kelly M
text: Lovely setting. Good coffee-as always. Delicious breakfast. Rude barista.

name: Michael Bukowski
text: Busy but worth the wait! It is hard to find a place to sit inside but there is additional seating outside however it is not convenient if you need to charge your laptop or get work done in this café.

name: Melissa Mularski
text:
A photo-perfect Milwaukee landmark and must-go. The dark wooded interior has a Harry Potteresque library feel. There are 3 or 4 levels of seating - besides the main level, there are several partial floors of seating up a few stairs,  then more tucked up in the loft itself, which overlooks the bulk of the interior. The outdoor patio, with hanging globe lights and brightly colored metal tables and chairs feels like a relaxed beer garden. Seating is the across the road from Lake Michigan, and is right along paved walkways, next to tennis courts, across the road from beaches, the McKinley marina, and is a short walk or drive to bike, kayak, and other recreational rentals. Behaved dogs are welcome to hang outside with their humans.

We’ve been here a bunch of times and I can’t remember ever having anything but excellent interactions with employees. They’re just good people. The meals, desserts, coffees and other drinks are very good and they have roasted beans for sale by the pound. The avocado bacon BLT is fantastic. I don’t think they have a specific kids menu any more, but they can make you a regular grilled cheese, and likely other similar things if you ask. Free water is located by one or both entrances, and there’s free WiFi inside and out. During summer they have free live music Friday nights.

There’s no drive thru. The attached parking lot is a fairly narrow one-way lot. Often it’s close to filled or overflowing, but if that’s the case just drive through and circle back in once or twice and you’ll usually find a spot. If not, never fear, there’s ample free parking across the road on the lake side. If it’s cold and you’re not finding seating inside, take a walk through the doors to the right of the back entrance (parking lot side). The historic pump room can be a little noisy but I’ve yet to not find a seat back there.

name: Ted Carra Augustine
text: Amazing coffee and unique atmosphere.  Whether you're just popping in for a quick cup, or looking for a full meal, you can find it here.

name: Molly Sroka
text: Staff are extremely pleasant and helpful, but food delivery was extremely slow. Can be a little pricey for what you get. Beautiful store and space, great place for a date or meeting.

name: Brian Moran
text: Love this spot for coffee and some quiet time in Milwaukee.

name: Eriq Tews
text: Super friendly baristas and awesome food & decor

name: John Kim
text: Havent tried must of their foods but enjoy their teas and coffee!

name: Jennifer Slowinski
text: My all time favorite coffee spot in Milwaukee! I have been going here for over 15 years. My kids love to go here and get a treat and people watch or do their homework. Perfect place for outside dining when the weather is nice.

name: Tom Gauthier
text: Hot chocolate was good. Didn't really taste the mint shot I got, but I might have a tolerance for it.

name: Heather Ingram Ortiz
text: Such a cool and delicious place to be while at the lake. The outdoor seating is my favorite. The coffee is outstanding!

name: Peg Harloff
text: Customers could move their things off of chairs so more could use counter. Food & coffee great.

name: Evan Knapp
text: Great coffee shop with great architecture and style but most importantly great coffee. The shop has a great view since it is on the lakefront. Great in the summer when you can sit inside.  The only issue is that since it is so popular it is often crowded and hard to find available seating.

name: Martin Haseman
text: Healthy and great taste...

name: Catie O'Donnell
text: Wonderful coffee in a charming historic building with a view of Lake Michigan. You can not ask for a better place to grab something to drink or a snack and enjoy a truly Milwaukee moment.

name: David Huwiler
text: I am amending my five-star review from some time ago.  The place has changed.  This evening I dropped in after the theater with my wife and 8 year old.  We walked in the door at 9:50 and received our food and coffee at 9:55.  No sooner had we sat down to eat than the manager announced that the place was closed.  He then walked over to our table and said, rudely, "Unfortunately you must leave now."  So this cafe will serve customers their food and drinks, say nothing about imminent closing, and then send them into the parking lot with their food and beverages.  I still can't believe what happened.  I can only say that Colectivo needs to do a much better job of training their managerial staff.

name: Jay H
text: Great coffee, and it has a nice outdoor patio and garden

name: Michael Wagner
text: Nice terrace but prices are pretty steep for a coffee or sandwich

name: Mike Niznikiewicz
text: Great feel and vibe. Could work here forever and it's a great place to chill. The coffee is great but I've also had better, so it doesn't get 5 stars. They have solid food, though! Would totally recommend - and they're rightfully a Milwaukee staple.

name: Dave Shapiro
text: Colectivo is one of the three popular coffee chains in Milwaukee. Like the other two, they grind and mix to order. This location is just excellent. The view is great, it is convenient to the Lake and (weather permitting), it has possibly one of the nicest outdoor areas available. Everything is handicap accessible. There is parking available but on weekends - you might have to walk a ways.

name: karl vogt
text: Atmosphere super service great and coffee good

name: Scott Hendrix
text: I gave it 3 stars, but I'm not the target demographic.  The coffee and food is good,  but you have pay extra for the hipster tax. The building is interesting, but the odd design means there's not enough seating so make sure to check and see if there's an open spot before ordering.  Terrible place to sit, sip coffee,  and work or read. Good place to people watch.

name: suriyaprabu vijayaprabu
text: Great food and coffee. More of a college cafe.

name: Raymon Exum
text: Very nice place. Set up well. Good selection. Outside was decorated perfectly for the season. Clean.

name: Vedran
text: Friendly place where you can feel relaxed. Espresso is really good!

name: Al Timm
text: Coffee good, great to sit outside in the shade. Tables could be kept cleaner (bird droppings) by staff assigned to outside maintenance of tables, trash and ground.

name: Katie Steil Ryan
text: Busy, but for good reason. Line goes fast. Great coffee, food and ambiance

name: Sean Kramer
text:
I ordered a cinnamon roll.

I've been to Colectivo before, and really enjoyed it.  This trip was no different.  Despite rolling in ten minutes before close the staff were super nice to my friends and I, and were exceptionally polite when letting us know that they'd be closing.  My cinnamon roll was delicious, although I'm docking a star because I asked them to warm it up.  They did so, but then placed the cinnamon roll into a paper bag, with warm icing...

I could see why they'd do this if the order was to go, but I ordered in.  I'm assuming it was just a slip up due to it being late, and chose not to say anything.

Overall the staff are awesome, the food is great, and the prices are pretty competitive!  I would recommend this to anyone looking for some good bakery, or caffeinated beverages on the lake front.

name: Jaymiee Terry
text: I came here the other day with my aunt , and the attitude of the man who served us was awful , my aunt asked a few questions about their different pastries and other food and he could not answer one question, just stared ! I get it’s tough times right now ! But not being polite isn’t helping anyone either ! Will not be coming back to this location again

name: Russ
text: The one barista looked like Gary Busey.

name: James Cadwallader
text: A super impressive facility, and a wonderful preservation of a Milwaukee landmark and history piece. The old pumping plant makes this coffee shop part museum! It's a real experience, and a must-see.

name: Laura Remy
text: I absolutely love this coffee shop! The line was long, but they were very efficient. Nice outdoor seating area that is dog friendly.

name: Brandon Martin
text: A little girl was very rude at the register

name: Kris Hillis
text: Great smell of fresh coffee.

name: Toni Berning
text: Great location. Always wonderfully senic, though often pretty crowded in the evenings.

name: Ben Nelson
text: Great place to hang out and do some work on your laptop or to meet a date.  It's built in an old public utility building but its a clever use of space and in a great location

name: Tony Berger
text: The beer is decent and the lake is always a nice break

name: Oleksiy Lysenko
text: Good coffee, good brownie, great view.

name: Lore Lisheron
text: Too crowded! No outdoor service, few people wearing masks. We did not stay.

name: Justin Anderson
text: The drinks are always as ordered and the food varies so you don't always have the same boring choices. It is in a good location near the lakefront and in a nice historic building. It can be cramped at times, but if you go in summer you can easily leave for more space while staying close if you need more food or drinks.

name: Carmen Baumler
text: Great atmosphere!  Comfortable.  I like it!

name: Bridget H
text: This is an awesome place. I wish I lived closer, I would be going there often. Lots of coffee varieties and lots of snacks and baked goods to choose from. I saw lots of people there doing stuff on their laptops so I assume electrical outlets and Wi-Fi are available. Has outdoor tables as well. Located right across the street from Lake Michigan.

name: Ray Yanda
text: Historic building (old water pumping station) with seating on different levels. Outdoor seating is great on Lake Shore Drive. Romantic lighting at night. Great coffee. Great employees.

name: John Draper
text: Great location, nice outdoor seating as well as inside. Friendly service. And a fine apple, mango, ginger smoothie.

name: Chi Nguyen
text: Best coffee shop so far! I enjoy working on my computer outside. So productive. Great vibe!

name: Rafal Stefaniak
text: Busy, but staff manages to keep the lines to minimum. Variety of coffees to choose from. Make sure to read the menu if you're trying new flavors.

name: Stephen Hess
text: Great coffee. Great pastries. Nice indoor and outdoor seating.  The Parking is terrible but I'll put up with it in light of everything else!

name: Robert McKinney
text: I really like this Collectivo, but there is never any parking or a place to sit.  People generally don’t flip tables very quickly.  A great place if you are just in and out for coffee.

name: Daniel Burkholder
text: Wonderful, but often really crowded.

name: Amanda Ybarra
text: The coffee is amazing and the atmosphere is very relaxed. It is busy in the summer but it's worth the lake views.

name: Hannah L
text: My favorite chai! They have such cute merch too

name: Kira Hagquist
text: Try the fried chicken sandwich!!! The breading has a lot of unique flavor, as do each of the ingredients.

name: Steven White
text: Always a great vibe, beautiful & unique location with a story. And they even serve thier own beer now!

name: Paul Polewaczyk
text: Nice like all other Colectivo's and they've done well with the patio. They serve beer here as well.  A nice thing for sitting outside.

name: Elisa Richter
text: Nice place to stay, the prices are ok. The tables should be wiped from time to time.

name: Tyler Jerome
text: I hadn't heard of Colectivo before and decided to stop while visiting a friend. The coffee was delicious and the inside of the building has a really cool design. Great place to grab a coffee and a pastry!

name: Lynn Bauer
text: Trendy coffee shop on Milwaukee's Lakefront.  Got 1 of 2 empty parking spaces, so stopped for lunch.  Years ago, they had great salads, but volume of diners has eliminated that.  Ordered a curried chicken wrap which came with chips.  As tables were full outside, dined indoors and enjoyed a hot Chai latte with the wrap.

name: Aaron Hartwig
text: Great coffee shop with an even better view. Beware coming to this location in the morning/early afternoon on the weekends - it gets incredibly busy. During winter seating can be hard to come by since the outdoor area is closed down.

name: Hoffmann Management
text: I love this place!  Fast service, excellent coffee and tea.  Very lively location.

name: Jennifer Haumschild
text: Can be a long line and crowded, but in a cool historic old pump house.  Take a look around, it's pretty neat!

name: RAFAEL EDUARDO HIDALGO SALGUERO
text: Great Hispanic Music on Thursdays and Best Tropical Pops, Popsicle's

name: Danae Fuller
text: Fun place to get coffee. Came at peak time and was able to be served quickly. Baked goods and coffee were great!

name: k keith
text: Bathrooms closed, ugh.

name: Beth Graham
text: Location is key! A view of the marina and lake from the outdoor gravel patio makes enjoying an iced or hot coffee hard to beat.  The menu has a large variety of options: my favorites are the breakfast burrito, green smoothie with sportea, and the avocado BLT!  Occasionally the lines can be quite crowded whether it's on a weekend morning when there's a lot of activity downtown, or a race day.  Building is a historic pump house!

name: Paul Hauer
text: Loved it! They were so helpful. I biked there with a friend and it was going to rain, so they gave me a Ziploc to keep my phone dry on the ride back.

name: Katozlato2 M
text: Relax with family, while enjoying a latte and delicious baked oatmeal! It doesn't get any better than this!

name: Mark Wolff
text: Long line. 15+min wait for espresso drinks. Hmm

name: SoranTheSky
text: Cool little place to hang out with great drinks.

name: Justin Borchardt
text:
Be forewarned I am a coffee snob :) Fantastic building and cool location. The coffee is good sandwiches are top notch. My  quams are q
1) for a decent roaster they take a fast approach to coffee. I prefer a good V60 or Lalita wave but no pour over brew methods available and the place is always packed to the max. I have visited several times and seasons. I suggest visiting on a nice summer night. Great lakefront to walk and beautiful outdoor seating.

name: Aime Hruby
text: Amazing historic lakeside location, delicious food and coffee. Try the cucumber dill cream cheese if you get a chance!

name: Angela R
text: This place is always busy but it's so nice to be by the lake and explore this multi level historic building, grab a snack coffee or lunch and take a walk to the lake front. It's nice to make a coffee shop into a "event" take a couple hours out of the day to relax!

name: Dean Milinski
text: Hands down a great and relaxing time.  The clientele was quite eclectic and added to the experience.

name: Meagon Ortiz
text: I LOVE this place! I usually go during the summer and it gets crazy busy but the staff remains friendly and extremely efficient. The product I receive is always top-notch. Great job colectivo!

name: Chetaan Shedjale
text: Great place for a coffee and walk on lake front ..always packed though

name: Linda Pozen
text: My absolute favorite one of all the Colectivo locations. There's usually always a line, sometimes one that stretches almost back out the door, but it's very worth the wait because of the amazing location both in the building and right on the lakefront outside. I highly recommend this spot to anyone looking for a nice place to grab coffee and lunch!

name: Timothy Salamon
text: They have some of the best coffee in the Milwaukee area.

name: Jo anne Kim
text: Great place, spacious and great staff

name: Austin Hartline
text:
It's always super busy when people want coffee, but I forgive this location because it's been the best since they opened. I don't know if collectivo would be what it is today if not for this location, and it's for a reason.

Good views, historical building context, great atmosphere.

My favorite is the mango ginger peach smoothie and I've probably tried to replicate it several dozen times with a magic bullet. Never comes out just like theirs. Someday, I'll steal the recipe.

name: Stephanie Martin
text: Collectivo on the lake is one of the most popular coffee shops in town because of its proximity to the lakefront (duh) and lots of associated parks and pedestrian activity. Parking on site is limited, but the marina parking across the street is free for up to two hours before 10 pm. If you're coming here during a peak time, do be prepared and patient, as the lines will get long.

name: Biggicus Weebimus
text: Possibly one of the best coffee shops in MKE.

name: Baudry Metangmo
text: Busy place yet very friendly. A great atmosphere of fun and community. Awesome coffee living up to the expectations...

name: dennis lemahieu
text: Coffee with a view and people watching free.parking lot but always crowded place as should be love this place

name: Teresa Bornheimer
text: Coffee way to hot.  But great service.

name: KB Raif MD
text: Park you can get some coffee and sit on the patio or go for a stroll on the lake front.  Cappuccino was perfect.

name: Lyndzi Miller
text: Usually super busy, but when you catch it at the right moment, you can enjoy a seat outside in the sun overlooking the lake and it is so incredibly lovely. Great place for coffee dates and meet ups.

name: sara devecchis
text: Beautiful location on the lake. A good amount of outdoor seating and nice food options. It does get quite busy here on the weekends though

name: Shaun Booth
text: The best place for a first tinder or bumble date. If things go well Brady street is right around the corner for drinks.

name: Jonathan Robinson
text: Excellent staff! Try a mocha made with oat milk. You will be glad you did.

name: Elizabeth Nonya
text:
Love this place- literally met my fiance there.
Usually meet there to go for a run then grab coffee after. They are always busy, so don't be disappointed if you don't get a table inside. Go when they open the patio so you're able to get a table. Sorry to all the baristas that have to deal with us smelly runners post run! I really like the Italian sodas, smoothies and Americanos. Wish they would ditch the plastic straws, I feel it would suit the company to bring that to Milwaukee.

name: Jake Wilson
text: Best place in Milwaukee to grab some coffee. The location is what makes it the best, but Colectivo has the best food for a coffee shop. Unfortunately I'm not a huge fan of their coffee.

name: Ghostii
text: It was a super nice area, and had lots of cool food

name: Leeann
text: Great coffee..seen a great band..S.C.O.T.S

name: Cori Brody
text: Love their coffee and ambiance

name: Vladimir Simić
text: Good coffee and snacks, great outdoor seating.

name: Michael Goodness
text: One of the very best possible locations for a coffee shop, right down on Milwaukee's lakefront. Plenty of seating inside and out. Beautifully remodeled, and still a working pump house!

name: Bill Kilbey
text: I wish they asked you whether you wanted your coffee to go or to stay because I would prefer to have it in a ceramic coffee mug. Great coffee and great food.

name: Sandy Sloan
text: Beatiful lake front area.

name: Sam d

name: Sherry Gac
text: Love going here. Very ecclectate. Great coffee. Still liked the old name better! Food very good, too, along with a historical building setting and a nice lakefront view.

name: Codie Vassar
text: Beautiful outdoor patio, friendly service, and summer beer garden!

name: Snigdha K
text: Large got to be large..not medium..but good coffee

name: Ana Charlene Rex
text: Very nice place! Ideal for meeting a friend for grabbing a coffee or hot chocolate. Their berry muffin is very good also.

name: Jeff Hughes
text: Fantastic setting—easily one of the best locations and ambiance in WI. Coffee is what your expect from a Colectivo.

name: William Fale
text: My favorite coffee place in Milwaukee - when parkibg us available.  Live sitting outside

name: Harry Madorin
text: Great coffee house for all three squares

name: Alex Francis
text: My favorite coffee spot in the city.

name: Mike Clancy
text: Great setting, live the Thursday night salsa evening

name: Konrad Von Hochstaden

Neat old pumphouse by the lake. Take a look at the old pumping equipment while you are there. Small portions of food do what you pay but ingredients are great and promptly served.

No refills on iced tea... really?!

name: Deborous Patterson jr
text: Very accommodating for the disabled and super yummy tea.

name: Alan Wysocki
text: Very cozy, neat atmosphere, great food, outstanding service!

name: Susie Scott
text: I love this location by the lakefront.  It's always busy and limited parking, but the patio is worth it.

name: Brian O'Regan
text: Great coffee and bakery within a very inviting atmosphere. One of Milwaukee’s best coffee shops.

name: Claudine Lienau
text: Great location, but it's always really busy. Excellent and fast service!

name: Brittany Lash
text: Very cool location. Busy at peak times, but the line moved fast. Awesome that they refurbished the interior of a processing building. Would definitely come back!

name: Daniel Tuchscherer
text: Bathrooms were trashed! Decent food.

name: Laura Narten
text: I decided to drive from Greendale to the Lakefront Colectivo to take a nice walk & have my favorite coffee with my dog. On my drive  it was getting warmer& I realized I couldn't leave my dog in the car to get my coffee. Should I ask someone going in to purchase it for me ? I pull up and notice that the park & patio were not full. I parked right in front of the back entrance. I called Colectivo explain I right in the back , I have a dog I can't leave In the car , I have cash could someone run out with a small mocha ? A few seconds went by &  Micheal said no he could not do that. I said you can't take a couple seconds to run a mocha out the back I have cash. And I would have gladly given extra. Micheal laughed & said he had a lot of other things to do. I said ok have a great day, he wished me the same. So I take my dog ,water & a warm Starbucks refresher drink  & go on my walk. Come back , get in the car & notice a Colectivo employee delivering food to people on the patio. What did I do wrong???

text:
Free wifi... Until noon. Umm, okay? I suppose, it keeps out the mooches, but that is kinda silly if you ask me. That's the downgrade.

The atmosphere is pretty awesome, as many have stated. Plenty of nooks and crannies to find an huddle up in. Whether you plan to be there alone, or with a few people, there are plenty of seating options. Oh, and that is just the inside. With the outside patio, there is even more fun to be had.

I enjoy the Malasa Chai, hot - because that is the way to enjoy a good tea.

Looking for a good local coffee shop, stop on down. They also sport fair trade coffee and tea, maybe more some of the larger chains can pick up on that...

name: Greg Dieter
text: Great service, fun packaging for coffee beans, great atmosphere, great breakfast sandwiches. The packaging for the coffee beans are so much fun and then enticing to buy; we really like the Cherry coffee beans with the unicorn on it. We like the brioche bread on the breakfast sandwich it's a really great decision and it pulls it all together that you wouldn't normally find at another coffee shop.

name: Christian Herbst
text:
I visited on grand opening day, excited to have a better local option to the shopworn  coffee chain 2 blocks away.

Service here was good, coffee was very good, and my breakfast was too.  Staff was personable.   The store and outdoor patio are very well designed and comfortable.  There is also a walk up window at the sidewalk that was very popular.
