name: Joseph Carey
text:
A cute coffee shop with well implemented covid precautions, outdoor seating may be a problem come winter though!

Great waffle, not sure what they used in the battery but it was a sweet waffle even without syrup. I just wish for $7.50 there was more of it!

name: eric k
text: I frequent this coffee shop just about everyday and they are always friendly will continue to come here

name: Bethany Blount
text: The food is on the expensive side for what you get. The coffee and tea are delicious with a wide variety of options. Stone Creek always has rotating syrup flavors to match what's in season; these are worth a try. My personal favorite speciality item is the Cream City Ice!!

name: Patrick Chaves
text: Lovely atmosphere and architecture.  Delicious food menu and coffee. Great customer service. Only down fall is how packed it always is and that makes it hard to find seating. I loved it when they had the Costa Rican breakfast sandwich,  but they changed their menu. Other food items I had were the yogurt, waffles, almond croissants,  and other breakfast sandwiches; all were flavorful. Just a tad bit pricey for the portions.

name: Crash Crawford
text: Cozy, modern, excellent friendly personal service, and a damn fine cup o' coffee!

name: Joe Smith
text: Visited Stone Creek today, and as a Downer resident, I will no longer be going to Starbucks. Food was amazing, pictured are the gruyere ham and egg waffle, and the blackbean sandwhich. The space is beautiful, and the patio is amazing as well, however, it seems a bit chaotic when ordering inside, seems as though there is no direction of where to go or where to wait, and also our food was dropped off separately with a few minute gap between. I'm sure these things will be ironed out, but regardless, highly recommend! :)

name: Cameron Kollath
text:
I've been here a few times now, and it's such a great coffee shop! Friendly staff, drinks are well made, the interior and exterior architecture is perfect, and the food is delicious.

The berries and granola is seriously so good. I could eat it all day.

It can be a little busy so grab the first seat you can get your hands on!

name: Cyndi Kramer
text: I love this place!  It's so easy for coffee shops, especially near universities, to become super precious hipster dens and this one has NOT.  Friendly and welcoming staff and a relaxing atmosphere.  As someone who drinks ice tea rather than coffee, I appreciate the year round availability of some truly delicious tea (I highly recommend the peach).  Oh, and really good music.

name: Samantha Lobo
text: I love this place.  Great ambiance in the winter months and in the warmer months the patio is great! I love their coffee and dark chocolate covered waffles!

name: Eric Ewing
text: FANTASTIC coffee! My friend and I had the cortado and it was great! Would definitely come back here.

name: John M Peterson
text: Good coffee and pastry. Nice outdoor space. Not currently seating inside.

name: Shoua Vang
text: Great interior, amazing friendly staff, beautiful art latte and peaceful vibe.

name: keegan howe
text: Wonderful location, plenty of outdoor seating that's shaded. Place gives off good vibes.

name: Holly Asbach
text: Love this new location of Stone Creek Coffee on Downer! The outdoor space is beautiful and has lots of seating available! There is lots of free parking within the neighborhood and this Stone Creek even has a cute outdoor “to go” counter where you can order your drink right away without having to go inside. Love the little recombobulation area sign outside since it is so true to the MKE airport! ☕️

name: Lee Ann Torres
text: Perfect coffee, great vibe, friendly service. I love the outdoor seating! As for the menu, it  includes interesting, appetizing,  delicious, and  healthful options. One of my favorites is the Avocado Spicy Egg Sandwich. I'm anxious to try the House made Yogurt Bowls. In particular the  Lemon, Rose, Pistachio Bowl and the Acai Smoothie Bowl. I should mention that there is also a very nice selection of sweets to go with the coffee such as waffles, pastries, and cookies. I'm guessing you'll be as pleased with this shop as I am!

name: John Wojner
text:
This place is great. The staff, food, and drinks are always superb. My fav food item is the "avocado and toasted chic pea". I normally get that and a fruit tray for breakfast.

This place is made for getting work done. They have several good seating areas. They have plenty of seating options including indoor, outdoor, high-top, small and big tables, and even a couch with tables in front of it! Lots of chargers too so no worries there.

I highly recommend this location - I sometimes work from 6am-5pm and noone has bothered me about it yet.

name: Sara Carse
text: Great atmosphere, friendly staff, and excellent coffee and food

name: Travis Sternhagen
text: Praise be to God for providing our City with this location of Stone Creek Coffee. For years I have been wishing for a solid coffee shop with spectacular work space on the East Side and finally my cries have been heard. Fantastic staff! Karen the store manager is one of the nicest people in the city. The coffee is always spot on, the food is delicious, and the environment is perfect for getting some work done! I’ve practically lived here since it opened and I couldn’t be happier that they opened this location.

name: Lee Ann Medina
text: I can get Iced tea without sugar...many places they sugar it up before you get it.

text: I've been in Milwaukee now two years, and there is a pretty fierce debate about who had the best coffee- Anodyne, Valentine, Collectivo- and all of the above are indeed fantastic. That being said- Stone Creek has and always will be my first choice- I discovered Radio Milwaukee before my move- and you can't listen for long without hearing about Stone Creek so admittedly I was excited to try it before even moving here. Man, I was not disappointed. Their passion and emphasis on the science behind the perfect cup, does indeed show in their flavors. They have a friendly and eclectic staff- and for the non coffee drinkers they have a great selection of local wine and beer. AND NOW THEY HAVE A CAFE! I'm lucky to be within a quick bike ride to the cafe on Downer- and I could not be more excited it's in my neighborhood! It's truly a gorgeous space with plenty of indoor/outdoor space to suit anyone's desires. ALSO THERE IS A WALK UP COFFEE WINDOW- can this get any better?? Pretty much because they have delicious food now! I would have posted a photo of my breakfast sandwich but it didn't last very long- All in all- 10/10. I'm drinking the cold brew koolaid.

text: What's even better than Stone Creek Coffee?   A new Stone Creek Coffee that opened one block from my girlfriend's house.  And has food.  Two large rooms with perhaps two dozen tables total of various sizes and a small bar at the window looking out over Downer.  (Where a bike race was zooming by on the June 30 morning I was there.)  Many of the chairs are a bit low for the table height.  There's a large patio with tables too.   Lots of outlets.  Wi-Fi with same password as other Stone Creek locations. Didn't notice the audio.  They have (like the other Stone Creek locations) a small select of good quality loose leaf teas, though their loose leaf chai is a "chocolate chai" I don't think much of.  They chai lattes are from the Chai Company, and are too sweet, but less bad than some.  Magnificent array of pastries and, at this location now, a small menu of breakfast and lunch things.  The lemon pistachio yogurt is amazing.

Im truck driver of 18 years..company i worked for closed 7 weeks ago..so last week i was hired at a new company...i not gonna get my first check til friday may 31st...anyways stopped at petro in sturtevant wi toda..sunday may 26th at 6pm..very very hungry..first of all very hard to do this..i go to the restaurant..a lady at the cashier station there..cynthia was her name..i asked..after explained my situation..if anyway msybe she could feed me..i said i will be traveling through her every week and be willing to pay back on friday the 31st..she said NO! ONLY GENERAL MANAGER  can allow that.....i guess then ftom the goodness of her heart..maybe she could have said sir..i personally will buy you something to eat..last time i eat was Saturday at 8am..2 eggs and 1 slice of toast a man pay for me...ITS OKIE CYNTHIA..YOU OR THE PETRO OWE ME NOTHING...So i go down the road to LOVES TRAVEL CENTER....I was allowed anything to eat...i got myself 2 hotdogs...2 for 3.33..thank you loves travel center from racine Wisconsin...
Last year i spend most of the times fueling at ta,s and petros...this company allows me to fuel any place i desire..do loves..i will do my business with your company from here on out....

text: What a shame what has become of this place. Understaffed, filthy restrooms, and the cook could use some help to keep up with orders. Put a couple specialty dishes on the menu and make sure your cooks have the means to make them well.

name: Captain Cash
text: Huge & clean parking lot for trucks. Their space fits 280 trucks. Well maintained parking with full bright lights. Their food was ok, staff aren’t friendly & the customer service was below average. This is probably the only truck stop in the country where you find TV in the bathroom 🤔

We are long distance truck drivers as a team. Stopped for their Thanksgiving Buffet,  it was good and hot, but service was not good, and the price of the buffet was much higher then their normal buffets.  And for the higher price no pie was included and drinks were extra..
Not at all happy!! Had to wait for them to clean silverware so we could eat..

name: Michael M
text: Everyone knocking this place, I don't get it. I've never had any problems there. Most Petro/TA restaurants aren't open 24hrs anymore, so I don't see the big deal in complaining. Never had any problems at the fuel islands or their restrooms or their showers. Yeah, it's old, stop crying about it. Best place for me to stop when I'm coming thru.

text:
WOW! Horrible service, Decent Establishment, but My God, HORRIBLE Customer service! This observation comes from Multiple Experiences here, as well as working at the gas station next to it, and getting to hear everybody's thoughts on the place.
The Female Proto Plasm working behind the counter this morning (4-8-19) was particularly Snide, Rude, and Unhelpful. As the Only Person most people will encounter getting gas here, *You Are The Face of the Company!* You're Attitude lady, and your Behavior towards Customers screams this Company only cares about collecting you're money, and then be gone the way you Came!
If you can, there are several other Large Truck stops along I94, within close proximity. Do you're self a favor, go support them, or one of the Numorous small town gas stations near by. They deserve it more than this place does...

name: Andy Sirianni
text: The Miller tour is a top notch experience. We got to try multiple good beers.  Our tour guide was Nate, and her really new his stuff.  The your was about 90 minutes, but I would expect it could go close to 2 hours if your group asked many questions.    Cost was reasonable and you get a glass.   $5 for instate IDs and $10 for out of state.

name: Fred G
text: Definitely worth the stop if you're in Milwaukee. Super cool to see how one of the biggest breweries in the country operate. The tour was a little over an hour, and worth the $10 admission fee.

text: Enjoyed the tour! Got in on the last tour of the day  at the last minute. Tour guide was enthusiastic and shared a lot of great info.

text: i’ve lived in MKE nearly my entire life but never took this tour. such a fun afternoon. great guide, fantastic caves, and beer! 🍺

name: Matt Mauer
text:
This tour was amazing and I definitely would do it again! For only $10 you got an amazing tour, several beers, a glass, and a token for a free drink at a local restaurant.
This place is really cool and has a good amount of history to it. Even if you are not a beer drinker, it's definitely worth it! Especially since you get 2 stops that offer soda to the non drinkers.

name: Greg Martin
text: Been here quite a few times. Tour guides are always friendly an knowledgable.  Each time we've taken tours the guides answer questions and add a great time to the experience. Great time sampling in the beer garden this trip.

name: Rachel Odolski
text: So this was my first Macro brewery tour and it was amazing. The tour was informative with a short video and beer sample in the begining, nice walk and another beer sample in the caves, then we went to have a small break in the taproom with a beer of course. The guide was always sharing fun puns, history, and making us all feel like Wisconsinites. Seeing Summer Shanty going into their cases was just the thing to get me ready for summer. The second half of the tour included some serious stairs and more beer, duh. 10/10 would reccomend. Highly reccomend if you are visiting Milwaukee for the first time!

name: Aaron Barber
text: Very educational and fun. Had an opportunity to enjoy many beers and take in the scenery. Staff are friendly and knowledgeable.

name: Emily Anderson
text: Okay free tour. There is a decent amount of walking outside. Good history notes. Free samples at the end.

name: Tyler Devan
text: Overall it's an alright brewery tour. You don't really get to go on the production line floor and most of what they show you is videos. Doesn't really have any personality or any interesting experiences built in like other tours.

name: Charles Strohbach
text: If you never been on a brewery tour before this is a great one to start with. Give you a great overview of how things work. Unfortunately you are always kept at a distance from what is going on and while they do a great job with covering most areas they fail to go into much detail. The tasting room at the end I find to be wonderful. Perhaps the best part of the tour. Ample parking and open most days. Does require some outdoors walking and quiet a few stairs, but overall it's a great way to spend an afternoon.

name: Brian Bayer
text: Interesting tour with beer samples at the end. The chocolate lager seasonal beer is good.

name: John Chatfield
text: Nice to be able to sample a variety of beers and see where they are made and hear a bit of history of the company for a very reasonable price. The tour could be better laid out. There was a lot of walking back and forth, covering the same ground

name: Karen Wyngaard
text: Hannah and Brian were awesome guides. Great tour.

name: Anne Kowal
text: Wonderful Christmas light show!

name: Don Samuel
text: Experience was a good 1

name: Rey Del Valle
text: It is still closed, hopefully it opens soon.

name: Dana Davidson
text: A must if visiting Milwaukee. We've done many brewery tours and although this was not our favorite, it was definitely worth doing. You almost feel as though you're entering a little city when you drive into the brewery.  You do have to watch a super cheesy video before the tour but it ends in free samples so that is worth it!

name: Phillis Coleman
text: The staff is extremely knowledgeable. Its also a great learning experience for kids of all ages. And with the free samples of all you can eat pretzels and limited free beer you can't lose

name: Kids Clemente
text: Nice tour free kid friendly and informative.

name: Caleb Sanders
text: A great tour with a well-made introduction/history video. Amazing capacity of brewing goes on here. Great souvenir shop.

name: Cassie Lemar
text: A great way to spend a couple of hours! Lots of historical information, beer samples and a great keepsake glass to take home! Not bad for $10!

name: Janelle Winter
text: Great tour for the money. You get four samples of beer along the way, which helps break up the 80 minute tour. You get to see the brewery, tanks, inn, and caves! A little outdoor walking and some stairs, but overall nice tour.

name: Bryce Caster
text: It's hard to criticize a free tour that gives you free beer, but the projector was broken so I didn't get to hear any of the history of the brewery. Also, due to the size of the tour, it felt rushed and was not as in-depth as I would have liked. My favorite part was the cave and the packaging facility.

name: Mary Words
text: I love taking my grand children to this event. This was our 4th year attending the Holiday Lights. The grands enjoy coming too.

name: Bill Cornett

name: Mike Peterson
text: Went for the holiday light tour. Really a great event that my wife and I go to every year!

name: Kirk Kapla
text: Lots of fun. The history is well worth the visit. Go if your in the area.

name: Cory Norton

name: Dohv Kahn
text: Definitely a must see if you are in Milwaukee. The brewery tour is amazing. Everything very well explained very hands on and the samples are great and not a tiny amount given for each sample. Give yourself extra time to come and look around. The gift shop has a lot to offer as well. The staff is super friendly and helpful again definitely a must

name: Jonathan Wickham
text: With any big city, I always appreciate when there is ample free parking. The Miller tour had both. I also appreciated that the tour itself was free and included samples. In total, the tour + tasting is about an hour long. You get to see some of the operations but not a lot (for obvious health, safety, and privacy reasons). If you're in the area, this is a must do.

name: Heath Vankooy
text: Nice tour. Learned a lot

name: John Morrell

name: Jennifer McNeil

name: Quinten Hoogenboom

Miller has the benefit of being a long-standing company, and has the old buildings and caves to show for it, but beyond that, the tour was sort of flat.

name: lauren eagle
text: Cool your. Highly enjoyed

name: glynn isoda

name: charlie reitz

name: Tom Seaworth

name: Barbara Williams
text: Wonderful tour not too long...just the highlights with 3 or 4 beer samples

name: Chris Smyczek
text: For a free tour this is great, especially for out-of-towners who know the brand but not the history. Mostly shown packaging and shipping, which is a major part of this second largest facility for Miller (sorry for the spoiler). At the end you get to sample some brews, and we sat with folks from Florida and Colombia - shows the brand reaches far, and everyone loves free beer!

name: Thomas
text:
Pros:  FREE tour and free samples at the end were great.  Touring the cellar was my favorite part of the tour as well as learning about the history of Miller in Milwaukee.

Cons:  This tour feel very corporate and lacks authenticity as you will find in other tours.  Guides were college kids versus beer enthusiasts you may find elsewhere.

Recommend this tour at the end of the day.

name: Kathy Coopman
text: Our tour guide Samantha did an absolutely wonderful job. Was a very nice tour. Learned a lot about my favorite beer.

name: Liam Bates
text: Considering that it's free and that you get free beer this is definitely worth a visit. We were given 3 small beers for free and a bag of pretzels each. They also give you free postcards to mail out with postage paid for!

name: Patrick David

name: andrea z

name: Christina R

text: Always prompt and professional. 3 lanes for check in and 2 for out. Shut down your truck, push the intercom button to speak. Say your p/up #, trailer#, your name and phone #. Your good to go....pull out , adjust your axles, close doors, drive up to check out shack. Verify p/up, BOLs, seal #. Sign and date, initial. Apply seal. On the road again....put that song and safe trip.

text: Probably my favorite restaurant in Milwaukee county. Everyone has to try it! I have never been disappointed! I've been here many times, and I've gotten take out a few times too. name: ragslittlebut mscuty
text: The food is always good. This location is always packed and rightfully so. The service is good, the food is amazing, and a place called mad rooster just seems like somewhere friendly. I got some banana pecan waffles with fries. Everything was good. Not to mention ordering and waiting 15 minutes for pick up which is not bad for a big order. I came a few times with my family. My mom had a omelet, Red potatoes, and a waffle.

resp.text:
Good morning,
Thank you so much for your visit and for taking some of your precious time to write such an amazing review for us. Stay safe and we'll see you soon!

name: Paul Dziadulewicz
text: Very crowded. My wife, daughter and I were seated promptly. The waitress went out of her way for us. Portions were large and reasonably priced. Great breakfast place and always a place we come back to.

resp.text:
Good morning Paul,
On behalf of the Mad Rooster's teams we would like to thank you for your review, the five stars and most importantly for your visit to our cafe! Have a great day and see you soon!

name: Maddie P
text: Excellent food. Excellent menu! Prices are about right for the quality of food. Atmosphere is busy and a bit noisy but thats because people love this place. We got seated right away. Employees are following CDC guidelines by wearing mask. Though seating is not. Everyone is seated close to one another. Overall I look forward to going back.

resp.text:
Hello Maddie,
Thank you very much for your review and for the five star rating! Hope to see you soon and stay safe!

name: Ana Aleman
text: Food was amazing!!! But I definitely feel like there should be a capacity restriction on this place. It was nearly overflowing. If you are someone scared to go out because of COVID-19 then this isn't the place for you.

name: Mary Meyer
text: Met my sister and niece for lunch and the menu has something for everyone. I am eating more plant-based lately and had the tomato basil soup and the superfood side. Both were delicious! My sister had the chop chop salad with chicken and niece had avocado toast...everyone was happy! Excellent service and clean environment too. Highly recommend!

name: Naturally Exquisite
text: The best chicken and waffles I've have in a while.  They sell a very interesting Bloody Mary. It comes with bacon, a deviled egg, shrimp and lots more additions. Delicious and did I mention VERY spicy.  Excellent service from my waitress as well. Great food.

resp.text:
Good evening,
Thank you very much for your visit to Mad Rooster Café and for such a great review. Stay safe and enjoy the rest of your week!

name: Scott McMillan
text: Absolutely amazing food as usual. Social distancing was very well set up even though it cost them almost half their capacity. Waitress was very helpful and friendly. Only drawback is a long wait but that is ameliorated by being text messaged when your table is ready so you don't need to stick around.

resp.text:
Good afternoon Scott McMillan,
We can not thank you enough for the amazing review! We really appreciate the support in these difficult and dark times. Please, stay safe and we hope to see you soon!

name: Brandon Cox
text: Good food & reasonably priced. Usually the service is fine. I’ve been a loyal patron of this establishment for years. Around 10 times a year since 2014. Today I was so disappointed in the service I received. Due to COVID-19, you are not allowed to wait inside. It’s winter, which means: wait in your car. We received a text stating we were to be seated next. In the 3-minutes from receiving the text, walking around their parking lot, to then reporting to the host...they pushed our reservation. We were then told we could be added to the end of the list... a 1-hour wait time. The host was very rude and uncompromising. Unreal experience. Not likely to recommend or patronize this restaurant moving forward. Blues Egg or Hollanders.

resp.text:
Good afternoon Brandon Cox,

On behalf of the Mad Rooster team we would like to thank you for your visit, for sharing your feedback ,and offer you an apology. Most importantly, we understand what you described on your review is very upsetting, specially in these dark and difficult times. Your comments have been discussed at the length with the responsible teams to ensure our café maintains its high standards and such matters will be addressed promptly.
Also, we would like to invite you back in hopes we can provide you with the real Mad Rooster experience. If possible, please contact our General Manager, his name is Alan at almroostercafe@gmail.com to speak furthermore about what happened on your last visit. Once again, we are genuinely sorry and look forward to speaking with you. Stay safe and have a wonderful rest of your week.

name: Jay Allen
text:
Good prices, very good food. Coffee is above average. Service was attentive.

Breakfast burrito and tacos were great. Breakfast potatoes were fairly plain. Sweet potato fries were good.

Large portions!

Atmosphere is pretty meh. Not sure if it was construction or what but there seemed to be industrial noises the entire time we were eating. Had to nearly yell to hear the person across from you at the table.

resp.text:
Good afternoon Jay Allen,
On behalf of the Mad Rooster team, we would like to thank you for the amazing review and the 4 stars. Also, we would like to thank you for bringing this to our attention and we’ll strive to do better on your next visit. Have a great rest of your week.

name: Delbert Williams II
text: Always a good experience when i visit. Great food and atmosphere. They doing a good job no matter how busy they are and staff is excellent.

name: John Contreras
text: I love going to Mad Rooster. The staff is always so friendly and helpful. The food is great, especially their breakfasts. Highly recommend

name: maria Farsee
text: Well. Our waitress was very nice . A lot of people like it for the family vibe. The food was good, could  be a little better though. Good place so far.

name: Matt H
text: So consistently good. Went here with my fiancée this morning. She got the Mad Style Greek yogurt, and I got the banana hazelnut crepe. Absolutely delicious and fresh. We will definitely be back. Highly recommended!

resp.text:
Hello Matt,
Thank you for your review, five stars, but most importantly for your visit at Mad Rooster Cafe. Have a great day and see you soon!

name: Petero H
text: This place always delivers. Even during covid, they manage to provide hot food with curbside pickup. I got the corned beef hash and eggs plate which came with pancakes. Easily two meals, and very satisfying.

name: Jamie Hall
text: Food was delicious and it seemed like staff was taking proper COVID19 protocols. I can't wait to come back to try more of the menu. Also, their Anodyne coffee is great! My husband and I both love it, which never happens with us and coffee. I wish I could buy some grounds to take home!

resp.text:
Good morning Jamie,
Thank you very much for your amazing review, but most importantly for your visit to Mad Rooster Cafe. Indeed, we are doing our best to follow COVID19 protocols to keep you safe and our staff too. Side note: we do sell our Anodyne coffee in a 12oz bag and we can also grind it for you as well!  Stay safe and have a great week!

name: Dionna Richmond
text: Portions were enough to share. Food was really good. Service was okay but it was a busy Saturday morning. We waited about 20 min to be seated. We will be back to try other menu items.

name: Kyle McHugh
text: Food was spectacular. Was very happy with everything I ordered. I got avocado toast and it was HUGE. I really liked this, every brunch spot I go to had small portion avocado toast. they do it all correctly here! Only thing was during covid it was a little bit of an uncomfortable dining experience. Very tight.

name: Jerry Broitzman
text: Great place! Wonderful atmosphere. The food is really good. The menu has a combination of traditional breakfast and lunch food, as well as original dishes of their own. Customer service is quite good. Our server, Aremy, was exceptional. She was very attentive and got everything right the first time. This is a very popular place, and for good reason. Give them a try. You will be glad you did.

resp.text:
Good morning Jerry,
On behalf of the Mad Rooster teams, we would like to thank you for your amazing review and most importantly for your support in these difficult and dark times. We hope that you have an amazing rest of your week and stay safe!

name: Van Strickland
text: The staff was very helpful and the food was great! Portions are hearty enough for you to take a little bit home with you. If you're offered the chicken gravy, please give it a try, it's f-ing delicious!!!

name: Cesar Perez
text: Disclaimer I'm plant based, was disappointed that such a cool place would have such limited options. The coffee is great, but no alternative milks ( waitress suggested half and half or hazelnut as alternative 🤦‍♂️) The only things were a salad that had to be modified,  a fruit bowl or oatmeal that was also modified,  it came original with milk, I requested water instead (easy swap imo) hopefully more vegan friendly items get added, place is busy probably doesn't need more customers though... this one might not go back, except for coffee... maybe.

resp.text:
Good evening Cesar Perez,
On behalf of our teams, we would like to thank you for your feedback. Also, we want to thank you for bringing this matter to our attention and we are also very sorry that we've failed to meet your expectations. Moreover, we would like you to know that your feedback help us get better and we are looking into this issue and hope to resolve it promptly and accurately. We would love to invite you back in hopes that our Chef or General Manager can talk a bit more with you about what happened on your last visit.
Have a great week and stay safe.

name: Patrick Morgan
text: Excellent food at fair price. Friendly service. My first time, I will return.

text: This place is always exceptional. Fresh assorted fruit, fresh ingredients in omelets. Good service, good portions for a good price.

resp.text:
Good evening,
Thank you very much for visiting us at Mad Rooster Café. Our teams can not thank you enough for the amazing review! Stay safe and have a great rest of your week.

name: Chris Williams
text: Best Corned Beef Hash in town! That's all I've ever gotten after trying it the first time. 🤷🏻‍♂️

name: L Turman
text: The place was nice and had a nice atmosphere to eat and enjoy brunch. The menu had very good selections to choose from. Pancakes, French toast,  etc to breakfast tacos and biscuits& Gravy... all delicious!  You were greeted upon entering, the service/ wait staff was very nice, and overall was a great experience. I did, however, not like the "hidden" side charges. Maybe I missed the fine print. But this place charged for everything edible with the exception of water. Another small ramekin of salsa was $1.50, a side dish of Gravy was extra, etc. Maybe a friendly reminder would be nice (?). Aside from being charged the "hidden" fees, it was enjoyable and I'd go back... less the extras.

resp.text:
Good morning L Turman,
Thank you so much for the fantastic review and most importantly for visiting us at Mad Rooster Cafe. On behalf of our teams we can not thank you enough for the support in this difficult and dark times. Also, we would like to apologize for what happened on your visit. Your comments have been discussed at the length with the responsible teams to ensure our cafe maintains its high standards and such matters will be addressed promptly. Have a great rest of your week and stay safe.

name: Madyun Wilson
text: This place is so full of positive atmosphere right now and the Mimosas are $6 so get them while there “cold” There's also a large menu of other beverages you can choose from. I ordered the salmon omelette which was a new menu item and got a greek yogurt from a old friend I've been seeing here since I was a child. Mad Rooster is timeless and full of memories the staff that been here all these years reflects that energy. I will be here more often now that the world is opening up with CDC guidelines. This is my highest review ever give to a breakfast restaurant in MILWAUKEE!!!!! I don't take that lightly! Happy brunch!

name: Mathew Mayes
text: This place should be world famous. I want to live here. Everything from the gravy to the potatoes to the coffee to the bloody mary to the pancakes is phenomenal. Amazing.

resp.text:
Good afternoon Mathew Mayes,
Thank you for your visit and for the amazing review. Hope to see you soon at Mad Rooster Cafe and have a great rest of your week.

text:
Let’s just say...my wife and I didn’t leave anything on our plates.

The food was yummy, the drinks pleasant, and our waitress Olena needs an award. Service was all around perfect. Would recommend calling ahead as there may be a longer than expected wait. It’s a popular spot.

resp.text: On behalf of our teams and Olena, we would like to thank you for your amazing review. Also, we are very happy that you liked our cafe so much and hope to see you soon. Thank you for the support and stay safe!

name: Dianna Moua
text: I simply love this place. Anyone stopping by Milwaukee needs to have breakfast or brunch here. The portion sizes are great. You won't walk away hungry. The chili is fantastic and if you get it loaded, the jalapenos bite back. Simply delish. Honestly, my eyes are always bigger than my stomach.

resp.text:
Hi Dianna,
Mad Rooster's team would like to thank you for coming in and really appreciate your comments/feed back. We are super happy that you like our food; please ask for a manger next time and don't forget to tell your server to go easy on the jalapeños!   Have a great week!

name: Andrew Lerch
text: Home made yogurt is amazing!! It is a main dish and not a side if you're looking at the price.  I had the reuben, which should be easy to nail, but you would be surprised how many restaurants screw it up!

resp.text:
Hello Andrew Lerch,
Thank you so much for your amazing review and for visiting us at Mad Rooster Cafe. We hope you have a great rest of your week and stay safe!

name: Maria
text: Great good and all but waiters could be a little more friendly

name: Ross Rondeau
text:
Amazing decor, great boodly Mary and awesome crunchy french toast!

Staff was friendly and atmosphere was great!

resp.text:
Good morning Ross,
On behalf of the Mad Rooster teams, we would like to thank you for your support! Have a great week and see you back soon !

name: Andrea
text: Waiter was very nice, food is real good. Very hopping restaurant. Kinda of pricey but the food is worth the price.

resp.text:
Hello Andrea,
Thank you so much for your visit to our cafe, for your review and for the five star rating! Stay safe and see you soon !

name: TaNesha Elam
text: Very good. The food was delicious and plentiful. The waitress was nice and kind.

name: Alaina Goss
text: Words can't express how delicious this french toast was.  Everything was so fresh, even the whipped cream (which I NEVER eat) was fresh made.  Was recommended by my boyfriends coworkers to stop in here and it did not disappoint.  Excellent food, great pricing and attentive staff. Definitely recommend and will be back to try everything on the menu!

name: Christopher Carroll
text: Yummy breakfast, big portions, friendly service, tons of seating, very clean, fair prices, and hot coffee. What else could you want from a breakfast place?

resp.text:

Thank you so much for your visit and for the amazing review! Stay safe and we'll see you soon at Mad Rooster!

name: Chay
text: This place was absolutely delish! The service was ahmazing! They even made sure my little baby sun was happy! The mimosa was so yummy! The syrup mmm mmm mmmm 😋😋🤤 I loved it, especially for my first visit!

resp.text:
Good morning Chay,
Thank you so much for your amazing review, but most importantly for visiting our cafe in this difficult times. Have a great day and stay safe.

name: Kelii Sipin
text: Online ordering was terrible. Planned to get girlfriend crepes she requested for her birthday, so she could eat them before work. I get confirmation texts with pick up time, but when I get there everyone is confused. "Online? Oh, the order just came through..." Now there's no time for her to eat, and I have to arrange a ride for her to get to work on time, then have to drop off her food so she can eat it slowly over the next several hours, on her birthday. I ask what they can do for me, I even already tipped online. Their answer? "Sorry about that, here's your order." Went from a favorite to likely never going there again.

name: Steven Parker
text: Great place to eat, great food. Waitress, and manager were excellent.

name: Nicole Lorene
text: Great menu options. Busy place, so service can be a bit of a wait. Pleasant and friendly staff.

name: Carol Baldwin

name: James Geilfuss
text: Great Place,. Service outstanding.  Food. Excellent

name: John Wyatt
text: Got food to go.  Ordered the Salmon omelet,  was very tasty.  Also ordered the OJ, not as good as usual, reminded me of made from concentrate.

name: Steve
text: One of my favorite breakfast restaurants in the area! Huge portions fast service and a very unique vibe.  It is normally pretty busy and only open to 3pm.  You can get coffee while you wait if you wish

name: Maggie Attoe
text: Always good food and great service! Their coffee tastes great too! Would go back in a Flash.

name: Rebecca Fuerbringer
text: Delish as always! Had the wild berry pancakes today. Starting to branch out from the chilaquiles (they are my fav)! Great Food!

name: T. Jace Fenton
text: Chicken and waffles omg so great! With syrup or the side of chorizo gravy you cannot go wrong.  Had the jalapeno special bloody mary it was a spicy drink that I needed in my life!

resp.text:
Good afternoon T Jace Fenton,
Thank you so much for visiting us at Mad Rooster Cafe and for the amazing comments! We hope you have a wonderful week and stay safe!

name: Nova Dust
text: Quick service. Interesting setup,  it looks crowded but depending where you sit its nice. Food is good for price. Trendy

name: Matt Boyce
text: Why have I waited so long to go here?   If your like breakfast and have not been here... do not do anything else until you get here.   Excellent food.  Super service.   GF pancakes are best I've had.   Really deep but not paralyzing menu.

name: Ya Sabes
text: Very fun place for a breakfast type meal. I have tried their Jalapeño meals and pancakes. You can't go wrong. The servers are very nice. Prices are reasonable, good portions, so you end up taking home leftovers.

name: bubba kahuna
text: We stopped for breakfast on a friend's recommendation. We were greeted and shown to your booth. We were offered a bottle of filtered water. The server was very helpful with explaining all the options on the menu. The coffee was absolutely amazing served with individual chilled pictures of cream. When our food was delivered I asked for a to go container right away because there was no way I could eat all that was served! The ingredients are fresh and very tasty. As we ate there was a constant flow of customers coming and leaving. I highly recommend you try this gem, you will not be disappointed!

name: Beth Wisniewski
text:
Absolutely amazing!!!!
Incredible food...so fresh... super friendly service.  Be sure to check in via Yelp to save wait time.

resp.text:
Hi Beth,
Thank you for your visit, your amazing review and the 5 stars. Our teams really try their best to have an amazing cafe where we can provide delicious meals and excellent costumer service. Once again, thank you and see you soon.

name: Michael Baumann
text: We went yesterday for the first going to Mad Rooster, even though we live within walking distance.  All I can say it was a mistake to have waited to try it out.  It was packed, as it always looks that way.  The food didn't disappoint.  We got three plates to share between my wife and I.  The crepes were not overly sweet and you could taste the cinnamon, along with fresh strawberries.  Everything was made fresh, and I had the biscuit and gravy.  The gravy was different, but it was slightly spicy due to the chorizo, which really made a difference.   Overall, we will be going back sometime soon.

name: Tracey Killoran
text: Huge menu, amazing food, fast & good service !  Will definitely be back.

name: Miss Megan
text: If you haven't been here, you are missing out! This place is delicious and delightful 😋 😍 🐓

resp.text:
Good morning Miss Mega,
Thank you so much for your amazing comments and for the five star review. Have a fantastic week!

name: Monica Cardenas
text: Busy place on a Sunday morning. Called to see if They take reservations and the hostess told us to join the waitlist through Yelp. Great suggestion since we only had a five minute wait once we checked in. The two of us were Seated in a comfy booth. lots of families And several large parties were seated in the large dining area. Very clean, roomy and embraces the rooster/farm theme to the max. Our waitress stopped by immediately to welcome us and to let us know she would be right back for our drink order. Ordered coffee and large glass of freshly squeezed juice. Coffee was hot and juice was sweet and obviously from fresh oranges - not thick pulp. Ordered the corned beef hash with two over easy eggs, side of bacon, farmers Benedict and fruit bowl. Pleased to see the corned beef was not the processed sliced corned beef that you see in the deli but chopped pieces from a brisket and tasty. As for the eggs Benedict, the hollandaise sauce was too thick but had flavor and the poached eggs were over done and already broken by the time they hit the table. Fruit bowl was generous and varied. The side of bacon included two strips of bacon and again tasty. Will return to try other dishes.

resp.text:
Hi Monica!
Thank you so much for your review and visit to our restaurant. We are very happy that you liked our food and service; our teams always try to to their best to provide excellent service and serve delicious dishes. Please, next time that you come in ask for a manager so that we can tell you more about our restaurant and make sure that your food is server correctly. Once again, thank you for your visit and we'll see you soon!

name: Ashley Mulholland
text: Everything was delicious. Service was fast and friendly. We will definitely be back!

resp.text:
Hello Ashely,
Thank you very much for your amazing comments, five star rating and most importantly, for your visit! See you soon!

name: Margaret Freda
text: This place is amazing! The options are different without being " too much" i.e over the top.  I took a friend there for her birthday and they gave us an amazing dessert made with banana bread whip cream chocolate sauce bananas and strawberries. They staff was pleasant and attentive and the best part is its reasonably priced! Can't wait to go back!

Even though that we do not do anything special for birthdays, we do like to offer a small treat from the bottom of our hearts. Please, visit us again soon and we hope that you have an amazing day. Happy Bday to your friend. !

name: Marcis Davidson

resp.text:

Thank you for your review, five star rating and most importantly for your support. Stay safe and have a wonderful day!

text: I'm never disappointed by my experience here. It's the cage-free eggs! Come hungry because it's real Wisconsin huge portions. Oh, and coffee is magnificent!

name: E W
text: Food and service was great! Long wait but worth it.

name: Andrew Krystowiak
text: Great food. Great service. One of the best breakfast spots in the Milwaukee area. I've been here many times now and it never disappoints. Highly recommend. Pro tip: use Yelp to put your name in the queue before you get there to avoid waiting for a table at the restaurant on busy days.

resp.text:

name: Imran @ Prime Printing
text: The place is so busy all the time that I never had the chance to eat here.  My wife and I finally made it here today and loved the food.  The place was very cozy and that also made the food taste better.

name: Fahd Alghazzi
text: Best breakfast place in southeast wisconsin. One of my all time favorites. Great staff and clean place.

name: Corbach Toolis
text: Large portions, delicious food, friendly staff!

name: Doreen Jewell
text: the egg was well  done the ham wasn't cooked enough never again

Your comments have been discussed at the length with the responsible teams to ensure our cafe maintains its high standards and such matters will be addressed promptly. We are very proud of our work and what we do at Mad Rooster and we hold our teams to a much higher standard than the situation you explained.
Moreover, we would love to invite you back in hopes that we could provide you with the real Mad Rooster experience. Once again, we are genuinely sorry and look forward to speaking with you. Have a great rest of your week and stay safe.

name: Chad Conte
text: Wow!! Do you want to experience a breakfast that's going to blow your mind??? This restaurant and service far exceeded any expectations that I had of just getting something to eat! There was a wait of 35 minutes for my table and that's exactly how long it took to get seated. It was so worth the wait! There's something to look at in every part of the restaurant and the food came out very quickly! The portions were enormous!! The wait had so many people just hanging around that they have a free coffee bar. They grind the beans right there. So the coffee is as fresh as you're going to get anywhere!! People that weren't drinking coffee or drinking mimosas or Bloody Marys that we're done perfectly! Talk about being blown away!! I was not expecting this. Their service and wait staff are very well trained almost as if being at a fine dining restaurant! Very impressive and worth the wait!!

name: Darcia White
text: Food was amazing! Service was top notch. I will definitely be going back!

name: Jon Hintz
text: Great rueben. Tender corned beef and a perfect grill on the bread.

resp.text:
Hello Jon,
Thanks for your visit and for the amazing comments! Have a good one!

name: Doughboy Food Reviews
text: Monte Cristo: Mad Rooster Café was first recommended to me by a co-nurse about three years ago. I really wish I had tried it sooner because the food rocked my world! I love my carbs (and I'll review my dessert tomorrow), but after my morning lifting session I needed some protein as well. I decided on the Monte Cristo, which is made with ham, scrambled eggs, bacon, cheddar & Swiss cheese, all on "Crispy-Crunchy French Toast" (French toast dipped in crunchy corn flakes & sprinkled with powdered sugar & cinnamon). The sandwich is massive and I was only able to gobble down half of it. I can never have enough cheese and there was just the right amount of melted gooey goodness on this beast of a breakfast sandwich. While the meats were plenty flavorful, the game changer was the French toast. I've never had anything like it. The bread was thick, soft, sweet, chewy & crunchy! If that wasn't enough I had to add some sugar free maple syrup for more flavor. The Monte Cristo left my taste buds crowing for more, Doughboy Approved.  Doughboy_Food_Reviews

name: Christen B
text: Options galore! They have so many options here, you won't be able to choose. Bloody mary's come with a deviled egg on top - extra win! The food quality great and quantities were plenty.  Popular spot to grab breakfast in MKE, so don't be surprised if you have a few minutes to wait but trust me - it is worth the wait!

resp.text:
Good morning Christen,
Thank you very much for the amazing review that you've written for Mad Rooster Cafe. We'll see you soon, stay safe and have a wonder rest of  your week.

name: Jack Moon
text: Literally the best bloody Mary I've ever had, anywhere! Our server wasn't the best, but the food was delicious, and the menu was playful and inventive. The decor was also not to be missed! Great place for the whole family

resp.text:
Hi Fallon,
Thank you for your visit to Mad Rooster Cafe! We are very happy that you liked our Bloody Mary!!!!! Also, we would like to thank you for giving us a good review and five stars! Please, visit us again and ask to talk to a manager and we can tell you more about our cafe!

name: Thomas Ryan
text: Chicken and waffles were excellent. Easy go to anywhere and cant go wrong there. But the chicken was flavorful. Lightly well breaded. And juicy. Good service. Would come back again.

name: Christina B
text: Came here for breakfast shortly after they opened in the morning and there was already a line forming at the door. This is an extremely busy place so make sure to come in bright and early. The food and service was good. The decor was interesting and vibrant. It's a smaller restaurant by it I enjoyed my experience. The only negative feedback I have is that it was quite warm on the inside of the restuarant. It was about 90 degrees the day we went and inside the restuarant it was quite stuffy. Otherwise it was a nice place to grab a quick bite to eat. They have a huge selection of foods so there is something for everyone.

name: F Crawford
text: It was ok. The waiter was ok. We waited even w reservations forever. Then waited forever to get drinks and food. Too much for mediocre food.

name: Nicole Johnson
text: Food is alway good. Fast service and great staff.

Once again, thank you for your visit and we hope to see you soon!

name: Sharon Clay
text: Friendly staff, awesome food, Great atmosphere

name: Michael Siebenlist

name: Osvaldo Lagar
text: The Mad Rooster was an excellent restaurant for breakfast! The theme of the place had an old farm design. It was very clean and comfortable. I ordered a MONTE CRISTO... This dish was nothing short of phenomenal. It had crunchy flakes on it, ham, egg, thick cut bacon, and cheese!! This also came with fresh fruit. To drink I had a 'cafe con leche' (coffee with milk) and when the glass was served, it had sugar and cinnamon on the rim. Altogether I had a really good experience there. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND CALLING AHEAD ON FRIDAYS AND WEEK-ENDS. I went there on a Wednesday and it was jam-packed. Call ahead to make sure they have room or to make reservations. Enjoy Mikwaukee!

All together, we recommend this place and 10/10 will go for another year. 👍

name: Kelley Randall
text: My husband and I enjoyed the breakfast tacos, biscuits & gravy, and buttermilk pancakes. I had a mimosa and my husband had a GREAT bloody mary. The coffee was delicious, too! You may enjoy a cup of coffee while you wait. Just take the cup with you to your table.  That is a nice touch. The staff are pleasant and professional.

name: Jason Smith
text: Had the day off and had heard of this place before so decided to try it. It was awesome! Decor was unique for sure. Seated quickly. Food was great we got the jalapeno skillet and blueberry pancakes. Wide selection of breakfast/brunch items. Happy hour Friday mornings too. Definitely try the yogurt! Will be back!

name: Marsha Hernandez
text: Great service, food is fresh and great selection. Highly recommend you give it a try.

resp.text: Hi Marsha. Mad Rooster Cafe would like to thank you for your visit. Comments like your makes us feel so proud of the hard work that our entire staff do to provide not only good costumer service, but to make delicious food as well. Thank again for your  visit and we hope to see you soon!

name: Heather R.
text: Big portions for the money. Unique twist on food that is very good. They do have gluten free pancakes and good coffee. Staff was friendly and made sure we had full cups of coffee. They only do breakfast and lunch, not dinner. You can get take out which is a nice option. Can be a wait at the usual rush time i.e. noon and on the weekends. It's worth the wait!

name: Tiffany Johnson
text: AMAZING! Originally my boyfriend and I were going to order from here on door dash, but decided to dine in instead for a cute breakfast date. Best decision! Our server was absolutely lovely, and the food was DELICIOUS! My boyfriend got mediterranean benedict, and it was perfectly cooked. I got the goodiva chocolate chip pancakes which were also super tasty! My only regret was not taking pictures of our food before we ate. We're definitely going to be coming back in the future!

name: SERKAN YORULMAZ
text: We love breakfast there. They have great options and huge portions. Food always good and the service!

name: Kelli M
text: Breakfast was good and hot. Go during a weekday and not during the rush hour, its crazy on weekends and during the typical breakfast times. My strawberry waffle was delish!!

name: Diamond Cole
text: The manager was training a new waitress, and needless to say it was awkward as hell. He literally stood over my Dads shoulder not saying anything until he caught an attitude when she wasn't moving fast enough. They got out order wrong and when my Dad told him he took my Dads plate off the table as my Dad was eating.....I could've snapped! And the food was okay....not something I'd die for.

resp.text:
Hi Diamond,
We are very sorry that you had a bad experience over at Mad Rooster and for sure will be putting more attention to these things that you pointed out in your review. Please, next time that you visit our cafe, ask for a manager so that we make sure that you get what you order, provide an excellent service and most importantly to apologize in person for not meeting your expectations. Once again, we offer you our most sincere apologies.

name: James Padron
text: I really liked the variety of the menu items and I'd like to try more. My down on the farm skillet was delicious. I'll definitely be returning.

resp.text:

Thank you so much for your visit and review. Stay safe !

name: Gianna Madison
text: I placed an order online and requested curbside pickup, as I had received curbside service only a few days prior. When I arrived I parked right across from the carry out door and called to let them know I was outside. The lady who answered asked where I was parked, I told her and gave her a description of my car. She said someone would be right out. I also received an automated text message indicating the same. After 10 minutes had passed, and no one had come out with my food, I called again. I was then told that an attempt to call me was made (I never received a call from them) and that no one had time to walk my order out...only several feet from the door...so I would need to come in. I explained that I had my baby with me (which was the whole reason I requested curbside pickup in the first place), her response was, “yeah, the carry out servers don’t have time because we’re busy.” If you’re going to offer curbside service it shouldn’t be predicated on how much business you have. Either you deliver the service or stop indicating that you can. My food was cold by the time I got home and the chicken that came with my waffle was so overly salted that it was inedible. I am so disappointed in my experience today because I’ve had good food and service there in the past, but now I don’t know that I’d go back or recommend.

text: We went on a Sunday morning for breakfast. The staff were friendly, the line was long but the wait time was reasonable. Plus there's a free coffee station at the waiting area. text:
This place is busy! We waited about a half hour, and let me tell you, it was worth it! The staff is friendly and attentive, the food is to die for, and overall a great place to dine. I would never turn down the opportunity to go here.

We went for a mid morning breakfast. I ordered A LOT of food. Had the coffee to drink. It's their own brew, and it was good. I prefer an earthier brew, personally, but there's was still good.
Next up was their secret recipe chili. Hearty, tinge of spice, topped with cheese and sour cream. I asked for the oven roast jalapenos to be on the side, and good thing, too! WHEW!

Then the main course! The boyfriend ordered the breakfast tacos with the soft corn tortillas and baby reds on the side. Excellent!
I ordered the stuffed French toast AND the breakfast burger. The toast is filled with Bavarian cream and topped with fresh fruits and icing with whipped cream on the side. Simply wonderful. It was like a breakfast doughnut, practically. The breakfast burger comes ona pretzel bun, veggies on side, topped with an egg, cheddar jack and bacon. Was very delicious. The burger still maintains some pinkness so it is good perfectly and not a hockey puck. I was initially concerned that it might be over done when I ordered it, but I'm glad my fear was wrong. Very good. On the side I had the loaded baby reds with cheese and onions and peppers. it was very good, but I would save teh extra couple bucks and stick with the original reds next time.

All items perfect. I was so happy we chose there, it is now some place I want to take people visiting town every time.

Pictures from separate visit. Biscuits and gravy, lemon ricotta pancakes, and baby reds.

name: Priscilla Riley
text: Love this place. The atmosphere and food is awesome. The prices are a bit higher than some places but well worth your time. Try the breakfast tacos.... I highly recommend it.

name: Alex Burbey
text: The food here is amazing! If you are in town on business, pleasure, or any other reason really, this should make it onto your agenda. Southern comfort breakfast done right. I have never had a bad dish here. The service is fast, but get there early. They fill their tables quickly in the morning, for good reason.

name: Verlonda Kirchner
text: Mad Rooster serves the best breakfast or brunch meals!!! We (husband and children included) really enjoy the menu items on their list to choose from. I would show a picture, but I don't think to do so until everyone is done eating. How the food looks on their menu, is how they serve you your meal. If, you would like to order for carryout, they are very accommodating for that too. Just to give a heads up. Mad Rooster is a very popular restaurant. Sometimes, there is a wait. They're pretty accurate when they say how long your wait will be. No more than 30 minutes for us, and we're a family of 8. The prices are a little on the pricier side, but they don't skimp on their portion sizes and the food tastes fresh. We could eat just the eggs along. They taste like they came straight from a farm. The staff are kind and courteous. They always have a smile and make you feel welcomed.

resp.text: Wow, thank you SO much Verlonda! We love to see these great reviews and appreciate so much when our guests take the time to write such nice things! We pride ourselves in the quality of our product and service and we are so happy that you and your family enjoyed yourselves! Hope to see you back again soon!

name: Khloé Kuriatnyk
text: Never had a bad experience here. Food is always amazing and so is the service. Get there early otherwise the wait is long.

name: Big Mo
text: Will definitely be back. One word of advice.  If your a big boy like me don't opt for the "small" , go for the booth or table option trust me.  But the food and service was the bomb.

resp.text: Thanks so much for the awesome review and 5 stars, Mo! Hopefully next time we can make you more comfortable!

The only thing that is a drag for me is the waiting time, up to 1 hour at times sucks that they close early, so if you are a big party or just want to drop by call ahead to see if they can accommodate you. name: Malinda G.
text: The food is okay but a bit pricey what really disappointed me was the vacuuming going on this kicks serious dust into the air while people are eating! What the heck the the tossing of the entrance rug big no no! The over whelming smell of mop water not appetizing at at but that's the managers fault the waitress we had was nice. Clean house before you open not during seating hours! Or wait till close. I can see a little mess that needs cleaning but not this serious vacuuming while people are eating.

name: Barbara Thompson Roethle
text: Our first visit here and we were looking forward to all the incredible things we heard from food to the service. We were seated with 15 minutes and our server approached a short time later.   Food was good, portion was generous,  and appreciated the fresh fruit .  The star rating is for the service.  Our server switched our meals upon delivery (there were two of us) and never stopped to ask how things were going.  He delivered the check, mumbled something,  and left.  We went  the pick up counter because that is what we thought he said.  The girl at the counter took our payment but didn't seems as though she wanted to but said she would because we were paying with a card. One more disappointment.

Thank you so much for visiting our cafe and we are very happy that you liked our food on your first visit. name: David Lee
text: Food is good its better to call and pick up ur food they are always busy especially Saturday's and sundays. The wait is about 10 to 15 mins to be seated on those but the food is worth the wait

resp.text: Thank you so much for the wonderful review and 5 star rating, David! We really appreciate it and hope to see you back again soon!

name: Jared Adamczyk
text:
Mad Rooster Cafe is consistently an amazing breakfast or brunch option! You can't go wrong here. Just make sure you get your name on the waitlist ahead of time as there is always a wait for a table.

I have not had one bad experience at Mad Rooster other than the time I forgot to pre register my name on the waitlist, lol.

The food is beyond fantastic. The servers are excellent at making sure you are well taken care of even though they are definitely very busy. The food always comes out fairly quickly, which is great because you are for sure going to want to dive right in to whatever you have ordered!

My go-to favorite dish is the Huevos Rancheros. The whole combination of the crispy tortilla, the runny egg, the slightly spicy sauce, cilantro, and those delectable potatoes on the side make my mouth water just thinking about it!

Most definitely highly recommended

resp.text: Wow! Thank you so much for the fantastic review, Jared! We are so happy and grateful that you enjoy yourself as much as we intend! We truly appreciate your amazing feedback and really look forward to serving you again! Come back to see us again soon!

name: Jeff Rey
text: Excellent service, fantastic coffee, really great breakfasts that are creative and quite different than the normal breakfast fare. Ample room and great atmosphere. Quite clean, well organized and just a happy place to be. Prices are more than the normal breakfast place, but the quantity and quality exceed most places. You get what you pay for. Portions are perfect for sharing.

name: Ellen Hanke
text: Breakfast / brunch foods sooo good. Wait staff friendly & happy. Our ladies group love coming here!

resp.text: Thanks for your awesome review Ellen! Hope to see you back soon!

name: Steve G
text: This is my go to spot when visiting Milwaukee! Great at atmosphere great food and coffee is good as well. You won’t be disappointed with whatever you order!

resp.text: Thank you so much for your review!!!! At Mad Rooster Cafe we always try to offer an excellent service and delicious food! We really appreciate your business and don't forget to visit us next time you are in Milwaukee!

name: wendy kaufert
text: Very nice staff and great food

name: Luis Vazquez
text:
I remember visiting this place when it first opened. The vibe is unique, the food is good (I usually get a skillet or Belgian bacon waffles!), and the service is super fast even when it's busy. The staff are really nice too.

Just be ready to wait in line for a while on the weekends. This is a great place to take out of town visitors for some breakfast or brunch. I usually take family members who are in town visiting.

Lastly, it's only open until 3pm, which I think might add to the magic of the place. Enjoy!

resp.text: Hi Luis. Thank  you so much for becoming a regular to our cafe and visiting us since we originally open.! We do our best to provide fast and good service. It's true that some times, specially during the weekend our wait gets a little crazy, but we do our best to keep up!. Please, next time that you come to visit us ask for a manager so that we can touch base a little more and talk about our cafe, food and our amazing staff! Thanks to you we have a unique restaurant in Milwaukee #Milwaukee, #localfood, #MKE Gracias!

text: Other restaurants should take notes from the experts at the MAD ROOSTER! The food was delicious and arrived exactly as ordered.  I often order poached hard eggs which is basically a hard boiled egg, they got it right the first time!  The only place that has ever got it right the first time in Milwaukee!  The service was quick and friendly. This is in my top 5 favorites!  Yumminess to the 10th power!

There are some items that are very high to get right, but thanks to our chef and "Heart of the House" team we are able to deliver!  Once again, thank you for your review and we hope to see you soon!

name: M West
text: Our waitress was great and the food options were above and beyond. It was super hard trying to pick out what to try for my first visit with all the options and then a spring menu to boot. I ended up with a "fan" favorite Chicken and waffle. It was the best I've ever had, the chicken was perfect and the waffle was fluffy. Came with real maple syrup and an amazing chorizo gravy that my GF ended up stealing from me. She had the French toast stuffed with Bavarian cream. She loved it also. Topped with bananas, blueberries and strawberries with some sort of drizzle. Side of bacon was okay. Service was very fast for such a busy place, order to food was about 10 minutes or less. $4 Mimosas and $3 beers on Fridays. I'll be going back to try something new.

name: JoyvsJoy
text: I love mad rooster never disappointed

name: Sarah Alloway

😎

text: Everything was absolutely fantastic.  We had a variety of entrees and drinks, and nothing was less than stellar. Our server was busy but extremely attentive and genuinely friendly.  We will definitely make the trip again.

name: Jenn Nowak
text: AWESOME! There were 4 of us on a Saturday at 10am. They were packed but it only took 15 minutes for a table and after ordering only 10 minutes for our food to come. Our waitress was so nice and literally everything we ordered was amazing. We thought it was going to be expensive and including specialty drinks (smoothies are out of this world btw) the bill was under $50. We will NEVER go anywhere else for breakfast in West Allis. I highly recommend the mad tacos or the fried cinnamon French toast.

name: machelle lexa
text: Food is outstanding,  waited over an hour to sit but was worth the wait. Even after the 44 min drive to get there.  Our Server (he) was very nice too. Fast n pleasant.

Staff is always friendly. Only drawback is that they get busy fast- call ahead during busy hours to check wait times, or use nowait app.

text: The corned beef hash is awesome here!

resp.text: Thanks so much for the great review and 5 star rating, Gloria! We really appreciate it and hope to see you back soon!

name: Michelle L.
text: Best breakfast I have had in a long time. The Monte Cristo was amazing. Great service and the entire menu looked so good! We will be back. Great addition to the Milwaukee area.

name: Christina K
text: Mad Rooster Cafe was a pleasant surprise; a varied menu with lots of options, including cage free eggs, grass fed beef, real maple syrup, and homemade Greek yogurt. They also serve filtered water (they bring a bottle and leave it at your table~ pour your own so your glass doesn't run dry) It gets busy fast; as soon as 7am hits, the restaurant fills up and a line forms. I thought menu items were a bit pricey but, the wait staff was friendly and our food came quickly, I'm likely to return.

name: J kbisch
text: Chicken fried steak and waffles were very good along with the bacon and choclate chip pancakes. Carnivore omelette is huge! Variety of french toast options. Service was fast and attentive.

name: B D
text: The food is great, and the service is great. They have vegan options, too. Everyone loves it here. If you don't believe me, believe the lines they always have. Like, this place is ALWAYS packed. The wait usually doesn't take very long, though.

name: Jacob Johnson
text: I've been here twice and both times I have enjoyed the chicken and waffles. The chorizo gravy it very unique and really makes the dish. The wait here can be long on Saturdays/Sundays, but it is worth it. Their pancakes are also very good. I will be back, and maybe this time I'll get adventurous and not order the chicken and waffles.

name: Taylor Wiliams

name: Mireya Carmona
text: Just went here yesterday. I loved the waiter that took care of us. Look for Hector he will make you laugh and just has a friendly attitude with you. He really makes you feel at home with the family. It was my uncle's first time there. Because of Hector he really LOVED it there. Differently will be going back.

name: Ben Holter
text: Come here hungry as this is a real hearty meal. The plates are overflowing with alright food you will probably need a takeout box for. Good variety for anyone. The food is all similar consistency so it ends up a bit bland. The huge portions make it better than a 3 star but the food quality leaves it short of 5 stars.

name: Ryan Boyer
text: Good service. Good coffee. Decent food. Prices are too high.

name: Latoya Renfro
text: The meals at Mad Rooster are AWESOME. Before they opened, other restaurants were...acceptable. Try going back to your regular spots after visiting this establishment. They're quick with service, the food is FRESH (the corned beef hash is more like freshly chopped corned beef, and potatoes that were just cut and cooked to order). Lol Not sure how they continue with the great service, but I LOVE IT!

name: Margaret A. Dierickx
text: Love this place! Hands down my favorite place for brunch! The food is always good and friendly service. Never had a bad experience. There's always a wait but its worth it. Download the No Wait app to check in remotely and it can cut your wait time by 30 minutes!

name: Elias Allen-Folts

name: Virgil Ewing II
text: Great selections for breakfast and lunch. Generous servings and fast service

name: Jeff Gray
text: Simply put, this was the best breakfast I've had in a couple years. Unique preparation unique offerings and you can have a bloody mary to boot.

name: Lauren Vieth
text: Fantastic food with a unique menu. Menu consists of not just your ordinary breakfast items. Loved the food we ordered and service was very good.

name: nicholas itsines jr
text: Everything is always great. Awesome staff. Avocado toast, monte cristo, and eggs Benedict are to die for. Always get the baby reds.

resp.text:
Hi nicholas,
First and foremost, we would like to thank you for your visit to Mad Rooster and for the amazing review! Our teams always try to do their best to serve amazing dishes and provide the best costumer service. Once again, thanks your visit!

name: Tabatha Hafemann
text: Love the food here and the service is great!!!

name: Sara Libbey
text: Food is always good. They forgot about us once they called our name for a seat though. So we waited too long

name: Joseph Kraus
text: Tasty friendly clean awesome

resp.text:

Thank you for your visit and for the amazing review! Hope to see you back soon!

name: Ana Jade
