resp.text: Thanks for the awesome review, Ana!

name: Christina Witmer
text: Go early, this place gets busy. Portions are large and delicious!

resp.text: We are so glad you enjoyed yourself, Christina! Thanks so much for the awesome review!

name: Kenneth J Kalfas
text: A great array of signature meals and excellent wait staff make this unique eatery a must-stop for breakfast or lunch

resp.text:
Good morning Kenneth,
Thank you for your visit to Mad Rooster Cafe and we are very happy that you have liked our restaurant that much! Our teams do their best to accomplish such great reviews! Once again, thank you for visiting us and we hope that you are having an amazing week!

name: Coco Mulla
text: Great food always packed with people thou. I usually order for pick up because I live close to the area.

resp.text: Thanks so much for the awesome review, Coco! We hope to see you back soon!

name: Derek Williams
text: Good food and service.

resp.text: Thanks so much for the good review and rating, Derek! We really appreciate it and hope to see you back soon!

name: Daryl Wheeler
text: Anodyne coffee, quality food and great service.

resp.text:
Good afternoon Daryl,
Thanks for the the amazing review and for your visit to Mad Rooster. Have a great week and see you soon!

name: Dan Cooper
text: Wide selection of entrees, plenty of options for sides, and the specials were intriguing too. If you're coming from Miller Park Way/ 43rd St, making the left turn into the lot can be tough. I'll be back for sure!

name: Amanda R. Berenguel Smolka
text: Mad Tacos and baby reds were delicious!!!

name: Ladonna Connor
text: Great omelets, chicken and Waffles are always delicious and the fruit bowl was so AMAZING

name: kevin brown
text: Havent been here in a while shut when I lived closer usually went here every weekend for breakfast. Wait wasnt ever bad if you learn the right times to go. Portions were always generous and food was always good.

name: Timothy Cunningham
text: Tried it for the 1st time today, the Monte Cristo was very good.  We will be going back to and try more.

name: Diana Dreger
text: Great food,  great service!!

resp.text: Thanks for the great review and 5 stars, Diana! We hope to see you back soon!

name: Vanessa Hernandez
text: Nice Mexican food nice service funny people

resp.text:
Morning Vanessa,
Thanks for your visit, for the amazing rating and for your review! Hope to see you soon !

name: Justin Kreger
text: First time going to this restaurant. Atmosphere is unique, staff was great and food was spectacular. They do what they do well. We will be back again.

name: Raeleen McMillion
text: Good eats! Blueberry crunch pancakes are special treat.

resp.text:
Good morning,
We would like to thank you for your visit, also we are very happy that you liked our Blueberry crunch pancakes... Those are a must in our restaurant! Please visit us soon !

name: Veronica M
text: love this place!! my husband took me on a breakfast date and asked where I wanted to go and I said Mad Rooster (he had never been) the wait is usually long if you don't get there early or make a reservation but I used this new app and when we got there we were seated right away and the food was AWESOME!! I love that they have fresh everything fruit, juice, eggs etc you can taste the difference and my husband and I LOVE to eat breakfast so we both enjoyed and didn't finish our food but it was a great snack later!!

name: Alex Jankovich
text: The best breakfast place around. During peak times call ahead or prepare to wait, although it's worth it.

name: ZfugeGaming2201
text: Love the food. Amazing service.

resp.text:
Good afternoon,
Thank you for your review and visit to our cafe! We hope that you are having an excellent week and see you soon at Mad Rooster!

name: Sean Fuller
text: Good and fast service and the food and coffee are always amazing!

resp.text:
Good morning Sean,
Thank you so much for your review and for siting us at Mad Rooster Cafe. We hope that you are having an amazing week!

name: Jennifer Bahr
text: Wonderful service, nice place for brunch. Make sure on a sunday you make reservations.

resp.text: Thanks so much for the 5 stars Jennifer! That is good advice about making a reservation on Sunday's, we are packed! Hope to see you again soon!

name: Sarah Flancher
text: Our favorite breakfast spot. Speedy service and always delicious.

resp.text: Thanks so much for the kind review, Sarah! We are really proud of the quality of our service and food, so we are so glad you enjoyed yourself!

name: Anurag Vutukuri
text: Really good food. I think that’s why the wait times are longer.

resp.text: Thanks so much for the good review! Sorry you had to wait for a table, but so glad you enjoyed the food! hope to see you back soon!

name: Joanne Haupt
text: Good food! Fun atmosphere. 🙂

resp.text:
Hi Joanne,
Thank you so much for your visit, for the great review and for the 5 stars! Hope to see you soon at Mad Rooster!

name: Terry Losey
text: First time there awesome place great food awesome service

resp.text: Thanks so much for the awesome review, Terry! We hope to see you back soon!

name: Gerald Edelin
text: No wait Calida gave great service food was good for the price. I will visit this place again.

resp.text: Thanks so much for the good review and rating, Gerald! We hope to see you back soon!

name: Lani Jensen
text:
The service was fast and pleasant.
I wouldn't say the food was phenomenal, but it was good.
For my fellow plant-based eaters out there: very vegetarian friendly, for the vegans you're better off going elsewhere. primarily egg and meat based dishes.

name: Si Philbrick
text: The food and prices are amazing and the staff here are soooo friendly! I love their omelette and coffee! Highly recommend this establishment.

name: Mark Borrmann
text: This place has the best breakfast food! Of you haven't been here you have got to go see what your missing! If going on the weekend call and get a reservation or you will be waiting 30 to 60b minutes to be seated! It's a big place too.. that right there speaks for the food!

name: Rosemary Lucas
text: Amazing brunch menu. Food is local and very fresh. The yogurt is homemade unlike store bought thick and rich try it with the honey and walnuts!

name: Betzaida Diaz
text: Amazing food and great customer service. The prices are reasonable. This restaurant opens early and close early. Enjoy.

name: Susie Scott
text: Had the crunchy french toast which was so good and my friend had the jalapeno skillet with chicken chorizo, which was amazing. Anodyne coffee made my day. Great service too.

resp.text:
Hi Susie,
Thank you for your visit and we really  appreciate your review. At Mad Rooster cafe we focus on costumer service and try to provide local delicious food. Also, we team up with Anodyne to provide a unique coffee that only our restaurant have in the Milwaukee area. Once again, thanks for your visit and we hope to see you soon!

name: R3D-1 Truth
text: I only downgrade the place due to long wait times to get a table. I think my shortest wait has been 30min. in the four visits. The food is ok, staff ok, decor cool. Kid friendly also. It’s never my first choice, the wife likes it.

name: Judith Palenski
text: Awesome fresh food. Love the salads! Coffee is one of the best in town. Excellent staff. Wish they were open for dinner. They close at 3pm.

name: Amy Hintz
text: Great food. Awesome coffee. Decent service

name: Mike Smith
text: Food was really good. The place is decorated really well. Very artistic. The restraunt was a full house again. Long wait. Wall to wall people. Located in a sketchy part of town. Lock your car.

name: Diane Mcginnis
text: This place is outstanding in friendlyness service , I'd go again .

resp.text:
Hi Diane,
Thank you so much for your visit to Mad Rooster Cafe. At our restaurant we take every review and feedback very seriously in order for us to be a better restaurant. On your next visit to Mad Rooster, please ask for a manager so that we can talk about your previous visit. Once again, thank you so much!

name: Susan Rakowski
text:
went for breakfast. I right away loved the decor and atmosphere. comfortable seating.
I ordered two breakfasts because i couldn't decide, Stuffed french toast with custard and fresh fruit, refreshing, sweet, delicious. Also an omelet with homemade bread with crispy real thick matchstick potatoes. It will be my dinner. I am already planning what to have next time.

name: Lillian Jackson
text: Love it great food

name: Jennifer Kallias
text: Fantastic waitress wonderful good, cozy atmosphere, delish bloody Mary--I'll definitely return!

resp.text:
Hi Jennifer,
We would like to thank you for your visit and your review! We are very happy that you liked Mad Rooster Cafe. Our teams try to do their very best to make delicious meals and provide good service to our guests! Once again, thank you so much. See you soon!

name: Melissa Leimberg
text: Big portions.  Good breakfast

resp.text: Thanks for the good review and rating, Melissa! Come back and see us soon!

name: Cheri Decker
text: Always has Amazing food, it's definitely a good place to take a group. Remember to give them a heads up as they are usually packed. Huge portions but not a overbearing amount. Vegetarian options, attentive staff, and a huge menu makes this place a great stop of breakfast.

name: L G
text: 40 minute wait. Food was ok. Not bad, but nothing that sticks out that I'd have to go back for. They do have a lot of options on their menu that I feel makes it more unique and you can't get at other places for brunch. So if you're looking for something other than your standard bacon eggs and pancakes you might want to give this a try. The place was absolutely packed and stuffed with people, we actually had to talk loud to one another to hear each other's conversation. On that note although it was extremely busy the waiter was amazing, patient and extremely fast AND our food was also cooked amazingly fast given amount of people in there.

name: Diana Nash
text: Awesome breakfast!

resp.text:
Hi Diana,
Thanks for visiting us at Mad Rooster Cafe and for the five star rating. Take care and see you soon!

name: Stephanie Panos
text: They have their stuff together here! Excellant hot Anodyne coffee given to those who have to wait. staff is polite. The breakfast potatoes are super yummy! And I personally like the crispy French toast!

name: Betty Schaefer
text: First visit. Food was very good as was the service.

resp.text:
Morning Betty,
Thank you so much for your visit to our cafe! We are very happy that you liked Mad Rooster on your first visit! We hope that you are having a great week and see you soon !

name: james doig
text: Saw lots of people outside and was worried that it would be a crazy long wait.  It was only a 10 minute wait.  Whats more they had free coffee for people that were waiting! The service was fast and attentive and everyone loved their food.  I had the chilaquiles with skirt steak.  It was fantastic! I highly recommend this place!

name: Alex Schneider
text: This place is usually busy and full of people. The food is good and the people working are nice. I would recommend

resp.text:
Hi Alex,
Thank you so much for your visit and we really appreciate your feedback/comments. Once again, thanks for your visit !

name: Michael Sobol
text: Good food and service. We never leave disappointed.

name: Brian Moran
text: Probably my favorite breakfast anywhere...and the lunch is awesome too. You cannot go wrong eating here! The decor is great and you will get consistent, friendly service.

name: Suzzette Grisham
text: Love the Mad Rooster for breakfast.  Super friendly waitstaff who make your visit entertaining.  Good bloodys too ..

resp.text:
Hi Suzzette,
Than you for your visit at Mad Rooster Cafe. We really appreciate your business and we are very happy that you like our bloodys. We have a unique team and they always to their best!  Once again, thank you so much!

name: Aaron T. Howard
text: Great food! Friendly, attentive staff. No question the food is farm fresh - the restaurant smells like a chicken farm. Eggs, chorizo sausage and fresh yogurt were all excellent!

name: Penny Dumanch
text: Just ok. Very busy place. Hens room..no paper towel or hand dryer working. 40.00 average lunch price there.

name: Luke Pifher
text: Best breakfast in the city. High quality everything.

resp.text:
Good morning Luke,
First and foremost we would like to thank you for your visit to our cafe; also we are very happy for your comments and for the 5-star rate that you've given us. Hope to see you soon!

name: Kelli Jo Schmitt
text: My 1st choice for breakfast anywhere. The food is SO fresh and the service is impeccable. Typically a 30 min wait or so to be seated on the weekend, but it is so worth it.

name: Carlos Carrillo
text: Food is great. Weekends seat waiting time can be lengthy.

resp.text: Thanks for the great review, Carlos! A good tip is to use the Yelp Wait List app. You can add your name to the list before you get here! Hope to see you back soon!

name: Jeremiah Gonzaga
text: Best place in town!!

resp.text:
Hello Jeremiah,
Thank you so much for your amazing review and for the five stars! Hope to see you soon, take  care and stay safe!

name: Jose Luna
text: Didnt really like the coffee definitely could be improve. I had the mad omelet, it was good and all but the one bad part about it was the avocado which was brown so It gave my omelet that funky taste old avocado has.

name: Dawn Lewinski
text: Always good. My birthday breakfast. Thank you!

name: Steph Rhone
text: I have nothing negative to say about this place. Food & service was fantastic! We had 11 people in our party, they worked us in quickly which we couldn't believe how quick since there was a line going out the door. Make sure you use there online seating which helped us get in. Thank you for a great 1st time experience @ Mad Rooster

name: John Zick
text: Excellent service and food, highly recommend.

resp.text:
Good morning John,
We would like to thank you for your visit and for the amazing complements! We really appreciate the support and hope to see you soon at Mad Rooster Cafe!

name: Michelle Simonis
text: Great food!!!

resp.text:

name: andrea johnson
text: Comfortable setting. Good size waiting area if applicable. Food is very good! Drink sizes are tiny however.

name: Dan Rafalski
text: Food good but a little pricey

name: J Ollie
text: Get there early. Usually 15-30 min wait time. Popular place. Good food!

name: Sand Fred
text: Breakfast, lunch - oh so good! Bacon is the best! Lunch salads a big and great for catering small office lunches.

name: Matt A
text: It was my first time at the Mad rooster and I have to say all around it is a five-star breakfast joint. Fast and friendly service great atmosphere and the food was excellent. I would highly recommend it.

name: Marykay Heidger
text: Really cool atmosphere, but the eggs have the odd flavor and texture.

resp.text:
Hi Marykay,
First and foremost, we would like to thank you for your visit to Mad Rooster. Also, we really appreciate any feedback and become a better restaurant for our guests. On your next visit, please ask for a manager to talk about your previous experience at our cafe. Once again, thank you so much for your visit and hope to see you soon!

name: Maggie Doré
text: We love the food here. It's always busy, so you will likely have a wait unless you're there when they open or very lucky. The service is usually good. They do care about your satisfaction. I don't care for their coffee but it seems I'm in the minority there. We always get the chilaquiles because they are amazing, but so is everything else we've tried.

name: Abigail Pranghofer
text: Oh my gosh, loved this place. Everything about it. The food, the service, the drinks, and the atmosphere was wonderful. I had the wildberry pancakes and couldn't of been more impressed. Only downfall is I would skip Sunday brunch here, it's very busy but they can't help that. They are just that good!

name: Dmitry Zinger
text: This place was extremely crowded. The wait was unreasonably long, so I chose to skip it. Seemed kind of old and understaffed. This area also looks quite rough and dumpy. I don't think I will ever want to go back.

name: FxckYouSmithy
text: Great food, but I believe one of the manager or server guys asked the server a question and I thought he was talking to me so I answered and he rudely said “I’m not talking to you” like okay....

name: M. Lewis Hansen
text: The food is always good and the service is fast and friendly. I love this place for brunch.

name: Esteban Romero
text: Very good food and very nice service

resp.text:
Morning Esteban,
Thank you so much for dinning in with us at Mad Rooster Cafe; we really appreciate your review and the 5 stars that you've given us! See you soon.

name: Natalie Gross
text: HUGE portions! Yummy food and good bloodys!

resp.text: Thanks so much for the awesome review Natalie! We really appreciate it!

name: Becky Foxx
text: Excellent food & service everytime we come here. I love the changing seasons menu. My favorite is the Salmon & Spinach which is really creamy.

name: Maverick 357Mag.
text: Great menu choices of breakfast and lunch options. Fast and friendly service. Sundays are the busiest so reservations a must! You won't leave hungry. Would highly recommend to anyone!

name: Hope Erdmann
text: The food was really good.  I ordered the skillet greens and coffee.

resp.text: Thanks for the 5 stars Hope! Come back and see us again soon!

name: Josephine Rembert
text: Wish i could give them ten stars the food was great.

resp.text:
Hi Josephine,
Thank you so much for such amazing review! Hope to see you soon at Mad Rooster Cafe and have a great weekend.!

name: Leif Nehls
text: Amazing food, great servers and the atmosphere is very enjoyable! Certainly will be back MANY times!

resp.text:
Hi Leif,
In behalf of our teams, we would like to thank you for your visit to Mad Rooster Cafe and for the great review that you wrote about us. We really try our best to provide not only great costumer service, but to serve delicious meals to our guests because we know how important and valuable you are to us! Once again, thank you so much and we'll see you soon!

name: Frederick Bankhead
text: I liked the various types of menu choices.

name: kamonie foster
text: Food was Delicious

name: Barbara Mort
text: Delicious breakfast skillet. The wait was 20 minutes on a Saturday afternoon.  The food was served very quickly and the waitstaff was friendly and smiling.

name: Maureen Brock
text: It's good but not great. Blues Egg is best

name: Jesse
text: Great food, great portions. The wait can be long.  Use the No Wait app to get your name in so you can avoid this problem.

name: Spencer L
text:
This restaurant has a good atmosphere and the staff takes orders and brings out food when its done.  The food itself is pretty good and the staff seem to check in with customers more then once.
If you have relatives visiting from out of town, this would be the place to take them.

Cons: For the area, this place is expensive. You wont be getting a much higher quality food or service than dinner grade. Though cleaner in general. The cost to quality/quantity ratio will not impress most.

name: William McGee
text: The food is great and reasonably affordable

resp.text: Thanks so much for the great review and awesome rating, William! We hope to see you back soon!

name: Gerald Dias
text: Great food.  HUGE portions.  Definitely returning again when we entertain visiting out of town guests.

name: Steven F.
text:
Food is very good, service and wait time are not. We put our name in on the nowait app. We were promised a 30-40 minute wait. We ended up waiting 1 hour 30 minutes. No apologies, no rush to seat us. Once we received our food (which was delicious) I had to wait 10 additional minutes for silverware. Coffee refills were never brought.
The food is very good. I very much enjoyed the mad morning tacos (I would assume they named them this because you are mad by the time you finally get your tacos). The biscuits and gravy were also very good.

Overall food = 5 stars
Service 2 stars
Wait and promised time 0 stars

name: Dan Behling
text:
Stopped on a weekday at 9am. The restaurant was a quarter full with immediate seating. I had a skillet with side of pancakes, a coffee and a decent sized fresh squeezed orange juice.

Service was outstanding, my meal showed up in less than 5 minutes. I was very satisfied with the quality, although my over medium eggs had runny whites. Blech!

Anyway, my bill was $22 with tip.
Recommended breakfast stop if you're in the area.

name: Nicolas Reyes Jr.
text: Favorite breakfast place. Great servers. Waits a bit lo ng but the wait is worth it. Side note: My 6 year old loves this place and always request this place.

name: Melinda Gladney
text: Good food, we had a 45 minute wait however when we got seated there were seats open.  The restaurant underused the space this causes guests who want to dine to wait.  Not good.  There were 4 tables open.  Other than that and asking a second time for what I needed, it was good for a first visit.

name: Bob Wooten
text:
Bold flavors, large portions, HUGE selection, good coffee, nearly everything is homemade.

We're not from this part of Milwaukee but visit for the large, nearby grocery store. Decided to give something new a try. Mad Rooster is well worth the trip.

Their chorizo is well seasoned and is healthy to boot as it's a chicken sausage.

The non-standard baby reds are a delightful change from the standard fare.

Give em a try, you won't be disappointed.

name: trinitta Smith
text: Food was great, service was also. No long wait!

resp.text:
Good morning,
Thank you so much for visiting Mad Rooster and for the great review. We really appreciate the fact that you took some of your time to post this and for giving us a 5 star rate too. See you soon!

name: James Pelkey
text: Has good food and a nice latino atmosphere.

name: deb micic
text: Excellent service and food!! Great atmoshere too.

resp.text: Thank you so much for your visit. At Mad Rooster Cafe we take pride of what we do and serve! Our teams really do their best to provide the best service! Thank you for your visit!

name: Rick Sear
text:
Went with the family and got Belgian waffles, "Carnivore Omelet," and a mixed berry pancake plate. Everything was delicious, filling, and very reasonably priced. I recommend this to anyone looking for an excellent breakfast at a non-chain restaurant.

Went here at about 8:15 on a Saturday and got a seat right away. Don't wait too long...it gets very crowded very quickly.

name: John Kress
text: Good food, prices. Great service.

resp.text:
Hi John,
Thank you very much for your comments! We really appreciate your business and next time you visit us, ask for a manager so that we can tell you more a bout Mad Rooster!  Once again, thank you!!!!

name: Allen Hentz
text: The staff here are polite and friendly. The crossaint breakfast sandwich was delicious.

name: Udont Nomi
text: I love this place! Great food and good food portions.

resp.text: Hello! Thank you for your review! We would like to thank you for your visit at Mad Rooster Cafe and also, we are very happy that you like our place! See you soon!

name: Penn Carlyle
text: Great food! And it was very fresh

resp.text:
Hi Penn,
We would like to apologize for not responding earlier to your review and we would like to thank you for it and for giving us five stars! Hope to see you again and have a great week!

name: Nikki Lelinski
text: Amazing food in a cozy atmosphere.

resp.text: Thanks so much for the great review and 5 star rating, Nikki! We look forward to serving you again soon!

name: Theresa Bollhagen
text: Awesome food, but very busy. Plan ahead!

resp.text:
Hi Theresa,
Thank you very much for your visit and hope to see you soon! Have a great week!

name: Kyle Clark
text: Awesome ma and pa-style restaurant. They use seemingly high quality ingredients and food is always good. Definitely try one of their smoothies! They are obviously freshly made and using all real ingredients (no mixes.)

name: Stephanie Werry
text: Love the options here and great coffee

resp.text: Thanks so much for the 5 stars and awesome review, Stephanie! Hope to see you back soon!

name: Tyler Listle-Hicks
text: Food and service is always amazing

resp.text:
Hello Tyler,
Thank you so much for your review, five star rating and most importantly for your visit to our cafe. We hope to see you soon!

name: Tall & Sexy
text: Clean, good customer service, food is always delicious!!

name: Annette Claus-Madison
text: Good food and good service. Always a crowd.

name: Allen Kepler
text: Good food, long long wait with little place to sit while you wait.  Could come up with a better waiting system.

resp.text:
Good morning Allen,
Thank you so much for visiting us! We are very thankful that you like our food and we want to apologize for the "wait"... We do our very best to accommodate any parties that we have, as fast as we can, but our restaurant is very small and our teams really do the best they can. Once again, we apologize for the inconvenience, thank you for your visit and we promise you that we'll do our best on your next visit! Have a great weekend!

name: Tim Lynn
text: Vary good food  fast service

resp.text: Thanks so much for the great review and 5 star rating, Tim! We really appreciate it and hope to see you back soon!

name: Anthony Givens
text: Great place good food excellent

resp.text: Thanks for the great review, Anthony!  We really appreciate it!

name: Jose Galvan
text: The best place for breakfast in town

resp.text: Thanks so much for the awesome review and 5 star rating, Jose! We really appreciate it and hope to see you back soon!

name: Luke Zepnick
text: I love authentic chilaquiles. This restaurant has very delicious dishes, but the chilaquiles with the flank steak is nearly perfect. Not only is everything on their menu reasonably priced, but the Mad Rooster will give you portions so large, you'll have leftovers for a whole second meal!

name: Myladys Montanez
text: In love with their Chilaquiles 🤤😍

resp.text:
Morning,
First and foremost we are super happy that you liked our Chilaquiles... they are delicious and a favorite at our Cafe! See you soon at Mad Rooster!

name: Brenda Sykes
text: The food was very good!

resp.text: Thanks so much for the 5 stars and awesome review, Brenda! We are so glad you enjoyed our food as much as we intend for you to, hope to see you back soon!

name: Denise Cruz
text: I gave them a four because everything was perfect I loved the food and the staff but they are only breakfast and lunch so everytime we go to eat they are closed :(

name: Pugs Pugliese
text:
Good food and friendly staff make this a great place for brunch.

The drawback is that on the weekends, the wait is almost always thirty minutes to an hour.

name: Emily Hall
text: Cute place. Service was good. We had no wait on a Saturday morning so that was great, considering it was busy. We had the strawberry crepes, chocolate chip pancakes and breakfast potato. The potatoes were excellent, pancakes barely had chocolate chips(one pancake didn't even have any in them, just a few on top) and my husband likes his crepes. They didn't have much inside them though. Will probably return and try it again.

name: Stephdn
text: Great staff

resp.text:
Good afternoon,
Thanks for your visit to our cafe and for the five stars! We hope that you have a wonderful rest of your week.

name: Donna D
text: Always delicious!!

resp.text:
Hello Donna,
Thank you for visiting us at Mad Rooster Cafe and for the comments too. Have a great day!

name: Dakota Stockwell
text: One of the most popular breakfast restaurants in the area. Unfortunately on weekends there is always a wait, unless you go right at open, or later near close. Great service, and excellent food.

name: Ed Wahoski
text:
Awesome place, We drive 50 miles go eat there
Great food, very busy

name: Rachel Westergren
text: I visit this restaurant every time I'm in town. Great service. Unique menu at a great value. The coffee is the best.

name: Eric Conover
text:
Pulled into the parking lot at around noon on a Friday looking for some delicious breakfast. Was worried when I saw the parking lot was so packed.  Walking in a was pleasantly surprised to find that this place is huge!  We waited all of 5 minutes for a table.
The service was fast and friendly... They have a pretty  large menu and also had mimosa/bloody Mary specials going on.  Settle on the Mad Omelette which has was not only delicious,  but Huge!  Definitely get your money's worth here.  The food also came out pretty quick considering how busy it was.
Definitely recommend this place,  especially if you  are tired of waiting an hour plus at some other local breakfast got spots.

name: Linda Underwood
text: Love the food here

resp.text:
Good morning Linda,
Thank you so much for your visit and for your the amazing review! See you soon at MRC!

name: Chris

name: Alan Williams
text:
I'm close to saying that Mad Rooster has the best breakfast in Milwaukee. Close, but I'm not there yet.

The food has always been excellent. Very good sized portions. Good coffee that keeps flowing freely. They have some top-notch Bloodies that go really well with your meal. Friendly and helpful staff round out the overall experience.

But...

If you're not getting there at the crack of dawn, bring a copy of the NYT Crossword with you, because you'll be waiting. Awhile.

This place fills up quick and the waiting area gets REALLY crowded. While you can't "blame' a place for it's success like this, it does make dining there something of an ordeal.

The last time we attempted to go, we used an app that said that we could reserve a "place in line". When you looked at our drive, it meant that we should be getting to the restaurant pretty much right at the time our place was good to be seated. When we got there we were told they had "no record" of our place in line, and that it would be about 45 min. for a seat.

No thanks.

I don't really blame them for the problem, they can't be held accountable for IT issues on a busy Sunday morning, but it does lend the to the overall issue with the popularity of the place.

We'll have to try it one day during the week to see if it's any better. Like I said, I really, really like the food and staff. The crowds...eh.

text:
Hearty breakfast and brunch options that will leave you satisfied and or stuffed.

They have a good selection of omelettes, skillets and scrambles for those that like a savory breakfast. They also have plenty of drool-worthy options for those with a breakfast sweet tooth.

The place gets packed early on the weekends. Even if you get on the list through Yelp, you can still expect a significant wait. My advice: go early on weekends.

It's a nice place to take out of town guests because it's a kitchy place with great breakfast food. They have good bloody marys, and it'll fill you up for a day on the town.

text: Very busy! Friendly Service with a smile. Very country home looking for such a large restaurant. Loved the décor! With the high vaulted dealings, the sound is amplified so be prepared to speak up.  The menu has many choices, many of which are new takes on old favorites. I ordered the Biscuits & gravy which it Chicken Chorizo over Biscuits. I was very displeased with the appearance as it looks like hospital food. I kept an open mind, cut into a biscuit and waited to be amazed.  I was not!! It tasted like chicken gravy smashed up with lots of black pepper. The Biscuits were thin & crisp which I think would be quite pleasing on a side plate. This meal comes with 2 eggs any style and a bowl of red potatoes. The eggs are from cage free chickens which matters none to me.. I had mine scrambled and they were good. The potatoes were the best! Chopped up with both tender and crisp pieces of potato, mixed with what appears to be green onion with light seasoning. These were great!  When asked about my meal and how it was, you could see that I only took 2 small bites. They were so kind and insisted that I allow them to prepare me a new dish to take home. Staff was Great!!! I would definitely go back to try the chicken waffles and the homemade yoghurt boat that fills half a pineapple and topped with a lot of fruit.  Thank You Mad Rooster

text: I live just up the road from here - yet I only recently had a meal here. Two, in fact, so good was the first one! You can tell upon entering the cafe - that the moniker "Mad Rooster" is not about an angry chicken, rather an off beat, crazy kinda place. Not too crazy - just different from your standard breakfast truck stops, for example (which can often be a surprisingly good thing). The first time I was there the service was a bit mediocre, but the waitress was young and I'll give her a break for that. Hopefully, experience will teach her that a little more alacrity when the customer asks for a clean glass and a refill makes all the difference in how the whole restaraunt is perceived. The second time I was there, the waitress (a bit older) practically did back flips to help me out. At both times, I was there during a non-rush time - but sure, it wasn't slow either. What I can say, is that the food is so amazingly tasty, fresh and well prepared that it makes up for any lack of service. The ambiance is wonderful - the kinda pick-me-up you can use when you are feeling bored, down, and need a change. I don't want this to be a review about one waitress - whose service wasn't horrible (don't get me wrong - I've had way, way worse), just not as good as I was expecting, I only pointed that out because even though it was a bit disappointing the first time - I was more than happy to come back. And it paid off with the better service. What is spectacular about this cafe is the wide, wide variety of breakfast foods. If I were in town more often, I'd probably be on my 10th or 11th review right now. :-) Check out the menu, a link is posted with this maps business. And enjoy!

name: lee Wolf
text: Stop for a bathroom break and found out they have a restaurant there. So we ate there food was good service was great. A nice place to stop and eat.

name: David Hass
text: Nice place. Just got coffee and it was very good

name: Martha Dyehr
text:
**UPDATE**

I think the owner should maybe think before getting an employee to come knocking on truck drivers doors. Sometimes we have no choice but to create a spot. Plus the traffic was/is able to go around me. Aaaand I was sitting there warming up my engine thinking I'd move my truck before I went inside... Difficult to want to spend money at places where the owners act that way. You all happy with our products and our money but have no regard for the driver it seems. Not impressed at all. And this was one of my favorites. Unfortunately not anymore. A huge thumbs down on truck driver treatment.

I was not blocking the air machine as there was a truck to my right when I pulled in at night and there was over a truck width space between the air machine and the truck on my right. You have 2 really wide driveways right close together and I was not obstructing any flow of traffic. I made sure of that. Im not just some yahoo that doesn't know how much room a truck uses. To my right there were 3 trucks parked when I pulled in at night also. Your employee could use some training on what to say to drivers then. As he figured I could of parked in the many spots in front of me. You think I create a spot to park if there is a lot of room or if I have enough hours to go further? I will maybe consider coming back simply for the reason you took the time to reply. If I had been blocking the flow of things I would of understood the frustration on your guys end. It's not like we drivers hang around that long. Plus soon as we wake up and our engines warm we move our trucks into available spots before going inside. Now I just feel like we don't matter.

resp.text: We are very sorry for the situation.  While we are primarily a truck stop, we also have to serve consumer vehicles.  You were blocking the air machine and the driveway and our employee asked you to move your truck.  We never want to upset anyone, but we need to keep our driveway accessible to all customers.  We did not mean to offend you by asking you to move, and we hope you consider coming back.

name: Victor Hackbarth
text: I just moved here from Wisconsin, so any gas station that actually sells beer in the PA/MD area deserves a five-star rating in my my book.

name: Kenneth Fox
text: Great staff. Very friendly. Clean facility all around. Prices were good for it being a truck stop as well.

name: Bonnie Morgan
text: Super fast in and out here and the place was very clean and the staff were very friendly and upbeat

name: Gregory Srock
text: Restaurant has good food and Travel Plaza has pretty clean restrooms.

name: Gregory Ailes
text:
Love this place..
People are friendly
Food is great
Place is clean

name: Michael Aas
text: Good truck stop. New owners, which was needed. Helpful staff and plenty of parking. Lot is a little rough.

name: Sheila Skillin
text: Good food n the restaurant but restrooms could use an update and the parking as well.

name: Dan Peck
text: Plenty of parking and a good restaurant. Good people and good food.

name: Freddy Fazbear
text: Stopped and ate..  great service,  and great food..  Thank You for everything..

name: Dragon Rider
text:
Jumped off hwy for washer fluid.
Cashier super friendly.
Fuel island has funny setup.

name: Ann AUSTIN
text: Nice place to park and trucking supplies and good food and choclate malts made right . Yummy!

name: jack weelmaa
text: Good food, good fuel price. easy in/out

name: Doug Tody
text: I have always had a great meal and the service is great and fair prices

name: David W.
text: Lots of truck parking, clean restrooms and friendly staff. I have yet to try the restaurant, been wanting to but never have the time. One of these days.

name: Scott Carlson
text: Easy in and out great restaurant awesome staff

name: Kim Colson
text: Amazing food! Great wait staff service!

name: Rat Mom Lee
text: I stopped here just to grab something quick and use the restroom. I walked in to find they sell what I consider comfort food right by the register... Chicken tenders, biscuits, potato wedges, and more I just didn't look at because I was set on getting a biscuit and tenders. Such a great surprise. They have a sit down restaurant attached that I'm guessing makes more comfort food. I recommend you stop here if in the area!

name: Jason Boynton
text: Clean, good prices on gas.  Good selection of food and snacks did not go into the attached restaurant.

name: Tom Lemmer
text: Love the Winchester. Bri is a awesome waitstaff

name: KOU XIONG
text: GOD BLESS Edgerton Travel Center! We got 10 huge pieces of boneless chickens + fried potatoes LOVE CHESTER'S. 1 piece each, we were full. Oil less frying chicken and fries. Great caring people works here. Highly recommend this place. Was today May 4, 2020 at 10:15 AM

name: Myron Schulist
text: Awesome personal, friendly and professional

name: allan bruns
text: Plenty of parking, easy to get to. Clean.

name: Teri Smith
text: Ate at Winchester Restraunt.  AMAZING food, excellent prices, friendly staff.  This place ISN'T listed on Trucker Path, but it certainly NEEDS to be.  A very LARGE lot for parking, gas station open 24 hrs.  Definitely a must stop here again kind of place!!!

name: Byron Smith
text: Nice selections, was clean even throughout even in storm

name: Sarah Larson
text: They have repaved the parking lot, so it's in good shape.  Restaurant has fast, friendly service with good food.

name: Michael Brasel
text: Dirty truck stop, bathroom was disgusting and the Chester's chicken had been sitting out for to long. Not worth the money I spent to get something for dinner

resp.text:
We're sorry for your bad experience.  Our restrooms are older, but we do our best to maintain cleanliness throughout the day.  Next time, please let an employee know about the bathrooms, and we will make sure to clean them up.

Our Chester's chicken is fried fresh throughout the day.  It does not sit out for very long, and we are required to discard food per health department guidelines.

Can you let us know what day and time you came?

name: Andy Anderson
text: Very nice place to stop and refresh

name: Cory Stellpflug
text: Great staff. Plenty of parking.

name: Armando Lopez-Escobar
text: Great. !  Another option in trucking business.

name: jacob jensen
text: Just awful it smells like grease and pee

resp.text: Hi Jacob, we are sorry for your bad experience.  We do our best to maintain a clean operation and always try to improve.   If you could message us letting us know the details, we can take corrective action.

name: Kim Gehrke
text: Winchester restaurant had THE best country fried steak I have ever had. Also the biscuits and gravy was THE BOMB!

name: robert yesutis
text:
Quick and easy stop of the expressway.

text:
I really like this truck stop. The restaurant has excellent food and service, actually, both sides, gas- station and restaurant have great friendly staff. This place is definitely one of my favorites!

Interestingly this past Thursday December. 13th I was pulling a priority load that was bound for Chicago, since the load was under a very tight delivery schedule, so I knew a hundred miles out that there was no way I'd be able to stop and I was bummed out about that.  So I'm coming down I-90 and as I was approaching the 159-mile marker my engine died, I restarted it but then just as I was approaching exit 160 it died again and I coasted up the off ramp. I had to keep restarting it but the tractor would go about 200 ft each time. I eventually was able to pull into this truck stop. I called my company and let them know that I was broke down.  So in the end, two good things happened ,  obviously, I was able to go in and enjoy a wonderful sit-down breakfast,  and yet another added bonus I discovered the absolute best road/ Diesel repair service I've ever encountered throughout the years of driving. Instead of being towed into a shop, these mechanics from:  "AFFORDABLE DIESEL ROAD SERVICE"  came out to the truck stop and completely repaired my semi truck right there in the parking lot.  So yes, it turned out to be a GREAT DAY!

name: Tom Pickart
text:
I absolutely cannot recommend this place. The reservations were made by my employer over the phone. Reservations were made from Tuesday to Friday of the following week. They were told I would not arrive until 2 or 3 a.m. on Wednesday morning. When I arrived I found that Super 8 have canceled my reservations because I wasn't there by 2 p.m. Tuesday. They only had one room available and when I got to it I found the sheets dirty, what I believe to be pizza sauce on almost every surface and light switch. The microwave was disgusting among other things.

I work 6 p.m. to 6 a.m. so I was sleeping in the hotel during the day. Even with the "do not disturb" sign on the door the first couple days Hotel staff attempted to enter the room waking me up. After that almost every day I was awoken buy them vacuuming and banging the vacuum against my door. I was never able to get a decent amount of sleep while there.

The free breakfast consisted of dried hard biscuits with gravy and scrambled eggs that were made fresh seemingly 4 days ago.

My employer told me that they spent $130 a night for me to stay there. It's more of a $50 a night place.

I've also had the the chili cheese hot dog and that is also very good.

It's also always really clean too from the eating area to the restrooms (one time I saw an employee washing off the chairs and when I asked her about it she said they have to completely wipe them all down including the legs every night WOW)! You order your food then sit down and wait for them to bring it to you and you don't ever wait long! Oh and try their Root beer ice cream yummy deliciousness! text:
The signs advertised a peanut butter float. I specifically ordered peanut butter floats, and paid for what I thought would be peanu butter floats. What we got were two small "concrete"  ice creams, which basically was just vanilla ice cream with peanut butter cups for $8!

Instead of being brought to the table by a waitress, as was done for anyone that had either food or a float (which we were expecting), we were called up to the counter. We didn't even rate a tray, despite having three items (my aunt also ordered a side scoop, since she was expecting a float). I asked twice for a tray, but was ignored by the person at the counter. I had to manage everything, while kids were running around under foot.

I hope the construction across the street is for a Culvers or a Baskin Robbins. Either would put this over priced, false advertising place out of business. They only lasted this long because they were literally the only place around.

name: Mark Elland
text: Really disappointed tonight, one cook and two waitresses. Friendly, but the service was slow. My order was not prepared properly, and my wife said the grilled chicken salad was not good. The chicken was dry and tough. After how long it took, we didn't complain.

name: Nick Mack
text: This is a great stop.  Neat place with a canoe hanging from the ceiling.  I had dinner at the restaurant tonight.  I recieved fast and friendly service immediately.  My food was brought out promptly!  Everything was good.  I miss the salad bar.  The salad was kinda lame but other than that everything was good.

name: Tammy Roberts
text: Staff was very nice. They set up tables for all 8 of us to sit. Mom got wrong meat for her meal though. Was a good visit.

name: Tattooed Bad Bitch Tee
text: Good home style food. Served quickly, staff was friendly, place was clean...I will definitely be back to try more off the menu, thanks!!

name: Bev Monahan
text: Excellent food, one of the last truck stops that have dine in. Tons of parking. I love this place, its definitely one of my top 3 favorite truck stops!

name: Bill Philippe
text: Good as expected.  Quick and friendly

name: Matthew Ellison
text: Phenomenal food, great servers, even with COVID and Social Distancing. Kuddos!

name: Jason Horstman
text: Food was good, A very nice and clean 24 hour diner. I was most impressed with our server she was great! Our food came out right away and my glass was refilled several times. She was extremely attentive.

name: Dawna Remley
text: Great food and nice people. We always come back here.

name: Chad Goodman
text: Great service good food.  Havent ate here in many years and was worth stopping

name: Cecelia Langland
text: Great breakfast, no buffet, short wait for food, waitress was nice and friendly.

name: Terri Burdick
text: Outstanding service and the food was very good. A lot for the money. The place was spacious and very clean. Easy to get to from interstate as well. Would recommend.

name: David Hass
text: Still the best truck stop chain. The food was really good and the service also. Bring back the buffet please.

name: Holly Stamper
text: Great lunch today with awesome service! Thank you!

name: robert gekko
text: The food was decent, the ranch dressing was off. I really enjoyed my waitress she was very helpful and attentive.

name: Ann O'Keefe
text: Food was good but for me it wasn't something that I hadn't tasted at other places.

name: Craigslist Beloit
text: Glad there is a place that can still do a sit down meal with appropriate precautions for the quarantine.  We appreciated the accommodations as a family

name: Aaron Schoelzel
text: Food okay service ok. Has gone downhill quite a bit.

name: Zachary Smith
text: Stopped in for coffee and the server was very attentive and always had a smile on !

name: Matthew Jenkins
text: Hands down the best food in the area. I have thoroughly enjoyed every meal I've had there plus the wait staff are super attentive and friendly. You won't be disappointed

name: Eric Otteson
text: Good buffet for a reasonable price on Sunday mornings. I particularly liked the bread pudding! Will come back again.

resp.text: Ty Eric hope to see you before the Big Game

name: Barbara Burnett
text: Good food and good service

name: Tom Hess
text: Food was good fast service

name: Scott Carlson
text: Good food limited menu

name: Jenny Laufer
text: I have generally liked Iron Skillet. It was the first time at this location. I really love the salad bar, and it is absolutely fantastic they now have the beyond burger! text:
The. Goat. Cheese. Salad. Changed my ever-loving life. It was absolutely incredible. Walnuts, cranberries, this insane balsamic glaze...I will dream of this salad for the rest of my life.
Those are little pads if fried goat cheese, BTW. Little. Pads. Of. Fried. Goat. Cheese. What? So good. Also, bartender Kristina (I'm probably wrong about that, given she made the mules so good...) was fantastic to us. Remember us? My girlfriend loved your new earrings and I said I had hoped you'd make the salad sound as sexy as I had read it on the menu and you totally did. Great experience all around. 🤤🥗

text: Very nice. Delicious food. I would recommend it to others... It was a little expensive, but all steak places in Lake Geniva are by design.

name: Ron Zack
text:
I think everyone who comes to Lake Geneva needs to visit the Tuscan sooner or later, it's just one of those places that is truly memorable.

On my most recent visit, I had a rather conventional meal of prime rib, garlic mashed potatoes, a salad, and tiramisu for desert.  Everything was cooked to perfection, with the glaring exception of the mashed potatoes, which tasted dry, and felt like they were reheated in a microwave, not good.  But the prime rib was OUTSTANDING.   One of the best cooked and seasoned prime rib dinners I've had in years.   As for the tiramisu, it was an extremely generous slice of heaven!   Again, it was some of the best I've had in a long time.   Many thanks to the waiter recommending a shot of espresso to go along with the cake, it was a perfect pairing.    It was so good, I ordered a second slice to go!

The service was top notch, absolutely wonderful.   They actually seem happy that you've come to dine with them!   The restaurant is dark, and relaxing, a perfect atmosphere for a evening meal.

My only complaint is that the wine selection was dominated by California and South American wines, with hardly any Italian selections at all!   Come on guys, a restaurant named "Tuscan" needs to showcase some Italian vino!   Thankfully, they had an excellent Chianti that they sell by the glass, so I was happy.

Really, this place deserves 4.5 stars, not four, but Google reviews doesn't allow for that option.   I was very happy that we stopped here, and I will certainly be coming back again.   RECOMMENDED!

name: Angie Tibbs
text: Felt a little rushed. Face mask is required to enter. That set the mood for dinner since we needed to go back to the car for them! Server seemed rushed. Salad was pre made and left in a cooler, my cucumber was frozen. Chicken parm was burnt a bit.  Really not thinking about coming back, we have not been in for a while.

name: Beth Snyder
text:
This place truly exceeded my expectations! We went here to treat ourselves for our anniversary. We picked Tuscan Tavern & Grill because the food looked great, a little fancy, but completely affordable. They start off by bringing complimentary bread to your table. We got the most delicious spinach artichoke dip as our appetizer, it tasted so fresh! With your entrees you can get soup or salad. And the portion sizes for the entrees are great. We ended with tiramisu for dessert, and this was the best tiramisu I've ever had! We had a very nice waitress (I believe her name was Nicole) and she was incredibly attentive to us. We went on a Friday night, which was of course busy, and she constantly checked in on us. She let us know there was a large party there that backed up the orders in the kitchen a bit, but that was no problem for us because we had to let all the other food settle before our entree. Finally after appetizer, entree, dessert, and drinks for two, our bill only came out to $64. Personally I think that's a great deal for all of that food, the amazing quality, and the exceptional service. As we left, every single employee we walked past made a point to tell us to have a good night, all with a smile on their face and in the friendliest tones. I would highly recommend going here because you're going to love the food and feel like you're the most important person in the world. So glad that we chose this place for our anniversary and we will definitely be returning!
**Edit: they had no idea we were here for our anniversary and still got treated great. Observing our waitress, she was treating all of her tables like this. Clearly how the team is trained there!

I am picky about Alfredo, but their sauce was amazing. Dipping the bread in the sauce is awesome too! Emily was the best server! She was fun and dealt with our craziness wonderfully. The manager (name started with R) stopped by to make sure all was perfect. He was really nice and made the experience a night to remember! So glad we chose this place instead of Popeyes.

text: Good, but not great. Went to Tuscan for an early Valentine's dinner on a Sunday night. The atmosphere was nice and cozy, although not altogether that impressive. Pre-meal we were served warm bread and olive oil, which was tasty. The meals came with soup or salad, the wifes broccoli cheddar soup was quite good, my salad was typical. The alfredo sauce was decent and the noodles were cooked very well. The shrimp were huge and quite good despite having the tails left on (not uncommon,  but I'm not a fan). The chicken was also good. Overall a fine experience and dinner, but I'm not sure we will go there again over Olive Garden. The food seemed similar quality (Olive Garden the clear winner for salad) and the prices were higher, but it is Lake Geneva and most things are a bit pricier.

text: The price and the value of this hotel is perfect for our traveling needs. The room is large and accommodating. Check in with simple and quick. Also didn't like that our bed was located right near the front door. We stayed in a suite, but the layout of the room was odd.  Late 4:00 p.m. check in. Got to be out by 11:00. Our friends stayed at The Grand hotel. Way better for a few extra bucks. Think that's what we're going to stay next time.

Dear Phil,

We are sorry to hear the bed was not to your personal preference of comfort. Our 4pm check-in and 11 am check-out times are standard in the hotel industry. We hope to have you back.

resp.text:
Dear Gloria,

Thank you for your 5 star review and all your great feedback! Please keep us in mind for your next visit.

name: Tori Von Holzen
text:
The Cove was great for our weekend getaway! It was right on the outskirts of the downtown area for an easy walk to all the local stores. It was also right across the street from the lake for a walk around the lake of you wanted.

We stayed in the studio style room. The bed wasn't what I had asked for. (We asked for a King and got a Double) However; it was a small mishap that didn't ruin out stay.

Covid procedures were present and not over the top. They just asked to be wearing a mask when not in your private room.

We would recommend The Cove to anyone wanting to stay at Lake Geneva and we would use them again if we ever went back.

Thank you The Cove for a wonderful weekend.

resp.text:
Dear Tori Von Holzen,

Thank you very much for your excellent 5 star review and feedback regarding our our well appointed suites, the safety measures we've taken during these challenging times and our close proximity to everything hat is Lake Geneva. Please keep us in mind for your next visit.

Out dated finishes and certainly could use a coat of paint. Showers had rust in side. Carpet was worn out. Very disappointing with the amount of money spent for the room.

resp.text:
Dear Dubuquerp4,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We are continuously working on updating our resort and facilities. We hope to have you back as our guest in the future.

name: Mona Jimenez-Jaimes
text: Very noisy, you can hear guests non stop walking upstairs or walking down hallway. Downside on having a kitchen, if a guests burns something it will stink your room, thats what happened to us last night. It took a while until the stinky smoke dissipated. We were woken up by a sound of door opening and closing.

resp.text:
Dear Mona,

Thank you for your review and feedback.

name: Hollie Kollmansberger
text: So nice and a beautiful beautiful hotel. Very nice staff and the indoor pool is great! Roxie at the front desk is so nice and helped us out when we needed help...

name: Paula Borokhim
text: We stayed there for the two days, the place is very convenient located, spacious rooms with everything! Quiet at night, for a good sleep. Just great.

name: Taylor Haile
text: Absolutely lovely hotel in a great location! huge pool, Bath & Body Works toiletries in the bathroom, gorgeous rooms. We had a great time with our family swimming, playing on the arcade, enjoying the gorgeously decorated spacious room. Made awesome new memories with our kids and family. Will most definitely be back again and again

name: Ron Rick
text: The Cove was incredible.  We really enjoyed our stay. The rooms were very spacious with  separate kitchen, living room,  and bedroom areas. We had a balcony overlooking the pool.  The hotel had indoor and outdoor pools, a kiddy pool , game room, fitness room, WiFi,  and restaurant.  Was our first time here and we'll definitely be going back.

name: Carolyn Anderson
text: They need to clean their Rooms better, sheets were gross, no hand soap, patio door was gross !

resp.text:
Dear Carolyn,

We have addressed your comments and hope you will give us another opportunity.

name: Toy King
text: Great room! Loved the stay. Will be back!!

name: Karen Harshbarger
text: Nice lobby area with coffee bar and pool areas. Both studio suites we rented were sadly less than suitable: very dated dirty decor, dirty rugs, deep dirt areas in bathrooms and tubs, broken screen doors, dirty outdoor furniture & balcony area, missing blinds, unworkable remote, light bulbs out, broken garbage disposal, dirty mirrors, dusty areas, dirty dishes in cabinet, did not seem sanitized during covid as I had to re-clean and dirt was removed. No mattress pad on beds - just a sheet thrown over mattress (untucked) - desk said “not their responsibility”but each condo owners...? I accepted their response and said I would leave feedback for 114 and 116. WiFi did not work on first floor. Unfortunately we won’t be staying again, expensive  nightly rate $200+ for what we received.

resp.text:
Dear Karen,

Thank you for your feedback. We are continuously working on updating our accommodations and hope to have you back as our guest.

name: GachaWolfie
text: We had such a lovely evening from a delicious dinner and drinks and friendly people! Swimming and fitness was very energizing thanks! A very clean and nice hotel!

name: Dan Gelfand
text: Best location if you want to explore the doentown area.

name: Suzanne Meyering

text: I booked a room here thinking it was just a simple hotel room. For the same price, actually cheaper, as any other hotel in the area I ended up getting an entire Suite with a full kitchen, big hot tub, living room, and a bedroom. Granted the hot tub was pretty dirty on the controls, but considering the price I pay for the room and how big it was I'll still rate it 5 stars. The staff was extremely friendly too.

name: Jack Slaughter
text: Nice room. I was surprised to see a kitchen and fireplace.

name: Jessica Sheridan
text: The room was a great value for the price we paid. The interior looks like it was recently updated and was clean and well kept, and the staff was friendly and helpful. It was really nice to have a good restaurant (Sprecher's) and bar located on the premises as well. The pool was well-stocked with towels (a rarity at many hotels and resorts), and there is even a 24-hour gift/snack shop.

name: Robert Rouille
text:
Love it ! Park the car and walk everywhere
.. great staff... and very clean...can get pricey, but shop for deals

name: Julia Hillman
text: Cove has a great program for investors purchasing units for personal use and as rental income.  As a realtor, it is one of my favorites to suggest to clients looking for a get-away and get-paid to enjoy! The facilities are great and you cannot do better at this price point and location while enjoying Lake Geneva all within walking distance.

name: Corrine McGonagle
text: Great little getaway. Cant wait to spend another weekend away.  Loved the staff, and all the amenities.

name: ZT Dobs
text: Very out of date and the internet was extremely bad.  Be ready to pay for internet fees and parking upon arriving, amongst other fees "not charged online".  We called ahead of time and asked if there was an oven and a stove in our suite, which they confirmed yes there was.  We planned our meals around that and got here, only to find just a stove top.  While this is a very family friendly (kids loved the pool and hot tub) establishment, fairly priced and everything is walkable, I will opt to stay somewhere else next time.

name: William Loeper
text: Definitely dated....  Heater in our room Kept tripping the breaker and shutting off.  Luckily the Fireplace was working.  But beside that the room was super clean and ready to go.

name: Carol Sallmann
text:
A very busy place with lots of "families" ..coolers, strollers, etc.  Had to wait until 6pm to checkin...4 pm was promised when we arrived at noon... Place was clean and a nice 1 bed condo.. surprised at how nice it was!! Worth the wait.  Front desk gave us 2 drink tickets for our inconvenience...

Pool area was well maintained. Enjoyed outdoor hot tub.. however rules about unsupervised kids and no under 6 were not enforced.  Made it a bit of a playland versus a relaxing experience..

name: Rose D
text: Horrible! Between the room rate, taxes, and resort fee, we paid $225 for one night in a one room king suite. There was no division between the kitchen/living area and the bed. The room was quite run down. The blinds were broken and there were a couple of spots where they did not come together. Not very good for privacy. The bathroom had cracks in the walls and ceiling. The jet tub fit one person. And the tv did not work. I called the desk and they sent a maintenance man who spent 30 minutes fixing it and he was very nice but it was a bit of an intrusion on our evening. And at that we had to use 2 separate remotes. There was no offer to change rooms or give any sort of discount, not that we were asking for anything, but one might think for the money that was dished out they might care a little more about customer satisfaction. We will never go back and would not recommend it to anyone. On the contrary, I would tell anyone interested in staying in Lake Geneva to go elsewhere.

name: Fred Lechuga
text: Bed is small for an adult couple pillows are way too soft to be comfortable for sleeping.  The family room area was nice but lighting was extremely dark for a big room. I wish the TVS were newer or better quality. The good news is this place is walking distance from all the restaurants, bars and the lake. Sprechers bar and restaurant that is downstairs and next door is pretty good too.

name: Sarang Kang
text: Cute expensive place to spend the night. Rooms are individually owned so furniture is unpredictable.

name: Karl Henk
text: Beautiful grounds and fantastic rooms and staff is super accommodating. Will be back soon.

name: Ricky White
text: This place is great. Pool is decent size. Rooms are clean and modern. Nice whirlpool tubs. It's affordable and centrally located downtown, within walking distance of most attractions. If you find a deal on groupon, the deal is even better.

name: Matthew Blake
text: Located right across from the Lake it doesn't get much better. The suite we stayed in was very nice. The rooms was extremely spacious. The service is spot on as well. The only downfall was the extremely small TV. I'd say it was a 27 inch.other then that perfect.

name: Denny
text: The location is excellent. The Sprecher’s restaurant delivers food to the room. It’s a great place for drinks and dine in too. We had the queen suite. It had a beautiful view. Well stocked kitchen with dishwasher also. The hotel is surrounded with good eateries so everyone’s food needs are met. Shops like Best Buy, TJ Mx are not far away.

name: David Green
text: The suite was a bit pricey however very large. The room was very clean although a tad bit dated. The pool area was very nice and not overly crowded. The fitness gym was somewhat lacking but had enough for me to get through most of my workout. Parking was a bit difficult but it was an extremely busy weekend and I was able to park eventually. All in all it was a very good experience and I would recommend it

name: Bobby Jackson
text: We went back in November 2016 and had a difficult time with an unruly guest that was above our room. So bad that we ended up leaving that night. The people at the front desk were aware of our situation and referred us to the manager of the hotel, Juan Ramirez. He took excellent care of us by giving us an opportunity to come back another time for free to make up for our lost night that we had to leave. They gave us an excellent room and we had a wonderful night this time around. The service and care of the whole front desk team was wonderful. Juan was particularly great to work with. There was no issue when we made our reservation to come back. The information was all there about our past experience and our comped room. The unruly guest was not their fault but they took care of our situation as if it was. We would highly recommend The Cove

text: Nice clean facility. Love the town

name: Scott Bunker

name: Marny Gamble
text: The resort is beautiful. It has a restaurant attached to it which is convenient. Many shops are within walking distance. If you stay here make sure your room is not close to the elevators. My one complaint is that people do not respect the quiet hours that begin at 11pm.

Of the multifloor conference facility there were only restrooms on the first floor. Rooms were either hot or cold, no in between. Staff was friendly. Beautiful location with a lot to do in the area.

text:
Wonderful employees ,very friendly and nice.

Monica at the front desk is awesome ,such a friendly person ,always with a smile and good recommendation.  It is clean, staff is really great!

name: Irene Ramirez
text: Great Stay.... Juan, Bri, Faith, Julie the Cove security and Housekeeping we say Thank You for the Great service, a clean room and another fantastic New Years and Birthday stay. (year #11) The COVE is the best place to relax as a couple and/or with the kids. The swimming pool and Lofts are always well maintained, the location is very close to the shopping area. The Cove is a Excellent winter get away!!

That Saturday night we were kept awake by drunken guest's in courtyard by the pool as well as the extremely intoxicated woman in room directly over ours who's enjoyed screaming profanity out on her balcony. I assure you we won't return, EVER.

name: Tim Packard
text: While the staff is always very friendly (5 stars for the staff), recent management changes are quite apparent. This store could take some advice from a few other stores and do better numbers by moving more of their donated items out the door faster, instead of holding out for top dollar. This store used to be one of the best but nearly every time I stop in lately, I'm greeted by overpriced items with an ebay printout taped to it, showing what it could sell for on ebay. Well, this isn't ebay. While I do think I see a fair share if ebay sellers shopping there, it isn't as simple as "buy and flip" for them. Once they find an item with some meat left on the bone, they still have to clean, test (if applicable), photo and list that item (incurring a listing fee). Then after it sells, they have to package and ship. From whatever the profit may be, they still have 10% ebay fees, 3% paypal fees, cost to ship and cost of shipping supplies. Goodwill management, these resellers are not getting rich off your donated items so quit ruining it for the rest of us by getting greedy thinking that the resellers are making big money off you. They're not, and for most, it's just a little hobby. I'd like to be able to come there and find things my family needs at decent prices again, not at regular retail prices or higher...and stop blaming the resellers for the insane price increases. It's not their fault, it's "young hotshot" managers thinking they're so smart. Quit wasting time looking everything up online and start moving the inventory we donate out the door faster. Take a look at the few stores in the region with the highest income and go see how it's done correctly.

name: JC Mountain
text: Wife and I are doing a overnight trip a few hours from home. This was the first time we ate in a restaurant in a year. You can reserve a separate room, which we did. The food was excellent. Service was good. The place itself is a interesting old house. They are currently adding an outdoor area.

name: Da-Wang Wu
text: The take-out system was very easy to use, and it takes <15 minutes to have our food ready for pickup - impressive! The spring roll was not properly wrapped, making it a bit messy when we removed the plastic wrapper. The red curry with chicken was pretty good. The chicken wings were not too bad but slightly dry and a bit undercooked in 1-2 pieces of them. The rice ball salad was disappointing to be very salty and not really crispt. Overall, it’s just an okay experience.

name: Michael Showalter
text:
I really wanted to like this place because I love Thai food. And it's close to being great, with a couple of glaring exceptions that cost a star each.
The food was good. My wife had the Pad Thai and she said it was OK. I had a Godzilla roll which was awesome, but first I ordered the Pad Ki Mao (Drunken Noodles), which tasted great but is also where we run into the first problem.
First Problem: I asked if I could order the Pad Ki Mao (Drunken Noodles) without bell pepper and the waitress assured me that all dishes were made fresh so it would be no problem. As I'm sure you've guessed by now, it came with bell peppers visibly obvious on the top. I sent it back instantly since bell peppers really mess with my stomach. So the waitress shows back up with my "new" dish about 5 minutes later. I'm skeptical, but okay, there are no obvious peppers.  So I take about six or seven bites and what do I find? More peppers. I stop eating and eventually have to go looking for the waitress. At this point I just order a different dish (the Godzilla roll) which has no peppers to begin with. The waitress swears up and down they remade my noodles, but that seems unlikely to me. And that leads us to the second problem.
Second Problem: the service was lackluster. After getting my order wrong, the waitress was more interested in telling me how they didn't do anything wrong instead of telling me what she was going to do to make sure it was going to be right.
Summary: with some focus on service and attention to detail, this restaurant could be great.

name: I D
text: This place left me with mixed feelings.  Appetizers and sushi roll were great and freshly made but a main course....The noodle soup I have ordered Mama Tom Tum Noodles was a totally disappointment....instant noodles and raw mushrooms...not what I expected.  Good think the two desserts they offered were yummy and allowed to forget about main course fiasco.

name: Dianna Moua
text: The restaurant is very cute. The server was very attentive and nice. We had the spicy Thai chicken, pho, and Tiger Cried Beef. They had a lot of different selections from sushi to curry to fusion-style entres. The beef and chicken were very good but a bit salty with the sauce. The pho had a light base and was tasty but lacked additional items to add to it. Overall, a good place to eat.

Unfortunately, they currently have an issue with staffing. We waited for 45 minutes AFTER our scheduled time. That is unacceptable.
During our wait, it was very apparent that one particular waitress had a pretty bad attitude. She was snarky and short towards other staff members right in front of customers. You could feel the tension in the air. Pretty unprofessional, and totally unnecessary behavior. You just can't act like that in a nice restaurant. Perhaps a 24 hr truckstop diner would be a better fit.
Give it a chance, the food is good enough to warrant a visit. Be prepared to wait for a seat.

We get to the bar and a lady asked what she could get us my husband and I out in our drink request and asked for menus so we could just see what they had for food as we’ve never been here before. The bartender argued with him and bickered said we didn’t need menus because we have a server however he tried to explain that no one has came to help us that’s why we came up and ordered our drinks. The lady( didn’t catch her name but she had a very strong jaw line) kept trying to bicker about it and all my husband asked was for menus. So I spoke up and said that’s not a problem. However we’ve been here for however king and would like to see the menu can we have our drinks and a couple menus. I’m not asking you to take my order. She was less than thrilled n shoved them at me. The only reason this place is getting a 5 star review is the server we had. Oh my goodness was she amazing. She was literally the sweetest, most kind and attentive server we have ever had. She joked around with us as well and she was just a joy. I didn’t catch her name but she was a little older with short brown hair and glasses. She should be a supervisor her customer service was so above par it was amazing

name: Jason Bloch
text:
We have been going to this resort yearly for the last 5 years. It has its pros and cons. We have been tent campers but we will reconsider for next year.

The bathrooms are very old and need to be updated. We have tent camped at so many other campgrounds that have nice shower facilities that you can adjust water temp, and the fixtures are nice and in order, and even family restrooms. When you put your money in the shower here you should expect to be scalded and water to spray everywhere, including the walls and ceiling. You should then expect the lights to turn off halfway through your shower and leave you in the dark with scalding water spraying everywhere. Other times the water will be cold and the lights might stay on.

Some of the RV sites are perched on top of the full hook up septic tanks. At peak hours of the day, youll get an unpleasent odor when sitting around the fire near these sites by the playground.

Plenty of activities to keep the kids busy, which is what brings our family back.
Convenient store usually has everything you need instock.

Tube rentals and river shuttles are very reasonable, with a wait list on busy days that will call you if they have cancelations.

name: Chad Caso
text:
I normally go back pack camping, because I go camping for solitude. However, this trip I went to relax, and that's what I did! The staff here is wonderful, and EXTREMELY willing to help.

The facilities were above standard. I mean, they have portapotties like any other campground, but there are also brick sheltered toilet buildings and showers, and of course they have bathrooms in their main building. I used the portas and the brick building, both were bug free and did not stink. I don't have to worry about anything nasty getting on me at all, so I felt comfortable with the most taboo part of camping.

I did tubing and mini golf, and the mini golf was included with our stay! I do plan to return soon; I am very interested in renting a cabin on the lake and to eat at their restaurant.

When I booked the site, I called and made reservations on the phone. I was able to do a late arrival with a morning check in. There wasn't a rush for me to get into the office, because I was able to pay over the phone as well. I wasn't harassed to wake up and sign in, at all. I woke up and did my morning hygiene, and then I went to the office. They had my info ready and quickly gave a receipt and car tag for parking. No vehicle and license plate form to fill out, which I liked.

The firewood usually goes fast, so I bought 3 bundles. I used 1 bundle a night, and the fire wood burned nice and slow! Adequate for cooking and light.

Since I arrived late, I was missing a picnic table at my camp site; apparently another camper boosted it from me. I've seen it happen, and I wasn't too upset. I let the staff know when I checked in, because i definitely needed a food preparation area. Within a half an hour I had a picnic table, I'm not even joking. I didn't have to harass anyone or feel like an a-- to get the accommodations I paid for. The staff also did not seem one bit bothered by my request, they were happy to help. And there were plenty of staff to help!

Bugs were not bad. I had spray, but that never usually helps. I got bit by mosquitos maybe 3 times the whole weekend, because my big spray was non existent after tubing. Bugs were a big issue at this place, despite the close access to the river. I never saw a tick.

I cannot say enough good things. My experience was great, and I WILL be back soon.

P.S. They also had ice cream!
