name: Steve Schmitt
text: CLICK ON USERNAME FOR FULL REVIEW.  Upon arrival, we were given a campsite that was way too small. We had an RV and two tents. We were told over the phone that we'd be given "the biggest site" and that we'd all fit. No problem. We get there and there is only room for the RV. We go to the front office and explain to the owner what we were told and they would accommodate us but "everything would have to be changed". Alright, no big deal, they'll make it work. We set up and see the owner creeping passed our campsite. The owner explained we'll "need to pay more money" and that "it's against a state law to have too many people on one site".  But I guess that law is waived if we pay you more?  Right.  He's biggest concern is the RV owners who spend a ton of money here and don't want to be disturbed by the "little people" who camp for 2 times a summer, if that. And apparently 6 people (two tents and an RV) was too many. This was clearly a miscommunication on the part of the resort which they should have owned up to and made it right, instead of whining about it and asking for more money. The owner also explained he'll have to avoid putting other people by us (Rich RV owners) since we are going to be too loud. We are a younger crowd but have never gotten out of hand. He also explained that “there are sites booked next to us and people are definitely going to be camping near us and he'll get complaints". FYI, no one ever booked sites by us and we were fine.  The owner should learn some customer service skills and own up to his resort's miscommunications and shortcomings instead of being such a snake about it. I've never encountered a business owner so rude to customers. It seems to be a common theme among the reviews on here. . .

resp.text: Thank you for your review.  At Wisconsin Riverside Resort, our rules clearly state on our website that an RV site is for a camper and 1 small tent, 2 adults and 3 children, with extra adults at $5 per person per night.  Your group arrived and set up 2 large tents along with your camper, 6 adults and 3 vehicles.  Immediately after telling you in the office that only 1 tent was allowed, you went to the site and set the 2 big tents up.  We did not charge you for the extra cars on the site.  I thought that we were quite fair in not making you pay for another site as which anyone who reads our camp rules would have done.   We enforce the camp rules for the safety and enjoyment of all of our customers and I am sorry you are upset with us for that.  Thank you.

text: While this is a must see for many FLLW fans, I have to say that it was my least favorite so far. While the house is nice and our guide was fantastic, the 4 hour tour was a bit long. I always opt for the most in-depth/longest tour they offer and the longest I have done in the past was 3 hours which was always a good length, however 4 hours was a bit much. I am sure part of the reason it is so long is that we walked all over the grounds, which I enjoyed, and I think the tour is this long to make sure everyone can handle the walk. But I also felt that we lingered longer than necessary in some areas. I still recommend visiting Taliesin, but maybe not doing the 4 hour tour.

name: Lawrence Tom
text:
If you like Frank Lloyd Wright stuff, you have to visit the Mother Ship. I took just the House tour and that was perfect for me since I am not a super fan but wanted to see some of his designs.
The tour is well laid out and it starts with the waterfall and only gets better.
After seeing The House on the Rock and now this, I am wondering why are all the ceiling so low. But again this makes modern homes boring and plain.
There are interesting features and details everywhere. My only quibble is the extensive use of modern materials of the time, plywood. Plywood is not a good durable material and doesn't last long and it is easy to see that the preservation society has a lot of work ahead of it.
Fun tour and highly recommend setting aside a couple of hours.

text: We were invited to a wedding reception here, and the service was extremely slow.  Dinner took from 5 through 8 to serve.  instead of having everything ready and bring it out at once, their service was staggered over the whole stretch of time.  Kids were wailing...  cake didn't get cut till after 9 or so, and a lot of people had started to leave already.  The actual food was decent, but servings of vegetables were pathetically small.  5 green beans doesn't make a portion.  My pasta primavera didn't have a lot of vegetables either, even though that's the focus of the dish.  Unless they change things, don't get your event catered here.  They get 2 stars only because of the taste of the entrees.  Everything else was deplorable.

I lost a day of work because of it,  and when I called to ask that my room be reimbursed,  all they offered was a $50 credit on my next stay.  I asked to be contacted by corporate,  and I am still waiting for a response.  Not pleased with how the staff has handled this. text: November and heat was pre set to 70. We sleep in 62 degrees every night at home so we turned temp down at 5pm (can't open a window on this hotel) A/C never kicked on (must be disabled this time of year?) And temp never got below 72*F. Finally at midnight we decided we would rather drive home 1.5hrs in a snow storm than try to sleep in that heat. They had no knowledge of the heating not/cooling system and no maintenance personnel was there (on a weekend, wow).. They offered a new room but I knew it would be the same deal so we rejected. We we're told to call Monday to speak to a manager about a refund. After playing phone tag for two days the best they could do was 20% off the room - we spent less than two hour occupying the room total (checked in at 5:30pm then checked out at 11:45pm).  Our stay was due to a foster care fund raiser event in the building so I guess we already got the tiny room "cheap" at $109 a night with one king bed tiny room tiny tv and a bathroom. No mini fridge, no Bible, no complimentary breakfast of any kind. TV worked terrible jumpy and loading all the time and internet speeds were under 1meg down and .25meg up.

name: Petero H
text:
The loaded baked potato soup stole the show for me. It made me want to come back and get it again. I enjoyed my veggie wrap but it didn’t even compare to the soup.

The loaded tots aren’t on the menu anymore but you can still request it. I enjoy the thickness of the cheese sauce and the flavor it packs. There’s a hint of sweetness from the beer.

name: Karoline Bakemeyer
text: World of Beer like it's name suggests has an unrivaled selection of various beer, ciders and other libations. The selection changes which means there is always something new to try out. The food is great! I always like to order the giant pretzel to share with friends. Great atmosphere and occasional live music. This spot never disappoints for a fun night out.

name: Jim Burgraff
text: Nice place, great beer selection and good food.  Nice place to hang out with friends.

name: Czar Mann
text: Good food ... plenty of beer to choose from !

name: Lucas Duffey
text: Cheese curds are really tasty. Really good beer selection and wings.

name: Daniel Annear
text: World of beer is the best, a bunch of beer on tap and tons of beer to purchase if want to head home with something special. The waitresses and bartenders were very nice and helpful. We ordered some food and we're very surprised how delicious it was. We will definitely be coming back very soon. Love this place

name: Chris Kettner
text:
Cannot post without leaving at least 1 star - On 01/09/20 we ordered appetizers - fair crowd.  The female bartender was terrible - no silverware, no plates no napkins.  The young man - he was new; was great - he got us what we needed to eat.  Then my tip amount was changed - by $1 - might not be much but add $1 to every credit card run that night - that adds up.  Spoke to Meg the manager a few times... 7-10 days she said for the return of the $1 - I told her I wanted to see my original receipt - said I was coming up there to get it.  We had a snow storm - I asked Meg to take a picture of the receipt and text it to me.
Nope - that never happened and she seemed to get more annoyed with me when I called - well we way past  7-10 days (01/22/2020) and no refund has hit my account.  I am not going to call again and be treated rudely - I am going to write this review and say Good Bye to Ferches - Staff was so much better when it was World of Beers - Watch your credit card charges people.. $1 might not be noticed by you..

name: Grace Zawatka
text: The beer was Good.  The philly was filling.  The dip was a little bland and a bit greasy.  The fries were ok could of used some seasoning.  The cheese could of been creamier.  Overall though a nice lunch.

name: Matthew Skidmore
text: Previously World of Beer. Same great owner and knowledgeable staff. Very impressive selection + kitchen. Honestly, cannot recommend a better place for beer connoisseurs.

name: Michael Wanta
text: Nice menu, good atmosphere.  Beer was delicious, food was hot and tasty.  Our waitron was very good. It happened to be trivia night.  We stayed longer and had fun!!!

name: Paul Rudolph
text:
Pretty great beer place. Very "chain like", but a decent choice with pretty good food. My girlfriend did note that in her veggie wrap there was only a tiny bit of hummus at the bottom of each end if the wrap. The beer selection is huge.

The staff was very friendly. The place is clean, except at the front is a display case that seems to be forgotten and is rather dusty.

name: Michael Mack
text: This is the old World of Beers. Same place with a different name. Always a good option for lunch and beer variety is still great.

name: Trisha Kawula
text: Amazing food! Had the pbj wings. Omg amazing. Also the beer cheese tater tots I could eat every day! Also service was amazing!

resp.text: So thrilled you had an amazing time with us, Trisha! From the food to the service, I'm happy to hear everything was a hit with you, and we appreciate all the support. Hope we'll be seeing you around the neighborhood soon! Take care. -Alisha S. Customer Service Manager

name: Courtney Ronning
text: Flights are reasonably priced and tons of beers to choose from.

name: Dan K
text: Only stopped in for a quick beer to kill time between events, but service was fast and friendly.  I love the big beer list and outdoor patio.  Great place to watch the Brewers blow a late lead.  Ugh.

name: Stephanie Kronenburg
text: Not only is the beer selection amazing and the food is delicious, the GM is awesome! ;) Come hangout or book your next party today!

name: Marco Briceno
text: They use to be better. There are other places that have a bigger beer selection and better food. It's good but it's not on my top 10 choices when I crave a beer.

name: Michelle L.
text: Such a great night. Really fun staff, Becky was so awesome. I would go back. We enjoyed the flatbread and pizza.

name: gleason345
text: Beer selection is pretty awesome, WOB changes the variety of beers on tap weekly!  They also have a plethora of bottled beers from around the world, except for Red Stripe, which is kind of disappointing to me.  Food's decent, service is good, sometimes great, depending on the server.  I recommend that you should check it out if your a craft beer drinker.

name: Steve Schmechel
text: Great place. Staff was really friendly and helpful. Unique specials and ways to sample a lot of different beers. Street taco appetizers were terrific.

name: michael krohn
text: I'm very impressed with this place. Very clean, very brightly lit. They have more selections for drinks than most places I have been to. The bartender was very friendly and very helpful. I only had a drink, but I'll definitely be coming back to try their food. It looked really good.

name: Cindy Bucci
text: Always a great beer selection.  Need more Belgium beers on tap.

name: Adam Mortensen
text: Love the trivia they host. Great food for a great price too.

name: Daniel Finn
text: It's now called Ferch's, but same menu. Great food and strong beer selection. Staff has always been friendly.

name: Emily R
text: Great selection of beer. They also have some games for entertainment

name: Chuck Wiggy
text: Great beer selection and good food. Lots of good craft beer choices.

name: Laurie Walvisch
text: Good selection of beer. Really bad PA system. We went specifically for trivia and it was near impossible to hear the questions.

name: Jason Rendel
text:
Came on Sunday. Sat at two tables ordered at the same time and one table was served 30minutes earlier than the other. When we asked about the discrepancy and voiced frustration since there were only 5 tables seated the waiter said “ok”.

The food is good the beer menu is extensive, the service is atrocious.

name: Sylver Slusar
text: Try the loaded Tater Tot appetizer. Very Yummy! Our waitress was attentive & very sweet!

name: Michelle Roux
text: One of my new favorite places! Large variety of beers and food. They don't just serve beer. Really reasonable prices.

name: Chella Bhagyam
text: Good nachos, good beer, lots of choice. Sample if you are unsure of what to get a glass of.

name: Mister Rodriguez
text: Great selection of beers.  The appetizers are excellent.  Small but good ambience.  The parking is challenging and the entrance is very inconvenient.

name: brian wolf
text: Soooooo many craft beers.  If you like beer this is the place for you.

name: Ashley Grau
text: If you are a beer lover, this is the place for you. They have samplers, flights, and pints. You can experience different beers from all over the world on a constantly changing drink menu. World of Beer provides a low-key, social atmosphere with lounging space and tables. The food is fantastic and so is the staff!

name: VIOLA ERVIN
text: Nice Belgian beer selection. LOVE the fruit cocktail beer. Staff is always great and knowledgeable!

name: Joe Thorstensen
text: Good food, great beer, friendly service.

name: WTF_yada!
text: This place may JUST be my new fave​ spot. They have a great laid back atmosphere. Came at happy hour with a few friends. Ordered everything on the happy hour menu. Especially loved the tavern tots. Yummy. They have board games, which I have NEVER seen.lol. how fun! Played a little scrabbled and enjoyed some great live music! If you guys haven't been, please go! The staff are fast and friendly. Definitely will be returning.

name: Michael Sippy
text: Very good deal for food. Not expensive at all. Service is great

name: Angela Murray
text: Our waiter Kelly was adorable efficient and friendly. My burger was delicious I would get it again

name: Benjamin There
text: Kinda new , could use some work . But not bad .

name: Brooke Pinar
text: If you want to sit and watch a game and drink beer, it's a decent place. Not many vegetarian options and the hummus was nothing special. Wouldn't order again. Go for happy hour.

name: Jared Feder
text: Wide selection of beer and good food. I wish that they had their beer on Untappd rather than their own app. Great place that I would definitely recommend though.

name: Ted Beschta II
text: Our server, Thomas, helped us pick out some great beers. He provided top notch service. The beer was great, and the atmosphere was just as good. I couldn't recommend it enough!

resp.text:
High-five, Ted! We're always happy to point you in the right direction. Hope to see you for another beer soon!

Cheers,
Alisha S., Customer Service Manager

name: Ally Marie
text: Yuck. Ordered some food last night and it was awful. Wings were gross and the burger was only cooked enough to be editable. Tacos were okay.. completely messes up your stomach though. Overall skip this place. You can do better

name: Heather
text: Exceptional hospitality!

name: Suzanne Potochich-Weigel
text: Excellent service from Leah..good food choices, decent beer choices, clean..all around good experience.

name: Marie Bruskiewicz
text: Great live entertainment. Stopped for a couple of beers and a cocktail. Nice change that a beer place also has a couple of cocktails to choose from. Not to badly priced, also had the carmel cookie with ice cream.

name: Tony Novinska
text: The food is excellent here, especially the Sunday Brunch!  Love it!

name: H. Michael Shoulders
text: Outstanding place, great options. Good food and conversation.

name: Elaina Neas
text: I enjoy the huge selection they have and the staff is incredibly friendly! I'd definitely return. Best place to try new beers and the food is delicious.

name: Mike P
text: Good food and a good beer selection. I took my parents and my mom accidentally left her credit card and the staff were very nice and helpful when we had to go back and get it.

name: Ken Krall
text: Perfect place to try a beer you've never had. We didn't have food, but a lot of items were tempting. Good attentive service.

name: Nathan Buckley
text: Visited for happy hour and taco Tuesday. Everything thing was great. They had a big selection of beer and the tacos where really good for happy hour bar food. Staff was attentive and friendly.

name: Peter L
text: This place is incredible and I love it. Good food. Good beer. Good everything

name: Peter Walter
text: The food was good, and the service was great, but my Corona could have been colder

name: Matthew Miller
text: Great place to hang out. I wish they carried High Life though.

name: Dave Berenson
text: Pretty damn good food. Excellent rotating beer selection, servers know about pairings and tasting notes.

name: BILLY FOX
text: Great atmosphere & great service

name: John Ahrens
text: Good selection of beer here that is always changing and the food is good also. Love stopping here with by buddies!

name: btophek
text: They have all kinds of beer from everywhere.

name: Kathleen Anderson
text: Easy to find. Great beer selections. Good is excellent also. Check the website for when they have bands. Outdoor patio with heaters also.

name: Nate Forseth
text: I had a good time here. The staff was very patient and friendly.

name: Ajith M K
text: Good beer collection from the tap, excellent Irish breakfast drink

name: Kyle Milligan
text: Good food, good beer, good atmosphere. What more could you ask for.

name: Adam Clausen
text: Awesome taco special on Tuesdays. And good beer (obviously)

name: Codie Vassar
text: Excellent beer selection and service!

name: John Budish, Jr.
text: Great beer selection. Really solid food that is beyond the typical bar fare.  Try them out.

name: Justin S
text: Awesome joint. Nuff said.

name: Douglas Kramer
text: Great building! nice and open to their covered patio.  It has nice tables and chairs and couches.  HUGE beer selection and pretty good food.  My chicken sandwich was a little overcooked, but it could've been saved if they had put the chipotle sauce on the chicken instead of on the bun.  The waitress was really nice, and helpful.  I was able to bring my dog and they had a water bowl for him.

resp.text:
Douglas, we're so glad you could come by with your pup! It's great to hear you enjoyed hanging out, but I apologize the sandwich was lacking a little. Please know, we're always happy to get those kinds of things fixed on the spot if we're made aware! We'd love to make it right on your next visit, and we hope we can look forward to welcoming you back soon. Cheers!

Warmly,
Christina, T., Customer Service Manager

name: Katie Smith
text: Stopped here for the first time recently. They have a HUGE selection of beers, both domestic and imports. Huge selection of beers on tap as well. They also have drinks for those who aren't beer drinker as well. The food was fantastic too! Definitely recommend the tacos. Service was great too! Nice patio area. There is hammerschlagen outside. While we were there on a Friday we saw a pretzel eating contest, a contest of who could hold a Stein full of water out in front of them the longest, and live music. Had a good time and will definitely return.

name: David Forde
text: A great selection of beer. If you want to try something new this is the place.

name: Beer Sultan
text: Had some really good appetizers for a dinner. A little loud, but it's a bar. Great selection of beers obviously.

name: brian fowler
text: The world of beer is gone. They are rebranding but they still have the same great selection of beer.

name: Loren Griffith
text: Waiting (and waiting) for the bill is the worst. No offer for refill on soda. Hummus plate was VERY forgettable at best. Pretzel was good as was beer cheese and mustard. Tacos were meh. Big sign for Sam Adams... But they have none. Overall will not repeat this experience. Wrote this. Still waiting for Bill despite having the rest of my party leave long ago.

name: Maya George
text:
First time coming here, building was freezing and the music was so loud I could not hear our server and wasn't able to ask questions about drink specials.
Turned out it was ladies night with really good deals, I'd already ordered 2 drinks so I missed out.

I wouldn't choose to go back but I would if I needed to?

name: Ryan Tengowski
text: The staff are awesome! Our server was super cool and very knowledgeable. Great environment. Will definitely be coming back here!

name: Mark Sansait
text: Damn good beer selection with service to boot. Food is passable, but the variety of drinks they have more than overcomes this.

name: David McSpadden
text: Lots of beer selections and  knowledgeable friendly staff

name: Jon Koelsch
text: Shrimp tacos were great.

name: Angi Pochinski
text: Hard place to find  parking for an after work gig, seating is adequate with heated outside seating. The service was great, my suggestion would be to sear clear of the mac and cheese,  tasts like cardboard.

name: Ledora Townsend
text: I went there with my granddaughter she likes the taco I don't drink beer.

name: Elder JediMaster
text:
Pretty nice layout and location.
Parking can be a bit difficult to get during business hours. You might have to go around down the block and park on the street (safe neighborhood).
Knocking one-half star off for corporate treatment. Their customer service isn't very helpful at all.
As always, drink prices are a little on the premium side, so another half-star off for that. Happy hour prices aren't too bad. I would skip the food there, although it really isn't that bad, and go to Mo's across the street though!

name: Ben K
text: Hey, know what would be great?  If a place that had an enormous amount of beer also served amazing bar far and an even more amazing brunch with bottomless bloody mary's.  Oh, wait.  This place has that.  Waitstaff can sometimes leave a bit to be desired, but not to the point where I'd downgrade any stars.  I mean, it's called "World of Beer".

resp.text:
Ben, it's great to hear the beer selection knocked it out of the park for you! We're so glad you enjoy spending time here, and we're determined to show you our best on your next visit. Thanks for taking some time to spread the word! Until next time -- cheers.
-Christina, T., Customer Service Manager

name: Lee Thomas
text: Nice craft beer selection.

name: Jackie Leon
text: I'm always pleasantly surprised at how good the food is here considering it's a sports bar with no real obligation to feed you well.

name: Talea Bloom
text:
Attentive staff.
Knowledgeable about beer selections,  clean and cool vibe.
Great outdoor area.  Of course who wouldn't like the garage door open to the patio?

resp.text: So glad you enjoy spending time here, Talea -- thank you for the kind words! Hope we can look forward to welcoming you back for a beer soon. Cheers! -Alisha S. Customer Service Manager

name: charlie reitz
text: First time there. Very good service.

name: Gregory Wolski
text: Its ok, has a great selection of beer. I'd stop there. The atmosphere is pretty lame, full of typical people who are overly full of themselves. Needs a better crowd.

name: Sean Gilmartin
text: Beer list is good but they can't tell you what they have in the cooler, you need to download the app. Kind of pricey.

name: J S
text: Great beers, fantastic service, huge burgers.

name: Megan Creech
text: Had a great night out! Wasn't super packed for a Saturday night and had a live band! The pesto hummus was absolutely fantastic!!

name: Todd Krupicka
text: Good selection of beer.  Wish they had more IPA on tap.  Atmosphere seems like something a former frat guy would like - similar to Buffalo Wild Wings. Bar staff on their phones a lot. Also, all bar staff are young women.  I have a suspicion they are not not avid beer drinkers. Probably will come again for the beer and the beer only.

name: Jason Atchison
text: Great beers and staff here are awesome! Trivia on Wednesday nights is always a good time.

name: David Steinbrenner
text:
Great beer, great selection, great service.

Haven't been here for two  years.  Not much has changed.  Love that they have live music and a large beer selection.  I'm a little disappointed that they don't have their beers on ipads anymore.

resp.text: We appreciate that, David! Thanks for the kind words. -Christina T., Customer Service Manager.

name: Darcie Trunkel
text: I love this place I must have hit the wrong button when I do the first movie oh great staff great people

name: Pete Wahlen
text:
At one time they had so many beers, but as of late that isn't the case any more.
A name that doesn't fit the offerings.
Yeah, I get it you want to stock what sells.

name: Louis Troutman
text: Excellent beer selection and food. If you are like me and your palate changes on a whim, you will love the options you have to satiate your hunger/thirst . This is a great spot to stop in for a date night or just to grab a few beers with friends. The price is moderate $$.

name: Jen M
text: Lots of beers to choose from and quick service for a busy night.

name: Dora roberson
text: It was decent and great service. This was my first time there. Decent prices as well.

name: ZT Dobs
text: Awesome service and beer selection!

name: Gregory Walz-Chojnacki
text: The food is good. The beer is better. Some of the best beer brewed in Milwaukee, in fact.

name: Scott Cuthbert
text: Good beer options and service is quick. Of you want a quiet place then dont go during a sports game cause it gets loud!

name: Diego Diaz
text: Usually good selection of tap beer but some can be pricey

name: Janice Schneider
text: One of the best burgers I have ever had and the tater tots were perfection.

name: Raymond Roberts
text: Great place to meet after hours

name: Benjamin W
text: World of beer has a decent selection of beer on tap. The only issue is that they often run out of what's on their menu. Totally understandable, but be prepared to be told to pick something else off the menu. The food is actually pretty good but World of Beer just doesn't feel like a place that is conducive to sitting down to eat dinner. It's definitely positioned as a place to come for happy hour, and I can see the appeal of that. It's modern and swanky looking inside, and my only complaint about the atmosphere is that it was perhaps a notch or two too loud to carry on conversation comfortably. I needed to shout to be heard. I could see this being a fun place for trivia or watching sports, moreso than just stopping in randomly for a drink or a bite to eat.

name: Ashley Cook
text: If you get to, stop at world of beer for weekend brunch. It's beer and liquor themed and good. Try a bloody mary with a splash of guiness.

name: Dylan Neinas
text: Great selection of beer and good pub food. Our bartender was very helpful and friendly! Will be back.

name: Gregg Kriegel
text: GREAT PLACE, GOOD FOOD AND AWESOME COLLECTION OF TAPS CLOSE TO HOME

name: David Brown
text: Nice selection of craft beers at a nice location. Friendly bartenders.

name: Jerry Grosenick - Real Estate Trainer
text: The food was very good and the service was excellent.

name: Kyle Salewski
text: This place just opened up so I figured I would give it a try. Nice atmosphere inside with good decor. Service was ok, had to get the bartenders attention more times than we should have for the amount of people in the bar. It just opened so I can see that they were working out kinks, but they should be overly accommodating since they just opened.  FYI, this is not a place to buy shots -- at $8/shot I felt like I was at the hotel bar down the street. Also, I was disappointed that after closing my tab they don't give you an itemized list of what your bill consists of, just a $ Total.  They were able to give me a list when I requested one, but it should have come standard. I'll probably be returning soon and seeing if they did iron out any of the kinks... I hope so.

name: Arstotzkan Soldier
text: Amazing food that didn't take too long to get served and the man serving us was funny and very good at his job. I strongly recommend this place.

name: Grandmaster LuBu
text: Good-to-Great food,  done with a little more attention paid to detail and flavor pairings than most pub fare. Don't get a cocktail here, it's called "world of beer"  for a reason,  the beer will always be the star of the show. Constantly changing selection.

resp.text: Erik, we're so glad you've had a chance to explore the menu, and we hope you've discovered some pretty delicious pairings along the way! We truly appreciate you taking some time to spread the word, and we hope it won't be too long until we can welcome you back for another round. Cheers! -Alisha S. Customer Service Manager

name: Sara Roberts
text: Very cool place. Extensive beer list. Outdoor seating is semi covered. Will go back.

name: Ralph Harris
text: Nice, clean, and nice T.V's

name: Nicholas Semler
text: Great apps, great food, fantastic customer service, better beer.

name: Alan Wysocki
text: Excellent beer selection, nice atmosphere and pleasant and friendly servers.

text:
For the most part, this Starbucks location is great. However. I cannot say they are completely consistent. I order 3 of the same drinks all the time, and they aren't always the same. I ordered an iced coffee today with vanilla AND classic(one of my regulars), and the woman only rung it in as vanilla. Doesn't seem like that big of a deal right? Except I ordered more than one, and I emphasized how I wanted both syrups in the drinks and she said okay and that she got it. Of course, when I get the drinks I ask if the man put classic in it as well, he looked at me weird and said no. So now I have to give my drinks back to him to add the syrup which inconveniences him. It's written all over her face. But he thinks it's my fault. It's not. It's his coworkers fault because I asked more than once and she still didn't ring it in right. I'm not mad at him or anybody. But if you give people the opportunity to customize drinks, at least give them what they ask for. Besides that, this location is alright. text:

I've tried Pho Cali, Pho Viet, Thai Kitchen, and Vientanne on 35th but the Oxtail pho at Jackie's Cafe is simply amazing. It's a new establishment so they are still working out the kinks so you'll see that the store looks a little disorganized. While the place might not look the best right now the food is really great. Portions were good for the price I paid.

Ordered Oxtail Pho and Hmong Sausage. Both came out in a reasonable amount of time. Got the chicken wings to go (8 for 5.99).
Only downside about this place is it's location. The parking lot is shared with three other business and it's a hassle to find a good place to park.

Definitely worth it though! Great job! Can't wait to see how it does in the future!

EDIT: I've been here a few times since and the food is still very good. They have added a buffet, and while the food from the buffet is still tasty, your money is better spent on just their regular menu items.

text: IHOP is one restaurant that you can count on for good breakfast menu and hot coffee.  They always have specials that you can try or you can order of the regular menu.  Either way I don't think you will be disappointed!

name: Cristiano Caiado De Acioli
text: It's a Dennys-style breakfast diner restaurant ; average food, average ambience. You can eat better with the same amount of money at other places.

name: Brenda Lovick
text: This place has been here forever. It's an old IHOP with a genuine retro feel. Good food.

name: terry moore
text: Very convenient open 24 hours and fairly good food.

name: Benjamin Black
text:
Good coffee. Good pancakes. Good breakfast food in general. These tend to be pretty solid greasy spoon restaurants and this one is no exception. Only giving it a 4 star because we happen to have quite a few breakfast places in this town and some of those do some amazing things.

Also of special note, because I feel it was the exception to the rule, everything wasn't sticky at this iHop. I've been to iHops in Iowa where I literally stick to every surface and come out feeling like I just wrestled Mrs. Butterworth.

name: Otto Khamphouy
text: It's IHOP food which we enjoy. However, this particular location is awful in terms of overall service. Our one waiter, Robert, was fantastic. He was very mindful and attentive, but he's where the good service ended. The hostess was rude. The other servers were openly talking about their tips with each other in front of the customers they received them from. They were openly arguing about the effects of their lack of punctuality and the personal problems involved.

Our service wasn't great either. Long waits at each stage of the process, and the server spilled juice on my shoes. Also the two person booths were tiny for a place where you get big portions.

The food almost redeemed it, most of each dish was teriffic. However one thing was gross in each, including way undercooked sausage links. The elements that didn't work could be set aside and we enjoyed the food, but it was just an overall bad experience. Wouldn't recommend this place.

I wanted a grilled cheese sandwich but the waitress claimed it wasn't on the menu. It was listed in two different places.

My husband got steak tips. They were charred black as well.

name: Marika Edwards
text:
I come to Madison almost every weekend and bring my 4 year old son to the "pancake store". Honestly, I'm pretty surprised at the many terrible reviews. However, I must note that most of them are from 3 or 4 years ago. In the past 2 years that I've been coming every weekend, the staff have been busy and clearly working hard. It's a small place with the pass through in the center of the restaurant, so it can get loud. My food comes out very fast. The food is always good and usually exactly what I order. They may miss bringing extra napkins upon my request, but honestly, everyone is human. I've worked in industry (management, service, and kitchen) for years and I have strong expectations. But it is unreasonable to expect perfection at every table at every moment. Some of you reviewers sound like a bunch of (insert NSFW name here). I will say they could improve overall cleanliness (sticky syrup containers) but they are clearly making a concerted and successful effort to diligent, professional, and delicious.

And to the person who got gum stuck on their leg, it clearly couldn't have been there for long if it was still wet enough to stick to your leg.

We won't be back, pandemic or not.

resp.text: Tony, we can't find your name in our reservation system.  Could you please emailus at info@wildernessresort.com the dates of your stay, who your reservation was under and your contact information? Thank you!

text: Love this place. Covid clean rooms and recreation areas. Including pools and eating areas. Rooms are great as usual. This was our first trip back up there in 12 years. We took our granddaughter for her first time. She and we had a blast. Handicapped parking and building Access.  Fast check in, all the staff are great!!!

resp.text: Thanks so much Anthony -- we are thrilled to read you brought your grand daughter to experience our resort.

name: Valeri A
text:
1. Wear shoes in the hallways. Dirty floors: debris, masks, etc the whole time we were there.
2. The cleaning staff pushed their way in front of people waiting for the elevator (with laundry carts), not once but saw this 3 times!
3. If you allow people to smoke outside then reserve certain areas. The wave pool doors were open constantly. Makes sitting near these doors can be very cold.
4. Life guards: only blow your whistle if really needed because no one pays attention because it's constantly happening! Scary if something bad actually happens!
5. Clean under furniture and around beds better, very dirty!

name: Angelica
text: Very disappointing to see that no one follows the mask requirement, and that staff does not hold their guests accountable for not wearing them. Last I heard, we were still in a global pandemic, and covid still exists. Do better wilderness.

resp.text: We are sorry you were disappointed Angelica.

name: Brandon Prusow
text:
first off this place is hugh. it can take you 15-20 minutes to walk from one end of the resort to the other. There are a few reasons I am giving this place a 3 star.

#1. noise- the walls and floors are super thin and you can hear people walking/running and talking a ways down the hall and on the floors above and below you, so when you are in your room trying to relax before going out again you have constant noise.

#2 temperature and people in the hallways- now this is not something they can completely control in places like the skywalk but the hallways were very  crowded which is to be expected in winter months at 97% capacity. but you would walk out into the hallways and there were very cold to the point it felt like you needed a jacket, and a few places were so hot you couldn't wait to get out of there.

#3 at the waterpark- I'm not sure if this was a design of the 2 different parks we went to but the first one we went to with the 1000 gallon bucket was warm and humid, made going in the water refreshing, they had a few cold spots around the room which ended up making the water feel cold. the other park we went to was the complete opposite, they had doors and vents open to the outside so it was freezing in the park. and that made the water cold as well, and because of that we couldn't spend much time there.

#4 room furniture- our room we stayed in was updated for the Wyndham  people and the furniture in the room was somewhat uncomfortable to sit on, the pool side had better chairs to sit in.

With all that said, myself and the group I was with still enjoyed our time there and our kids had a blast. The room we stayed in was clean and spacious with all the amenities needed for a longer stay. there was so much for us to do that we couldn't see it all, there is a candy shop and convenient store in the lobby, along with 3 arcades and 3 indoor water parks to visit. a few different restaurants and bars on site as well. Would defiantly stay again, but maybe during the summer time when its less crowded.

resp.text: Thanks for your feedback Brandon. The Wyndham property is separately owned and operated from Wilderness Resort.

name: Elizabeth Prusow
text: The water parks are relatively nice and family friendly. We did run into some accessibility issues with needing an elevator and not being able to get to it, resulting in having to carry a stroller with a toddler in it down stairs. Thankfully, another guest was able to help us lift the stroller. Some of the water parks are extremely packed, which makes maintaining distance difficult. But other parks are less packed, so it's easy to pack up and walk to a different indoor park. The hallways aren't great with temperature control (extremely hot to extremely cold). We also experienced semi-cold temps in one of the water parks. Warmer air or water would've been great, but the kids still had fun. We've been here before and I'm sure we'll be back. We just likely won't stay at the Wilderness itself.

name: Kandy Stevens
text: We came to Glacier Canyon Lodge after years of not staying in the dells and are ammazed at how much things are built up for tourism, It's all good of course. We had a great time and the condo we stayed in was filled with everything you need to feel like home.

resp.text: Thank you so much Kandy -- glad you enjoyed it!

name: Jeremy Schultz
text: First weekend they have been at Max Capacity (since all the Covid nonsense) and everything was great! We were in a Villa and it was great. The staff was amazing and it was so great to see people enjoying life like before it all happened. None of those ridiculous face masks was the greatest part!

resp.text: Thanks for your review Jeremy.

name: Obrecht Aron
text: Nice rooms, friendly staff. The arcade is packed, and the convenience stores... well, go through the effort of going to a gas station because everything is double regular price.

resp.text: Thanks Aron.

name: Mandy Love
text: This is by far the best place I've stayed at in the dells so far! I love that they have free shuttle buses to each of the different hotels/water parks. The staff is very friendly and the wilderness on the lake rooms are bigger than expected! The only part I didn't like was the Take Flight ride lol I'm afraid of heights and we ended up on the 3rd level which is the highest and also had a 3yr old with us and it of the 6 of us only 3 actually watched the 15 min ice age film the rest of us had our eyes closed and I had a bit of a panic attack lol.

name: Nicole Raboine
text: We had an amazing family get-a-way. I asked for a special package at on and they had it all set up and ready for our kids. Our room was very clean, customer service was great, and check in and check out process was easy!

resp.text: Glad to hear it thank you Nicole!

name: Scott Ayen
text: It was a nice place but some of the staff are not real friendly. But overall was still good.

resp.text: We are really sorry to hear this Scott. Thank you for letting us know so we can address this in our staff meeting.

name: Valori Chapman
text: We participated in a Halloween 🎃 special, 2 nights. Special amenities like horse drawn cart ride, pumpkin patch, cookie decorating, and trick or treat. It can be a bit spendy with the arcades, candy shops, and attractions like Take Flight, Escape Rooms, and the Fun Pass but you never really have to leave the hotel. The staff was fabulous. There are three indoor water parks available year round. They could be a little more clear in what the water parks offer so you don't have to go there and find out your kids hate it. A good way to spend our 15 year anniversary with our kids, who wouldn't be here if it wasn't.

resp.text: Thanks for your review Valerie. We hope you had a happy Halloween!

name: Mitchell Ferencevich
text: Best resort in the Dells and quite possibly the US.  Wilderness offers great rates especially in the off season or first and last week of summer.

resp.text: Wow, thank you for the wonderful compliment Mitchell!

name: Sara Bear
text: The money today this place is insane, personally I'd prefer the rooms cheaper. I do understand that we are getting into their indoor Waterpark included but still room rates are a bit high. Also you spend just as much time walking to each park as you are actually in the park.

resp.text: Thanks for your feedback.

name: Kim Novak
text: Our favorite hotel every year to stay at,  everything is clean and everyone is so nice really, yummy food,  fun water parks everywhere,  the play area is also fun for the kids.  Love the ice cream and the wave pool,  have to get more deals going ? Thank you!

resp.text: Thanks for the nice review Kim. We are glad you enjoy our resort so much!

name: Jason Schmock
text: We have been to Wilderness many times and we love it! Lots to do for any age from waterparks, painting pottery, arcade, kids club. So many things to do at anytime of the year.

resp.text: Thanks for the love Jason -- we are glad you enjoy our resort so much!

name: Marie Wasner
text: Great service and amenities! We always have fun. My only suggestion would be a better layout provided to show how to navigate the hotel and activities.

resp.text: Thanks for your feedback Marie!

name: Justin Tyler
text: We love this place. The best wave pool around. Staff is very friendly. Rooms are adequate.

resp.text: We LOVE your review Justin. Thank you for taking the time to leave it.

name: Blanca Torres
text: Love staying at the wilderness..always a great time..so much to enjoy..today we tried the new Take Flight thing..it was the most awesome! Oh my goodness..best thing ever!..its like you are actually flying..took my breath away..loved it

name: Marc Johnson
text: The family and I just stopped by to try take flight.   The Polar Express was alright,  but would be better if lasted a bit longer.  The smell of a pine forest, cookies, wind and snow in your face was a great touch..  The Flying Wild film was the best seeing the dells and having water splash in your face and the smells was fantastic.

resp.text: So glad you enjoyed our Take Flight Theater Marc!

name: Bruce Dudzik
text: Bad experience. Indoor pools were overcrowded. We paid $650 for a weekend and could not even use the  amenities. Talked to others using the indoor pool and was told they were staying in a different hotel a couple blocks away. They paid less then $100.00 per night for their room (with 4 people) and received passes to the water parks. Wait??? What???. Why the hell does the Wilderness $350 per night. Room was dirty upon arrival. Could not get another room because they were full. So, if rooms are full at hotel, other hotels are using the amenities, for 1/4 less then I paid to stay at Wilderness hotel, why even book a room at the hotel. I felt bad for my kiddos, 9 &4, could not even enjoy their weekend at the water pak. All in all, I would never book a room here again. There are many other options at Wisconsin Dells, I have been at 3 others, that were less expensive with same amenities, I will not stay at the Wilderness again. Shop around, google and call various hotels. Many have passes to water parks and their room rates are 1/2 or less then the Wilderness. You will save a few hundred dollars for the weekend. Lesson learned.

name: laurie hoffmann
text: Great place to bring kids & enjoy the waterpark. Had a blast. The lockers shouldn't cost anything to guest that are staying there. It definitely adds up over a few days.

name: Barbara Fernandez
text: Welcoming environment, great service and fantastic place to have fun and have a exciting experience. I recommended it 100 %

resp.text: We love your recommendation Barbara -- thank you so much!

name: Alicia Jackson
text: We went to the Wilderness for the Take Flight ride. It is an awesome experience for those who have never done anything like it before. However, we have done Soaring Over California in California Adventures and Wings Over Washington in Seattle. Take Flight, unfortunately was our least favorite of the three. The National Park idea is really neat, but the screen seems pixilated or blurry (not clear). There also weren't any fragrances or smells (which I was expecting and really looking forward to). The ride also doesn't really lift you up and out (Wing Over WA suspends you really high out out towards the screen). The ride at Wilderness only takes you forward a few feet. The Polar Express Ride was really hyped up, but SO very short. It had to be like 4-5 minutes or at least that is how it felt. We are happy the ride is here, but it could use some improvements.

name: Soap Box Gaming
text: Love every time I stay the staff are quick on check in and are just a text or phone call away for any needs you may have.

resp.text: Thank you so much!

name: Kathi Jo Wondra-Schraufnagel
text:
If you have a medical reasons avoid this hotel/resort!
Usually have a great time here.
But..... the night of February 21st was different. A young woman by the prize counter at the Northern Lights arcade was so rude. She asked if I had a mask, (I didn't) she directed me to the masks. She said I needed one to be helped, I told her I have medical issues and can't wear one. She said that I didn't have a medical reason that I just didn't want to wear one. I can not believe all the money and time I have spent at this resort that they would treat me like this.

resp.text: Kathi - we apologize that you were treated rudely.

name: Timothy Holloway
text: Well overdue remodeling was a welcomed surprise. Great updates. Customer service is excellant.

resp.text: Thanks Tim -- glad you like the improvements.

name: Kashyap M.
text: Super crowded in spring break. Great amenities and clean.

resp.text: Thanks for the five-star review Kashyap.

name: Brian Mayeshiba
text: The staff was extremely helpful and friendly every step of the way. The new remodel is clean, open, and inviting. The pools were a tad crowded, but what else is there to do in the middle of winter in Wisconsin?

resp.text: Glad our staff was helpful. Thank you for the review.

name: Kyle Clough
text: Great place to stay and good water parks to have fun at. Definitely recommend checking out the swim up bar

resp.text: Thanks Kyle!

name: Doberman_Wi_Us 2020
text: The new Fly theater is truly a great family experience.  I also need to mention the remodeled portion.  It is breathtaking. Everything looks great.  Love the new carport. Reminds of what you would see in Vegas. Your team is second to none. We will be back a lot more in the coming months and years to come.

resp.text: Thank you Doberman -- we appreciate the time you took to leave a review!

name: Victoria Shea
text: I cannot explain to you how much I absolutely hate this place.  There is food crushed into the hallway floors,  People are packed in small hot tubs  and packed into very small swimming pool areas... there were band aids floating in the pool, along with a used condom.  It smelled musty... the hallways also were filled with weed smoke. I'm so disappointed.. not to mention I paid almost 200$ for one night! I am NEVER coming back.

resp.text: Sounds like the guests who were staying in the hotel when you were there were not very responsible. We are sorry to hear this and that it negatively impacted your stay.

name: Andrew Grosman
text:
Our favorite weekend vacation, and favorite place to stay in the Dells. The Wilderness Resort never disappoints, even during the COVID-19 Pandemic. Room was clean, waterparks well attended but not overcrowded and near-to-water grill food was good.

If there was room for improvement, its not a big deal, but the room darkening shades are showing their age, and their holes. Didn't effect our stay, for sure.

As for following COVID-19 precautions, all staff did; I would say 33% of guests had masks on.

We'll be back - hopefully w/o masks. ;)

name: Dustin C
text: This place is HUGE! I would recommend going there in the summer vs the winter as u will then be able to use the 4 outdoor waterparks. I've seen and used better indoor waterparks elsewhere in the Dell's that I'd recommend over the ones here at the wilderness resort. The biggest downside is the size of this resort. You have to walk a mile to get to where u want to go or wait a long time for a shuttle ride.

resp.text: But all of the walking you do at our resort justifies indulging in some great vacation treats. Lol

name: Nicole A
text:
Overbooked,  especially during COVID. Masks were the exception and not inforced which was  disappointing since we were told 50% capacity with masks required. I fully understand the risk of traveling during a pandemic,  but I thought I was being careful.

Parking lot was overflowing, the lines for activities (we paid for in advance) were incredibly long and both the bumper boats and
Go carts were broken resulting in unused Fun Passes.  Hot tub was shoulder to shoulder, it would be nice if there was at least one that was adult only.

That being said,  our room was clean and safe and we had a fantastic view, saw 6 does in the woods on the first day.

We'll try again post pandemic,  if there's such a thing.

resp.text: We apologize that you were disappointed.

name: CaVe Yt
text: The stay was fun! E. There was many waterparks and fun attractions! The only thing I found bad was the walk! haha. And also the kid that threw up in the pool but besides that E

name: James Meyer
text: Great time. Not crowded, felt comfortable with social distancing even though few guests were masks. We stayed in a condo so it was nice to be in a quieter, less busy location compared to a hotel room. Golfed on the Woods course twice. Nice course.

resp.text: Thanks for the.nice review James!

name: Heather Deja
text: We rented a cabin and boy was it awesome! For it being off season (2nd week in February) it sure was busy as ever, I mean obviously not as busy as summer but it was busy. If your worried about covid I do not suggest going here.  They're is no such thing as 6 feet apart in the pool area especially, it was shoulder to shoulder with no mask obviously because your swimming.  The arcades were just as packed but most people had a mask on in there,  but again they're wasn't even room for 6ft apart it to was shoulder to shoulder.  The best part was for sure, the cabin. Even when we got neighbors that had a handful of kids, we didn't here them at all it was pretty great.

resp.text: We are so glad you enjoyed the cabin.

name: Nix 89
text: We are planning our wedding here and the staff have been nothing but amazing Caitlin the events manager is amazing she has helped us through the whole process and has made things easy on us. I've recommended this venue to multiple people and will continue to because we are highly satisfied.

resp.text: Thank you so much for your feedback. We will let Caitlin's supervisor know.

name: Justin Zipperer
text: So glad to have been able to return.  New lobby lost the woodsy feeling which I missed from our past checkins.  Camp Social seems overly priced for what you get.  Disappointed with the high food prices, didn't try as much as I would have liked.  Rooms looked the same as they did 8 or so years ago.  Very comfortable and plenty of room.  Less than ideal to be on the 2nd floor, its great to go right away since its the main commuting floor, just wish it would have been wider.  I always have to look side to side to see if it was safe to walk out.  Also you literally hear everyone walk past your room, especially at bar close.

resp.text: We're glad you were able to return as well. Thanks for the feedback we appreciate hearing from long time customers. Have a great week Justin!

name: Lyndsy
text: Spent the weekend here last weekend for my daughters birthday and we had a blast! Super clean hallways and rooms, tons of entertainment for kids, friendly staff. Will be back. Definitely best resort in the Dells.

resp.text: Aw, thank you Lyndsy and happy belated birthday to your daughter!

name: Rene Mireles
text: Great family atmosphere..you have everything here to make good family memories

name: Jay Tinder
text: Awesome resort our two bedroom condo  at Canyon Lodge had everything we needed and was spacious.   The water parks was all clean and offered something for all ages.  Lastly the communication was top notch from our arrival to the very end.  Constant communication with us via text during our entire stay making sure we had everything and informing us with daily text.

name: Sarresa Hrenak
text: #1 place to stay in the Dells--No one else even comes close!! 18 years going and can't wait till our next visit!!

resp.text: WOW Sarresa, Thank you for your kind reviews and all of the years you have been a dedicated customer. We LOVE to hear reviews like this.

name: Jody Miles
text: I rented the 3 bedroom suite and was very pleased. This place is far better than Great Wolf Lodge. There's something to do for everyone. It's a large complex with many water parks throughout. It can be a bit of a walk but the shuttle's worked out great for us (when needed). Food and drinks are pricey but if you plan it well (bring grab and go breakfast items and sandwiches for lunch) you can make it affordable. I suggest going out of the complex for dinner. We found some good places nearby. The grandchildren LOVED this place!!!

name: Sammie Glasheen
text: I love the water parks and all games and the gift shops and the other shopes

resp.text: So glad to hear it Sammie!

name: Charles P Lucas
text: Stayed here a few summers back. The place has a really fun vibe! The outdoor waterpark is great as well as the indoor! Rooms were fine, nothing too extravagant. Its what you would expect from basic lodging.

resp.text: Thank you for the review Charles.

name: Briana Laczkowski
text: This place is so fun! So much to do! and its big.

resp.text: Thanks Briana!

name: Jackson Larson
text: This is the water park/resort where  it never gets old. In fact, it gets new! I don't know exactly when they made improvements, but I do know that the last time I went there they had this new thing where if you got a bar code scanned on you water park pass, you could set up some sort of gamer tag to use these tubes where when you ride some of the slides you press buttons according to the lights in the slides. And not only is it an amazing water park, it's a nice hotel as well. They also have go karts, laser tag, ropes course, and an arcade, all super fun! If you want more excitement, go in the summer and have access to there outdoor water parks! (Note:  my pictures are from different times I have visited)

resp.text: Thanks Jackson!

name: H G
text: My family and I always enjoy the wilderness resort. Plenty of stuff to do and we love the waterpark. The restaurant choices are good and so is the service.

resp.text: Thank you so much HG!

name: Tom L Christian Channel
text: There are 4 waterparks her they are all great for children and adults and the staff is friendly

resp.text: Thank you Tom!

name: Brianna
text:
I don't think they read my review before commenting"thank you" updated to get an actual response.

Overall great experience.
4 indoor waterparks with plenty of activities.
Arcades are super fun full of interactive games for all ages including high ropes, Lazer tag, mini golf, go carts and crafts.
Food was hyped up and was the worst part about the trip and it was WAY OVERPRICED! Save yourself some money and head off property for good food. Example: cheese curds, average blt, kraft Mac and cheese, 6 wings and 2 drinks came to $89.

The food court is $14/adult and $7 for kids and the breakfast potatos were mushy and cold, the eggs did not even have taste and the biscuits and gravy were so hard it was like a hockey puck.  Writing this in hopes the hotel can pay more attention to quality instead of cheap/poor quality food preparation. Use better ingredients.
I left an item behind after checkout and could not get ahold of anyone at the hotel to get my item back, it was a family take flight photo, we stayed in 677.
Our room was clean but the hideaway bed they clearly haven't changed the sheets as there was hair and stains all over it. I'm giving it a 4/5 because we had so much fun, please note that this resort it HUGE and easy to get turned around it.
Employees at the arcade and take flight are less than helpful, they act like your questions are just mind bending and too much to answer. The guy at take flight gave no direction and took 2 personal calls on his cell phone, did not greet us and did not smile.
The girls working the ropes course were the best as they really interacted with my son and gave us all the info we needed. Greeted us with a smile and cared if we had a good experience.

resp.text: Brianna, we are sorry you were disappointed in our food. We are sharing your review with our food MD beverage director. To report lost items please email lostandfound@wildernessresort.com.

name: Andrew Campbell
text: Great place!! Very clean and friendly staff. Always love coming here.

resp.text: Thank you so much Andrew for your great review!

name: Sherry Herron
text: They could a lot better toilet paper,and better more powerful blender. The stools and beds aren't  for shorter people. We asked a person upstairs a question over text and voice mail without even a return response. It seem that every vacation seems to have a flat in Tennessee we were maliciously  lied too. Branson would not take the word no so he kept us from our vacation for over 3 hours more so in pigeon Ford TN.

resp.text: Sherry, We would love to know how we could have improved your visit to our resort. Would you mind taking a moment to provide us additional feedback at info@wildernessresort.com? Thank you so much!

name: AnaM M
text: We love this place! Great water parks.   Everything is nice and clean, great guest service. Expensive but worth it!  Parking lot was packed! That made hard to go out just to explore around .the picture is the view from our room

resp.text: Thanks so much!

name: Amanda Labrec
text: Great place for younger kids !! Wish we would've known that one of their parks was closed before we came but it was still fun

resp.text: Glad you had fun Amanda!

name: Ariana Nevarez
text: Ive been here several times and it never disappoints

resp.text: Thank you so much Ariana for the five-star review!

name: Ryan Ziegler
text: Enjoyed the indoor/outdoor heated pool...

resp.text: You mean outdoor hot tubs in April. Our outdoor waterparks don't open until Memorial day weekend

name: Kim Pozo
text: We stayed at Wilderness a week ago. They wouldn't let my grandughter be passenger on go karts for being 35" 1 inch too short but let another girl shorter than my grandughter I took pictures and saved them doing it. My grandson didn't like Take Fleight ride and they wouldn't refund our $. Bumper cars were closed what we came to Wilderness for. Then Timberland house was closed and climbing walls. The staff at restaurant ignored us didn't get us menus. I told Manager they didn't seem care. We also waited over an hour for shuttle bus to get from one pool to next. We had call shuttle 3 times. Very disappointed this was our yearly vacation.

name: Tiffany Smith
text: Kids had an excellent time. We go here every year, and it's always a great time for everyone.

resp.text: Yay, thanks Tiffany!

name: amy bowman
text: Special thanks to Joshua at guest registration for getting us in early due to flight situation. He was very accommodating and it was really nice . We had great time even during covid-19. Thanksgood fun

resp.text: So glad you had fun Amy. We will share this review with Joshua and his supervisor. Happy holidays.

name: LaConya Blackwell
text: There have over 8 different water parks, a theme with indoor go carts, mini golf, games, laser tag and more. There is so much for the kids to do🤯. There are plenty of restaurants as well. The downside is you have do ALOT of walking to go to each activity because they are all not in the same building. Shuttles are available but they come every 15 to 20 minutes. Overall a GREAT place to vacation with the family !!👍🏾👍🏾👍🏾👍🏾

resp.text: Thanks for the great review LaConya -- we appreciate it greatly!

name: Jenny F
text:
As much traffic as they have, its not bad. They have indoor and outdoor parks, giant wave pool, all the slides and lazy rivers. Tons of stuff to keep the kids AND the grown ups happy. Fastest pizza on the planet, on site froyo and dining. The candy shops are a great addition. Make sure to check out the new TakeFlight. Great room deals, nice and spacious for a hotel room. Its awesome you can take a shuttle to the other property. They offer free wifi, but with traffic as heavy as it is, they should offer a premium wifi option.

The downside: This place can seem like a giant maze. At times I felt like we were in a giant escape room scenario.
A number of the people that come here probably shouldn't be here or out in public amongst the population either, this is not the resorts fault though, except the maze part. I'm also pretty sure the resort had no influence over the half dressed drunk girl standing on the table on the balcony screaming  motherf***** into the parking lot and all the children.
There should be someone to tell the kids to stop cannonballing and wrestling on top of people in the spas. At many times, the indoor areas are kinda over crowded with people who really dont care even about personal space. We nicknamed the Klondike Cavern something else and made it a point not to go in there after we saw the overcrowding.
Even with the downfalls from other "guests" we've stayed here a few times and will stay more.

Addition: You are very welcome Wilderness Resort, it is not the fault of the resort when some bad guests come and behave badly. Problems reported seem to be taken care of quickly and overall it was a great visit. We hope to see you guys again soon!

resp.text: Thanks for your feedback Jenny.

name: Damon Liddicoat
text:
Spent $400 for 2 nights. Room is identical to a Days Inn, could have just done that. Clean but for 2 beds and a basic bathroom certainly not worth 200/night.

Waterpark is not at all adult friendly. Hot tubs were a joke, go to Great Wolf where they have an adults only hot tub (and enforce that.) Finally got fed up with unsupervised children cannonballing into the hot tub and kicking me while swimming through the hot tub and left. There were lifeguards watching who continually saw and looked away during this behavior.

Will not be back.

name: Sierra Phillips
text: Great place for a birthday. Family fun and lots of variety for activities.

resp.text: So glad you had fun Sierra!

name: brett bjorn
text: We witnessed a kid heavily puke in hot tub. We immediately went and got a life guard thinking that was the responsible thing to do. He blows his whistle twice at the hot tub from 20 feet away (I understand he couldn't leave his spot) with no explanation and didnt feel the need to get people out. We decide to alert a different lifeguard as this is a disgusting situation. He replys to me "thats why we keep the temp nice and high and went about his day like its just a normal every day occurrence. Fair warning to all

resp.text: Brett - Your review concerns us greatly. If you remember the names of either of these lifeguards or can describe them please send us an email at info@wildernessresort.com. This situation should have been addressed immediately by them and we apologize that it wasn't.

name: Dan Anderson
text: Pool where cold. Waterpark was freezing cold air blowing in everywhere really could not enjoy the waterpark as it was cold everywhere we went. Took about 15 mins to walk to the waterpark from our room.

resp.text: We are sorry you felt this way.

name: Dawn Grady
text: I love the Wilderness Resort! A wonderful spot to vacation and part of what is so nice is that you don't have to go off of resort property to enjoy a vast array of activities! Some of these are indoor and outdoor waterparks, outdoor zip line, indoor ropes course, laser tag, indoor and outdoor mini golf, outdoor and indoor go-karts, several arcades, restaurants, gift shops and concessions.  So much to do!!!

resp.text: Thanks Dawn for the five-star review.

name: Meemers 7
text:
The wilderness is a nice resort with amenities for everyone. The entire resort is huge with indoor and outdoor activities. The rates are fairly reasonable, but are significantly more expensive during the summer.
The Employees are very helpful, however due to the facility being so large it is far too easy to get lost. The layout is quite strange so definitely ask for help, get a map or do a walk-through of the property when you arrive.
It is a great place for families, especially for children. Definitely check them out if you haven't already

name: Chelsea Kaminski
text: We went for an impromptu no work no school getaway! We had tons of fun for an exceptional value. Booked with groupon got fun passes which allowed us to go kart and do the ropes course as much as our hearts desired. Check in was smooth and our room was ready on time. Our room was spacious and clean. Had no issues and already planning our trip for the summer so we can enjoy even more of the fun!!

resp.text: Glad you had no issues with your getaway Chelsea. Hope to see you again soon!

name: Michael Montana
text: Huge Waterpark, indoor and out. Great hotel rooms and service. 5/5 for sure.

resp.text: Thank you so much Sawyer! We appreciate it.

name: Mark Ellwitz
text: Take Flight is a great attraction for the whole family

resp.text: Glad you liked it Mark!

name: David Willis
text: My bread and butter. Of course I love it!

resp.text: Awe, thanks David. We will gladly be your bread and butter!

name: Jared Dudzek
text: Good indoor water park, rooms could use some updating but the parks are fun.

name: Alex Wiezorek
text: Great place for family's 3 indoor waterparks perfect for winter!

resp.text: Thank you so much Alex!

name: Sahara unique
text: Great experience everytime I visit

resp.text: We love to hear this Sahara!

name: Mike Dayton
text: Lots of walking but a lot to do.  All kinds of things for the kids to have fun,  plus they love the indoor water parks!  The bumper boats were a hit to!

resp.text: Yes, there is lot of walking but that just justifies getting ice cream! Glad your kids had fun in the waterparks and on the bumper boats!

name: Dan Svoboda
text: The staff, service, food, drinks, waterparks, and activities were excellent. The only minor downside is that the rooms are starting to show some wear.

resp.text: Thanks for the feedback Dan!

name: Kelby Stewart
text: Great place to go with the family.  There are things to do for all ages.  There is everything from arcades, gocarts, and (of course) water parks.  There restaurants are pretty good, expensive (but things tend to be in the dells), but very good.  If you are looking to save a little try booking during a less busy time of year and during the week.  There also are a lot more water parks to choose from if you go during summer.  Finally, they are not far from the rest of the dells, so you can get to other attractions fairly easily.

resp.text: Thanks Kelby!

name: Steve Konkel
text: One of the most amazing places because I work here I get to see everything and how awesome and cool and fun it is. it's kind of like a Mini version of Disneyland ,must see.

name: Crystal Briggs
text: Love this place about to go again next week for the family vacation my hubby took me to Mt Olympus last year for my birthday had a horrible time the first night there than he discovered Wilderness Resort we loved it so much we came back 2 weeks later for my son's birthday. The staff is very friendly and helpful with whatever u need I would definitely recommend taking ur family here weather its just u and ur spouse or the whole family...

resp.text: Thanks so much Crystal!

name: Berto
text: This place is great family fun

resp.text: Awe, thanks for making our day with your review Berto.

name: Sheila Wiley
text: Kids had a Blast of different activities to do and the nearby Villa Pizza was Delicious. The Candy Shop was even more Pleasure to the Getaway with yummy chocolate covered strawberries, turtle taffy apple, and Smores marshmellow on a stick! Simply 👍 👍

resp.text: Sheila, glad your family had a great time.

name: Zachary Zimmer
text:
HUGE resort with lots of options for waterparks and entertainment.  The parks are separated for the most part which makes them seem smaller, almost too small.  Plus only a couple are actually connected so you may end up taking a shuttle to get to the others.  The same goes for dining, there are a lot of choices but they may be on the otherside of the resort so you can't walk there.

On the plus side, many other activities for kids beyond the water including laser tag, go karts, and an arcade.  The resort was also very well maintained inside.

resp.text: Thanks for your review Zachary.

name: Andy Larson
text: Great rooms, reasonable price, many restaurants, water parks, arcades all within the resort.

resp.text: Thank you so much Andy -- we appreciate your review and are glad you had a great time!

name: Z Syed
text: Liked the BLAST package $175 ( $25 Arcade credit, Large Pizza, 2 Fun Passes, 2 Queen beds) Toddlers enjoyed the water parks more than arcade Within water parks toddlers enjoyed all but wave bar dome In order Klondike, Cubbys, Wild west & the Dome Liked black hole for adults Liked the Self-checkout, drop keys in drop box, return towel passes You can hang on to towel passes after checkout until we exited Liked the Unlimited towels & clean water Car to Cubby’s cove was better than waiting for shuttle to avoid cold Did not have to interact with staff except for one question about a microwave in the lobby Planning: Reached at 1 PM , in the room by 1:45 PM, in the water by 2:30 PM. Check in took 20 minutes on a non-busy day. Active play time was b/w 1 PM to 8 PM both days. Notes to self for Next Time: • The preparation & packaging was good enough to last for two nights. • Forgot Strollers but it was not bad at all with 1.5 yr & 3.5 yr old. • Carry Water Bottles • Plan for dinners & breakfasts ahead of time. • No Indian restaurants nearby. • Walmart Frozen meals worked out. • Lot of time was wasted in brining the meals & heating them up. • Keep in mind there is no Microwave in the lobby so cannot heat food after you check out. • May be finish your vacation in the Cubbys Cove & preferably during a non-busy time (i.e. before noon)

resp.text: Thanks for the feedback

name: Brad Gray
text: We had an amazing vacation! Staff was very friendly.

resp.text: We are so glad you had an amazing vacation Brad. Thanks for letting us know!

name: Laura Koeppl
text: Super nice rooms at reasonable rates for 2020 year of the Pandemic. Another facility with a well executed plan designed to keep staff and guests safe, as they minimize the capacity of individuals inhabiting available space. Staff is very polite and accommodating. Lots to see and do in the hotel, itself.

resp.text: Thanks so much Laura!

name: Heather Lynn
text: We had a great time!! The resort is incredibly big so there was A LOT of walking everyday. Shuttles will also pick you up to take you to the different water parks there. The parks were super fun. The double suite rooms were okay, not the greatest. We had to have maintenance come to the room shortly after we got there, but the maintenance man got there very quickly! We were never told the housekeeping would not come unless requested everyday by the guest due to COVID-19 precautions.

resp.text: Kayleigh, the no housekeeping is a COVID-19 safety precaution so no one comes in your room once you are there.

name: Troy Van De Hei
text: Best vacation so far with the kids!!! Definitely enough to keep busy and then some. Can't wait to go back again in the future.

resp.text: This is so nice to hear Troy, thank you so much!

name: Billy Suhm
text: Sweet place but alot of walking kina long lines today

resp.text: Thank Billy.

name: Michael Flannery
text: This place was amazing.   Even went swimming outside on Saturday September 26.  The water was so warm and clean.   This place was way too big to experience everything in 3 days.

name: Steve Cass
text: We've stayed here for many years and it's always been great. This year was still good although a little crowded and we had some things stolen from our table in the Waterpark. I was told they are selling day passes now which they have not done in the past. I hope this is a temporary decision based on Noah's Ark being closed.

resp.text: Thanks for your loyalty Steve -- we appreciate it!

name: Angi Scott
text:
Large waterpark, indoor and outdoor options, arcades, mini golf, bars, restaurants.

Busy place.

name: Kimberly Hernigle
text: The rooms are updated and clean, very spacious and great layout.. the only thing I would say is make sure the person before you didn't set a 6am alarm when you plan to sleep in.. lol otherwise, great hotel, professional employees and very clean swimming areas!

resp.text: Thank you so much Kimberly!

name: Tina Kuehn
text: Maps were not super clear. The survivor restaurant was delish!!! The swim up bar was good. Wear your walking shoes to get to the different water parks. The rooms were very nice and the beds were comfy!

name: Marianna Miller-Martinez
text: We loved our room....  Loved 75% of our stay....  However did as were told for special transport seeing as though we have a wheelchair dependent child and sadly 2 times the bus to take to water park didnt have a lift even though we called in advance for the bus very frustrating... After that we did our own transports....

resp.text: We're so sorry you were frustrated with our shuttles.

name: Tim Malone
text: We love visiting this resort. Each time we visit the dells, we come to the wilderness. They have a great selection for our kids and we have a great time as adults.  Our room was pretty good. The shower curtain had mold on it, which was disturbing.  The rest of the room worked as required.

resp.text: Thank you for your feedback, Tim. We are disappointed that we did not deliver an exceptional room experience. We will make sure to not only correct the issue in your room, but we will also be sharing this with our housekeeping leads so they will be sure this doesn't happen again. Thank you for your loyalty and we hope we get the chance to "WOW" you on your next stay!

name: heather Chouinard
text: Like always a great time

resp.text: Thanks so much Heather!

name: Katie Kocan
text: We love The Wilderness Resort!! It is our go to getaway. With so many different waterparks to choose from, you never get bored. In each area there is stuff for all ages. Don't forget the multiple arcades, restaurants, snack bars, go-carts, and so much more.

resp.text: Thanks for the glowing review Katie!

name: Mike Harris
text: Great experience, enjoyed all of the waterparks, arcades, and activities they had to offer our family. The room was great, roomy, clean, big refrigerator, and comfortable beds. I do not have a single complaint to report. Will definitely only go to Wilderness Resort for now on.

resp.text: Thanks so much Mike for the glowing review. We are thrilled you had a great time!

Best stay ever. Came to celebrate my best friends 30th birthday. Ronald, the bar tender, and Daniel Pletsez, the kitchen supervisor, at camp social were amazing. They brought our sprits up on an otherwise stressful day. Would stay again!!! And would recommend the camp social to friends.  5*s plus.

And the night shift on 11-28 lady at the go carts was amazing. She was sociable while we were waiting for 10+ minutes while we waited in line. Wish I cought her name.

name: Lucas Adrian

name: Pete Diaz
text: Great place for entire family! The inside was warm, clean, lots to eat, lots to do here. You don't have to go anywhere, everything is here, from hot food, drinks, but the beers are $8/ea, a little pricey.

text: Very nice well worth the money
