name: Cheryl Ann Chapman Cichy
text: We are Wyndham Destination timeshare owners and the Wilderness Resort offers Wyndham's Glacier Canyon at the Wilderness and also a separate domain on Lake Delton in the Wisconsin Dells as well called Wilderness On The Lake. Wyndham villas are available at Sundara Spa as well and it is gorgeous! Differences...the Wilderness itself is a huge waterpark functioning both inside and out. Slides, lazy rivers, hot tubs and a huge waterdome with a giant wavepool. It can all be overwhelming but once you get your bearings you can make your way about. Great for kids but be warned this facility gets busy...lots of kids from parents with babies up to teens. Put a life preserver on your child for safety and do not let them wander into the wave pool alone...they need to be strong swimmers. Lifeguards are dutiful and on constant watch. We were there during a storm that turned into a tornado and I was impressed how quickly the staff got everyone out...checked on  and assured people they were fine but they could not stay in the water!! Yes...people wanted to sit in the hot tub with lightening shots through the sky. We have never had a problem with unclean rooms. There are great restaurants all about the area and I'm 54 and still love going!

resp.text: Thank you for your nice review.

name: Greg Wiggins
text: Wish all stuff would of been open but other then that great place to stay, take your kids and see some attractions.

resp.text: Thanks for the five-star review Greg.

name: Victoria Olubiyi
text: A great place for kiddos. Even if it's a day trip. There are so many Waterpark options and it's enclosed.

name: Dagmar Merfeld
text: We do love it here. Currently under going renovations which are exciting. The decor upgrades are wonderful! Added attractions on site are very inclusive. resp.text: So glad to hear you love our resort and the changes we are making Dagmar!

They have multiple arcades, go-karts, shopping, restaurants, bars, mini golf, paint your own pottery, and much more. I highly recommend staying here if you're looking for a great place to take your family.

resp.text: This is an excellent review! Thanks so much Josh!

name: William Bauer
text: It's fun to have fun by making others smile😃

name: Ashley K
text: Pretty awesome , lots to do !!

name: Melanie Sculley
text: We had a very nice stay. The only reason I took off 1 star was because of it being pretty crowded...but it was the weekend. Take advantage of the shuttle system if you go. It's way better than walking. There are a lot of things to do. Some activities cost extra but I was prepared to spend a lot. Everything costs a lot in Wisconsin Dells. All the water activities except bumper boats are included. I think if we went when the outdoor water parks are open then each park might not have been so packed. Do take the advice of others and dont book a room on the second floor as that is the floor that most if the foot traffic happens between parks.

resp.text: Glad you had a nice stay Melanie!

name: Talia Mindyourbusiness

text:
Excellent place to stay. The water parks are great. The ropes course, mini golf, laser tag was fun, but i would not pay extra to do those things ( we got a deal on the room via groupon for room and extra passes)

The hotel room was clean!!!! Great condition!!

Save your money on adult drinks- we spent way to much and the drinks had been watered down.  Overall our experience was great, we would go back via good rate on room!

name: Stacy Beals

name: Krista Pope
text: Bullies stay here. This was my children's first trip to the Dell's and since the reviews were close to 5 stars I thought we would stay there. While spending time with my daughter a group of teens decided to pick on my 10 year old son. One or them actually threw a big inner tube at his head and the lifeguard seen it along with me and did nothing about it! I yelled at the punk as he tried to stair me down. My son sustained injuries for this abuse. When I asked the lifeguard where would I go to report this he said that I couldn't. Oh and don't bother calling for housekeeping to bring more towels, because they won't show up! Gave 2 stars because there is lots to do and before that incident my children were having fun.

resp.text: Krista, your review concerns us and we wish you would have reported it while you were onsite to a manager so these kids behaviors could have been addressed. We are so sorry your family didn't enjoy your visit.

text: Not a great layout, poor pillows, my 11 and 9 year olds actually asked to go to other dells attractions. Staff was friendly though. Room was pretty clean. Pizza was really good!

name: Lilyana T
text: The best resort!! Has a lot to offer for the whole family

resp.text: Awe, thank you so much for such a great review!

name: Edward Stoller
text: Great time all around. Close to everything. So much variety to choose from. Always a great family time there.

resp.text: Thank you Edward!

name: Brittany Kat
text: Wonderful, I love it here! We decided to stay an extra day cause we couldn't get to all the attractions in two days 😊

resp.text: So glad you enjoyed our resort Brittany.  Than you for leaving your comments.

name: C. Huffman
text: Has gone down hill! Poor service by guest services,argumentative, they have also hiked prices up on everything else do to lost income over COVID. Did you know they forse the room cleaning staff to work WITHOUT AC!!!!!!! How awful!!

resp.text: C. your review really bums us out. If you know the names of the guest services people who were argumentative with you please email them to info@wildernessresort.com.

name: Amanda Monahan
text: Everyone enjoyed our stay here. There's so much to do that I don't think we saw everything.  It's perfect for kids of all ages.

resp.text: Thanks Amanda!

name: Jonathan Stechner
text:
The staff was very friendly.  There are a lot of activities to do, and it wasn't over crowded when we stayed.  They gave us a coupon for a free $15 item at the pottery painting, which we didn't see until we got home. Went to all 3 water parks, and all 3 were enjoyable.  If you have smaller children, the Wild West park was the better of the 3 as the play area was the largest.  The arcade by that park was the better of the 2, not only in size but they have a large play area in the back.

If you are buying the unlimited wristbands for a child, know that you cannot go with them on the rope course unless you have a band or pay separately.  When I bought the unlimited wristbands, I asked If I could go with for all the activities and was told yes. If your child does not meet the requirements for the rope course, you cannot go with them unless you pay or have a band.

resp.text: Glad you enjoyed your visit.

name: alex csukas
text: Great option for a winter get away.

resp.text: Thanks Alex! Happy Holidays!

name: Jinoj Mathew
text:
This is definitely a good place to be with kids. Plenty of things for kids and most of them can be enjoyed without even leaving the hotel. There are plenty of indoor and outdoor waterparks. The wave pool is a big one and one of the best. Staff is very professional and helpful. This place is huge. Go kart racing was fun. You can order food within the hotel.
Few reasons for one less star:
Room had moisture seeping from the room next to us and made the carpet there wet.
When we looked under the bed there were candy wrappers and toys left over from whoever stayed there before. There were mosquitoes in the hallway too. Some of these are out of the hotels control.
Having said this the feel in the room is great. All the furniture makes you feel you are in the wilderness. I will definitely stay here again.
FYI: Checkin at 4 pm was crazy. They had 5 associates checking people in and still there was a huge line. This place is big so allow plenty of time for check-in. Also don't take your luggage with you when you check in. Your room may be very far away and you will end up moving your car closer to your room.

name: Jackie Handrich
text: Great customer service.

resp.text: Thanks so much Jackie!

name: Justin Rodriguez
text: My favorite dells resort by far.

resp.text: Thank you so much Justin! We appreciate your review!

name: Lisa Lueneburg
text: We stayed in the condo that sleep's 14 people .. the price was definitely good during the week. But would have been a few hundred dollars more a night for the week-end...SO,.   I was impressed by everything except for the cleanliness throughout the park and our cabin.. we all took wet wipes everyone wiped light switches door knobs countertops and they ended up being disgusting if you could see how dirty the wipes got... Yukky..in the park all the lawn chairs were sticky fingerprints they all need a good scrubbing when we went back to the park next day found dirty table's sticky ice cream never seen anyone attending or taking care of them ...now as far as having FUN YES...it was great.. Park pool slide attendance was awesome very kind doing a great job. Food was awesome wait staff too.. really took good care of us.... With illnesses and such take care of yourself for your breathing depends on you !

resp.text: Thanks for the feedback we are sharing it with our housekeeping team!

name: Julie Thormodsgard
text: Wonderful rooms and amenities. Something for everyone to do.

resp.text: Thank you for the wonderful review Julie!

name: Tiffany Rupp
text:
Decent sized rooms. If you expect to eat in your rooms alot get one with a wet bar otherwise you'll run out if space. This resort is huge. It takes a good ten minutes to walk from one lobby to the other depending on your kids. The pools are lots of fun though some of the equipment definitely needs to be upgraded. Our kids had a blast. Though the kiddy pool on the wild west area is way too cold for lil ones. The wave pool is awesome and the ambiance was by far the best of all the pools. Foodwise most of the offerings are ok but the Thirsty Buffalo and the saloon are the best that are attached. The saloon has a quinoa bowl that's amazing.

WARNING! The Wyndham Club people will pull you aside after check in. This is not just looking at rooms they are trying to sell you on a timeshare. It is a good deal but it's a two hour presentation. They told us that there was childcare but when we got there they said no kids who aren't potty trained. So we had to drag our son out of the room crying. We were eventually brought back into the playroom to go through the rest of the presentation because we couldn't get our son to settle down and the rest went fairly well though i was really disappointed that they did not tell us that it was going to be a timeshare presentation.

resp.text: Thanks for your comments Tiffany.

name: Zachary Gerhartz
text: I hate kids. Lol

resp.text: Then our resort probably isn't a good place to visit. Lol

text: Great place to bring kids over for little fun and people don't harass u for the dumb mask will come back soon

name: Bruce Larson

name: Travis Burton
text: A great place to stay. Tried three cabins for the first time in numerous stays - love it!

name: Jeff Petersen

name: Paul Ray

name: Dominic Costanzo
text: The Wilderness is a wonderful family destination all year round. My family has had a get-away home in the dells all of my life so I have seen all the changes the Wilderness has gone through over the years. I was recently at the Wilderness this past weekend and stayed at one of the on site cabins. The cabins and resort hallways felt dated and needed renovations. The wild-west fitness center was smaller then a standard hotel room and the machines were dated. Also the drinks at the water park bars were extremely over priced. I spent over $75 on 5 drinks and they were not extravagant what so ever. All the Wilderness needs is some updates to make the resort feel more modern and less dated. With these types of renovations I would feel better about the $75 worth of drinks. Overall I had a great time and would go back again.

resp.text: Dominic -- If you want to give us more feedback we would appreciate it. Please email us at info@wildernessresort.com. Thanks!

name: Denny Berry
text: One of the best places to stay in the dells! There are three water parks with their own unique theme and attractions. Tons of things to do for kids of any age. The arcade is pretty nice too. Definitely recommend checking it out!

resp.text: Than you for your recommendation Denny!

name: Mike Hawkey
text: Great time place was clean and fun

resp.text: Thank you - glad you had a great time Mike!

name: Adam Brunker

name: Susan Hunter
text: The water attractions were fairly nice. The beds were like sleeping on a concrete slab. The food and drinks are extremely pricey, bring your own and save yourself some money. The arcades and other attractions are pricey as well, it was 7 dollars to ride go carts for about 7 or 8 minutes. You can buy a bracelet and ride the go carts, bumper boats and do lazer tag as much as you like. If your kids want to climb the rock wall or play mini golf, that's not included with the bracelets. A soda from the vending machine is 3 dollars. Bottom line...you need deep pockets.

resp.text: Sorry you didn't sleep well Susan. Mini golf is included in our fun passes.

name: T S

name: angelica melchor

text: Resort is great. They need to work on there website and there customer service phone line. One of them has to be efficient.

name: Melonie P
text: Fun place to stay.

resp.text: Glad to hear you had fun Melonie!

name: Jerry Key
text: Great time and not crowded.

name: No One
text:
Pro's -
The different pools and water slides available.
The front hotel entrance is very welcoming with it's wilderness attire.

Con's -
The interior of the buildings and the hotel rooms look very run down and dirty.
The $50 up charge to use the facilities in addition to your normal nightly hotel fees, taxes.
Bring your own food and drink because it's very expensive in the bars and restaurants on site.

resp.text: If you have additional feedback about how we could have improved your stay, please email us at info@wildernessresort.com

name: Brandon Recknagel
text: We had a great stay recently and my kids loved the waterparks! They do have a serious problem with parking spots. We have 2 rooms booked but had to call to get adjoining, no way to do that online or with separate people paying, was told none were available unless we want to pay another $25. Is $25 really worth making it so a family can’t be close if we are already paying for two rooms in relatively the same price range. Also wasn’t impressed with the fees for canceling. Regardless we are excited for the water parks and to try another resort however we may end back at the Kalahari for our next stay. text: Waterparks have changed a lot since I was a kid.  Back then, The Great Wolf Lodge was the only indoor waterpark.  This place was huge! We spend the night the day before new years so it was rather busy but the most we had to wait was 20-30 minutes for the super intense slide (can't remember its name).  But all of the slides seemed faster than the waterparks I remember from 15-20 years ago.  Plenty of different activities outside of swimming to keep the kids entertained and plenty of alcohol to keep the parents entertained.  We stayed in a 2 room suite that had an adjoining 3rd room to make it 3 bedrooms.  It was perfect and could hold a lot of people.  Will definitely try and get back here in the future!

text: The place is relatively outdated but not by that far comparing to all surrounding resorts. There is shuttle service but we weren't able to catch any when we were there. We waited about 5 - 10 mins a couple of times. The water parks themselves are pretty standard comparing to other resorts in the area. Wave pool, hot tubs with outside access outside, several slides. Nothing too special. A bit let down actually since I'm more used to more the young adult oriented slides at other resorts. This one is more geared toward toddlers and < 6/7 yrs olds.

name: Chris P
text:
Spent 5 days here with my family... I'll break the review down into sections to make it a little easier to find what you're looking for.

Rooms: rooms were mostly clean, nicely decorated with the cabin-y theme going on around the park, but also looked slightly dated. A couple light bulbs need replacing. Carpet could use a shampooing (and probably a replacement soon) in our room. Beds and pillows were very comfortable and made for a good night sleep. Water pressure in sink was a little on the low side and sink was slow to drain. Sliding door to the deck is in need of some maintenance... Very hard to open and close. (Staff notified of issues so they could be corrected).

Water parks: A combination of both indoor outdoor water parks and a wave pool are located at the main resort area. There is something for everyone, from splash pads for the little kids, to giant buckets dumping water on those that want to get drenched all at once, to intermediate water slides for older kids, to intense water slides for teens and adults. Multiple lazy rivers and hot tubs for those that just want to relax. Well staffed with lifeguards to keep an eye on things - we got to watch one make a save of a small child that got pulled too far out in the wave pool.

Arcades: Arcades had a solid mix of games to play. Some games were a little over-priced (like the small toy claw games). Everything seemed well maintained - no games were out of order and all that we played seemed to function as intended.

resp.text: Thanks Chris for taking the time to write this thorough review.

resp.text: Glad you think our property is amazing. Yes, you will get your steps in here.

name: Corrina
text: This was my first time going to the Wilderness in the Dells. I will definitely be making the trip back. There is so much to see and do. Indoor wave pool was great and a great size. Bigger than other indoor pools. It was very clean and reasonably priced. The reason why I didn't give 5 stars is with the size of the resort and with it being my first visit, I wish there was more specific signage or a change in the decor from one wing to another (where the rooms were located). I got side tracked multiple times and I ran into other people with the same frustrations. Even a map that labeled inside landmarks and not just outdoor ones. Also, when finished checking in, I was ushered over to a group of sales people selling discounted coupons for local attractions. I also signed up to get and additional discounted stay if I toured a new timeshare facility. I never did this before, so others who also haven't, skip it! Not worth the hassle or 2 hours of the vacation they take from you... skip the whole desk and enjoy your trip, the sales desk doesn't save you much.

resp.text: Thanks for your feedback Corrina The hallway colors do change when you cross from the New Frontier into the Wild West portion of the hotel but evidently the check in staff didn't tell you this.  We're sorry if you got frustrated. Did you get a map in your check in packet? We certainly hope so!

name: kathy ward
text: I am so sorry.. my fingers stopped at 3 stars.. your staff was so helpful the room was great.

resp.text: Hi Kathy -- We would love to hear some more feedback from you. IF you have suggestions for how we could have improved your stay please email us at info@wildernessresort.com. Thanks a bunch!

name: Alyssa Huebschman
text: The condo was beautiful but when my family got there we had to clean off all counter tops. There was a hole in the wall from a previous occupant. I did enjoy the space and the large area that we could congregate in. There was also no real waiting for a bathroom since there were 3. Will still continue to go here every year.

resp.text: Thanks for your loyalty Alyssa. Sorry the counter tops weren't clean and that there was a hole in the wall. If you didn't report this could you please by emailing info@wildernessresort.com with who the reservation was under and what condo you were in? Thank you so much!

name: Mark
text: Fun place for the kids. Rooms need to be updated. Every is expensive. You pay for the experience but that's about it.

resp.text: Glad your kids had fun Mark. Thanks for your feedback.

name: Andrew Gauger
text:
We always stay there...
...now.  forget the other Dells hotel/resorts... we've tried many.  Wilderness is the best... clean, innovative water park slides and stuff, best food options, fun decor and theme, etc, etc.    Cab be a hike from rooms and parking (parking is their biggest problem.) Can be loud in the hallways, but that's a problem with ALL Dells resorts.  Each room has a private balcony and mini-kitchen.  Fun place, and again, good food options.   Ditch the kids and treat yourselves to dinner at the 'Fields at the Wilderness' restaurant across the lot from the main entry... GREAT food!

name: Angela Wanatee
text: Loved my stay. The rooms are so quiet. I love the space in the rooms. Very clean. Polite workers.

resp.text: So glad you loved your stay Angela!

name: Jerhad Thompson
text: Kids loved it. Each time I've been there one part of the park or another is closed. Which you never find out until you get there. Lots of construction going on. Water park is great though. Easy to get around from park to park.

resp.text: Jerhad, Our waterpark hours are always posted on our website so you can see what will be open before you book. Glad your kids love our resort.

name: R. M. Ramirez
text: It gets a little to cold at night but otherwise amazing

resp.text: Thanks for your feedback.

name: Bruce Wilk
text: Spent three days here in July. Amazing place. Three different water parks. Food was great service was great.

resp.text: Thanks B!

name: Dan Rozdzialowski
text: Love coming here! It's big enough that even during peak season nothing seems over crowded. Food choices vary from quick cafe food to sit down dinner. All the water parks are very well maintained and there are many options for areas to let little kids play in the water.

name: Alejandro Curiel
text: Very Fun

resp.text: Glad to hear it. Thanks Alejandro!

name: Steph Perez
text: Great place to go for families. There's always something to do here for everyone. My family and I go pretty much every year. Would definitely recommend it !!

resp.text: Stephanie, Thanks for the great review and for your loyalty! We appreciate it. Happy Holidays!

name: Diane Worcester
text:
Rooms need updating with more electrical outlets with USB chargers for cellphone & the like
Mattresses were to soft  & sinks should be in bathroom.

resp.text: Thanks for your feedback Diane.

name: Aaron Stoen
text: Wife and I spent a weekend and we're very happy with all accomodations!!!

resp.text: So glad to hear it Aaron!

name: Carol Radtke
text: It's an awesome place. Lots of walking but they do have shuttles every 10-15 minutes. Breakfast at Wild Canyon cafe was amazing. They have the best buffet ever.

resp.text: So glad you had an awesome time Carol.

name: Lily N.
text: I have gone here every year for many years and its so fun.

resp.text: Thanks for your loyalty! Glad you love it!

name: Brey Wolter
text: Our favorite place in the dells.  Always have a great time and end up staying a day or two longer than planned. Staff is always very friendly, helpful, and explains everything great. We had a minor issue one time and they fixed it right away, and gave us passes to the attractions. The best part is we almost always get to check in early.

resp.text: Thanks Brey for your wonderful review and loyalty.

name: Dan Pourroy
text: It has been a great stay. Lots to do. The wilderness dome is great during winter. Makes you feel like it's summer when it has only 2 degrees outside.

resp.text: Glad you had a great stay Dan!

name: Elder J.P. Mc Sr.
text: Had a great time!

resp.text: So glad to hear it Elder!

name: Deborah Hunt
text: Great condo,  good food lots for kids to do. Could do without the vacation resort sales!  Also customer service needs some help, except for our server in the Survivor. He was super.

resp.text: Deborah we are sorry to hear our customer service wasn't top notch. If you remember the names of any unpleasant staff please email us at info@wildernessresort.com so we can address their behavior with them.

name: Sharon Loga
text: Stayed in the condo and had a great time at both indoor and outdoor water parks. Fun for all ages. Condo waa well stocked, clean and comfortable!

resp.text: So glad to hear you had a great time!

name: chris marweg
text: Nice rooms and Waterpark!

resp.text: Thanks Chris.

name: Meredith Congdon
text: Great water park hotel with indoor full size wave pool. Only downside to this hotel is where your room is. You could literally be over a 1/2 mile away from the wave pool or other hotel attractions based on where your room is. Make sure to ask questions like that especially if you have small children.

resp.text: Glad you are having a great time Meredith. We do have a shuttle service if you don't like to walk. And we also allow strollers in our hallways.

name: Elizabeth Kolarik
text: I love this place. I went for a weekend with my boyfriend and his friends. We chilled in the 21+ pool all day and it was awesome! It was salt water too! So no chlorine smell!

resp.text: Thanks Elizabeth -- glad you loved it!

name: carrie mathison
text: Great for the family. Several indoor/outdoor activities. Not over crowded like indoor Mt Olympus.

resp.text: Thanks so much Carrie!

name: Steph Nauer
text: Great time and family friendly!

resp.text: Thanks Steph!

name: Jimbo R.
text: If you are looking for a place to stay that will be entertaining for the kids and adults try the Wilderness.

name: Jason Foster
text: The wilderness is our go to spot for water parks! Always a great time here.

resp.text: Thanks a bunch Jason!

name: Travis Johnson
text:
Stayed in a villa and for the price you pay per night I expected more.  We chose a villa to minimize the number of times we ate out.  With a family of 6 it gets expensive so it's nice to plan meals an eat home cooked meals.  While we were able to make the meals we planned for the vacation, the kitchen amenities were very disappointing.  There wasn't a whisk (used a fork but it's cheap and would have been nice), no large mixing bowls, 2 frying pans (villa sleeps 9 people so a few more options would be great), no tongs, no large spoons that weren't slotted, etc.  Additionally, the unit was older and showed many signs of its age.  Toilet paper holder was falling off the wall.  The shower doors were old, didn't roll smooth, or close all the way.  The front door let in a fair amount of cold air from outside and a few other things that should have been fixed.  Overall, decent stay but way overpriced!

On the personnel side, the staff was AMAZING!  Thoroughly impressed with the hospitality and service we received.  Life guards, hotel staff, security, and anyone else we interfaced with was absolutely wonderful to talk with.

resp.text: Travis, thanks for your review we are sharing it with our condo and villa management team so these issues can be addressed.

name: Myrtie Fendryk
text: What a fun place! Very helpful staff, free wifi, so much to do. The only problem I experienced was one of the water parks i was looking forward to swimming in was closed with no notification.

resp.text: Myrtie -we are glad you had fun and liked our staff. We are sorry you were disappointed that one of our waterparks was closed.

name: MBK ZILLA
text: Had to get moved from a dirty room to a mildew room then the third one was okay, nothing special at all. The lake units were fun a few years ago though.

resp.text: Ron, we are so sorry you had a problem with the rooms you got assigned. We hope our managment was helpful in getting you the assistance you needed.

name: Bernardo Tellez
text: Great and relaxing resort with so much stuff to do so much good food and fun for everyone.

resp.text: Thanks a bunch Bernardo!

name: Glen Ornquist
text: Had a great time at wilderness! With access to 3 different water parks it never felt crowded. You can bill food and snacks to your room which is very convenient while in the water parks. However, the food in the hotel is on the expensive side and it feels like cafeteria food (Even at their "real" restaurants). Easy enough to fix though either go out for dinner or order in, and save the hotdogs for while your in the water park.

resp.text: Thanks for your thoughts Glen. Glad you had a great time!

name: Matthew Hernandez
text: We spent a weekend here for my son's birthday. This was the first time our family spent time here. We had been to the Kalahari before but the Wilderness out did that place. It was busy all weekend long but we still were able to enjoy everything. We didnt have to spend a lot of time in lines waiting for the water slides. The attendants kept it going quickly. The whole resort was very clean and all the employees were amiable and willing to help out. We ate breakfast at the Wild Canyon Cafe. We had their breakfast buffet and the offered many options for the whole family: waffles, pancakes, eggs, bacon, fresh omelettes, and much more. They snack food and small cafes around the park were a little pricey. The kids really enjoyed the water parks, which there were three, and they had several arcades, huge play place, and dry attractions. I would highly recommend this resort as a place to take the kids. Hopefully, in the summer I can review their outdoor attractions too.

resp.text: Thanks so much Matthew!

name: Brian Hulbert
text: Amazing staff!!  Nice lodging!!  Fun water park.

resp.text: Thanks Brian!

name: Janice Marie
text: Fun

resp.text: So glad to hear it Janice. Thank you!

name: Nancy K
text: Always a fantastic experience! We've stayed at many different places within the wilderness resort and enjoyed them all. The water parks are definitely the best and we also like that it's close to Cascade Mountain (which is a great place to ski).

resp.text: Nancy - Thank you for your wonderful review and your loyalty. We really appreciate it. Happy Thanksgiving. We are thankful for customers like you!

name: Christine Hanson
text: Great for kids of all ages. Have been here several times and it's always a positive experience. Our favorite of the Wis Dells waterparks. Cabana was great for the little ones.

resp.text: Thank you so much Christine!

name: Dawn Auld
text: Loved the rooms, spacious and had everything we needed to be comfortable in them. A little pricey,  but worth it. I also loved how many options there were for entertainment.  Go carts, laser tag, water parks...I'm exhausted after all of that playing.

resp.text: Thanks Dawn!

name: dean rams
text: Quite expensive for gramma and grandpa to go spend 4 hrs at the water park with the grandkids....$90....when we even had purchased a room for my daughter and soninlaw and the boys to spend the nite as a Christmas present....$225....we just came up for a few hours to c them swim and have some fun....oh well, they had us....🤷‍♂️

name: David Medwed
text: Wayyy crowded and no one is wearing their mask

name: Amanda Duncan
text: Loved it!  We stayed across the water in Wilderness on the Lake in two bedroom condo.  We had three kids all under four and four adults.  It was really nice to have a kitchen so we did not have to take our kids out to eat, because they were so tired from all the fun they had at the water parks.  Clean, easy to find each park, friendly staff, and great family atmosphere.

name: Mark Medinger
text: This place even when crowded will be relaxing.  Ample pool space in their three indoor water parks, two arcades with fun games, a ropes course, mini golf, go carts... You'll always have something to do on site.  The rooms are spacious and clean.  Their towel policy for the pools makes sense, but adds a little worry to using them.  If they get swiped, you'll be out 25 dollars per towel... We avoided using their towels... Otherwise, not a complaint.  You'll have a good time.

name: Jesse Rosalez
text: Spent a two day weekend for a baseball tournament. Never been at this resort. First night had a issue with the bedding. When you find other people's hair on the sheets or comforters. That's a problem. Made my wife really uncomfortable and rethink the stay. Called for all new blankets. Over the night the heater went out. The next morning used the sink. We came back from breakfast and found our sink had backed up. Called maintenance once again to fix the clog. Overall was just uncomfortable for the stay.  For the amount you pay shouldn't come to that. The recreational part the kids had a blast. Unfortunately wasn't our call on the hotel stay.

resp.text: Jesse we are not finding your name in our reservation system. Can you please email us your contract information at info@wildernessresort.com?

name: Jorge Lopez
text: Family fun for all ,kids ,teens , adults

resp.text: Glad to hear all of you had fun Jorge!

name: Patty McKenney
text: Room was nice.  Lots of water activities for all ages.  Lots of good restaurants and non water activities

resp.text: Thank you Patty!

name: Yvonne Cerkas
text: Fun place.  Family orientated.   Enjoy being there with family.

resp.text: Thanks Yvonne!

name: Charles Lawson
text: Best for your money resort in the Dell's. Great getaway spot for a couple days

resp.text: Thank you so much Charles!

name: Robert Roth
text: Very nice coffee sucks though rooms are great .

resp.text: Robert, We are sorry you didn't  like our coffee. However we are glad you thought our rooms were great!

name: Diane Pryitt
text: We do our annual Christmas for some of our Kids and Grandkids. We just love the place and the different water parks. Many places to eat and games and shopping. Food is great and shuttle services was needed this year with all the rain. We love this special time with our family.

name: Sean Juhl
text: Loved this place.  We went to Kalahari last year and I think this place blows it away. More water parks, better restaurants and excellent service.  Would highly recommend.

resp.text: Thank you so much Sean for the fantastic review. We appreciate it. Happy Holidays!

name: Azazel Ashbight
text: Great staff multiple indoor waterparks and close to the kalihari if u are there for daishocon

resp.text: Thank you!

name: Steve Penn
text:
Please note:  I didn't use any of the water parks.

Check in:  took just under thirty minutes because we had a group registration. New girl was being trained on the job. Poorly.  Disappointing management.

Room:  clean enough though nothing special.

Buffet:  excellent. Fruit was fresh, and. everything else was pretty good. The bacon was piled literally a foot high. Service was good for a buffet.

name: Jessica Kowalczyk
text:
The room was great every thing we could need with decent space. The water park was not to busy and fun for all ages.

The only thing I didn't like was no ceiling fan in the 2nd bedroom -other condos I stayed in had it.

resp.text: Glad you had fun in the waterpark Jessica!

name: Kylia Gillis
text: Very helpful very nice people !!!

resp.text: Thanks for the nice compliment Kylia!

name: Jasmine I.
text: Very fun for the kids. Room was clean and comfy. Definitely going to visit soon again:)

name: ChiPyro
text: Great price great location love all the swimming pools great for the family and kids come here twice a year

resp.text: Thank you for the wonderful compliment and your family's loyalty. We really appreciate it!

name: Stephanie Steffen
text: Great family fun.

resp.text: Glad your family had a great time Stephanie!

name: Angie Caceres
text: We loved our stay at The Wilderness. Everything was clean and well maintained. There are multiple waterparks which is awesome...lines are short and you can enjoy the pool without being overcrowded...unlike many other resorts in the area. This may be due to the fact their parks are for guests only...vs. other resorts allow day passes. We will be going back asap!

name: Chad Hansen
text: Had some good family time here! I think for the enormous size of this place they do a very good job. I would differently give the lifeguard staff at the wave pool absolutely 5+ stars!!!!! Very professional! Several times the emergency stop button needed to be pressed to ensure the safety of a young child as one of them jumped in to take care of the situation. Very impressed indeed! Excellent job!

name: A F
text: Best resort in the Dells! We take family trips every year in the dells and The Wilderness is by far the best. Plenty of indoor and outdoor water parks, shops, craft stations,  kid friendly tubes with screen bottom, kid friendly spas,  and a friendly staff (indoor go carts are fun too). I would love to see an updated arcade.

name: Love Charisma
text: Would like a refund. I was charged more than initially told. I asked to speak to the manager 4 times. I guess that didn't matter because I didn't get loud, obnoxious and rude, because the manager never came out. I kept getting the same woman, who kept saying there's nothing she can do. Smdh. I was so excited about this trip for my fiance's bday and being over charged $120 made it the absolute worse, and knowing that I clearly was not worth the managers time no matter how many times I asked for them is just ridiculous.  I'm very disappointed in this establishment.

resp.text: Could you please email us at info@wildernessresort.com your review, contact information and dates of your stay so we can investigate this further for you?

name: Xerxes Griffen
text: all around pretty good place had a nice arcade had a nice water park and good beds and in a pretty decent spot

resp.text: Thanks Xerxes for your review.

name: Dan Skvie
text: Not bad but they need more updates.

resp.text: Thanks for your feedback Dan. We are currently creating a new food hall where the Wild Canyon Cafe was. It will open on Dec. 21. We also are redoing the New Frontier lobby, building a new 3-story laser tag arena and we're adding Take Flight An Aerial Adventure ride. There is a also a new Twister themed DOA Room Escape in the works over at Wilderness on the Lake.

name: Anthony Havranek
text: We have been here at least 5 times.  Always fun, clean, and friendly staff.  Stayed in the presidential suite this time.  Pricey, but nice and plenty of room for the kids.  Fireworks were great!

name: Walter Fritz
text: As always great place! Been getting villa for family for the past few times. It is like staying at an apartment with lots of room for the family. At least gives you option to prepare food in the villas.

resp.text: Thanks Walter!

name: Jeffrey Bowers
text: This was the 1st time we've stayed at a cabin on site and it was totally worth the extra cash for a large group! Swim facilities were great as always. Worth the drive from anywhere!

name: Maryann Hahn
text: Everything you need to enjoy your stay.

resp.text: Thank you so much!

name: Len Swestka
text: Very nice.  Rented condo for family Thanksgiving.

resp.text:
(Translated by Google) Thanks Len!

(Original)
Thanks Len!

name: Katrina 7th it Witt
text: Fabulous time. Our family has been going here for 11-12 years. It's a great time.  We add more of the family when we can.

resp.text: Katrina, your review just made our day. We love to hear from return customers. Thanks so much for choosing us as your family vacation destination.

name: Nyssa Gardebrecht
text: My hands down favorite place to come relax with friends or family for a few days! So much to do and the rooms are amazing

resp.text: Thank you so much Nyssa! We appreciate your kind words!

name: Emily VandenHeuvel
text: Massive water park resort with SO many things to do! Incredibly clean and friendly staff. The swim up bar is incredible!

resp.text: Thanks Emily! We're thrilled you like the swim up bar and had a positive experience.

name: Sarah Crystal
text: Best hotel in the dells, well kept hotel rooms, rides for all ages, great breakfast, and a really fun wave pool! Tons of memories here and can't wait to make so many more

resp.text: So glad you made great memories Sarah!

name: Bradley Pacyga
text: Great facility. Very crowded for a Sunday. Food wasn't the greatest. Water parks are decent but Kalahari is better.

resp.text: We're sorry that you feel this way Bradley.

name: Paul Raso
text: Went here for a company meeting and all I can say is WOW. So much to do here, had a blast. Can't wait to return. Great service. Great food. Nice rooms also. Make this a place on your stay list.

name: Kimberly Jany
text: Way to many people!

resp.text: Sorry you felt this way.

name: Eric Thietje
text: Room smells like pot and there where m&ms on the floor when we checked in ,,, with a quick vacuum and a few pumps of some  Deodorizer the rooms ready to go Could almost guarantee that sheets are clean since the floor was not. But the water is warm and the parks will clean u up

resp.text: Eric, we are so sorry your room was perfect upon check in. We hope the rest of your stay is better.

name: Tryston Montgomery
text: Lines were quite long on Friday and Saturday, but on Sunday the place was pretty clear. Lots of stuff to choose from. 3 indoor waterparks.

resp.text: Tryston -- We actually have 4 indoor waterparks. We're guessing you missed the one at Wilderness on the Lake. Hope you had fun.

name: Carl P
text: Overall this is a quality establishment, but there were three things that really put a damper on our experience. First, the front desk took half an hour to assist us and two other guests. Second, the shuttle to the condo was very slow to respond. We lost a lot of time out of water park hours.  Third, there is a 250lb weight limit on one of the slides, posted only on one small sign partway up the stairs. Carrying a tube it's very easy to miss. There is a scale at the top, and multiple people in our group had to walk back down. Did I mention that said scale had a digital readout and all your friends get to see? Humiliating. That's a mistake a place like this should not make!

resp.text: We are sorry you were disappointed in these 3 things.

name: Mike Richardson
text: We had an awesome time at Wilderness Hotel!  It was about perfect for our 3 1/2 year old.  I highly recommend the Wild West area and would consider not going if that area was closed (as is often the case on slower days).  The restaurants were good, the mini golf was fun, and the indoor go carts were fast and definitely worth it for our little guy.  This is definitely a step up from Mt. Olympus...

name: Paula Weaver
text: Did the zipline and had a great experience. Wonderful kids to help.

resp.text: So glad you had a great time! We will share this with our team!

name: MERL PAAVERUD
text: A lot of fun and very nice rooms.

name: Katie Bucholtz
text: We go as a family every year between Christmas and New Years. We stay at the Wilderness every time. This year was the Wilderness on the Lake. Loved the fireplaces and the jaccuzi but there was a "heard of elephants" in the room above us. That and a round of stomach flu really put a damper on this yr but already looking forward to next yr!

resp.text: Katie, Thanks for making us part of your holiday tradition. We are sorry to hear this year's visit was ruined by noisy guests and the flu. However, we are glad to hear you will be back.

name: Dave Fleegel
text: Nice variety, and wilderness on the lake rooms are always great

resp.text: Thank you so much Dave!

name: jailyn z
text:
Excellent Place to take the kids for a Vacation. I have 3 myself, and the wilderness offered more than enough activities, in a very wide, multi complex layout, so you don't feel claustrophobic nor smothered while inside the parks. The 2 bedroom Condominium we got was clean, stocked, and really offered that *Home Away From Home* atmosphere, and comfort.
Food, and all the Extras ( to which there are MANY ) are a bit Pricey, so prepare for that. We spent about $500 more than originally planned! Other than that just avoide the Person waiting for you right Next to Check IN, they are trying to get you to go on a *Wyndham Tour* for a few free Tokens, and resort bucks! It's a 3 hour sales pitch robbing you of you're time. Politely Pass on it, you'll thank me...

resp.text: Thanks for your review Johnny!

name: Marius J
text: great pools, rooms super outdated.

resp.text: Thanks for the feedback  Marius.

name: Dave H
text: If you or your kids love water parks. This is an absolute must!!! Four indoor and four outdoor waterprks included in the price of your stay. Staff was very helpful and kind. We brought our 7 year old boy and 13 year old daughter (and her friend) and fun was had by all... for 5 days! And we didn't even make it to Wilderness on the Lake. We went to Noah's ark one day, but the lines were so long that we only went on a few rides... then back to the Wilderness where there were no lines (in late June) for rides that we're just as good and a much better wave pool. Definitely going back!

name: Luke Ritter
text: Do not forget your sandals!  The only thing that is "real" about the ones they sell here is they are Real terrible.

resp.text: We will let our retail buyer know this. Sorry about that Luke!

name: Sarah Reimer
text: Very good time! Plenty to do! Book a stay!!

resp.text: Sarah, thank you for the wonderful endorsement!

name: Seth Bergile
text: Just too damn big!! We spent most of the time we were there walking from water park to water park!! It's literally like a small City! They also sell day passes so the water parks are always packed!! It's worth a visit for the experience but that's enough for me!!

resp.text: Seth, We are sorry you feel this way. We have a complimentary shuttle service that can drive you around if you don't want to walk and our resort is guest exclusive. We do not sell day passes.

name: Alba Scruta
text: It is a great water park if you enjoy water parks, and not just a spouse of someone who is a water park enthusiast. Luckily a nearby motel (Field's Park Motel) has room rates less than half of the rates at the Wilderness, but have free Wilderness Water Park wristbands! All the fun for half the price. But you do have to drive a few minutes to get to the water park.

name: Georges Hanna
text: The trashiest place I've ever been to in the Dells.  I wouldn't consider it a resort.  Low people poor customer service.... kids hired as managers... it's a mess.... will never step a foot there again....

name: Nicholas Barta
text: Loved our stay here! Waterparks are great! Everyone had a blast!

resp.text: So glad you had a blast!

name: john harrington
text: My wife booked a weekend for the family in November.  My kid turned seven. He was able to take a friend. The rooms were amazing, the atmosphere was fun and the three swimming areas (and swim up bar for adults) were awesome and very well kept. 10 for 10 would do this again.

name: Saiyan FPS
text: Amazing winter vacation spot with family and friends alike!

resp.text: Thank you Jacob for the great compliment!

name: Keith Staebler
text: Fun place, expect to get cracked over the head on everything.  Internal pizza place sucks.  Parks are fun.  Plan on bringing your own snacks/food.  Buy refillable beer glasses.  Best price in whole resort on refills

name: SlumpBuster Tackle
text: Great family destination. The kids always sleep well after playing all day. The weekends get more crowded but over all great family getaway location.

resp.text: Thank you!

name: Eric Introligator
text: 2 indoor water parks that were open were fun. Good slides.  Room was a little dainty.  We didn't do indoor amusement park, but looked fun. Large resort.

name: Chaos New Money
text: MY 3 CHILDREN AND I ABSOLUTELY LOVE IT HERE! AMAZING PLACE FOR FAMILY GET AWAYS!

resp.text: Thank you so much for your review. Glad you love it.

name: Anthony Capriola
text: Kids had a great time tons of choices for all ages for fun food and drinks

resp.text: Thanks for the great review Anthony!

name: RCnurse
text: Huge indoor waterparks, and plenty to do with a family!

resp.text: Glad your family had fun Jordan!

name: Jessica Lodge
text: Tons of stuff to do with kids. Highly recommend the play pass. It will save you money on all the extra things to do like laser tag, mini golf etc

resp.text: Thanks so much Jessica!

name: Jim Miller
text: We always have a great time at the Wilderness. The key is to stay in the condo's. Excellent shuttle service.

resp.text: Thank you Jim!

name: John Rueff
text: We thought this was the best resort in the Dells and stay in the  Dells every fall.  This stay was strange.  Half the park was closed for renovations.  This included some restaurants and kiosks like the snow cone stand which my daughters really disliked.  The first night they were only open until 10 but the next night they stayed open till 11 because they had more people.  Then we had a Wilderness gift card but couldn't use it at half the places we tried including the pottery place on grounds.  Typically go here ever year.  Gonna consider other locations now.

resp.text: Thanks so much Jeff. Your review means a lot to us.

name: W M
text: I'll just lead off by saying, my stay here was terrible.  The room got cleaned 1 time in 3 days, and even then I had to call the front desk and force someone to show up.  The waterpark manager was the most aggressive moron I had ever dealt with, he shouldn't be allowed near customers.  The food was worse than a fast food restaurants, but 5x the cost.  I would take the kids to a Super 8 with a pool before I went back to this place.  Anyplace else will be a better choice.

resp.text: We would really like to talk to you about your experiences. Can you please copy your email and paste it into a message along with your contact information  and email us at info@wildernessresort.com?

name: J.T. Grantin
text: Wasn't impressed at all. Indoor waterworks are small and boring for our young kids. Had to walk a mile of hotel hallways to get between parks. Recommend Kalahari #1 then Great Wolf Lodge #2 over Wilderness. Won't be back.

resp.text: We are sorry to hear you feel this way J.T. Many people like that are parks are spread out because then the all of the hotel guests are not all in one location.

name: Michael Aschinger
text: Even just staying for a night is fun, such a great environment for families but enough for adults to enjoy too.

resp.text: Thanks Michael!

name: Michelle S
text: Very pleased with how thouro the staff was everyday very clean and safe place!

resp.text: Thanks Michelle!

name: Nick Berlick
text: Interesting set up the parks were spread out far apart. Almost too far apart. I'm also a waterslide not and I think they could have had a few more slides at each park.

name: Yeng Vang
text: Fun place. All activities are inside, so it was very convenience.

resp.text: Thank you Vulkee!

name: Christopher Twohig
text: Wilderness is a great resort for families of all ages with indoor and outdoor waterparks,  arcades, go carts, and all sorts of fun attractions.   There are skywalks to the different areas as well as a shuttle service around the grounds.  You can even take a boat ride across Lake Delton to the Wilderness on the Lake, weather permitting.  We've been going to Sundara for years, but now we bring our kids to the family-friendly Wilderness side of things.

resp.text: Thanks Christopher!

name: Sarah Aupperlee
text: Fairly run down. Woods view is nice. Our room for over 250 dollars per night was not great. Burn holes in the carpet, soaking wet carpet, disgusting stain on bed.  Hopefully some of the newer places on the property are better. Staff seemed nice.

name: A BoogieMan
text: Amazing waterparks!  Spend a day at the indoor wave pool!

resp.text: Thanks Mike -- We love that you thought our resort was amazing!

name: Terry Bialeschki
text: We went there just last year ,, Great place but we will stay in the resort instead of a cabin next time for more convienance .  Skiing and many Water rides to keep you busey.  Great place for a winter getaway ,

resp.text: Thanks Terry!

name: Berkeley Blum
text: Wide variety of water parks. Can be expensive during the season. Great deals in off season.

resp.text: Thanks Berkeley!

name: Jack Johnson
text: THE RUMORS ARE FALSE!!!! THEY DO NOT HAVE ALL YOU CAN PRINT PRINTERS!!!!!

resp.text: Thanks Jack.

name: Mike Kostuch
text: Nice water parks and other amenities but the it would be nicer if more things were closer together. The shuttle service is nice but sometimes riding a shuttle in your swimsuit is not ideal especially in colder temps.

resp.text: Thanks for your thoughts Mike. Glad you thought our waterparks and amenities were nice.

name: Nicholas Bauer
text: Great resort with plenty activities and nearby attractions. Accommodations are excellent, well kept, comfortable. Close to golf courses!

resp.text: Thanks Nicholas. Be sure to check out our Wild Rock Golf Club.

name: Amy Hurt
text: Soo much variety!! So much to do! All of the indoor parks are connected by indoor walk ways. Be aware that the roof covering the wave pool allowed uv rays; wear sunscreen!

resp.text: Yes, definitely wear sun screen. Glad you had a great time Amy. Thanks for your review!

name: erin zimmer
text: I Love The Wilderness Resort!! It's Amazing BUT sometimes they put a little bit TOO much chlorine in pools which is bad for adults or kids with asthma.

resp.text: Thanks Erin.

name: Terry Hopkins
text: Always a great place to spend time with family...

resp.text: Thanks Terry!

name: Ashton Decker
text: My family has been going here for years, it's trustworthy, reliable and fun. The renovations they did make are odd I will say, I wish there were more things for babies and younger toddlers, the last time we went was for my nephews 3rd birthday and my daughter was 8 months at the time, pretty much all me and my daughter were able to do was play in the teeny tiny playground they have off to the side next to the gigantic playground for the older kids, we went swimming in the open water, played in the shallow water and went down a few kiddie slides and that's it...it's a place for children ages 3-10 I would say. I always loved coming here as a kid otherwise, playing the arcade games, running around in the playground, going down the water slides and having that loving family experience.

name: Jeremy Salentine
text: Staff was great!  Water parks were fun.  Kids had a blast!  Room was nice.  Floors could be a little better sound insulated in our building we could hear some banging or heavy footsteps, couldn't hear talking or yelling though.

name: Ry Guy
text: This place is great!

resp.text: Thanks Luke!

name: JR Trempala
text: Love this place so much family fun

resp.text: So nice to hear! Thanks JR.

name: Megan Starr
text: Fun place, very nice rooms. Only issue we had was out first stay the wave pool "room" was closed for all but the first night of our stay. Which also meant we could not enjoy the swim up bar. But our second trip everything was open inside and always have a Blast! Cant wait to visit in the summer to enjoy the other water parks and check out the infinity pool at the lake delton resort(Wilderness on the Lake)

name: Justin Spaulding
text: It's awesome place for children and adults. We had a blast, especially in the wave pool.

resp.text: Glad to hear you had a blast Justin!

name: Amy Gempeler
text: Been here before and it keeps getting better as the kids get older. Always clean with great staff. Witnessed a lifeguard save in the wave pool yesterday and you could tell the level of training and dedication to the guests. Well done!

name: Hope Dupee
text: My husband, a few friends, and I came to this place back in December and the experience way beyond fantastic. The staff were friendly and polite. Our room was clean and well worth the price that we paid.

name: Summer Bird
text: Amazing resort! Tons to do without ever leaving the hotel (indoor waterparks, outdoor waterparks, arcades, mini golf, ropes course, VR experience, laser tag, laser maze, pottery painting, etc) and even more to do off site downtown. Rooms are clean and everything is functional. We had a minor issue with our room (couldn't get patio door to lock, and we were on the first floor so that is a must), and they sent maintenance within 10 minutes and they were in and out within 5, problem fixed.  Highly recommend, especially the rooms with the Jacuzzis in them! That was a great way to wind down after a long day!

resp.text: Thank you so much Summer for the wonderful review!

name: Eekicks
text: The good: Variety and size of water parks was awesome. Had lots of fun and lines were short enough that the kids do not get to antsy.  The not so good: Floors in the room were not very clean and no one has cleaned under the beds in probably years. Some areas of the pool were black and possibly moldy? Would I go back... yes and now I know what areas to avoid. Quick tip, get a room on the 3rd floor as the second floor is a highway of foot traffic since it has access to all buildings.

name: Sean Deets
text: Comfortable rooms, great services and fun activities

resp.text: Thank you for the nice review Sean!

name: patrick lang
text: Always a good time, also it's way cheaper to stay at the Glacier Canyon! You gotta walk further to swim, but it's all indoor walking.

resp.text: Thanks Patrick!

name: Nich Robotka
text: Friendly staff, wonderful rooms, and a swim up bar in one (of several) waterparks. There's plenty to do in a span of 24 hours ,in addition to the many restaurants & gift shops located right within walking distance. Highly recommended if you're looking for a getaway during the frigid season (or blistering summer months)

resp.text:
(Translated by Google) Thanks Nich!

(Original)
Thanks Nich!

name: Ramsin Gabriel
text: YES!  What an amazing place.  We came with my 18 yr old Daughter.  3 of us had a blast. But we realized it was more for families with younger kids.  While we still did the zipline and other activiities, it didnt warrant us staying there for more than 2 days.

name: Sarah Stallman
text: We've been coming here for over 20 yrs, and still have a good time today.

resp.text: Thanks for your loyalty Sarah!

name: Rhonda Lane
text: The wilderness was nice....service was nice as well

name: Michelle Grau

resp.text: Thanks for your feedback Michelle. We will share it with our management team. We are sorry yhat you were disappointed.

name: James Young
text: My favorite place to go! Crazy fun and relaxing!

resp.text: Thank you!

name: elaine miller
text: Very large place with lots to do there...Polka dot pots inside is fun place to make pottery,  they fire overnight and you pick up on the following day!

resp.text: Thanks Elaine!

name: Charlie Tuna
text:
I dunno about you, but when we stayed here for a family reunion, we took up like 7 rooms. Pots, pans, silverware, glasses, paper towels, and toiletries were already ready already, which was great! One thing we didn't think of was salt and pepper =/
Fortunately some of our neighbors (with adorable bouncing twin girls) we're making chicken and loaned us some.
Bummer was how crazy early the water parks shut down!?!?!? 7PM in summer, for even an outdoor pool is too early!
Mainly just wish it was less expensive, as we'd all love to do that again =)

name: Marcie Beshears
text: Our stay had been very good. A few suggestions- trying to pay for breakfast was difficult because the only personyou can pay is the waiter, but ours basically disappeared. I had to try very hard to find someone to pay. This was all while my son had an explosive diaper and I needed to leave to change it. I'd suggest bringing a stroller if bringing young children. The walk between buildings and parks is extremely long. Like half a mile or more. This is not bad unless you have cranky toddlers, all the pool stuff and trying to get everyone back to your room. :) the resort is very clean, the staff are all mostly helpful and polite. The rooms are spacious and quiet. I would stay again. My biggest complaint would be the walking ( only bc I came unprepared without a stroller), the prices of food and drinks (a 20oz beer in the water park was $17!), and check out is at 11am, wish it was noon or 1pm.

resp.text: Thanks Marcie. Glad you had fun. We always say all of the walking justified treating yourself to some Pistol Pete's ice cream.

name: Jose Lopez
text: Awesome place for family vacation

resp.text: Thanks Jose!

name: Willie Kreis III
text: Always fun here. Wish we could afford the luxury rooms.. Hint hint (wilderness)..

name: belle city
text: Very fun for the family but needs to be updated

resp.text: We are currently making lots of updates Belle. We just opened a new restaurant, we're renovating our lobby, building a new laser tag arena and building a great new aerial adventure ride.

name: Angela Cantu
text:
I retract my previous statement. I was speaking of a different hotel we stayed at. It was the one we stayed at previous to this one. You have my sincerest apologies!

This hotel was super awesome! My family stayed in the condos. They fulfilled every accommodation for us!

resp.text: We are bummed to read this. Please email us at info@wildernessresort.com about your experience.

name: The Willes Family
text:
My family and I spent one night at the Wilderness and we had an absolute blast. I would love to give this resort 5-stars but I just cannot do so, and here is why:

This is a family friendly resort with three large indoor water parks. Although the water parks were a lot of fun for my 2-year-old daughter, I could not help but notice the insane amount of alcoholic beverages that people were consuming. One water park appears to be geared more toward small children with a large lazy river surrounding it. This water park was best suited for my 2-year-old daughter and we had a wonderful time. My complaint is this.... If you have one water park geared more toward smaller children, it seems inconsiderate to have a bar serving drinks the size of your head. I witnessed several intoxicated individuals arguing, cursing at one another and eventually the cops were called. We moved our table to the other side of this water park and then had to deal with a heavily intoxicated couple indulging in lewd behavior that was entirely inappropriate for children to witness.

WITH that being said, this hotel would receive 5-stars from my family had their water parks not been serving alcohol at all three pools. Just pick one water park that is family friendly all around for little children under the age of 7 -- with no alcohol, please.

Aside from the water park fiasco, our room was clean and quite spacious. We loved Polka Dot Pots where you can paint your own pottery! We toured this entire resort, each water park and visited all the shops. Overall, this was a great stay with a few flaws -- over-serving alcoholic beverages around small children being the biggest flaw of all which will most likely hinder us from returning.

name: Colton White
text: Fun for all ages

resp.text: Thanks so much Colton!

name: Cait Cronson
text: Go during the week and invest in the large, refillable margaritas!

resp.text: Thanks for your tips Cait!

name: David Webb
text: Front desk gave us wrong directions to room. Was a quarter mile off. Room was delightful

resp.text: David, We are so sorry that you were given the wrong directions. It must have been a new an employee although that isn't an excuse they should have known. Again, we apologize!

name: kayla kusters
text: Super fun. Lots to do.

resp.text: Glad you had fun Kayla!

name: Joseph Thorp
text: Everyone is real friendly but it needs alot of attention regarding communication between everyone the right had dont know what the left hand is doing you guys can do better i have seen it

resp.text: Joseph, we are sorry if you didnt have a positive experience and we will be sharing your review with our management team.

name: Elizabeth Rankin
text: We have been taking our kids here 2 times a year since my oldest was 6 and she is now 19!! Cant say enough about this place. There are 4 waterparks located within the resort and they have lots of other things to do. They have paint and pottery, go carts, arcades, ropes courses, laser tag, glow miniature golf etc all located right inside the actual hotel! If you are looking for a good cup of coffee in the morning than head over to Starbucks over at the wild west waterpark. The Wild Water dome is a great place to lay out in the sun indoors to catch a great tan and it also has a heated adult only swim up bar there as well. The wilderness has family rides and single rider rides. Check out their website to see if they are having special activities around the time you are going. We have been there while they have offered free horse drawn carriage rides, free pumpkin patch rides, trick or treating etc. Also if you guys get a little tired than they also have a kids club where your kids could work on crafts. This place is definitely worth trying out. Look for deals because in the off season it isn't uncommon to find a room during the week for $99.00. If you have small children I would recommend you bring a stroller because the resort is big and there is a lot of walking between watermarks. Enjoy!!!!

resp.text: Thank you so much Elizabeth for your loyalty and your wonderful review. We really appreciate guests like you who love our resort!

name: Laura Rixen
text: Clean, comfortable. Not crowded. We always stay at Wilderness and rent a condo with kitchen and 3 bedrooms. Vigilant lifeguards, life jackets supplied for kids. Towel service. Love it.

name: Cheryl Kloss
text: Continues to be an annual destination for fun. Stayed in Glacier Canyon Lodge section. Room amenities average. Maintenance staff responsive to lock and dishwasher issues. Disappointed with in-room coffee pots, now provided with a small 4cup maker in a room that sleeps at least 6 people.

resp.text: Thanks for making us part of your family tradition. Sorry you had issues that required maintenance.

name: Jason Severe
text: Awesome Waterparks, fantastic rooms, and excellent service. My family has been coming here for several years now and they just keep getting better. They are private and do not allow non-guests to access the facilities so the crowds are not that bad, especially compared to the Mt. Olympus parks that are always Insanely overcrowded. Wilderness has a lot of fun activities and the rooms are very nice. My girls have a great time and we never want to leave. The souvenir soda cup is by far the best deal with $1 refills for your entire stay. And the giant beer and mixed drink cups are good values for the amount and refill discount. Something for everyone, young and old.

name: serena wildt
text: Our family thoroughly enjoyed our stay here! The waterparks are phenomenal!

resp.text: Thanks so much Serena!

name: Carmen Oschmann
text: Great Father's Day! Sharing in Family time fun

resp.text: That is wonderful to hear! Enjoy your day!

name: Marius Eugen
text: Very nice place for 2 or family. Many please for children to play. Amazing. Beautiful. Very good service, clean and everything u waiting for is here. Definitely I'm back in this location

name: Anthony Peacock
text: One of the best places that I've been. Very family oriented.

resp.text: Thanks for the wonderful compliment Anthony!

name: Bruce Bancroft
text: Great resort, everything you could ever want in one location.  Try and look for deals if you book in advance.  The only downside is the place is huge!  Expect to walk a great distance and it can be crowded.

name: L Bingham
text: This was our second stay at Wilderness Resort. The room was clean and well kept. Our favorite is the sun dome / wave pool and the relaxing atmosphere. It's a great get away to brake up the winter months. We plan on going again next year.

name: Tammy R Fuller
text: Fun, and amazing for kids of all ages!

resp.text: Glad to hear you enjoyed our resort Tammy!

name: annielibes
text: I like the Wilderness, but after going to the Kalahari for the 1st time it really doesn't compare. It's very annoying that the waterparks are all spread out. If they were in one location it would be a lot more enjoyable. It can also be hard to find a table or chairs to put your things down. The staff isn't always very friendly which makes the experience less enjoyable as well. I also find the people who check the ID's for the swim up bar are rude. I look very young but am well over 21- every time we go there they "overly examine" my ID. Just read my birthday and let me through!

resp.text: We are sorry you feel this way Jessica.

name: Miccayla Furman
text: Pools were ice cold at all 3 indoor parks, all the kids you saw were walking around with purple lips and trying to go into the whirlpools to warm up but we're kicked out. Wave pool had vomit in it and was still open for use. 1 large indoor water park wasn't open on Thursday or Friday during the day. Many restaurants weren't open during the weekday. Food was unimpressive and over priced. Most of the staff was nice and rooms were clean.

resp.text: Miccayla - We would welcome the opportunity to talk to you more about your experiences. Please copy and paste this review into an email and send it to info@wildernessresort.com with your contact information so we can address what you have written about.

name: Eric Maas
text: More to do here for all ages than any resort in the dells.  The restaurants are all clean, fair priced, and well staffed.  The place is clean and the customer service is nonstop from the second you walk out of your car.  Up to date rooms as well. Great WiFi reception throughout the resort.  They also don't sell tickets to everyone off the street which makes the parks and attractions not so packed.  Awesome place.

name: Jen
text: Meant to write a review about this place a few months earlier, but never got around to it. Anyway, stayed here in August and our family had lots of fun! I felt like a kid again with the indoor and outdoor water park and had a blast on the slides and wave pools. My son really enjoyed the wild west area as did all the children. I love the swim up Margarita bar and the rooms were  nice and clean. Hope to visit here again!!! Great place for family vacation.

name: Stacy Rodriguez
text: My children and I enjoyed our trip. We will definitely come back again!!

resp.text: So glad to hear it Stacy!

name: David Guillen
text: Never miss an opportunity to visit. The wife and I bring the kids here several times a year. Multiple indoor water parks, outdoor water parks, arcades, indoor go carts, indoor playground, stores, buffet, restaruants, crafting activities, you really dont have to leave for your entire stay. This has been the only resort in the Dells we have been to as we were blown away by everything. Also always seems to be the best value.

name: 1HOTGal
text: I love this one Wilderness Resort and i have been here 2 times already . My favorite pool was the wave pool that one was really fun .☺😊

resp.text: Thanks so much Sarah! We love the wave pool too!

name: Sue Sears
text:
We're having a wonderful time here at The Wilderness Resort. I came here to celebrate my Granddaughter's  birthday and Fathers Day.  My granddaughter will dance here on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday with her Dance group, The Hot Shots. This place is a huge water park with all the water attractions you would expect, plus two lazy rivers.   The rooms are comfortable and scrupulously clean. The outside grounds are well maintained and beautiful. The staff is friendly and accommodating. Everything was wonderful !
Couldn't ask for more.

name: Jessica Cole
text: IMO, this is the best resort in the dells. There are so many water parks to visit, and they cover all ages. It usually isn't so packed that you're waiting hours, because there's just so much to do! The wave pool and outdoor hot tub are my favorite. Outdoor hot tub is a MUST if you're visiting in the winter!

name: Todd Lemke
text: We'll put together resort.  Lots of life guards for safety.  Polite staff.  Activities for all ages.  We stayed in the condos which had enth of space for our large crowd.

name: Misty Casey
text: We stayed at the Wyndham resort and it was fantastic.

resp.text: Thanks Misty!

name: Jason Benson
text: One of the best hotels I've ever been at. Plus all the the great indoor water park fun

resp.text: Thank you for the wonderful compliment  Jason!

name: Joel Bonasera
text: Everything was fun. Everything is clearly designed to "be fun", mostly with kids in mind. There are elements of this place that give the appearance of a "resort", but the execution is off. The furniture in the rooms and public spaces feel built to be durable and just comfortable enough that you don't mind. The food is passable but nothing to get excited about. The privacy of a cabana was nice, but the service was not any better than if you just got your food and drinks yourself. There are definitely plenty of options for water parks, and the pools rarely felt overcrowded in the middle of July.

name: Aiko
text: Very helpful and freindly front desk staff.  The room was very clean.  The waterpark was crowded but well maintained.   Great job Wilderness team!!

resp.text: Thank Paul! We appreciate your compliment and review!

name: Ross K
text: Stayed in the Wyndham area was amazing nice rooms was a great place to sleep and relax before having more fun also fun pools indoors and outside and even indoor arcade rooms was a great time there

name: Scott Miller
text: We had a nice time. The room smelled like mold which was a bit uncomfortable.

resp.text: Scott, We would really appreciate it if you could email us at info@wildernessresort.com more details about your stay and how we could have improved it.

name: Scott Bunker
text: Clean, lots and lots of things to do and very nice staff.

resp.text: Thanks Scott!

name: Corey McLaughlin
text: Water parks are awesome

resp.text: Thanks Corey!

name: Jenny Ness
text: Our family loves heading to Wilderness in the off-season to enjoy their indoor waterparks. We took advantage of the unlimited fun pass this time, which was a great value for my non-pool loving son. There is plenty to do here that isn't swimming, but only the swimming is included free with the stay. Our favorite park is the wave pool, by far, but there are plenty of options to pick from. The new "game" slide has tons of potential, but no one in our family could get it to work correctly.

name: Molly Jones
text: Everything is fine, not awesome but fine. Everyone seems to get lost, we usually see numerous people wandering around looking for something. We come here usually for conferences, the food is in dire need of updating. It's just so crazy with all the people

resp.text: Thanks for your insights Molly. We will convey them to our food and beverage team.

name: James Bond
text: This place will always hold a special place in my heart. Fond memories with family and friends here that I will treasure forever.

resp.text: James - you just made our day -- it's reviews like yours that bring smiles to our faces. Thank you for sharing your thoughts.

name: M Johnson
text: Three water parks strung together by what seemed like a mile of corridor.  Loud, crowded, mass of humanity in single file corridor.   Also, about a minute after checking in a guy at "information" desk waves me over starts a hard sell on some kind of time share thing.  When I told him I wasn't interested he was kind of a jerk about it and it just got the stay off to a  negative start.  The room was nice.  It was clean.  The water parks when one got to one were ok.  Big wave pool was nice but all things considered I wouldn't go back.

resp.text: We are really sorry you didnt enjoy your stay. Yes, there is a lot of walking to do but we always say that's  your excuse for treating your yourself to a Pistol Pete's frozen temptation.

name: sheri kuzur
text:
Love love love this place
Only place in the Dell's we stay at.  Been to them all.  None even come close to this place

name: Micah Vaughn

resp.text: That is wonderful to hear. Thank you Micah!

name: Dekunutman 31

resp.text: Thank you so much for the great review!

name: Tanya Treleven
text: We love coming here as a family!

resp.text: That is so nice to hear. Thanks Tanya for your review!

name: Jacquelyn Ziegler
text: We Honeymooned here 7 years ago and come back again and again. There is Nothing I don't like about this place.

resp.text: Awe, this review made our day! Thanks Jacquelyn!

name: Rob Goncalo
text: Went to the Wilderness on a getaway with my 4 friends. Got a room with 2 Queen beds and a pullout sleeper. The sleeper was uncomfortable and bowed in the middle. The patio door wouldn't latch properly.  Shower was fine. Sound dampening could have been a bit better. Service was mediocre at best. Shuttles to the casino were late. Drinks and other things were very, very expensive. Room was clean. View was over the kid pools but they were drained at this time of year. Wave pool and other resort activities were fun and worth the cost. Would recommend this over the Kalahari and Mt. Olympus

name: Mary Updike
text: Love staying at the Wilderness! Great atmosphere, friendly staff, quiet for sleeping and lots of great restaurants within close proximity. Would highly recommend!
