name: Nadia Yakich
text: Good serivce, good food. Very busy but very nice. Suggest bringing an extra pillow

resp.text: Nadia, Housekeeping would have brought you more pillows if you needed them. Glad you enjoyed your stay. Happy Holidays!

name: Steve Seaney
text:
Room literally stunk

We stayed for three nights in a two bedroom suite.  The room literally smelled like garbage.  House keeping tried various sprays  to alleviate the issue, but nothing helped..

As we left we saw the next person moving into the room; no special cleanup appeared to have been done to address the issue.

name: rea summer
text: It is so much fun took my nefues and they had a blast so much fun

resp.text: Glad you had a fun time Rea!

name: Elizabeth Larson
text: Lots of fun, 3 indoor water parks to choose from (being December when I visited those are all I know of). Loved the indoor/outdoor hot tubs. The indoor parks definitely cater to children. Very few large slides and wait times were almost an hr in line. Regardless, our family had a lot of fun.

name: Rat Mom Lee
text: Gorgeous accommodations and so many fun things to do. Hoping to go back soon.

resp.text: Thank you!

name: Ian Haight
text: Great parks and games for a family trip.  So much to do.

resp.text: Thanks Ian!

name: Brian Gleason
text: I have visited this resort as a family and on business. In both experiences, the staff were friendly and helpful and facility upkeep is great!

resp.text: Thanks Brian!  We appreciate your FIVE-STAR review!

name: Melissa Milkie
text: Had such a great time with my family. There is so much to do that you really don't even have to leave.

resp.text: Thanks Melissa!

name: Clinton Stumpf
text: Most WI Dells rooms are kinda nasty, but Wilderness are clean and spacious rooms. A lot of great water sides. The Hurricane is pretty insane. Margarita Bar for adults in the dome is definitely worth checking out.

resp.text: Glad you enjoy our resort Clinton.

name: Robert Gates
text: Alot of FUN! But, if your my age with COPD, can be breathless!!

resp.text: Glad you had fun Robert! Take care of yourself. We don't want you breathless!

name: Betty Carmichael
text:
There were plenty of things to do here for the kids and they enjoyed themselves, but most of the employees lacked a good attitude or work ethic.
Our room in the hotel was alright, had a nice view and a sofa and extra television, but other parts of the resort needed attention. The wave pool was filled with band aids and other debris and several glass doors I encountered were filthy.
Parts of the water park were were closed and we were not informed this was going to be the case when we booked.
We were unable to get service in two separate restaurants at at 7pm on a Sunday evening and there is no breakfast or coffee available until 8 am or later in the mornings.
If you're not the kind of person that pays attention to the little details you might have an alright time here, but there were just too many negatives, more than I have time to list, for me to overlook.

name: Colt Van Rite
text: Ive stayed here over 30 times and its always a good experience. Great place to get away for the weekend no matter the age!

resp.text: Wow Colton, thank you so much for your loyalty! We really appreciate it and your wonderful review!

name: Christina Fennell
text: The report was nice and clean but very hard to find anything. Clearer signs for lobbies and where things are would have been helpful. But the staff was friendly and the room clean.

name: Lizzie Kommes
text: Awesome

name: Jason Nix
text:
Our family of 11 loved our stay here. The staff ( every single person, really!! ) was kind, helpful, friendly, personable, well mannered, polite, and very very patient. We will come back here for sure next time hands down. The resort is well laid out and maintained. The water parks here were all warm, well staffed with happy people, had short lines if any for the more popular rides and ( to my surprise ) all the guest were very polite. The shuttles make things super easy. If I had to complain about anything here it would be that the condo we had says it sleeps 14, it didn't say comfortably, It can sleep 14 but so can a minivan. 8 adults could sleep comfortably and there's 2 cots and 2 pullout sofas  (not so comfortable).
I know that all of us are looking forward to coming back next year to make more great memories. Thanks to all the staff ( front of the house and all the hard working behind the scene  staff )  and the do the zipline.

name: Christian Kauphusman
text: We have always enjoyed our stay at The Wilderness Resort. It is great for families and very entertaining.

resp.text: Thank you for the wonderful review Christian!

name: Joanna Maslanka
text: We had fun in the water attractions. Disappointed in the evening by the game rooms. Multiple games not functioning and card readers that only worked occasionally. Prizes were underwhelming and the arcade by the go carts was stifling. Staff were nice enough. Driver on the Red line on Monday was very nice, friendly, and communicative. Surprised that we had no kitchen towels or hot pads in our condo. I mention it because we've had them years previous in cabins. Looking forward to seeing what is new next year.

resp.text: Joanna, We are glad you enjoyed the water fun, but we are so sorry for our oversight missing the hot pads and kitchen towels in your unit. We hope you were able to have some brought to you. If you ever question something like that in future stays, please call the desk and we will have them brought to you right away. We will pass along your comments about the arcade so they are aware of your feedback. We hope to see you again next year!

name: luzanobelfield
text: My family and I LOVE the Wilderness! There is something to do for ALL ages! From arcades, go karts, mini golf, zip lining and ropes course to various timed activity stations (for a reasonable fee). We love that there is 3 separate waterparks! 2 out of the 3 waterparks has an Indoor and Outdoor area with the exception of Lost World. It is an outdoor park only but is our favorite since there is an exceptionally big lazy river! You can certainly walk to all parks in between the hotels or be lazy like us and drive to each one (a very short distance). Staff encountered are friendly and almost always smile! This is however a private resort and only guest are able to access the waterparks. This is definetly a park we never get tired of!!

resp.text: Thank you so much for the fantastic review!

name: Kristen Colgin
text: We had a great time! Plenty of activities for an enjoyable weekend away for adults and kiddos alike.

resp.text: Thanks so much Kristen!

name: Jason Buchanan
text: Always a great family get away!  Lots of updates , clean and friendly staff.

resp.text: Thanks Jason!

name: RaeAnn Shaw
text: It's a great place to take kids. The hurricane is the best ride for adults.

resp.text: We agree! We love the Hurricane

name: Mike Mckinney
text: Not a bad place, just wish they had a bigger indoor swimming pool.it was too cold outside to have the outdoor water park open

name: Jon Nagle
text: First time staying there, and will definitely go back!

resp.text: Thanks Jon! So glad to hear you will be coming back.

name: Saralyn Ostwinkle
text: Had a great time. Place is super clean!

resp.text: Thanks Saralyn!

name: Nicholas Dufek
text: The room was nice.  The water parks were cold for my whole family.  Turn up the thermostat a bit.  A few of the slides for closed.  Wish the water parks were closer together.  All of the amenities are expensive.

resp.text: We are sorry you were cold. The waterparks are at kept at 84 degrees.

name: Maria Yolanda Pena
text: It's always fun! Clean rooms. A lot staff to do in just one place. Love it.

name: Joseph Bartkiewicz
text: Great please to chill out and have great time with family and friends. 🌴😁🍹

resp.text: So glad to hear it Joseph!

name: Linda Trew
text: The rooms (suites) r starting to look shabby.  The buffet for breakfast is awful. Will never eat there again. The pots n pans r poor quality. I don't expect fancy cookware but a non stick frying pan would be helpful.  We had to throw our eggs in the garbage.  My grandkids love coming there.

name: Daniel Page
text: From the very friendly and efficient staff at the front desk to the housekeeping staff to the myriad of personnel supervising and maintaining the water park, everyone that I interacted with was all about providing a very pleasant experience.

resp.text: Thanks Daniel!

name: Katie Wolak
text: The parks were very child focused (which is expected) but they do have a nice "adults only 21yr+ pool" with a swim up bar area that was a pleasant surprise and much needed reprieve from the children in the Waterdome park. Overall this was a large resort with a ton of amenities indoors like go karts, Lazer tag, mini golf and more which made it a great place to visit even in the winter; the only downfall was food quality and the price of said food. So if you're looking for some family fun I recommend but if you're a couple looking to get away maybe look else or look into their Sundara Spa.

name: Crystal Kultgen
text: We had a great time staying at the wilderness.  We had a 2 bedroom villa, it was super spacious and clean.  Nice view from the back, you had a patio on the first level and two balconies on the second level.  They were quiet and fairly private.  The set up for the waterpark is really good, lots of options for all age ranges.

name: Joe Ottens
text: Absolutely huge! The upgrade suites are a very long walk to the water parks in the winter. The standard rooms are roomy enough to offset the walking distance.

name: Drake Spahn
text: Fun, good rooms, clean, friendly. Great place for a little vacation

resp.text: Thanks Drake.

name: Jon
text: Clean rooms and fun place to stay. The rooms are clean, but some are showing their age, but it seems like they're in a constant state of updates and improvements. We hosted all of the guests for our wedding here, and the reservations office was super accommodating to everyone and really helpful to make sure we were all near each other. We have stayed here a few times, and have never had a problem.

name: Robyn Miller
text: We always love it here. So much to do

resp.text: Thanks Robyn!

name: Thomas Schelonka
text:
The Restaurant Fields is Operated and staffed with people who have no business working in a fine dining establishment.
Customer satisfaction is not the number one priority as it should be. The staff leaving is the number one priority at the end of the night which would explain why we were rushed from appetizer to salad to entree and then asked  twice if we were finished with the creme brulee... finally asked for a manager who said he would take my advice on the customer satisfaction index problems that I described. This was then not reflected in even offering a free cup of coffee or the desert that was ordered. Never will I visit an establishment that doesn't recognize customer satisfaction is being number one. There are plenty of places to go in the Wisconsin Dells area that will meet our needs next time.

resp.text: Thomas, We apologize that your dining experience was anything less than exceptional. We will be sharing your review with Field's management team so they can address it in their next staff meeting. Thank you for reaching out to us.

name: Jake Larson
text: It's fun but everything seems spread out still had a good time

name: Timothy Dembkowski
text: The room was wonderful!  Very spacious and clean. Every employee we encountered was very polite and accommodating. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and will return.

name: Scott Dryman
text: This is the clear choice when visiting the dells. Many people ask how can you really go wrong when selecting a resort in the dells? I'll tell you. By not lodging and vacationing here. That would be such a mistake. I met a charming individual named Gerry just this afternoon in the swim up bar. He helped me find my pocket, that of which I had clumsily misplaced.

name: St Cindy
text: Spacious, clean, and they use ultra violet light to disinfect the water, so not too much chlorine in the water! Fun!

resp.text: Thank you for your review.

name: Alex Shane
text: Been here three times, always a great experience. It's our mini vacation destination. They have everything you need, and stuff you didn't think you needed. In my opinion, it's much better than the Kalahari and the outside parks make it comparable to a mini Noah's Ark.

name: Holly Gerstner

name: dre21us

resp.text: Thank you so much for the FIVE-STAR review.

name: J Laber

resp.text: Thanks Will!

text: Found a used condom in our room that we had kids in. Refunded our money for the night and that was it. Pretty sad for such a disgusting thing you would think they would do more to make it better. Getting my money back for the night is not gonna make me return. Kalahari would have made good on this and took care of us. Go to Kalahari!

name: Jena Gardner
text:
Pros:
The waterparks were both kid friendly and adult friendly.
The beds were comfortable.
Entire place was clean.
Staff was super helpful!

Cons:
There is hardly any parking spots

A lot of walking and confusing turns to get to the different waterparks

So many stairs and with little ones they tire easy.
Most of the life guards were unfriendly and boarder line rude.

Elevators are tiny so fitting all the luggage on in one trip and our party all on in one trip.

Very noisy place. 3am and there are still ppl stomping on the floor above and yelling in the halls. Very frustrating with young ones. It would be great if they would separate families from the people there to party.

name: Jason Shepherd
text: We always enjoy staying here fun for the whole family best place in the dells

resp.text: Thanks for your loyalty and wonderful compliment Jason!

name: Tony Perez
text: It's a very nice place for a family vacation, the place is huge and has alot of things to do to keep the kids busy. The only thing is the water is always too cold, I've been to alot of water parks and compared to the wilderness the wilderness is much colder all the time winter,summer ect.

resp.text: Sorry you feel that way. We keep the water at 84 degrees.

name: Ellery R
text:
Winter review: great place to be midweek in the dead of winter. Plenty of rides and attractions for all ages. Lines are pretty long for the more intense slides on wknds so avoid wkdns if at all possible. The crowds are also pretty bad. Lastly, Chlorine levels are soooo intense. I couldn’t swim more than 2 hours.

Food and beverages: drink prices are hilarious. Glad we brought our own to the condo. Food prices are also terrible, and for the quality, I have no idea why. No one comes here for food though so *shrug*.

Condo cabin: this is the way to go. So much space, comfortable, and cozy (fireplace for the win).

Great time.

resp.text: Glad you had a great time Ellery. Thanks for your feedback.

name: Jeffrey Hafert
text: Great place for kids and adults but more for kids. Kind of expensive, but I think it's worth it. I go back there every time over other places.

resp.text: Thanks Jeffrey for your dedication to our resort and the great review.

name: jen kensmoe
text: Have been going 2 times a year for about 8 years!!   Lots to-do and a great family mini vacation!

resp.text: Wow, thanks for your loyalty Jen and your great review!

name: Sabrina Sanchez
text: Had a blast with my family will definitely be back again next year.

resp.text: Thanks Sabrina. Glad to hear you will be back.

name: Lisa Scanlan
text: This is our favorite vacation spot in the Dells.   There are 3 indoor water parks and two arcades.   We always have a great time here.   The condos and villas are especially nice.

name: Jason Eiting
text: Mega venue! Multiple indoor waterparks. Entertainment for all age groups. Drink specials. Arcade. Go Karts. Hot Tubs. Outdoor Pool. Wave Pool. Single and Double tube slides. Solo tube slides. Multi person large tube slides.

resp.text: Thanks for the great review Jason! Happy Thanksgiving!

name: Ryan Carr
text: It was a ton of fun with the family. A little crowded but it was the weekend so.

resp.text: Glad you had a ton of fun Ryan!

name: Jacob Von Tish
text: Awesome place for family fun. You never have to leave. Great entertainment for everybody and lots of variety of restaurants and water parks. Dont stay on the 2nd floor!! Its lound due to heavy, heavy foot traffic. And the halls are too narrow to accommodate the flow of people.

resp.text: Thanks Jacob. Glad you had an awesome time.

name: Consuelo Mesa-Anderson
text: We went during wintertime and it was extremely busy.  There are three indoor water parks but they are all miles away from one another...TONS of walking to get to each of them, crowded and a lot waiting in line for drinks, food and rides.  They also don't allow carry ins which would be fine if their food and beverages were reasonably priced and/or higher in quality. I went to the information desk for my complimentary coupon book, supposed to be a quick thing.  I waited 15 minutes while the ONE employee went through each component of the book with the folks in front of me. I kindly interrupted and asked if I could please just pick up my coupon book and not have to go through the whole presentation, he asked that I'd wait till he was done with the family. I left. Good grief!

resp.text: Sorry you were so disappointed. Our Wild WaterDome and Klondike Kavern Waterpark are connected via a short enclosed staircase and hallway but yes the Wild West Waterpark is at the other end of the resort. However, we do have a shuttle service that will take you there if you don't  want to walk. We will share your comments regarding our food with our Food and Beverage team.

name: tammy johnson
text: Rude staff, horrible experience. Upon arrive people standing directly outside the entrance  smoking marijuana and drinking. At the pool my son reported a kid hit him with a snowball (in the face, leaving a mark) in the out door hot tub and staff did nothing until I became upset after the second negative contact from the same kids. Parking was a nightmare to say the least. I walk over a mile carrying an infant in aa carseat with all our winter gear on. This place books winter capacity as if the outdoor things are open. To many people for winter!!! Dont do it ever. Go to Great Wolf lodge, they treat you like family!!!

resp.text: Tammy, we are sorry you had such a negative experience. If you remember any of the staff who were rude to you please email us at info@wildernesresort.com their names and the situation so we can address it with them in our monthly training sessions. We also hope that you reported to our security staff that people were smoking by the entrance so that too could be addressed.

name: Amanda Conway
text:
Love the Wilderness in off peak season! If you're complaining about wait times in peak season, just go when there are less people. All of the dells are overrun in the summer, so you're always going to have long lines and just OK service.

Off peak, the dells are a gem and a fun time to hang out and relax, and the prices are stellar. Customer service is much better as they aren't overwhelmed.

Our favorites were:
Giant wave pool. Good for older kids, I was shocked by the number of babies and little kids for the giant waves. They alternate between so there's plenty of downtime between, but it's a cardio workout!

Black hole bowl ride. My husband loved this one, but Wild West territory was only open a limited amount of time during our stay.

The Hurricane was hands down a fun ride, but fast and sometimes scary.

Only downsides we found we're that the wild west didn't have a pool to hang out in between rides, and we wanted to try the VR but it had limited hours that overlapped with the wild west water park.

Overall, excellent stay and we can't wait to come again!  This is our new favorite spot in the Dells.

name: Joel Kellso
text: Overall good and comfy place. Theater could use a little bit of worker but everything else is very nice.

name: Curtis Gibeaut Sr

resp.text: Could you please email us at info@wildernessresort.com your contact information so we can talk to you about room? Thanks.

name: Hannah Van Der Weele
text: Had my bachelorette party at the Wilderness resort last weekend. Stayed at a condo which was great. Comfortable beds, very clean. name: Chris Michaud

Numerous indoor and outdoor water parks, indoor 3D and outdoor mini golf, 3 different arcades, zip line, huge indoor play house for the kids, lots of other things for families to do. Rooms are multi-bedroom apartment style with full kitchen, Jacuzzi tub, fireplace, in room laundry, and walk out deck. Great place and great time for all.

name: Tracy Berginz

name: Philip Rossing

name: Connie James

name: stupus

name: christian everett

name: Kati Kleveno

name: Justin Lindh
text: I would not recommend this place. Many issues with the booking of our room. We came here with another family and asked for adjoining rooms since we both have toddlers. Despite my knocks on their door and calling the front desk to complain 6 times, nothing was done about this. When we arrived we were told that we'd receive a text when our rooms were ready. This did not happen. All first world vacation problems i understand, but I expect, and have received, better service in the Dells.

name: rbennett53520
text:
It was ok.

Typical salty over chlorinated pools but was fun. Room was a bit sub par. Missing hook on bathroom door screen door didnt lock.

name: Melissa Smart

name: Sara Bella

resp.text: So nice to read you enjoyed our resort. Thanks Sara. Happy Holidays!

name: Larry G. Irwin II
text:
Visited both the Wilderness and Great Wolf within a week of one another. In what was almost certainly the off-season: the outside was closed.

Check-in at the wilderness was _infinitely_ better than the Great Wolf. And Wilderness did not have any potential fire hazard events... but I think I would still prefer the Great Wolf - and dont get me wrong - Great Wolf is not 5/5.

The snack centers are not always open, which at the main campus might be ok because there are others, but at the "on the lake" location (which is were my son loves) that meant that the _only_ snack place (that I was aware of) was closed. Note that it closed early one day, completely closed the other day.

The water park at the Wilderness is huge - but that means that walking/traveling to use the slides. And when you are with a 4yr old, doing all the slides can be a priority - and thus here we are walking over the place. And in the end, very few slides are one he can go on. Further, one of the few slides that he could have used was open on Sunday then inexplicably closed on Monday. No signs about when it was open or anything.

Some of the rules at the Wilderness seem more relaxed than at Great Wolf. Case in point: the rope & lily pads at the "on the lake" The rule at the Wilderness is one person (?) per lily pad. But that leaves the person to grab and manipulate the rope - which clearly impacts others. And as one's weight grows - so does that impact. Finally, in what I now see as parents worse than those that treat locations as baby-sitters - are parents that are completely oblivious to the world: I saw parents "playing" with their kids on the lily pads - completely unawares of the other children further down the obstacle. There was NO corrective action from the life guards.

The staff at the Wilderness seem distant. I am not sure that I spoke, or made eye contact, or that any of the safety staff interacted with anyone in my family. And before you think that  maybe they had more important things to do - I agree. But at many points my son and I were the _only people_ in the pool area.

Also, it is worth remembering that this place is like a time-share resort. So the booth marked "information" is actually people trying to sell you condos. Do they know things, probably. But based on the few questions I asked, they knew as much as someone with google would know. So, I would skip it.

Finally, the food was terrible and over priced. This was the second in our double trips to the dells and we either found places closed for the season or went to the locations we had picked out the first trip. So, this time we decided that we would eat about the resort. We had pizza at a snack shop, lunch at the bar/saloon near check-in, and breakfast at the restaurant near checkin. Not again.

If you do decide to go wandering into town - one more bit of fair warning... maybe not go too far from the tourist strip and get into "downtown". On the first trip to the dell, we did that. We ate at a bat that served breakfast and had a kids menu. There was also some clearly inappropriate discussion (sex, racism, homophobia) that I have not heard in quite some time.

For me, in summary - this last foray into the Dells has me seeking alternatives.

Good Luck

Not worth it anymore. Rooms are disgusting! Pool had a dead BAT in it near all the kids.

AFTER RESPONSE FROM OWNER: It actually was the indoor pool. Overall, you guys know that this place is way overpriced for what you have to offer. I've stayed in the Villas 4 times, Glacier Canyon twice the year it opened, as well as other surrounding properties in the area. Each stay at THIS resort was nothing short of $1000+ room rental and I've never once enjoyed the whirlpool in the bedrooms. They ALWAYS have a dirt slime ring inside them and the water gets cold 1/10 of the way of filling it up. A lot of lousy housekeeping and maintenance, but the catch is, YOU GUYS KNOW ALL THE PROBLEMS. These robotic responses mean nothing. You will continue to dupe the public like you're a luxury resort with luxury prices. Give it a break. Find a way to show appreciation to the CUSTOMERS, instead of your pockets all the time. Spend some money and upgrade your facilities. This is an entire Wisconsin Dells issue.

resp.text: Dee, As with all  outdoor pools creatures do go into them from time to time. We are sorry if the bat wasn't removed in a timely fashion. name: Ninja ross
text:
Wilderness Definitely a HUGE disappointment
For the past 14 YEARS annually I've booked a block of rooms at this facility. There have been some qwirks within this year's of reservations but never did I complain until now.  I now know how customersget treated after years of loyalty.
Our rooms (17 of them) were booked Oct.26-29) On Saturday night Oct.28. 4 adults were laughing and talking while 1 adult was sleeping and 3 smaller children sat amongst us adults.  3 security men approached our open door. 1 of them came in literally screaming and acting like he was making the largest drug bust in the state. The veins in his neck were bulging out he was soo mad. We sat there confused. I even looked at this man and asked him if he was "for real" he then stepped out in the hall looked at his SUPERVISOER and said "yep, she's out of hand" (because I asked a question) The Supervisor then step in and screamed "If you don't stop you'll be out within a matter of seconds". (I think he said 5) .. At this point we were all speechless. My 7yr old was scared to death, crying and wondering if his mom was going to jail. Again, mind you there are 17 rooms booked. And everyone said they couldn't hear us. 3 other families were now standing in the hall watching all This go down (speechless) This was also the first time security stopped. They never stopped prior to say "HI folks, keep it down" I can't express the fact that they came in like a swat team making a bust and scaring the heck out of innocent kids. 14 years I've never complained until now!! As a group we spent over $4800.00 (that doesn't include their taxes) on the rooms, $625.00passes and let's not forget the meals and drinks. Or the 14 YEARS OF LOYALTY also the emotional earthquake (abuse) they put 3 children through. The harassment and the assault when they got into one of my guests face for also asking "is he for real right now"  THIS MAKES ME SICK!!!
The Wilderness offered a $50.00 gift card. Well isn't that a slap In the face after 14 years!!!
NEVER AGAIN!!!

name: Bryan Kujawa
text:
Good resort overall. Stayed New Year's Eve with friends. We're all in our 20's. We had a decent amount of fun in the water-parks, arcade, mini golf course, etc. However, it became clear very quickly that this resort is best designed for young kids and their families. The resort is very large, so a lot of walking must be done to get from Glacier Canyon Lodge to the water-parks and such. At least they have walkways all indoors so you don't have to walk outside in the winter in your swimwear.

The room itself was very nice. It was clean. Bed were comfy. Everything in the room was fine, no complaints. I especially liked the ability to control the room temperature within the room itself.

With the NYE Extravaganza, we expected at least some part of the event to be for adults 21 & over only. Unfortunately, that was not the case. Kids and families were in every-room. The $15 admission included one beverage and one "party favor", which was a cheap plastic hat. Food/snacks would have been nice for the price.

I would probably return as a parent, but no time soon.

A few more things. One, parking is a pain. Lack of space that is. Kalahari has a much better/bigger lot. Two, the find little ways to get more of your money. For example, a $1 fee to process my credit card, simply to put it on file. Another is in the arcade, a $0.50 fee to activate your card. I would think they got enough of my money with the $350 for one night (granted it was NYE).

We actually stayed in the time share portion. Check in was 4:00 but we had to wait until about 4:10 because our room wasn't ready. People we travelled with had to wait longer for their room.

They have three indoor water parks. Klondike Kavern was under construction for some new slides but still partially open.

Wild WaterDome has a nice wave pool. The kids splash area was partially roped off and you could see some equipment was removed. There is a waterslide called "Dueling Mammoths" but when we went the lift for the rafts was broken down. People could still ride it but groups had to carry rafts to the top. This park made us wonder if the resort was in decline.

We spent most of our time in the "Wild West" park. No complaints about this park. Everything worked and has stuff for all ages.

The resort overall is showing its age and could use some TLC but it looks like they are working on it.

Wilderness is really nice. It's not my style though.

I really enjoy the amount of options to stay and the cost compared to other large resorts. The building variety and style is great.

The shuttles were quick and there was no need to call ahead. If you were ready they were ready and there within 5 minutes.

There is far to much walking from water park to water park and it's unfortunate they are so separated and not all under one roof.

A lot of the buildings need more updating. 5 years ago they did not have flat screen tvs in the cabins we stayed in. We stayed in the frontier condos in 2015 and they did. So it seems like they are updating.

Unfortunately the walls had a lot of chipped paint, the cleaning supplies were old and dirty, one of the door locks was locked from the inside and outside (fire hazard?) and I had to call to get it fixed so we wouldn't be charged, then the guy didn't show and had to be called again, and the screen porch didn't lock to the outside and the door to the inside from the screen porch didn't unlocked causeing you to get locked out.

The staff was good and everything went well while during our stay. This is a great resort for the price.

name: Steven Hay
text: A good, well-run store with helpful employees. Has many things that might be on your shopping list. Not the least expensive in town but nice to be able to pick up several things in one stop.

name: Dawn Scheppke
text: This is a nice family owned regional chain. The saying goes "If they don't have it at Farm & Fleet you don't need it". They have clothing for all ages, pet supplies, all kinds of stuff for your kitchen, shoes and boots galore, tools, farm stuff, and more. I love their selection of pet food and pet toys plus the wild bird feeders and bird food. Oh, and don't forget the wide selection of candy, nuts, and bottled root beer! Yum! 😋

! I encountered nothing but sour faced employees on Tuesday when I was at Blaine's. Had to come back on Wednesday because no one could solve a simple problem. Sorry to have to say this Jason but you didn't deal with this well either. You didn't even apologize for the ad screw up or for the uninformed people you have working there. name: Sean Hallfrisch
text:
Interior is clean with modern decor making for a nice atmosphere. Our waitress was Teri, she and rest of the staff were fast and very friendly, even when moderately busy. I had a coffee in front of me before I could take my jacket off. Food was on the table within 10 mins. Price is fair. Food is a touch better than my average experience but nothing to write home about. With the staff being so quick in service it sacrifices the personal touch.

For the covid conscience, staff wore masks and tables were separated some but they did not close every other booth.

name: Kayla Luttinen
text: Talk about great service and homemade foods! We got in quickly on a busy Sunday. Each employee was kind. The food was quick. The selection on the menu fits anyone and everyone's needs. Having a manager present says a lot. Highly recommend this place in the Chippewa Falls area!

text: Great service, good food, friendly staff, large selection during non Covid times!

name: Chris Clark
text: Excellent food and very friendly, great service.  Stopped in to have lunch with my sister and enjoyed the atmosphere, food, and the overall feel of the restaurant.  Our waitress was very friendly and always checking on us with courteous service.  So great to have such a dining experience with so many chain restaurants taking things over.  Don't change a thing!  Oh, and the pie was phenomenal too, so much so that I had to get 2 pieces to bring home.

name: Eric Stephenson
text: This is one of the best places to eat in all of the Chippewa Valley. Family Restaurant has been a staple in the community for years. They're known for generous portions at great prices. text: I went here with friends on a beautiful sunny Saturday and the service was great! Perfect location too! We arrived on out pontoon which was fun. Prices were good and bathrooms were clean. I ordered the fish tacos which were ok, the cabbage chunks were too big and too much sauce so the tacos got messy quickly (-1 star for that). I put money into a slot machine and won so I cashed out and was told to come back the next day to pick up my earnings. The next day I arrived through the street entrance this time and there was a young man as the host. I started to explain why I was there and he cut me off, so that was kind of awkward (-1 star). Would've been nice if the host was as friendly as the rest of the staff. I even said goodbye to him on my way out and he was silent.

name: Julia Dolata
text: The hill is small providing only very short, quick runs. The small terrain park is also a extremely short run with a rope tow. Was not very impressed. Not worth the drive for us. We made the best of our 9pm-3am $20 lift tickets, but don’t feel the need to come back. This is not the place for advanced boarders.

resp.text: Hey there Julia.  Sorry that you didn't have a great time.  We are fairly average when it comes ski area vertical for the Midwest and the Great Metro St. Paul/Minneapolis Area.  I hope you checked out our main terrain park over in Valhalla, we have professional and advanced riders in that park daily and have only received positive feedback this season.  We have found that most riders prefer the rope tow so they can get in more reps.   If there is something in particular you were looking for in either of our parks feel free to let us know at info@trollhaugen.com.  Thanks for sharing!

resp.text: Thanks for the kind words Andrew! We've been told our Bar certainly has a nice ski area ;)

resp.text: Thanks Quinn, I'll let the NASTAR guys know!  Thanks for coming out!

text: Avoid this place. There are signs all over that a mask is required when in line and on the lifts. Not only is it not enforced, the staff do not wear face coverings. They keep the mask on their chin. Unprofessional and poorly run. My wife and I purchased a full day, but left after lunch due to non enforcement of their own mask rules. We will definitely not be returning to this place.

resp.text: Shane, we are sorry that your expectations were not met.  If you would be able to direct message us at info@trollhaugen.com to further share your experience as to which areas you witnessed employees not properly wearing masks we would really like to hear it.

text:
The two main food items I get at this location are the cheese quesadillas and the potato olés.  I love getting sour cream and nacho cheese with the olés and also putting sour cream on my quesadillas! I also would like to mention that I have not had a problem with any of the staff and my food has come out in a timely fashion while still tasting great! As for the price of the food I believe that it is fair especially since the food is pretty good! There are many pros and cons of both Taco John’s compared to Taco Bell so for me (personally) I will list a few...
Taco Bell- pros: Cinnabon’s, closer to me, good bean and rice burritos. Cons: no potato olés
Taco John’s- pros: better quesadillas, potato olés Cons: no Cinnabon’s and far away.

I’ll leave it up to you to decide which is your favorite since I am caught in the middle. Either way I hope you enjoy your food at this restaurant because I know I do.

name: Amanda Ness
text: First time visiting action city for three of my kids and myself. Kids definitely enjoyed the trampoline part and the go karts were a big hit. Would definitely recommend to friends and family.

resp.text: Hi Amanda! Thank you for the great review! I'm so glad you had fun with your kids!

name: Jason Green
text: This place is a lot of fun packed into one building. Stopped by the way back from Wisconsin dells. My son seem to have more fun there than he did at the dells. Many different video games trampoline park air hockey go karts food etc. Lots of fun under one roof and reasonably priced.

resp.text: Hi Jason! Thank you for the great review! We look forward to seeing you again!

name: Sterling Silver
text: Awesome place to let kids run wild and enjoy the time! Great food,Great options! However I do wish they had a complaint desk or something. l had a issue with my play pass card to get help I had to wait in line and this place can get busy at times to get back up to the desk may take some time and u may lose time on your card to play just to get the issue fixed. Overall bring the fam or if ya just a big kid ya self either or you going to have fun!

resp.text: Hi Sterling! Thank you so much for bringing this to our attention. We will review that with management.

name: paul Brien
text: My Grandchildren love this place!  Indoor and outdoor go carts!  A zip line that is an addition fee!  They have a nice climbing wall.  Good for beginners and younger kids. Mini bowling and laser tag. Indoor bumper cars. Lots of other things to explore! They also have a small indoor water park at the other end of the property for an extra fee!  If I remember right it like an addition $10.  They also have a trampoline park attached!  You can buy combo passes to bring the price down!  There is also a hotel attached and if you are a guest of the hotel, I believe almost  all the attractions are included in your stay!

resp.text: Hi Paul, thank you for taking the time to review us! It sounds like your family had a lot of fun with us. Please visit us again soon.

name: Angeleyes Dawn sweet & sassy9
text: Had fun but wish there was only a few games we could play that didn't cost money

resp.text: Hello! Thank you for the review!

name: Justin Kutchenriter
text: This place is more than decent. Free admission which is nice, especially for folks that don't wanna participate in the games but maybe wanna get pizza and still have fun with their family. They have all the fun activities including go karts, multiple virtual reality games (which can be intense in a good way for the inexperienced) massive trampoline park, bumper cars, lazer tag and lazer maze, mini bowling plus a whole bunch of fun arcade games with a friendly staff to back it up!  Honestly I hate to say it, I want to give this place 5 stars cause it is great in every way, but they don't sell beer here. You can get alcohol at the pub in the hotel that's connected but you can't bring it into Action City, just a heads up. Otherwise this place is awesome. Lots of great deals and coupons online too, cause this place can get spendy.

resp.text: Hi Justin! Thank you for the review!

name: Josh Korger
text: It was fun but only a 3 because it was hot as heck out and very little shade, so that dropped it one star, then there was more real grass on the golf course that mowed days ago and never cleaned up so thats another star lost. But again it was fun and my family had fun.

resp.text: Hi Josh! Thank you for the review!

name: xanthprime
text:
About half the video games are the ticket based pseudo-gambling games.  The other games are okay except the selection is small and are in need of repairs.  Broken joysticks which at least one appears to be from vandals.

If you are paying for time to use Go karts or VR, expect to spend half of it, if not more, waiting in line.

resp.text: Hello, I'm very sorry you did not enjoy your time with us. We appreciate your feedback as it helps us to grow to better serve our guests.

name: Avery Pedersen
text: Fun for all ages! Went for the mini golf, all employees wear face masks and everything is sanitized before use. Definitely going back for axe throwing.

resp.text: Hi Avery! Thank you for the great review! Come back and see us soon for some axe throwing!

name: Stephanie Roytek
text: This place is a joke. Half the games are turned off or broken. They tell you your pass is good for non ticketed games however it's only good for half the non ticketed games. They change the rules each time you show up. One day your kid is tall enough to ride and the next time he shrunk and is no longer allowed. If I would have known my kid couldn't do anything I would have saved my time and money. Half of the trampoline park is also closed down with no warning until they take your money.

resp.text: Hi Stephanie, I'm sorry to hear you did not enjoy your time with us. I will speak with the managers on the games that were not working for you and to keep consistency in how we are informing our guests on parts of the resort that are currently closed and height requirements.

text: A day here can get expensive very fast. If you are taking more than 3 people book a party! It is way cheaper than paying individually. Kids always have a lot of fun every time we go here

text: Good place to take the kids, lots to do, food, carts, mini golf, games and more.. would recommend.

resp.text: Hi there! Thanks for the great review!

text: Lots of fun for the kids

resp.text: Hi Melissa thank you for the review!

text: Not well maintained at all!

resp.text: Hi Jordan, I'm very sorry you did not enjoy your time with us. We appreciate your feedback as it helps us to grow to better serve our guests.

name: Mike G
text: We had a birthday party planned for our son here for weeks with high hopes for fun.  We arrived to a very busy place which looked like a lot of fun.  The staff seemed as if we cought them off guard even though we had arrived a tad bit late.  Most staff was quiet and didn't have much in the way of direction.  We followed our "host" to the party room.  We had some questions about our ability to add things to our tab that remained unanswered.  The room was clean and ready for us.  I thought she will have more information at that time...I was wrong!  She asked when we wanted food and scampered off only to return to tell me I had to return to the check-in desk!  We finally got the play cards that were part of the package only to find most games off limits, the saving grace is the attractions were available with the cards.  Pizza was served on time hot and pretty good, no complaint with the food.  However we had parents, our guests, that had to retrieve things like forks and straws and more soda as no attention was paid to the room other than when we had arrived.  Some of the games seemed to be in disrepair or out of order.  Staff was inattentive and very uninformative, confused, unorganized, I could come up with a few more.  Not a great experience at all would not suggest planning a birthday party here, didn't get what I had paid for.  Hopefully they can turn it around.

name: Abbigail Allen
text: Labor Day! Had a blast! Our family's first time in the building, we loved it, staff was aware of all areas and made sure safety was followed.  Some kids obviously spend more time there than others but all was fun, Arcade could be a little different.

name: Khris Wright
text: School hosts a lot of fundraisers here and they are always successful and everything goes as planned. Kids love all the different attractions! Definitely recommend!

resp.text: We love helping the community whenever possible! Thank you so much for taking time to give us such a thoughtful review!

name: Shelley Riphenburg
text: Fun had by all!

resp.text: Thanks for the great review!

name: Amy Hahn
text: Daughter always has fun here.  We love the games, and mini golf.  She loves FlappyBird, got a collection of Pokemon animals from this game.

resp.text: Thank you for reviewing us, Amy! We're so glad your daughter enjoys our arcade!!

name: Jeromy Prosser
text: Great place for the kiddos. Toddler days are best. The games and all trampoline areas are all in excellent condition. Staff is super polite and helpful.

name: John Cherwinka
text: Cannot beat it for the price!  I have taken my son and his friends here numerous times for hours of fun!  We do Skyzones, Dave and Busters, and for the money Action City was great!  Trampoline Park is great, Water Park is cool, video games, mini golf, go karts, batting cages, rock climbing, and more.  Seemed clean and very few things under repair, great times.  Highly recommend!

resp.text: Thank you for visiting us, John! We're glad your son and his friends had a great day with us. Thank you for the thoughtful review!

name: Jacob Von Tish
text: Very friendly staff! A good variety of attractions and games for all ages! It's well maintained and clean. They run lots of promotions and specials all week long. It's a great place to have a birthday party for your child as well. Worth every penny! Some of the games dont work, and are old and that's why I didnt give 5.

resp.text: Hi Jacob, thank you for coming to visit us and leaving a thoughtful review. We're so glad you were able to enjoy our attractions. We take pride in our staff! I will let our game tech know to look into any games that are down!

resp.text: Thank you for the great review!

resp.text: Hi Todd! We're so glad you were able to enjoy our trampoline park, and have a ton of fun doing so! It really is a place where all ages can enjoy themselves. Thank you for taking time to review us, and for bringing the whole fam!

name: Ryes on the Rise
text: Brought my 5 year old son and my 7 year old brother in law for my son's birthday. Had such a blast I didn't even take pictures... Not one! Great food, great staff, amazing service, so much to do... We easily could've spent days there. Waterpark leaves something to be desired but if you're going for action city and the trampolines, YOU WILL NOT BE DISAPPOINTED.

resp.text: Thank you for all those stars, Melissa!

name: Justin Babel
text: This is a great family place to come to especially if you just wanna get a way for the weekend. I would highly recommend spending the entire weekend there and making sure buying a full pass for all the attractions!

resp.text: Hi Justin, thank you so much for the thoughtful review. We are so glad you enjoyed your weekend staying with us, and were able to take advantage of our unlimited play passes. We hope to see you again soon!

name: Sean Anderson
text: Expensive, half the games didn't work or were broken. You buy the play pass and very few games actually work with it. It wasn't great and the kids won't remember the experience

resp.text: Hi Sean. We are sorry to hear you didn't enjoy your experience with us and there were issues with the game. I will be sure to pass along to the game tech to make sure games are running properly.

name: Ryan Larson
text: Had a really good time playing arcade games here. Pricing seemed decent and there were a lot of options. Will come back with my kids sometime soon. Lots of parking and it wasn't that busy on a Saturday morning during the summer.

resp.text: Glad you enjoyed our arcade, Ryan! Thank you for stopping in!

name: Jason Goodland
text: The only thing I don't like about this place is trying to get the kiddo out the door!  Always a blast, the jump park is a blast for kids and quite the workout for adults.  The games are always fun.  Great for a rainy afternoon but also some great outdoor activities for the sunny days!

resp.text: Hi Jason, thank you for the kind review! We definitely have something for everyone. Thank you for stopping in, we're glad you all had a fun time!

text: AWESOME PLACE to hang out, also connected to a trampoline park, hotel, and a water park.

resp.text: Hi Tre! So glad you enjoyed your stay! Come back soon!

text: We love Action City and the trampoline park, we would give 5 stars if the cleanliness of the machines, chairs, floors, bathrooms etc were of higher priority. However that being said the customer service is getting better and we have had great service at a recent party we had there.

resp.text: Hi Lisa, thank. you for leaving a thoughtful review. We're so glad you enjoyed your time here! I have forwarded your message to our management team so we can better address the cleanliness issue of the various things you mentioned. Thank you for stopping in, and having a party with us. We're so glad to hear our staff is taking good care of you!

resp.text: Hi Joshua! I'm so glad your family had fun during your visit! Come see us again soon.

resp.text: Hi Ert! Thank you for the 5 stars!

text: My daughter and her friends had her 13th birthday party there and everyone there had a ton of fun.  And it's hard to get a dozen 13 year old girls to like anything.

resp.text: Thank you for leaving a review, George! We're glad your daughter had a great birthday party, and that everyone had an enjoyable time!

name: Erik Weyers
text: Games of skill, video games, trampolines, go carts, mini golf, axe throwing, prizes, and food!  Lots of fun, a bit expensive for larger families.   Lines can be long for certain things and can be messy because... Lots of kids!

resp.text: Hi Erik! Thank you for taking time to review us. We're so glad you were able to enjoy many of our attractions!

name: Delta 2662
text: Pretty good fun, have things to do all day. Only bummer is when your time card runs out, so maybe get an all day card if possible.

resp.text: Hi Benajmin, thank you for taking time to rate us. We agree, the full day option is definitely the best deal and great for a full day of fun! We're glad you were able to enjoy us for the time you were here. Thank you for visiting us.

name: Brian Wolosek
text: Kind of expensive but, my son loves it, had a blast. There is a good variety of things to do. There is a trampoline park, video games, go karts, and small water park. Easily can make a day of it and we'll have fun the whole day

resp.text: Hi Brian, thank you for stopping in, and for the nice review. We do offer a variety of deals throughout the week and for special events! I am so glad you and your son had a great time exploring our three parks!

name: Brittny Karnes
text: We had a birthday party here. It was great to be able to just come and enjoy! 4 stars instead of 5 because our play cards did not work, but that was a very minor inconvenience.

resp.text: Hi Brittny! I am sorry to hear that the play cards didn't work. Our play cards for birthday parties include all main attractions and non-ticket arcade games. If this didn't work for you, please don't hesitate to reach out, so we can fix this! I am so glad you enjoyed the other aspects of the birthday party, thank you for choosing to celebrate with us!

name: Tyler Elwood
text: This was a great time with my friends and I. We purchased the 3 parks for the day and we spent the entire day here. It was a great time, and worth the price!

resp.text: Hi Tyler! We're so glad you enjoyed our three parks for all day pass! Thank you for taking time to leave a review!

name: Brady Reetz
text: Always a fun time! The unlimited annual jump, play, swim pass it definitely the way to go :-)

name: Mathew Rohde
text: Nice place, bit on the expensive side compared to other indoor amusement parks. Prize selection is over priced and all the arcade games you win tickets on are $2 or more.

resp.text: Hi Mathew, thank you for taking time to review us. We offer a variety of deals and promotions based on the time of year, holidays, and special days during the week.

name: Daddy4G W
text: Fun times with the kiddos! We come here often and will continue too! Would highly recommend if you are in the area with kids!

resp.text: Thank you for the kind words, Shawn!

name: Sherry Stanley
text: I took my grandson and he had a fantastic time.

name: Cody McMahon
text:
The trampoline park was a HUGE hit with our toddlers. They absolutely loved it. I enjoyed my time there as well, lots of different areas to jump as well as a kids playground area. Will definitely be going back at some point.

Only concern is it does seem like an injury waiting to happen. Between the "trampolines" the landing area is hard and doesn't have any give to it. If you come down wrong you'll probably injure yourself.

resp.text: Hi Cody! Thank you for all the stars. I am your toddlers loved jumping around in our trampoline park. We always have staff watching all of our jumpers to make sure all safety rules are followed to prevent any injuries from happening. Thank you again for stopping in!

name: Mel Yo
text: Go karts, rock wall, laser tag, laser maze, arcade games, and trampolines. My girls had a blast we only played for three hours but easily could have played for three more. However for sensory sensitive people it may be better to go on a slower day and have access to noise cancelling headphones. They also have a variety of concessions. Its family friendly. Oh and bring your trampoline socks- or you will need to buy a pair but they are only $2.00.

resp.text: Glad you had fun, Mel! Keep an eye out, we have sensory friendly nights in the trampoline park. Next sets of dates will be announced soon. We'll see you next time!

name: Jen Wiggin
text: Mini golf is so much fun!!

resp.text: Hi Jen! Thank you for the awesome review!

name: Lauren Nee
text: Loved the indoor go carts and the virtual reality. Decent pricing deals, but majority of the arcade games are not playable unless you add money to your play card, which can definitely add up. Was also disappointing how only one person can use the card at a time. If you want to play the same game with your buddies you need separate cards with money. One card cannot be used for more than one person. As for the trampoline park, seemed pretty standard to me. Everything was well kept, but make sure to bring water or something to stay hydrated... you'll get hot really fast since there's really no ventilation or fans

name: Jeff Krueger
text: We did everything except the water park, some of the games didn't work or didn't have the right equipment, but the Laser Tag, VR and trampoline park were good.

resp.text: Hi Jeff! Thank you for the review!

name: alan hembd
text: To many games with broken parts/ duct tape used almost like they neglected the original space of action city very disappointed will not recommend there was duct tape on the roller coaster simulater the  speakers did not work on it either the left seat sounded like it was about to fall apart all of the shooter games had something wrong with it weather it was no feedback in the gun or actuatters in it for gun animation one of the driving games that was a multiplayer game  the steering wheel didn't even work the jr bball game had flat balls the TV screens at DQ had dried splatter on them 4 out of 6 mini bowling games were not functional this was at 1 pm-4pm they may say that their was maintenance on duty but if there was then someone hasn't been on the floor in a while!!!

If you would like to reach him directly his email is Jesse@MetropolisResort.com. for we've been messaging back and fourth and I'm having a hard time getting back into our messages. Could you reach out to me directly Liz@MetropolisResort.com. Thank you!

name: Christine Stephens
text: Wednesday wristbands is definitely the way to go! For $17 you get 3 hours of unlimited Action City and trampoline park. With a few exceptions, such as redemption arcade games. The kids had a great time they expecially liked the VR and laser tag. This is a great deal in itself as usually laser tag & VR games each cost about $7 to $10 per person. The kids weren't extremely impressed by the trampoline park, but in Action City's defense they have been to some pretty nice ones and may have been spoiled by it. I thought it looked pretty fun though!! If you already have trampoline socks don't forget to bring them, as they will be $3 a pair and are mandatory. They have food right on site which was really great for us, as it was starting to get late. We got a 17in one-topping pizza for about $18. Not a huge steal, but the pizza was good. I have the boys bring their own water bottles as they only sell sodas for $2.99. They're bottomless sodas and can be refilled as much as you want. However, it was a school night and three teenage boys don't need that much soda! lol Altogether I dropped about $80, for 3 hours at Action City, including food. not my first choice of how to spend $80, but the kids had fun and it was for my son's birthday. I didn't check into it, but they have deals on actual birthday parties.

resp.text: Hi Christine! Thank you so much for stopping in! We agree, Wristband Wednesday is a great deal. Tell your son happy birthday from us. I am happy to hear that they all had a great time!

name: Monty Peterson
text:
Trampoline Park:
If you have kids with too much energy, go here. A bit pricey to go more than once a month or so, but a GREAT family experience. The trampoline dodge ball is a hit along with their ninja warrior inspired obstacle courses (one kid sized and one adult sized)

Action City (main area)
If you are a game lover at all, you will be able to find something that piques your interest, standard joystick video games, lay-down moving games, balloon pops, mini-bowling ally. If you like games, they have it.

Laser Tag:
Black light laser tag cave, nicely designed, equipment is in good shape.

Climbing wall:
Next to their food court they have a smaller one and half story-ish climbing wall, great for beginners.

Indoor go-karts:
2 speeds, standards and Go speeds. Go speeds require an height limit and I *think* and age limit. Standard speeds have both single and dual seats cars for younger riders. The cars themselves are if fairly good shape. The speed and the upkeep of the track are both good.

Outdoor activities:
Mini-golf, Zip line, outdoor go-Karts. I haven't most of these, but they all seem kept up well.

Overall,
A great place to come to have some fun. Seeing as how it's connected to a hotel with a water park inside, this is THE place to go in Eau Claire for fun.

They seem to have gotten better at keeping machines repaired, employees properly placed, and the place now seems to run smoothly.  Besides the Arcade, there's a hotel with a bar/eating area, water park, mini-golf course, go-kart racing, mini theater, and now, a trampoline park .  They seem to be doing a good job of keeping the place relevant by adding these new features/attractions.

name: Craig Loewenhagen
text: Action City used to be a great place to go and have fun. They have now changed the way you use their money/credit system and the cost of a game has become outrageous. Used to get a $60 deal where you got $60 on your card and a 17 inch pizza with 1 topping and 4 drinks. The games cost from $1 to $2.50 for most. I'm sure there were some a little more. Now you pay $30 get 200 credits and don't get the pizza included. Most games are now 5 credits but others are 9-10 credits each. You don't feel like you get to do much and you credits are gone. Now they are building a tramp park among other things that they obviously need the money to pay for so they are charging way too much. Needless to say we are not going back. This is the same for the Metropolis Hotel and Chaos Water Park.

name: Steve Reilly
text:
Great place to check out. Daily specials during happy hour are really good. Try the shrimp! Burgers are very good. They have a great fish fry on Fri nights. Staff is very nice and also helpful if u have questions. Place is clean. Wonderful to check out in the summer when they have live music outside. Do yourself a favor and check this joint out.
Located in a beautiful part of Menomonie

Until the next review,
-Steve-O, out!

name: Charlotte Hamilton
text: My family helped me celebrate my birthday by dining at Jake's  Supper Club. Marvelous atmosphere, fantastic food and wonderful staff. Katie was our server; she was a breath of fresh air. Had a great evening!

name: Patrick Dallager
text: Excellent server and food at a fair price. Also: Warm and Inviting Atmosphere.

name: Paul Tolar
text: Nice little super club.  Great view on the water.  Waitress was very friendly and knowledgable of the menu.  She did a good job keeping the glasses full.  Steaks were cooked the way we asked.  Dinner was brought out in a timely matter.  Great overall experience.

name: Will Duchaj
text: Great experience!  Walleye and salmon were delicious!  Loaded mashed potatoes were decadent!  Fried cheese curd app was wonderful!  Enjoyable wine and awesome old fashioned!  Can't miss weather tonight and outdoor seating with a serene setting make for a great evening at Jake's Supper Club!

name: Anjola Dee
text:
We loved our meal and experience at Jake's.
Our server was Emily, and she was sweet as pie and very knowledgeable of the menu.
I ordered the shrimp, my husband the surf and turf and both were excellent!

Make sure to save room for dessert!

We'll be back for sure!

name: Jason Lautenschlager
text: Best, most tender prime rib i have ever had. First class very friendly service.

name: Travelsalot1988
text:
Beautiful facility/ location.
Server was slow or a Sunday night-not busy. Food tasted good.

name: Roy Ellsworth
text: Great place..  food is awesome...  Service is wonderful...

name: Lara Van Dreel
text: The French dip sandwich was great but the salt /seasoning was way too much. We dusted off our fries and still left a lot behind. Service was great but.... Probably will hop across the street next time

name: Julia D-W
text: Atmosphere, food, and drinks are exceptional. I love the wine selections. The best wine selections you can get in menomonie amongst other high quality beverage items.  They have a great atmosphere which includes many live bands. The bar tenders always know who I am when I come in and know what to get me. And I have to be honest...I'm not there all that much! Excellent service, scrumptious and tasty food selections, and top notch beverages make this place high up on my food chain of places to go. Get out there....you wont regret it!

name: Melissa Vick-Wruck
text: Amazing food,  atmosphere and servers!

name: The Rogue Scholar
text: A must have experience if you live in Menomonie or travel there. The atmosphere was top notch for area. My food was cooked to perfection. The libations were great.  Staff was knowledgeable and courteous.  A gem of a place.

name: Kayce Cowan
text: Great place worth a stop!

name: Tristan Roen
text: Great location on the river but I thought the food was a bit expensive. That said the food was good. Everybody was happy with their meal. Plenty of room. And there was a band. I would eat there again.

name: AdamNatasha Wilkens
text: We really enjoyed our visit here good service, hot delicious food , first trip here sorry I didn’t get any foods pictures but ver delicious , I had a Mediterranean chicken sandwich, served nice and hot which is positive the few trips out to other establishments my food has been cold , when you order something that is supposed to be hot that’s what you expect,  Jake’s was excellent, wife had the Friday fish looked good as well, they have their own breading on their cheese curds which was delicious as well , two thumbs up for Jake’s, and it’s a nice view on the patio there in the late evening, good experience here 👍

name: Kevin Shibilski
text: A nice "Wisconsin" Supper Club on the river.    Food is always good if you like supper club fare.

name: Ernest McCormick
text: Great food good prices.. perfect place for date night.

name: Richard Buss
text: Great dinner.  Excellent food and service!

name: Anne Gallagher
text: Fast and personable service... Following the Social Distancing and other CDC Guidelines...Outdoor seating and Tikki Bar were great...Will return!

name: Dean Tronrud
text: Great food and service

name: Doreen Mcgill
text: Nothing is better than sitting outside in nice weather in Wisconsin and being on the water! This place is excellent for that alone!  I started with a Crown Royal Peach Old Fashion (delicious!).  I had the Feta Pesto Salmon which was outstanding! Hubby had Prime Rib. It was much rarer than he liked but he didn't send it back. (so his own fault!) The service was a little slow, but they were pretty busy, so no big deal. It was fun watching the boats go by and the children playing in the green space by the water. Live music started around 7. Just a really fun place!

name: Stephanie Lemay-Posbrig
text: First time here and I  was blown away! Drinks were phenomenal and food was delicious.  Kind waiting staff and food was brought out to us quickly! I will definitely will be coming back and highly recommend this place!

name: Nicole Lunde
text: Great off the beaten path Restuarant! Awesome 2 tier deck on Tainter Lake ample space to enjoy. Food was excellant as was the service. Definetely worth visiting this place. Food , drinks, ice cream drinks and dessert and a great location what more could you want

name: Cathryn Sleep
text: Love the Outdoor Tiki Bar & outdoor live music !!

name: Clint Best
text: The food was excellent and the staff was great. They had a limited menu at the time. I cant wait to go back when they have there full menu.

name: Bobbi Swanson
text: Wonderful supper.  Service was great.  We'll go back again

name: Sheila rIeck
text: Wonderful! Our waitress was sweet n very attentive. The prime rib was amazing as always. The gentleman playing keyboard added a special touch to our evening. ♡♡♡

name: Joseph Moyer
text: The bartender is very friendly and quick!

name: Christa Evans
text: Our waitress was right on top of the quality of service, we both had the Dijon salmon and it was perfect

name: Rebecca Lehnertz
text:
Food was fabulous. They have daily specials that actually have a good amount of food or options for many types of diets.
Our server was outstanding and followed up on all requests promptly.
The outside decks are next to the river and are beautiful.  I can't wait to go back when the temperature finally warms up.

name: Allen Breeden
text: Classic Wisconsin Supper Club, with a few twists. The Prime rib bites are always good. The scallops were a perfect buttery medium, and it was nice to be back somewhere that knew how to make an old fashioned.

name: Kris Brenner
text: Great little supper club with awesome service and food.  I had the prime rib (their Thursday night special) with their potato soup.  They were both very good at a fair price.  $17.  It took a little longer than it should have to get our food but there were 7 of us.  I would defantly go back.

name: Kali Poehnelt
text: The steak bits, beer and the music were just what I needed after work 27 hour straight!

resp.text: Thank you for coming out, we appreciate it!

name: Jacob Von Tish
text: The quintessential wisconsin supper club with classic cuisine you would expect to find, steak, fine seafood as well as fried fish, pasta and homemade desserts. Nice large bar and lounge, cozy dinning room with fire places. Frequently they have live music, bands on the amazing tiki bar stage or a intimate jazz pianist in the lounge. This is a great place to take in the beauty of lake tainter in comfort and class. Stop for a fine dinner or casual drinks and everything in between.

name: Joseph Friberg
text: Great northern super club

name: Ariana Waukau
text: Always a great dinner, great beer, and great service.

name: Tami Cabrera
text: A wonderful hidden jem!! Classic supper club and ambiance. Great deck, staff and menu!

name: Zach Boaz
text: Prime bites, Delicious!!!! My wife had the sautéed shrimp, very good!!!

name: David Enyeart
text: The food average, but fine. The setting is lovely. It's a classic supper club, and it's well worth a visit. (Also good with kids, since it's not especially quiet.)

name: Sue Dubiak
text: After waiting 10 minutes to be seated and seeing no one around we left and went elsewhere.  We were there around 11:30. There were 2 people at the bar. This  is not a  bogus statement.

resp.text: Great, thanks for stopping out!

name: Alex Sikora
text: Great food. Great service. They always treat you like family.

name: Mitchell Reisdorf
text: I work there, so I may be a tad bit biased. But the food is incredible. I recommend the Jakes Burger with bacon. Served California style, cooked anyway you want. Incredible.

name: fftaylor34
text: Outside patio is amazing. Food is on point and live music is awesome. Perfect for a quick bite or a few hour stay!

name: Heather Wiseman
text: Jake's is always amazing. Super friendly staff, great food and a wonderful atmosphere. When friends and family come to town this is the first place I think of to go out to dinner!

name: Julia Welch
text: My husband and I split a steak. It's awesome that they give you this option. You pay four bucks and get a second salad and side and end up with a reasonable amount of food. My Cosmo was good and stiff and cheap and my husband's old fashioned was decent. A very helpful waiter. We really enjoyed our visit. They also have a great and spacious outdoor patio, right on the water.

name: Jeromy Prosser
text: Went for Valentine's dinner. The food was good but the curds  and my wife's steak we're slightly over salted. The Prime I had was very good. Overall it was still a good experience and we will be going back to try other things.

name: Benjamin Cornell
text: Great food. Nice patio.

name: Jay Hanson

name: Corey Van Norman
text: Love the prime rib!

name: Patrick Oneacre
text: Meal and service were both excellent.

name: Ron Welsch
text: Dinner was magically served by Jade out on the deck.

name: Jay Dee
text: Great cheese curds, solid ribs and the fish fry was great. They don't really have much for a vegetarian and nothing for a vegan if that's you.

text: Not the cheapest but good. They got rid of Sunday buffet which was amazing! Bummer.

text: Went to Jake's which is close to our house. Sadly, I think this is the last time we come. It isn't as good as it used to. I ordered a special: chicken and ribs. I asked for white meat. I only ate the wing and thought, boy my chicken breast looks small but whatever. The next day I eat and it was a thigh...really?! I got gyped. The ribs were dry.  The only good thing was the bread and I'm sure it's frozen.  Lol. Well we tried one more time...we keep trying to see if they redeem themselves but doesn't look like it's going to happen...

name: Ruth Javener
text: Good food, great staff. Beautiful setting

name: Karl Wise
text: Chose Jake's for their Sunday brunch and beautiful location.  The brunch buffet included both breakfast and dinner selections, including prime rib sliced to order. I enjoyed each of the offerings I chose, and would recommend anyone partaking of the brunch try Jake's fantastic chocolate chip cookies.

name: Optima Graphic & Web Design
text: Great food, good service, and excellent atmosphere!  The Tiki Bar is my favorite place for date night with the hubby.  Love when they have rockin blues bands playin.

name: David Rutten
text: Location was great... food very good.  Staff was friendly and helpful.  The price although not unreasonable but was high.  You should expect about 25.00 per individual

name: Sue Schrantz
text:
Sunday Brunch was very good. Fish was delicious. Plenty to choose from.
Unfortunately the service was lacking. We had dishes that needed to be picked up, there was 7 of us. Ordered a bloody mary and didn't drink it, no flavor. I was surprised she didn't ask why it was still full.
Willing to go again.

name: Patty Clark
text: Love the food and atmosphere.

name: Willie P
text: Great supper club feel and excellent service. I had the surf and turf which filled me up well. Enjoyed the band out on the deck after dinner with tasty cocktails.

name: Janice Wittrock
text: Good food and service

name: Ron
text: Ok drinks, but my steak was to full of gristle and could not eat it...

name: Kim Nessel
text: Great super club. We love Jakes and have never had a bad experience there.

name: MG Roman
text: They have really improved the food.   Service was good; as always. Good setting in or out.

name: Trent Isaacson
text: I love this place for Sunday brunch buffet! Good tap beer selection, quality bloody marys. The brunch buffet includes standards like scrambled eggs, hash browns, sausage links and bacon, but they also have mashed potatoes, ham, fried fish fillets, and normally some sort of pasta as well.  Outstanding service, even when busy!

name: Spencer Pasno
text: Good food and service, as well as live music!

name: James D
text: Used to be great!  Menu is down to 2 pages, about the only thing on it under $20 are burgers.  Drafts for most beers are $5, cheap beer is $3.50.  Food is still decent, but Skoog's or Pioneer is just as good.  Unless you're trying to impress someone for date night by how much you can spend its become a place to avoid.

resp.text: Thanks for the review James,  I would encourage folks to view our menu on our website.  There are 36 menu items with six daily specials and a whopping 7 are over $20.   Nitro beers and premium pours are $5 but a buck off on happy hour, M-F 3:30-6 and 11-5 on Saturday!

text: Great food.   Great service.  A little loud but it was a Friday night.

name: Waverly Windus
text: All food was terrific for our party of 4.  Service was just as great.  Have not been there for a few years but after tonight,  we will be back again soon.

text: Always enjoyable. Been there a bunch over the last couple decades. Need to bring the chicken back tho

name: Cindy Hatella

name: rose ellsworth

name: Tony Baker
text: A good experience, great wait staff, good food.

name: Saraphina Curren
text: The food and service was great. But at one point we had 7 flies on our table. They were non stop from the moment we sat down. One of them even got stuck in the ranch.

resp.text: I apologize, being on the lake in the middle of farmland there is usually a couple days right before frost that the flies sneak in every time the door opens.  We do what we can, but we can't spray when there are customers in the restaurant. Its a tough situation.  I encourage you to stop out again, talk to the manger, I'll buy you a drink or two.

name: Marvin Whitman
