name: Jack Loftus
text:
Excellent visit tonight. Great service, clean table,  relaxing environment and great tasting food.

I ordered the 1/4 lb thick burger with extra onion and pickles. Also upgraded the fries to garlic and cheese fries.

name: Nick Mack
text: I got the breakfast platter.  It was good.  Fast friendly service.  Not a bad price.   I avoid fast food most of the time.  But the platter appealed to me on this morning and I must say it didn't let me down.  Nice hot gravy and 2 portions of egg.  Some hot hash rounds and sausage with a biscuit, it hit the spot.

name: Lori Feyen
text: Decent food. Fast service.

name: Michael Capobianco
text: Food was cold, and fries were soggy, but staff was nice, and liked to be goofy

name: Rick Carlton
text:
Strawberry milkshakes? Need one say more?
Succulent 2/3 pound burgers?

name: Eric Freberg
text: Hand scooped malts. It's In a truck stop right off I94 so very convenient for travelers. Best burgers anywhere.  I love Hardee's because they don't pretend to be health food - just delicious.

name: Robert Wolfe
text: Drive thru speed should be much faster with only 3 cars in line

name: S.J. Lewerer
text: Food is usually hot and fresh. Sometimes at night the onion rings have been sitting to long.

name: Kathy Carlson
text: Service was great, food was hot and fresh.

name: Brian Moll
text: Good food service was slow

name: Troy Cockeram
text:
Went through the drive up only took 25 minutes and only got 1/2 of my order.
Didn't have time to wait another 25 minutes for the 2nd 1/2 of the order. Sorry will never go back. Do yourself a favor and find someplace other than this.

name: Andy Barford
text: Good service in the am,only time I have been here.

name: Michael Anderson
text: Good grub!

name: Nicholas Nielsen
text: Super nice drive through people the last couple of times I have gone both ladies were polite and very patient ad I didn't feel rushed

name: K H
text: Hot fast and is no longer in my city so ita nice to see one out therd

name: randy Goss
text: Best combos in the chippewa valley

name: Rob Kelly
text: Food is good but you sure don't get what you pay for

name: James Molnar
text: Taste better than B.K. impossible burgers.. also have more condiments & tomatoes.. isn't burned like Burger King . b.K tells me that is the only way they can cook is to burn the outside. Hardee's is cooked thru our.

name: Carlos Bailey
text: The fries and the burritos are always good

name: Mitchell Reisdorf
text: Nummy burgers and curly fries

name: dana swagger
text: Always friendly, and dont forget the apple pie... the bfc  burger is an amazing xtreme cheesy goodness.

name: Anaiya Love
text: Love this place, friendly guest and friendly workers everytime I'm here. Keep it up hardees menomonie!

name: sliperymangravy
text: Come here quite a bit. This visit, as always, was great. Staff is always nice, your order is up very quickly, and most importantly, I've never received an incorrect order. Definitely recommend coming here. Also, it is a pretty new building, so it is very nice inside.

name: Brian Hunt
text: I wanted to double meat Burger but they were limiting these due to shortages? I got a burger with a single Patty and it was just okay

name: Adam Nelson
text: Open 24hrs and they make you fresh sandwiches in the middle of the night. Great selection that you can not get at some other Hardee's.

name: George James
text: Good typical food

name: kristine lahaie
text: I didn't actually go in here. Only drove by. But was clean on the outside from what I could see.

name: Greg Ward
text: Fast and friendly staff.

name: Kate Curran
text: The food was really good each time I have been there. The only issue I encountered was the customer service. The first time I went it was raining and I pulled into the second stall to order food. (Sometimes when I pull up to a drive thru they start talking right away and I don't open my window fast enough. So I thought maybe that was the case.) No one answered me, so I pulled up to the brick & mortar window. The associate wasn't as friendly as she could have been in explaining that the 2nd drive thru is typically closed. I drove back around to see how I could have missed the sign. It was positioned in a way that you might see more clearly when it isn't raining and if your side mirrors aren't in the way. She just seemed annoyed that I came to the window without ordering. I would anticipate people making that mistake and be really friendly and maybe even apologize. Overall it was good food & I will go back from time to time. Just curious as to why the second stall isn't used in such a busy location. I normally try not to use the drive thru to cut down on emissions, so maybe I'll stick to that.

name: Dan Murray
text: Prices getting pretty high. Won't go there very often.

name: Brian
text: My burger was so badly burned i couldn't  even eat it. Unfortunately, by the time I  opened up the bag I was on the interstate. The cashier was extremely  polite and friendly. The cook is terrible. The establishment itself was clean.

name: Allen Chapman
text: Always good here, if you get there early definitely try the cinnamon rasin biscuits.  Now if only there were still more of these in Minnesota, you can find one in Oakdale but not in minneapolis.

name: Michelle Swenby
text: Food didn't taste good

name: Matthew Mitchell
text: Horrible! This has to be the worst Hardee's in Wisconsin.  I've never had a fresh burger here.  Only ever get chicken because I know it'll be fresh.  Go across the street to Subway

name: David Free
text: Cain't make a good frisco !

text: Not my first hardee's review and probably not my last, this place meets the standards of even the most scrupulous of managers. Also its hardee's so it's great.

text: Fast service... chicken sandwich was awful... not this locations fault I don't believe.  Just nasty over processed fake chicken. If you like real food... you won't find it in the chicken at Hardees.

text: Not even worthy of one star. First time I went to drive thru. Placed my order, and sat at the window for 5 minutes. It’s like I wasn’t there so I left. text:
We ordered a #3 and #5 both only the sandwich. A soda and a strawberry shake.
We waited at least 20m. The #3 was just warm. The #5 was a little warmer. They took and served d/t with the counters food and the dozen people and to wait. I saw the grill area  take a sandwich back that drive had ordered did something to it and put it back. It wasn't ordered for them. It was counters. My shake wasn't any better. It was 1/2 melted by the time I got.
We will NEVER stop there again. We wanted a change from the same old and was totally let down.

name: Cliff Boggess
text: Stop here often. Mess up my order almost every time. UPDATE 12/1/20 walked in. No one around, wait, wait, wait. Cook sees me and says nothing. Wait, wait... LEFT. Gotta be worst Hardee's in the franchise!

text: The young man that took my order for the onion rings tonite didn't listen to my instructions on how I wanted them made. I wanted them crispy but they came out soggy. Couldn't eat them. Plus the burgers were dry and the buns were hard. Very disappointed in the food.

name: Janet Henriksen
text: Cold soggy walnut shrimp. Gummy noodles. Very hard broccoli and tough beef.  Egg rolls and orange chicken were pretty good.  Went back through drive through and asked for an orange chicken to replace beef dish, grumpy window person.  So sub par compared to next door neighbor LeeAnn Chins. Had a gift card to use and $10 left on it but probably won't use any time soon.   Really had such high hopes.

name: Brett Covey
text:
This is HALF noodles and half rice. This is after eating most of the rice, and as many noodles that were exposed. Just like where's Waldo, let's play where's the noodle. Unacceptable, corporate needs to take a journey to this awful location of Panda Express to evaluate and recognize how much of a dump this franchise is;

The orange chicken is all bread.
Food isn't ready when you get there.
Staff is unfriendly and rude.
When I ask for noodles I should really just say all the onions, cabbage and celery you can get me.

This establishment is a disgrace to Hudson. Go to woodbury. It's a lot better, customer service, staff and overall food quality.

name: Joseph Shakal
text: You’re facing the classic dilemma- famished and need good food fast, or is it fast food good... or good fast food. Whatever it is, there’s a good chance you’ll find it here; at a pretty decent price as well without any gimmicky app based coupons or other stunts. See pics. Chicken Teriyaki チキン照り焼き (wait a sec, that sounds Japanese, not Chinese !) was freshly made and generous portion. See pic. They have handy covers for the serving bowl to make it a Take-away.

name: Bev Monahan
text: This place has improved IMMENSELY over the last year. I had stopped going to this Hudson, WI location for a long time after multiple bad experiences, but the past several times I've been through here in the past month it has been spot on excellent food AND customer service. The guy managing it now is definitely vested and cares about his customers. I've met him on two of the three recent visits and I'm super impressed. The food was very fresh--made to order, cooked perfectly and was really delicious, all served by staff that appeared to like their jobs and their customers. FANTASTIC! Thanks Panda Express Hudson!

name: Mike Drexler
text: Drive thru only, but was quick and efficient.   Food portion in bowl was great

name: Liz Montello
text: Good food, wish they had more gluten free options.

name: Ashley Rae
text: It was really busy, so I don't fault them entirely. Will be back again. Food was good but was missing some of my order.

name: Ted Wallerstedt
text:
High price for fast food,  but the food is hot and delicious.

Had to wait on teriyaki chicken. 15 minutes.   But they gave me a 10 percent discount for my trouble.

name: Senko
text: Love the food here, especially when I get the chicken and sweet and sour sauce. Yum!

name: Joe Huerta
text: Ordered for me and my fiancee, got the bigger plate. Well someone intelligent decided to put my teriyaki chicken in the side box with no sauce. Finacee got black pepper chicken and it was mostly vegetables. Rice and Chow Mein both were dry like they were old. Ordered spring rolls and wasn't asked if we wanted sauce! Really ust to enjoy panada express until this location ruined it for us. WISH I COULD LEAVE A NEGATIVE STAR

name: Eric Sonia Bogenhagen
text: Always fresh and delicious! My mom and I had gone in awhile back and the orange chicken was getting low and instead of scooping out the last of it they made a whole new batch.  Every time I have been the food is great!

name: Jerry Carlson
text: Great tasting food, totally worth waiting for when it gets busy.

name: P Liebre

That runs about $35 or about the same amount as 5 Guys for three people excluding their delicious malts (love their burgers and fries as well!). Anybody else craving a California Cheese Burger with extra onions and Fresh French Fries covered in salt and malt vinegar??
Oops sorry 😬 I'll get back on point.
I'm always happy at the Panda and feel like I'm eating healthier. But choose wisely grasshopper, there is much hidden sodium and fat at the Panda. For instance if you're getting some deep fried chicken covered in a sugar sauce probably not a great choice. The teriyaki chicken thighs are one of my favorites!!

text:
We usually have a good experience here other than the food sometimes taking a while in the drive thru. I stopped tonight after work after checking that they close at 9:30. I was greeted by a very rude young lady who said "we close in 10 minutes so we're out of a lot of food and everything is made to order". I told her that I thought they closed at 9:30 (it was 8:48 when I got there). She replied and said the drive thru does close at that time but that the cook doesn't like to cook past 9 because they don't want to waste food. Which I can kind of understand, but she was very rude. A few of the things I ordered she kept saying "umm that will take about 5 minutes to make", like she was trying to convince me not to order it.

I work in a restaurant and I know what a pain it is when people come in minutes before close.  However, I didn't think ordering fast food 40 minutes before close would be super rude. Here I am, at 9:02, and I'm heading out with my food. They really made it seem like a huge inconvenience. Very disappointed. It's not like I rolled up at 9:25.

name: Chris Cook
text:
Our experience started with our digital key not being assigned.  We had to get another set of keys from the desk.  We were then welcomed with a stain on the bedroom floor.  We asked for additional luggage racks three times over multiple days and finally received them after I expressed the fact that our previous requests were ignored. The ceiling tile in our room also showed evidence of an issue.  On top of that, our room door had to be pulled shut with force.  We reported the issue of the door and it was never addressed.  A maintenance person did walk in on my family saying they were there to fix a toilet, which we didn't have an issue with.

The guest rooms were a decent size and breakfast had a decent variety.  They had a cook available for omelettes, pancakes and waffles.

If you don't like heights, know most of the rooms are lined around an atrium overlooking the ground floor.

name: david macy
text: To be honest this place is in need of leadership. Great facilities, but the leadership in my opinion is not present. I stayed there for a week. Pool was turning green, and I swim for e exercise. I notified the night auditor of the issue. He assured me it would be handled by maintenance. That did not happen and a day later it was closed. The next issue was housekeeping came into my room and did not.make the bed or empty the trash. I had a suite where you get free stuff (sodas candy) put into your room on a daily basis, that was not done correctly. Missed couple days. As well two days I had to run around asking for coffee after service. We are lifetime diamond members 120 hilton stays last year. As well I have.worked in hotels and this location has leadership issues. This is written to the GM and AGM. I would suggest to not berate your staff. I only put in bad reviews after I attempt discuss onsite the issues and am ignored. Well that is what happened at this location. Left my cell number and room number with the front desk. 48 hours later at the prompting of the front desk talked to AGM. She wanted to just give free stuff. 15 years of hotel leadership and experience was lost, because the leadership was too busy? I have a saying "I cannot hear what one is say because their life is speaking volumes to me"

resp.text: David, we are deeply troubled by the experience that you had at our hotel in January 2020. We are happy to report that we've added some amazing team members to our team and I am 100% confident that your next stay with us will reflect the positive changes we've made, if you give us the opportunity to serve you again. We hope to serve you again and show a lifetime Diamond member how we've improved.

name: Mrs. NJ
text:
The hotel is really nice and newly renovated since it will soon be an Embassy Suites. All of the furniture in our suite was new. They have a really good hot breakfast which is NOT a continental breakfast, but rather a full breakfast with French toast, or pancakes/waffles (changes), hash browns, sausage and bacon and then other cold items like fruit, yogurt, cereal, toast, bagels, and hot and cold breakfast drinks. There is also a made to order omelette area where a live chef makes your omelette the way you like it. They also have a place called Fountain Bar and Grill that offers free non-alcoholic (Coke products) and alcoholic drinks between 5:30pm-7:30pm (not sure how long this will last). They also have a nice pool, gym, sauna and steamroom, but all are under renovation for I don't know how long. The one downfall is the business center consists of 2 computer screens posted right by the front door and not enclosed. Any scanning or faxing is done through the front desk and they must have their computer security set really high because I could click on a link on a web page to print a document out. I called the front desk for towels after 11pm and thought I'd need to go down to get them, but someone was available to bring them up that late at night and fast. Also, the room temperature settings are weird because the front thermostat panel works the a/c and the bedroom one works the heat. It took us a couple days to figure that one out.
They are also under renovation, but the hotel still looks beautiful. They are not very noisy with the door closed, but if you are near the rear of the hotel, they are doing some work, so we could hear Living on a Prayer and other songs and drills, or the large units whirring. We had earplugs , so we were fine.
I really enjoyed my stay and so did my husband and will definitely plan on staying again.

name: Norm Walker
text: Culvers is an institution here in Wisconsin they make great burgers with lots of cheese.  This location in Hudson is one of the better I have been to.  The average age of the workers is probably 16 but they hustle and work their butts off.  My order has never been wrong and they usually bring it out in less then 5 minutes.  If you are going to be going East or West on I94 you need to stop at this location.  My favorite things to order are the Cod Dinner $8.99, and the Wisconsin Swiss Melt basket for $6.49.

name: Joe Korbel
text: I stopped here on my way home from MSP this past week. I live out on the East Coast now and this Culver's immediately reminded me of how great Midwest hospitality is. I made a mistake on my order and the staff insisted they take care of it even though I said it was my mistake and wasn't a big deal. I had a couple employees talk to me at my table and they were very polite, but the best part was on my way out I asked for a spoon and at least 5 employees started rushing to grab one and bring it to me. I left with a big smile on my face.

The coffee was given to me cold and when I took it back to the counter they made a fresh pot. THANKS.
My wife ordered a Butter cheese burger with catsup and mustard, well they didn't forget the cheese but the rest was not there. SAD.
Sweet potato fries were brought to us late and they were ice cold. Didn't bother taking them back. ICK.
We ordered two side salads and they were fresh and crispy. YUMY.

This location was at the DeForest exit off I39. We stop here often after visiting family in Madison area and this is the second time we've  gotten substandard food here. One more chance and I'll not return again if the food is substandard next time, I'll drive up the road to Portage. We like Culvers because the food normally is fresh and hot, if we wanted crappy food we would stop at other fast food location and pay much less. One more time LAST CHANCE.

resp.text: Thank you so much for your kind review, Claire. We appreciate your feedback as a valued Culver's guest and hope you'll visit us again sometime soon. Have a great day!

We're so sorry to disappoint you, Jody. Could you please share additional details with us here? Contactculvers.com. We'd like to address your concerns. - The Guest Relations team at the Culver's Support Center

Your review means a lot to us, Darren, and we'd like to know more so that we can deliver a better experience next time. If you wouldn't mind, we'd love to know more about your visit here: Contactculvers.com. Thank you so much.

name: Matthew Lind
text: I don't give a lot of five star reviews, but this place is just a cut above the others in every way. Drive out here and try it. You will be pleased.

name: Jacob fischer
text:
Placed my order for 4 sushi rolls at 6:01pm on their website.  I received a text saying my food would be ready in about 25 minutes.  I arrived on time and waited patiently outside in the cold along with a dozen other hungry people.  After waiting 45 minutes past the original 25 minutes I  made 4 phone calls before the restaurant answered.  My food had not been started so I requested to cancel the order.  Unfortunately when ordering online you have to pay ahead. Time will tell if I actually get a refund.

I understand that they were very busy on new years eve. Staff appropriately and do not mislead customers with unrealistic times.

Toppers pizza was an excellent fall back.

Update: refund recieved

text: So good! We've been enjoying Sakura for a few years, and their quality is always high. Food tastes delicious, and prices are reasonable. Staff are always easy to work with. The takeout system they have set up while the dining room is closed due to COVID is pretty slick. We ordered online (currently take out only, no delivery) and received an email confirming the order, then a text confirming our pickup time and order number. Order pickup is completely contactless, with your food waiting in the entry way for you to pick up. Hand sanitizer and disinfectant is provided at the pickup station.

text: Ordered carryout. I was told it would be a 30 minute wait. I got there about 35 minutes after ordering and was told that the sushi rice wasn't ready yet. All together my sushi and salad and one appetizer took 52 minutes. I got home and there wasn't any soy sauce in the bag and the hot appetizer was cold. One of the sushi rolls was not presented nicely and was incredibly sloppy, but the other was good. May try them again, but not as a carry out option. Definitely would be nervous to go back again during my lunch break!

name: Megan Dant
text:
Great food, good selection of wine, picturesque view of the St. Croix River, inviting space, super friendly staff, and very reasonable prices. They also had a patio that is great for when we have warmer weather.

My husband, daughter, and I went her for Sunday brunch. I got the eggs Benedict and a couple of mimosas, both of  which are always great. It also came with these kind of cheesy hash browns, which were amazing. My daughter had the fried French toast. I tried a bite, and I highly recommend. It's like a cross between a churro and French toast. She also got the lavender lemonade and it's AMAZING. My husband got the all American breakfast and was very happy with it. We also got the walleye cakes for a stater. They were very fresh and light- not overpoweringly fishy or greasy. All that for $63! You'd practically pay that for one plate in downtown Minneapolis. And our waitress was super friendly and outgoing. Will definitely go back.

resp.text:
Megan!!
I am seriously just LOVING your review!!! Thank you so much for the awesome 5-stars!! Brunch is something that we do once a week, and I am just thrilled that you loved your brunch with us, at Pier 500!!
I have never heard that description on the Crispy Fried French Toast - but I LOVE it!! (I also looove churros) ;)
We appreciate your support and love that we delivered an excellent overall experience for you and your family and we cannot wait to host you again soon.
Sincerely -

name: m hk
text: Loved it. Asked for a table away from television sets and got it. Atmosphere us a bit lodge-like/ sports bar, but nice backroom.  Lovely patio. Food was overall quite surprisingly good. When I walked in I feared there would be nothing for me to eat. The healthy bowls (edamame, quinoa, greens, etc.) was amazing. Tofu would have been nice, but I still adored it. The quality of the lobster in the mac and cheese was a bit fishy, but fine. Best grapefruit gin and tonic ever. Brussel sprouts - could do without sweet sauce ( balsamic and olive or sesame oil would work), but fine. Chocolate cake - cake to frosting ratio off, but what a fun dessert, with hot dark chocolate you pour yourself and vanilla ice cream. Service was inexperienced, but took suggestions well (bread, side plates).  A really pleasant surprise overall. I will return.  Had a lovely time.

name: Tom Dietz
text: This was ALWAYS my go to restaurant in Hudson.  Love the food and the service has always been very good.  Recently, however, they have upped their drink prices to the point of price gouging.  I was charged $10 for a Whiskey Old Fashioned.  That's absurd.  I travel the entire state of Wisconsin for work, and no where else am I charged this much for an Old Fashioned!!   I'm sorry but do some research of what the average charge is state wide, because I did.  The average Old Fashioned price across the state via Google was $5 per drink.  You have lost my patronage because of being greedy at the bar.  $10 for an Old Fashioned is ridiculous.  I'll have to find a new restaurant now in Hudson.   Very disappointed.

name: Dan K
text:
We had high hopes after the reviews we read and seeing the restaurant when we pulled up.  We were seated immediately on the patio overlooking the river.  The location is top notch with beautiful views.

Our drink order was taken right away, and it was served quickly. Unfortunately this was pretty much the only nice part of the visit.  It took a little longer to take our food order, and once our food was delivered we never saw our waiter again.  Waters were empty shortly after food arrived and were never refilled, we were never checked up on, and we had to flag someone down for our check.

I'd say the food was above average, but we were fighting off flies the whole time we were there.  This MIGHT be discounted because the river was right across the street. There was a funky smell the whole time we were outside too.  We chalked that up to the river.... But our stroll across the pier after dinner was bug and stink free.  I'm not trying to pile everything on because of bad service, just documenting the full experience.  Take it for what you will.

It certainly could be a great stop for dinner with (much) better service and maybe more frequently emptied trash cans.  The bugs and smell were tolerable, but being ignored by our staff wasn't.

resp.text:
Dan,

I would first like to thank you for taking the time to send me your feedback, as hard as it is to read, we truly appreciate your feedback. We are always training our staff to improve our guest experience. We clearly missed the mark with your experience when you were here.
I would very much like the opportunity to talk with you if you are willing to call or email, just to gather more information regarding your service as we would like to have you back as a guest.

The location and view from the patio are probably the best thing about the place. The outdoor bar is nice, too. I have also eaten in their small reservable room for a rehearsal dinner. I think there were just too many if us as it was crammed and loud, but a very nice place for the occasion.

What I don't love about the restaurant is the price you pay for the great location and view. There is never any parking (we went on a Thursday at 11:30 and were lucky to find a metered spot in the lot close by) and there is almost always a wait for a table at the patio (where I don't think they take reservations).

If you're planing of eating here during the summer months and wish to have a seat on the patio facing the water you can expect to wait a half hour or more during peak dinner times since the water view patio seating has about 20 tables and is very popular.

Pier 500 is probably one of the most popular restaurants in all of Hudson not just downtown due to the friendly staff and excellent food. This restaurant has some of the best Chicken Wild Rice Soup I have ever had which it what I always make sure I purchase whenever I am there. This restaurant has two bars one inside and the other is outside on the patio, Both bars tend to be very busy at all times of the time and offer a large specialty drink menu.

Lastly, If you have questions about the menu the waitstaff are very knowledgeable and offer great recommendations based upon what you like or are thinking about.

text: First time here.  Wanted to try something new for my birthday. Found decent ratings on yelp. Tried oysters Rockefeller for the first time. Omg, amazing. .not fishy which I was afraid of. I normally don't like potatoes but these were amazing.  Not sure what is in it, like a cream soup or somerhing.  My husband couldn't stop raving about them.  He thought his walleye was amazing.  He tried a scallop for the first time.  Hey Mikey, he likes it! I tried a smidge and it was fishy, pretty good. I liked his sirloin better, more flavor. We will definitely be back. Very laid back but nice. Our waiter Michael was super friendly.  Keep up the amazing food service!

resp.text:
Helllllloooooo Monica!
Thank you SO much for this amazing review!!!
We appreciate you taking the time to give us such a great review and we also appreciate you stepping out of your comfort zone and trying our Oysters and Scallops!!! We are thrilled in your food choices, sounds like you ordered some of the best on the menu!! Whoo Hoo!!!
Aren't those hashbrowns just like SO crazy good?!?! We are thrilled that you tried the cheese curds and Walleye as well and I will pass along the compliments to Mike!!
Thank you again for such a great review and we look forward to your continued visits!!
Cheers!
Tom Hommes

That being said - our rotisserie chicken (when cooked correctly) will have a slight red or pink hue near the bone. We do check temperatures of all our rotisserie chickens when they come off the spit. text: What horrid customer service. The lady on the speaker told me that there were only hamburger or cheeseburger when I asked for a butter-burger. And then proceeded to argue with me. The Eau Claire store are always kind and friendly.

text:
Pretty good barbecue place that we tried the other week. Our order ranged from the rack of ribs, to chicken wings and tacos with plenty of sides in between. We all thought that the food had some down home flavor and zest where it was needed but none of us were blown away by the barbecue flavors.

We ordered ahead and picked up, and the customer service was on par. The atmosphere inside was definitely inviting and fun - too bad the pandemic has to limit these types of experiences. Overall, we would probably return!

text: Unfortunately this restaurant is going down the tubes. The quality of the food has astonishingly gone down in years. It was "fine" but I know we will not be going back again. name: Derrick Nash
text:
Reeeed Robin, yum! First things first...the food is outstanding! Full disclosure, I’m a vegetarian so I write with a particular bias. The Impossible Burger is outstanding! The best you can find anywhere, and trust me, I’ve looked! And what’s really great is, you can try the Impossible Burger patty on any one of their gourmet burgers!

Did I mention they not only have bottomless fries, but their garlic fries are so good you’ll forget about the burger! Let me suggest when you go, tell your server to start you out with an order of the garlic fries while you wait for your burger (you’re welcome).

My only critique is, the staff here isn’t the warmest bunch. They aren’t mean or even rude. They just lack any type of charisma. Other than that, bring a hearty appetite 😋

If I were to 5-star anything about this restaurant, I'd FOR SURE 5-star the decorating. It is *mwah* on point. My favorite piece is the eclipsing burger picture. It's right by the "Today's Brews" sign. Love it.

What has happened with this place? The quality of the burgers at Red Robin has dropped to such a horribly low level. I am a person that really likes and knows a good burger. But that just hasn't happened for me over the last few visits here. I feel that I could have a better burger at some other chains or even a fast food places. To give you an idea I actually ate a salad for my meal instead of a burger. Red Robin is a burger place and that is truly not a good thing if a person ops for a salad over a burger at a burger restaurant and it's NOT for a dietry reason. The food in this chain has by far dropped to point that is really unacceptable for a burger place.

I would suggest just that you try it for yourself. But I am not going to be eating there again unless it's a last resort to be honest. I don't think the quality will improve it will only keep dropping like it has been for the last few years.

name: Lyle Haferman
text:
We had not been to Red Robin for a year or more - it seemed like the food was not worth the cost.  But, with a 15% off coupon, Red Robin seemed like a viable take out option.  Ordered online via Postmates which did not accept the Red Robin 15% coupon.  No problem, surely Red Robin will honor their OWN coupon when I pick up the food.  WRONG - Red Robin would not honor the coupon because of I had ordered through Postmates.  The store manager did not come to the front to discuss this issue.  Left because I had people waiting at home for food.
Filed a Guest Feedback comment with Red Robin explaining the aforementioned situation.  Was told on June 23rd that my comments were shared with the local Red Robin GM and the Regional Operations Director for Red Robin in Brookfield WI.  As of July 26, 2020, I have heard nothing from Red Robin regarding this situation.  I even filed a second Guest Feedback comment with Red Robin.  That comment was basically tossed away by the Guest Relations Specialist.
In light of this unacceptable lack of communication on the part of Red Robin Management, and the poor value of their products, I will forever be a Red Robin detractor.  I will not eat there again.  I will instead continue to frequent the locally owned Culver's where the burgers are better tasting and you get a better value for your money.
From now on Red Robin, you can take you coupons and stick them

in someone else's mailbox!

name: Chad Vandermark
text: I ordered online and they told me 15 minutes food actually took over 25 minutes then myself and three other people were basically pushed out the door and told to wait outside to make room for the people dining in. Not to mention the guy was kinda rude, We won’t be going back anytime soon. The only reason I gave them one star was to leave this review

name: Thomas Bohm
text: Thanks for wearing masks and cleaning so well. Oh and the food was delicious

name: Amy Kautzman
text: Excellent customer service, the waitress was very attentive. Thank you Ally for the Fantastic experience.

name: Marty Christensen
text: Best burgers anywhere

name: T Shark
text: Can never go wrong with the California chicken sandwich! First time trying the wing appetizer and the waitress was gracious enough to bring a few sauces on the side to try. I was very pleased with the crunch of the wing and each flavor was delicious.

name: Brandon Combs
text: As a chain restaurant, this is one of the better ones. The burger options are excellent and you can swap out the burger patty for a grilled chicken breast, turkey burger, or a veggie burger as desired. Love the bottomless steak fries. If steak fries are not your thing there are other side options (other types of fries as well as a side salad or  broccoli).

name: Mark Webber
text: There grilled Turkey pattie was really good.

name: Katie Elliott
text: Awesome food. Friendly employees and clean restrooms. 🥰❤

name: Carl Gust
text: Service was horrible,  worst I've ever had.   Food was lack luster, nothing special.

name: Kelly Pearse
text: Great options for burgers, sides and drinks.  Everything was great.  There does tend to be a bit of a wait at prime meal times.

name: Clifford Easterday
text: I enjoyed the burger, food was cooked correctly, and good service.

name: Andrew La Roy
text: Food was good and server was friendly and playful.

name: jazzy Oz
text: Great food and service. It’s not cheap but you get your value.  I love going here with family often.

name: J F
text:
I won't be back after our lunch today.
The burgers were "hockey pucks."  They were hard and cold.  Clearly, they had been cooked earlier and were not freshly made when we ordered.  There was a hair on my plate.  There was flakes of something in my water.  The service was ok.

The womens bathroom was dirty and needed a good cleaning.

For the price, I will not go back.  There are other options for burgers nearby

text: When I was there before the service  was excellent. This month I visit it was horrible. I ordered the wedge salad!I asked for my salad to be remade due to the lettuce was withered I ask for it to be re made she bought  to the table only lettuce the (wedge) No toppings and I asked can I get some toppings. And replied easy  peasy. Then the waitress went from table to table  with a basket of fries  and then she gave them to us after taking them from table to table. I was not happy.

resp.text: So sorry, Sharon! Please tell us more about your experience at https://redrobin.secure.force.com/rr_home?cu=1&c=Social&l=en_US&fs=Search&pn=1 or 1 (877) 733-6543 so we can follow up directly. Much appreciated!

name: Christine Miller
text: Excellent quick service.  Everything was sanitized and safe.

name: Bryant Fields
text: The staff here is amazing. My son loves this place and so do my wife and I. We went there for my sons birthday with 2 other little kids and our waiter was so great with all of them. When they were arguing over some chips that one of them got he brought a whole basket of them for free. We've been back since and our waitress was just as great with our son and did an amazing job refilling our drinks and making sure we were taking care of. The food has been amazing each time and I look forward to going back.

name: Robert Kohn
text:
Usually this place is a 5 star Burger joint. However this time it was a 3 star. Not due to the server or even the food for that matter. For some reason this store was out of C02 ... Which means no carbonated drinks.
That is poor management to allow your store to open without the basics. Having a broken machine I get, but to not have C02 in amply quantities is just poor management.

name: Jorge Lopez
text: Good food and staff

name: Jeremy Boness
text:
Horrible service. Mediocre food.
My bacon cheeseburger looked like it was literally thrown together. Cheese melted half on/half off. Had to walk up to the kitchen area in order to get our waiter to get drink refills. Our waiter only had our table and two other tables to attend to. The rest of our side was empty.
What ever happened to cooks with big hair wearing hair nets?? One of the cooks had no protective netting on his hairdo.
Bathroom didnt look like it was attended to. Toilet paper out, garbage full, garbage on the floor. This place used to be good. Hopefully Red Robin will make positive changes to this location. Until then we'll be going to a different burger restaurant.

name: Karen Thomas
text: Great server!

name: Tyler Friedrich
text: Got carry out and the food was very average. The fries tasted like they were sitting out all day and weren’t fresh what’s so ever.

name: Peng Chen
text: I came here for their burgers several times in the past. They were always good. Juicy and fresh and tasty. It's a little short today probably because they were super busy. It's father's day. I will give them a chance and try back another time.

name: Robert K
text: Very small portions. Ordered the bowl of chili it was very small. Asked if I was served a cup by mistake and was told it was a bowl. Won't be back.

name: connie tarbah
text: I have tried this restaurant a couple of times and I am never really impressed.  The gourmet burgers are really good but its still a burger nothing totally unique about them.  Unfortunately, one we walked in and sat down it I noticed at least 5 tables that were not cleared around our table.  That was a definite turn off.  We went to the restaurant because it was supposed to be two burgers for one but when the bill came it was only if you were already enrolled in the program so our bill was way over $50. for 4 burgers and 4 soft drinks.  I just don't think I would go again.

name: Meme Dream
text: Host and hostess were both friendly, server didnt refill any drinks, food was good until my friends and I got food poisoning from the fries. Either too greasy or some contamination. We each ordered different things but we all got fries. Felt awful.

name: Jackie Wachowski
text: burger was ok. fries were good. wait staff nice. kitchen a bit slow

name: Lisa Striebel
text: Honestly, the burgers were not good at all. They had no taste or flavor whatsoever. Very disappointing. My husband had the burning love burger. No heat or flavor. All in all an epic fail. The one star is for service.

name: Vicki David
text: With carryout during pandemic the service was great, food amazing and done timely!! Will order again

name: Angie Nosek
text: Good food, the waitress was very good at the beginning but then we saw less and less of her. At the end there were a couple charges on our bill that we never asked for, she took them off after we mentioned them to her so make sure you check your bill

name: Abe Dickenson
text:
Been to Red Robin a handful of times. I always enjoy the food and bottomless sides they're great. Service is hit or miss though, today I got a glass with multiple lip stick marks on it. Noticed them after drinking some of my water and pointed it out to my waitress, she says "I noticed those and was wondering if your girlfriend had drank out of the glass." She wasn't wearing any, and the waitress admitted to noticing them and not saying anything.
The waitress then also seemed short with us when we had questions, brought our shake out before the food (probably about 10 minutes), and never got us refills on water.

name: Joshua Jones
text: Great burger!

name: Jeff G
text: Always great service and great food. Very accommodating to people with food allergies. Place fills up quick after 5pm so expect a wait otherwise get there early.

name: drum line
text: Excellent customer service and the food is really good as well reasonable prices. Highly recommend eating here.

name: Terri Burns
text: One waitress handling majority of tables on both sides of the restaurant. She had spilled a couple drinks when she fell in front if us and manager walked by twice and looked at it and NO one cleaned it up.

name: Laurie Zimmerman
text: Great service. Food was excellent and timed perfectly with appetizers.  No waiting.  Restaurant was clean and appealing. Highly recommend.

name: Jim O'Keeffe
text: Fantastic burger options a good beer selection. Good soup too! Wonderful, friendly service from greeter/host to servers. Fun decor, nice table/seating arrangements. Plus, they offer endless fries with burger options (if you're so inclined and in the the mood!)

name: Dawn Kirschner
text: Great service

name: Diane T
text: Food was great, service wasn't.  It took 20 minutes to get a straw.  The waiter stated the original one got wet.  Really, it was a straw in a drink.  Isn't it supposed to get wet.  Also didn't clear the dishes when we were finished and took forever to get the check.

name: Val
text: Not a fan of rolls of towels on the table for napkins, menus left on the table and not wiped down, and no water delivered unless it's asked for. Besides that, there were 7 tables left unbussed the entire time we were there, the floor was in desperate need of vacuuming/sweeping, and both my sweet potato fries and burger were barely warm right out of the kitchen. We ate at about 8pm and I was hungry and tired so did not tell the waitress, though she did not come over to check on us until she thought I was starting at her while I was actually reading the beer list. While we were told they were a little short staffed we saw hostesses standing around talking, as well as other staff doing the same. Lastly, my wife went to use the restroom as we were leaving and turned right back around. She said the best way to describe the room was, "dumpster fire" and she could wait to go until we got home. I see little reason to ever go back.

name: Jessica Buss
text: Food was very good and came in a fair time frame once our orders were FINALLY taken. We had a big b-day group  (which having been a server I know can be overwhelming) but we didn't place drink orders for a good 20 mins and almost as long waiting to place food orders. Multiple people brought food out so less issues there but table service was less than fantastic.  Maybe it will was an off night- understandable.

name: Kris T
text: Waitress was wonderful. Food was cooked correctly. It was nice to be out and about.

name: Marie B
text: It was just okay. Now our waitress was decent but the food was blah. We actually haven’t eaten here in over a year because the last time we came the turkey burgers gave me a stomach ache. We were in the area and decided to stop for something different. As you can see in the pic, my son’s pizza looked odd...very burnt around the edges. I can say I’m not a fan of Red Robin’s and for sure I won’t be giving them another chance, I’m done. There’s far too many other restaurants that can service our needs. Again, decent waitress.

name: Ericka Smith
text: Not best experience, but good food. Garlic bite things were terrific. It all depends on whether your server is a good listener/knows the menu and can understand what it's like to take kids to restaurant. We had 3 this time...At end of meal, we saw sign on table that said kids eat free or something with entrees. We didn't go there for this - would never had known if we didn't read the little table tent thing. When we asked server, she said "oh, yeah! Let me adjust your bill". Shouldn't this be thing they say...with 3 kids? We walked in expecting no deals, we love Red Robin food, but if you are gonna advertise it...

name: Alison Worm
text:
Who wants to walk into a restaurant and eat amongst 5 tables piled with dirty dishes? Not this girl... Not to mention the 4 or 5 other tables piled with dirty dishes in another section we saw when we first walked in. Disgusting and definitely not a first good impression. I can hardly believe that there was no one- a manager or a server who wasn't busy, to help clean the restaurant. Especially since guest perception reflects on the managers and staff.

Ordered a salad and wasn't given any silverware. When we asked the host as she was walking by, she legit brought us wrapped plastic to-go utensils. I had to ask for real silverware for my salad 👎 Also had to ask for salt and pepper as neither were on our table or any of the tables around us. Doesn't seem like the restaurant was set up for success from the beginning of the day. Overall, not impressed AT ALL! We eat at Red Robin frequently, more so at the 76th St location before we moved to New Berlin and I would probably make the longer drive to go to that location in the future.

Food was good. Server was nice. The guy who walked our food was nice as well. Not sure if we came on a bad day but I definitely expect better appearance-wise and couldn't wait to get out of there!!!

name: David Komas
text: Great food and service. Give them a visit.

name: Tracy Lewis
text: One waiter for the whole section at lunch time.

name: Kim Grossmann
text: Normally I would have ranked Red Robin higher but this time the burgers were a little off (because we were rushed for time we didn't complain but should have and will if it happens again). Overcooked for the way they were ordered and the serving of Fries seemed to have shrunk and were not up to expectations...hopefully just an off day and not a sign of the times where quality seems to be sidelined.  Join the loyalty club for special deals, it's easy. Service was great.

name: William Holmes
text: Great food

name: Jonn Harris
text: RED ROBIN... YUMMMM!!! Nice lunch I had here. Try the El Ranchero burger, limited time only tho. Will visit this location again.

name: Norma Round
text: Their burgers are yummy. The onion rings are fantastic too.

name: Jet Gramma
text: Just meh... my sister who was with me ordered only soup cuz she said last 2 times she got burgers, felt unwell when she got home. She said tortilla soup was OK. I got soup and salad. Server brought wrong soup and had to wait for what I ordered - salad was not good -cucumber slices were so thin they were frozen, iceberg lettuce was yellow/brown, and I got 2 croutons, not much else - skimpy on dressing.

name: Abraham Mundt
text: Great food and excellent service. Highly recommend.

name: becky lynn
text: The food is delicious! The fries are endless which makes sharing easy. The drink menu has a lot of great options- beer, margaritas, mojitos, strawberry lemonade, iced tea, soda. We went during lunch rush and only had to wait 5-10 minutes to get seated. We didn't feel it was too noisy and we could still visit and talk The prices are a little more than I'd usually spend for a burger meal, but they do have a 6.99 menu as well. Otherwise, it's about 9-15$. Good appetizer menu as well. Friendly and very competent wait staff. I'd gladly go again!

name: Elaine Blumreiter
text: Good Service, Good Chicken Tenders and Unlimited Fries!

name: Ed Zetting
text: Never dissapointed with the food

name: Dave Wiese
text: Good food, and you get a free burger for your birfday. Bottomless root beer floats and fries are a nice touch too.

name: Kathryn Welden
text: You can always count on Red Robin for a delicious burger! The bottomless sides are nice too. We do try to avoid peak meal times, it can get very busy.

name: Daryl Smith

name: Michael Wright

name: angela Wiklin

name: Elizabeth Welch

name: Joyce Walker

text: The burger was very good. Wait staff was also pretty good. Beer price was a little steep. Wait for table was long...even at early hour of dinner window. Well we have tried it, and now we will go back to our old staple Soblemanns.

name: Marsha Mueller
text: The food and service was ok. This place could use a deep cleaning.

name: Kevin Montoure
text: If you're a burger fan you'll appreciate the wide variety of options here. Plus they offer bottomless fries !!

name: David M
text: Really good burgers!  We had an awesome waitress, Mary,who was wonderful.  Service was fast and friendly.

name: Bobby Bosler
text: Very good food, but I had a insist on not being seated near the bar several times. Thankfully, the hostess eventually agreed to place me away from the bar.

name: dion McCullum
text: Food was good and hot. Had a lunch date with my cousins, and we had a great time. Wait staff could have been more attentive and friendly, but overall it was an OK experience

name: Paulette Oberlin
text: I don't have a clue why the wait staff don't listen when you give them your order. I had to remind her at least 6 different times on things I wanted. I was here a few weeks ago and nothing changed at all on service. I spend good money at your establishment and I will not do that again.

name: Robert Woods
text: The food was very good, but the service was terrible. There were two of us at the table, but it took 95 minutes to get in and out. Other table were served and left in the time we were there. Once again (like other times to this particular restaurant), the service was VERY slow, even when not particularly busy.

name: Scott Nichols
text: Burger presentation and taste was 5-star.  The service from Ry Guy on 10/29/18 @ 1:45 was perfect. Can't wait to bring family.

name: John Bell
text: Great Atmosphere and great rewards program. A free burger on your birthday? Yes please!

name: David May
text: These burgers are indescribably good. There's no way to put it. Just. So. Good. If you haven't been before, try their Hawaiian Heart Throb smoothie. It tastes so Bueno I'm telling you! Take a girl here and she'll love you forever! (maybe)

name: Jean King-Catt
text: Best service ever tonight! Karen was awesome! Extremely attentive, frequently visiting our table to check on us and to bring refills, super friendly, order was all made correctly, came fast & hot, just a great experience overall! Restaurant has a fun atmosphere, friendly staff, good food, and they often have meal discounts if you belong to their free Red Robin Rewards program. They could use a few more low carb food & drink options for those of us that have to keep track of that. But it's a really nice burger place that'll likely become one of your go-to restaurants. It's one if ours!

name: Andrew Marvan
text: It's always okay but never great. Takes longer than anything to order drinks and get the show started. The last few visits servers have gone missing for periods during ng the meal not showing up even in our seating area. Lastly, am I the only person who hates seeing servers complain about getting too many tables while I'm still waiting to be greeted?

name: Calla Meinen

name: Keyur Parikh
text:
Have always loved it. Service food drinks all excellent. Our server last night was especially nice and patient.
Love their "ancient grain and quinoa" patty.

name: jethro harrison
text: Good burger. Very cold beer. Will go back again for sure 👍

name: alley kitty
text: I could of made a better burger at home for cheaper. The bun was dry and the burger seemed smaller then i remember. Not only that, I couldn't stand the server. He was arrogant and weird. Sorry, I won't be back!

name: Eddie Rags
text: Bland food. Service was great though.

name: Nick Berlick
text: Waiter was very entertaining and I hope he continues to be just a little bit extra. He went for all of the 110% effort while he was serving us and the tables around us.

name: Jocelyn Loehe

name: KELLY HENDRIX
text: This is always where my husband wants tti go for his birthday.  He keeps saying he'll get a free burger, then he always orders the wrong kind.  He's still a pretty cheap date though.

name: Daniel Tacner
text: Burger are great but, why does it cost so much?

name: tyler devillers
text: My burger was ice cold and my gfs was under cooked and the pay things were down

name: Ama Schu
text: Normally a 5 star experience, but this visit was a bit...awkward. The manager acted like they didn't really care about anything, and our waitress, Meghana, was even more bizarre. She didn't introduce herself, and she too our order as quickly as possible. She even started walking away before I was finished telling her my order! I had to raise my voice to complete it to make sure she heard me, and she still forgot what I had asked when someone else?? brought out our meals. She was untimely with our drinks and barely checked in on us. The restaurant was not at all busy.

name: Scott Hendrix
text: Although they don't provide heating for their hostess, poor Ashley, the food and the giant beer continue to impress. I just hope Ashley doesn't freeze to death. My wife also wishes the seasoning containers fit into her lady bag better.

name: H G
text: Fun food and big beers, worth the stop .

name: Evelyn Hubbart
text: I wasn't impressed. My server wasn't rude, but he also wasn't very friendly, even telling me at one point while I was talking to him that he would come back because he had another table. WHILE I was talking. And after I paid he said he would come back but he didn't. We made eye contact a couple of times but he  ever came back while I was waiting and seemed more interested in goi g and continuing his conversation with the other staff. The food was ok though.

name: Chevy McGill

name: Pete Sagat
text: Poor service.

name: Rez Kin
text: Always satisfied after a visit to Red Robin. Good food, good beer, and better service. I come back whenever I have a chance.

name: Sierra Currie
text: Great Burgers!! Also has some delicious alcoholic shakes! 😋

name: Lisa Marie Idzikowski
text: Fun atmosphere for the family, yet still able to hear each other. Good food and very friendly wait staff!

name: Phil Wilson
text: Its a burger joint that prides it self on there top notch burgers and bottom less fries. Bring the family it's worth it.

name: Brian Tully
text: Good free burger for Veterans Day. Thank you Red Robin!

name: James Martinson
text: Great burgers...love the Smoke and Pepper burger.  The fish fry is excellent as well.   We will definitely be back!

name: Bill Brewster
text: Good burgers fixed lots of ways. Great service. Only complaint would be it is a little loud with many families with children there.

name: Mikayla is Human
text: Decent. Nice food. Good wall decor.

name: James Watkins
text: The food was great and so was the service. Shot out to the two greeters at the door.

name: Aleah Chacon
text: Beyond amazing experience here everyone was sooooo nice and respectful!!! Me and my daughter had a blast definitely coming here again thnx again to Justin and I believe she was the manager with blonde short hair she was awesome too ❤❤

name: Sujay Gandham
text: Really good place to have burgers. I'm not a burger person, but this place is an exception.

name: Darkened Archangel
text: Overpriced middle quality burgers. Visit elsewhere for a better experience. I spent way too much for such menial quality.

name: Greg J
text: Excellent food and service.

name: Shawn Long
text: Very nice place the workers are great as well

name: Steve & Judy Reichman
text: Good for casual lunch.  Kids enjoyed it.  Nice touch- unlimited fries (which we took advantage of)

name: tyler orr
text: Felt like castle being put at such a small table, we didn't even have room for our food with a appetizer on the table. Waitress was very nice and refilled drinks on time but the burger was so gressey it fell apart when I picked it up and had to put it back together. Would not eat here unless you like be crammed in.

name: Nancy Boutilier
text: Hadn't eaten here in awhile and found too many changes which was not good. Had French Onion soup.  Served cold and minus onions.  Prices up but not quality.  Paper towel roll? On table. What happened to napkins?

name: kelly dingler
text: Wow.. Use to be fantastic.. Burgers are smaller and smaller.. Service not good.. Dirty menus, tables. Music from back mixed with dining room very annoying..

name: Mark Friedman
text: Pretty decent burger, unlimited fries and lemonade.  A bit spend and I felt guilty I bought the cheapest thing.

name: Margarita Rios
text: The food was awesome and the staff was very helpful and friendly.  My son the up getting sick (ate too much) but they were nice about not making a big deal and offering to clean up for us so we could leave.

name: Brittany Steinbring
text: Great food and clean location. Servers are fast and friendly

name: Rachelle Jaquith
text: The waiter was more interested in checking out a table of men been waiting on his tables. Food was extremely slow coming out waiter never return to ask if anybody needed refills on beverages will not be going back

name: Holly J H
text: Good burgers, excellent service. Logan was a great waiter.

name: Diane Brunette
text: Dood is always so delicious and fun drink menu too. Great place to go with great menu and pricing too.

name: James Thompson
text: Great place for a burger and beer. Huge menu and beer selection.

name: Sherelle Harris
text: I am always pleased with my food and service

name: Mark Janetski
text: Amazing food as always.  Had a burger with the lettuce wraps. Seems to give more of the flavor and spices.

name: Benjamin Smith
text: This location is improving. I previously walked out because it was so filthy, about a year ago. They obviously have a new manager - I saw him actually sweeping his own restaurant. Paper towels were out in the Men's room, they are very understaffed. They are doing really well for being understaffed, however. I had two different people wait on me. Manager did not stop by to see how things were. The bartender was waiting on us and when she was busy another lady was helping us. Bartender was complaining about the tips people were leaving her, very unprofessional. She did do a good job otherwise, so we left her a good one. The host was the most professional out of everyone in the restaurant, he needs to be promoted. I'll start coming again. Value for the money in this chain is lacking. 14$ a burger is laughable. Hamburger costs $3.99 a pound for the high quality 90/10. They serve 80/20 and It generally costs $1.99 a pound or $2.99 a pound. A half pound cheeseburger costs $1.50 You shouldn't be charging 14$ for it, ever. Fuddruckers has much more value for the money and choices. None the less, we will come back here on occasion.
