name: Taz Connect
text:
(Translated by Google) Good burgers super nice staff

(Original)
Bon burgers personnel super sympa

name: Tania De la Rosa
text:
(Translated by Google) Delicious food and excellent service

(Original)
Comida deliciosa y excelente servicio

name: Dean Raudabaugh
text:
Stopped here to pick up some sushi. (I haven't eaten in a restaurant in over a year because of covid.) The hostess was attentive and helpful and I loved the decoration and furniture. There is a pond with a few fish in it and the water was very clean and clear.

My sushi came out in less than 15 minutes, even though they had just opened. I ordered the Fancy Rainbow and the rolls with the pickled cabbage. Everything was fresh and obviously made less than an hour ago.

Will come here again! And try something more than sushi.

resp.text: Dean, we're super pumped that you enjoyed our sushi! The Fancy Rainbow is a tasty favorite of ours. Next time you're craving some fresh, delicious food, come on by and see us. -The team at Fuji Steak House

name: Nicanor Gonzalez
text: Food's awesome, service needs to improve greatly.. the servers barely come by and Don't really remember much unless they write it down.. the habatchi chefs are super fun tho!

resp.text: Nicanor, we've taken note of your feedback. Thanks for your review. -The team at Fuji Steak House

name: Savanna
text: The interior is absolutely beautiful, gorgeous artwork but not overdone. There is a lovely seating area if you need to wait for a table at all. The service was excellent and the food was well done. Definitely will be going again in the future.

resp.text: Savanna, walking through our doors, our ambiance helps create a beautiful experience. We're happy to know our food and service doesn't disappoint either. We can't wait to see you back again in the future. - The team at Fuji Steak House

name: Gary Dahl
text: Excellent food. Place needs a bit of an update in in a couple of places. Covid probably hurt though so no downgrade. Great for kids and adults. Sushi was excellent.

resp.text: Gary, thanks for the wonderful review! -The team at Fuji Steak House

name: Kenneth Kolbrak
text: Always an amazing time here. Family and friends all met up here and truly enjoyed our dinning experience here. Love it!!! Will be back again and again.

resp.text: Kenneth, we're really glad you could swing by! Be sure to come back our way soon. -The team at Fuji Steak House

name: Sharon Preston
text: It was an excellent experience with family for a very special occasion!  We were seated with a really genuine couple and our chef was super entertaining!

resp.text: Sharon, thanks for celebrating your special occasion with us! We enjoyed your company. Hope you can come back soon for dinner and a show. -The team at Fuji Steak House

name: Gaziuh
text: As soon as you walk into the establishment you are greeted by a beautiful water pond with water trickling down into it. Giving you a feel of authenticity and elegance. Staff exorcised 6 foot distancing and masks at all time. Seeting was every other booth as to feel less crowded and gave a relaxing experience. Looking at the menu you will be surprised to see the amount of different Alcohol choices, sushi options, and my personal favorite, the ramen.

resp.text: Gaziuh, we love to hear about your favorites! Ramen is a top choice for many, but sushi never fails either. Come back again for more. - The team at Fuji Steak House

name: Teresa Marquardt
text: Fuji was very disappointing.  I've been here before and the chef put on a good show and the overall atmosphere in the restaurant was fun and energetic. However, this time we had a new chef who didn't attempt to make conversation, much less do any of the entertaining things that make Fuji so much fun. He forgot to give everyone the two shrimp appetizer (the manager later took less than $3 off of our bills because of this error), and he didn't evenly distribute the rice or vegetables. The food was ok, but not as well seasoned as I remember. The fun atmosphere was also missing at all but one hibachi table. Overall a very, mediocre dining experience.

resp.text: Teresa, it pains us to know your previous, positive experiences were overridden by your last meal here. After making accommodations for you, we're sorry to know you're still upset. We'll make sure this doesn't happen in the future. Please come back again -- we can bring back the entertainment you're used to. - The team at Fuji Steak House

name: lori thomson
text: It was really  fun! Our chef has a great sense of humor

resp.text: lori, thanks for the excellent review!  -The team at Fuji Steak House

name: Todd Court
text: It seems they pick the freshest vegetables and cuts of meats.

resp.text: Todd, thanks for the support! See you again soon. -The team at Fuji Steak House

name: Joyce Warner
text: Service was slow, sushi had a lot to be desired, small and not tasty as compared to the restaurant in Middleton.

name: Kari Lowe
text: I love this place! It was the first time I have been to a place where the food was prepared in front of me and the food was delicious!

resp.text: Kari, hibachi grilling is an experience everyone should try! We're delighted to know you gazed your eyes upon a tasty meal being prepared just for you. Hope you'll be back for your second soon. - The team at Fuji Steak House

name: Maiah Vande Hey
text: The food is great and you get SO MUCH of it. It is a little pricey, but again, for how much you get, the quality that it is, and the overall experience of hibachi grill styled dining, it is totally worth it. And if you get two meals, you get a free appetizer, which is a great deal. The dumplings/potstickers were a great, free, addition for meals we were already planning on getting. You WILL need a box.

name: Eric Stephenson
text: Great place to eat with a fun atmosphere. To get the most from your experience, I'd recommend going with a group. The food is good and the show is enjoyable. Don't get too close to the flames 😊

name: Cathy Hale
text: The food was very good and the Grillmaster was great!

resp.text: Cathy, thanks for the wonderful review! -The team at Fuji Steak House

name: Scott Turk
text: Even with all this COVID-19 stuff going on they've put as many precautions in place as per the state & federal orders. It still was a great experience & we'll be back again!

resp.text: The safety of our community has always been a priority, Scott. We're glad that was clear the last time you joined us. When you want to come out for more sushi, we look forward to making you feel comfortable at a table with us. - The team at Fuji Steak House

name: Brianna Schwanbeck
text: Such a fun atmosphere and the food is amazing!

resp.text: Brianna, thanks so much for stopping in! We'd love to welcome you back our way again soon. -The team at Fuji Steak House

name: Josh Szydel
text: Awesome food and service. Best sushi in eau claire

resp.text: Josh, we're happy you could join us! We'd love to see you back. - The team at Fuji Steak House

name: Jeff Rye
text: Great food as usual and atmosphere is fun. They are following all social distancing and safety protocol.

resp.text: Safety has always been important to us, Jeff, but it's even more so now. Any time you get hungry, just know: We're here to keep you as safe and comfortable as possible. See you soon! - The team at Fuji Steak House

name: Samantha Smith
text: Everytime I went here its been delicious! Portion sizes are questionable considering the price though. Anybody who says its to much food, yikes. But otherwise, great food, good service.

resp.text: No matter what you order, Samantha, expectations of great flavor is met when you walk through our doors! With that, we understand why you wish there was more on your plate. Hope the next serving is enough to conquer your craving completely. - The team at Fuji Steak House

name: Star Fordham
text: The food is good and the serving staff are nice. Definitely my favourite place to go for sushi in eau claire.

resp.text: Star, it's an honor to be your favorite spot in town for some great sushi! We'd love to see you back our way again soon. -The team at Fuji Steak House

name: Steve Hansen
text: Awesome place. Great food and the staff always making it interesting while cooking the food

name: Marnie Schaller
text: Entertaining, delicious, not much wait time at all!

resp.text: Marnie, so glad you got to the good stuff without having to wait. You're always welcome back to a seat at our table. Hope it's soon. - The team at Fuji Steak House

name: Sharlyn Fellenz
text: Yum yum yum!  One of my favorite places!

resp.text: Sharlyn, thanks for your excellent review! We'd love to see you back our way. - The team at Fuji Steak House

name: Lisa
text: The food was delicious and it was entertaining watching the food being cooked.

resp.text: Who said waiting for your food has to be boring, Lisa? We're glad you embrace the entertainment of watching your favorite flavors being cooked before your eyes. The next time you want a fresh meal, our chefs will be excited to prepare one for you. - The team at Fuji Steak House

name: John Cobb
text: The food was great and I appreciated the opportunity to have a meeting without a lot of distractions.

resp.text: John, keep us in mind anytime a meeting comes up. Sitting you and your buddies in a quiet part of the restaurant is something we're willing to do. Plus, you get a great meal. Hope your next one is soon. - The team at Fuji Steak House

name: Becca Lust
text: Best place around for some good hibachi!

resp.text: Becca, we're glad you enjoyed your visit! We look forward to welcoming you back. - The team at Fuji Steak House

name: BT
text: Waitress was extremely professional and respectful. Our order arrived quickly and the food was delicious. Highly recommend.

name: Nikki R.
text: The atmosphere is unique. It was very busy and loud, but it's fun if you don't mind that. The fried rice and all other foods were really good. I went with a group of 7 people at the hibachi table. 10 people are seated to a table so be ready to sit with other people if you have less than 10. I recommend making a reservation. Overall would recommend!

name: D B
text: Never disapointed, lunch specials grate value..

name: Randy Hanson
text: Great food and service.

resp.text: We're so glad you visited us, Randy! Hoping you're able to come back our way soon. -The team at Fuji Steak House

name: Andrew Nickel
text: The food here is almost unbeatable in taste and quality. Their steak is some of the most tender in town. Their shrimp are plump and fluffy never overcooked. The sauces they come up with are amazing and the fried rice is to die for. The hibachi is fun if your looking to take some friends out but be warned, it is expensive! If your a light eater this place is perfect for you. If your appetite requires a little more to satisfy, like mine, your going to want to get extra. I would expect to spend no less that $40 per person to do the meal right on any given night. It is a little dated on the inside and the staff can come off as unhappy at times but all in all I'd highly recommend giving it a try!

name: John Hodges
text: Great food, friendly staff

resp.text: Glad to know you had a great visit, John! Hoping you come back soon. -The team at Fuji Steak House

name: Lon Jorstad
text: This is a great place to eat and be entertained by the staff. I recommend this place!!!

resp.text: There's nothing like seeing your smile begin before your meal to the very last bite, Lon. Thank you for choosing us as your entertainment and dinner for the night. Hope to see you back soon. - The team at Fuji Steak House

name: Michele Shrader
text: Service was great. Food was good. Always entertaining.

name: lil strawberry
text: The food was amazing 🤤 The restaurant is also very pretty. I cannot wait to visit again!

name: Joshua Strand
text: Great Hibachi lunch!

resp.text: Thanks for your great review, Joshua! Hoping you make it back our way soon. -The team at Fuji Steak House

name: Cole Baumann
text: Great atmosphere, our cook was very enthusiastic and made great food. Also absolutely LOVED the white sauce. I'd say if you're going, go with hibachi. A little pricy but honestly the food lives up to the price. And if you can, open up for some sake.

name: Dawn Dean
text: The food was fantastic, however, the service was extremely slow.

resp.text: Thank you for thinking of us when you were ready to eat a delicious meal, Dawn. We were really hoping it was delivered in good time. We're sure we can improve that before your next visit. See you then! - The team at Fuji Steak House

name: Jeff Meyer
text: Great food great atmosphere

resp.text: We're so glad you had a great visit, Jeff! We'd love to see you back. -The team at Fuji Steak House

name: Gregorio J
text: I love the atmosphere, and have always gotten above average service and food quality.

resp.text: When going out for sushi and steak, Gregorio, we assume our guests are expecting above-average service. That's why we deliver every time! Can't wait to have you back again. - The team at Fuji Steak House

name: Jeromy Prosser
text: We have come here several times and each time it is very good. The only complaint we have is that refills on drinks, or getting steamed rice, can take quite a while. We will continue to come here as the food and chefs are great!

name: christian jasmer
text: Dinner and a show! Great for the whole family. The food is amazing.. Can't get enough of it.

name: Travis Harelstad
text: Very good atmosphere, fantastic quality of food, and a very good hibachi show. The hibachi show is definitely different than the hibachi show over at Tokyo on London road, but that is good, because it gives a little bit of variety. Really have enjoyed every experience I've had here, and I'll be glad to go there again.

name: Kenny
text: Very good quality food and atmosphere.

resp.text: We're grateful for you joining us, Kenny! Hope to see you back our way soon. -The team at Fuji Steak House

name: Pedro Cancel
text: Great food . Good prices.

resp.text: Pedro, thanks for leaving this review! Hope you'll be back. - The team at Fuji Steak House

name: CJ Ackley
text:
I eat here all the time. This place is a really fun hibachi restaurant. The chefs are all very experienced and the food is very good. One of my favorite places to eat out in Eau Claire.

If you want a more private setting than the grill there are very nice booths for date night as well.

name: Dustin Smith
text: I really like this place. The food is delicious and the staff is friendly. I am a sushi lover and this is the best sushi I have had anywhere. They have so many options I will need to keep coming back to try them all. I like the options like that boat of sushi, sample plates, etc. The prices are good and the staff if friendly.

name: Hali Ryan
text:
Fuji's food is very delicious, but I feel is pricey for the amount of food you're given. I've only eaten in their dining area, so I can't speak for the habachi experience.

Their sushi is very delicious and they have a lot of different rolls to choose from, but the last two times I've been their with friends, their regular food comes out a lot faster than the sushi to the point that they are almost finished eating by the time the sushi rolls arrive. It would be nice if they could time it, so the entire table gets their main course at the same time.

Their yum yum sauce and other menu items have all been very delicious. I just wished you got more food for the price you pay.

name: Dabs Guy
text: Best food I've ever eaten. They proof it's fresh meat and veggies. They cook the food in right front of you. Huge flames.  Awesome!

name: Dan Delkamp
text:
Meh.

The food was good, I will give it that.

Not sure why they call it a steak house when you can't order a steak. Steak bites in a meal, but no actual steaks.

The server and cook spoke so little english, we had to resort to pointing at things on the menu to order.

Also, very expensive.

Frankly, the food was the only good part. I've had better experiences for half the cost.

name: Travis Holbrook
text: Good place to bring a whole crew of friends or family to eat, but make sure you have reservations and know EXACTLY how many folks will be with your group. You wont sit until all are present and accounted for due to the nature of the seating.  Food quality is just average for this type of establishment, not great and not terrible. Drinks are good,  but at peak times are slow to arrive.

name: celeste snyder
text: The server was excellent. She was familiar with the menu and gave us some great suggestions.  The dining area is very cozy so it's a great place to meet friends where you can actually  have a conversation but if you want to be entertained, try the hibachi grill.

name: Christian Emerson
text: Very entertaining offers a little of everything,  brought a 3&4 year old and they were very entertained food was delicious

name: Jacob Johnston
text: I had the habachi experience amazing. I've been here before for the sushi which is also incredible. I forgot to take more photos because I was enthralled with the experiance. Best miso soup I've had in recent history. They have a great Saki selection. I got the calamari habachi and it was to die for. Best friend rice I've had in forever. They have great yum yum sauce and all the staff has always been amazing. I remember Kevin and I beleive the grillman was Alex, so funny so nice. I will be back.

name: Tahlyr McCarty
text: Always love coming here with my family! The lunch specials are priced great and the staff is friendly!

name: Tara Mae
text: Absolutely amazing service,  entertainment and food EVERY time I've ever been here.  Highly recommend.

name: Addie Shilling
text: Fuji is always able to accommodate a large group for us (12-15 people). We love the food.  And for birthdays, they'll sing a song and the birthday person gets a scoop of ice cream.

name: Justin Vajko
text: Best sushi in town in my opinion! Wait staff is fine, hibachi grill is entertaining.

name: Maria Elliott
text: Cool Hibachi presentation, nice staff, food was yummy but be sure to speak up and have them pull your steaks when you see they are med doneness. Ours all turned out well done.

name: Michael Moulton
text: Always great service and great food!!

resp.text: Thank you for swinging by, Michael! We hope we'll see you here again soon. -The team at Fuji Steak House

name: Tim Davis
text: Great time with the Hibachi chef, he entertained the kids and cooked an excellent meal.

name: Grace Junio
text: I've tried this place maybe around 6 times and haven't been here in years. It's not because of the food but because of what I witnessed the last time. The sushi chef was scolding one of the waitresses. It was bad. I lost my appetite and the desire to be back since. Food-wise, their bento boxes are excellent; it's just that they are not enough reason for me to give them another go.

name: Joanne Busack
text: First time eating there and I have to say that the food was delicious and amazing!!

name: Mike G
text: We always have good luck here.  I love the sushi, the wife loves the hibachi. Always leave more than full and feel well taken care of. The staff is very friendly and quick to help. Dining room or hibachi great choice!

name: Kevin Franklin
text: Fair mix of veggies in hibachi fun decor and lots of space. The water fall at the entrance was anything but unassuming.,

name: Wendy Montag
text: Beautiful place to eat. The drums that they played for birthdays were deafening, but the people that were serenaded seemed to love them. The food was delicious and the servers attentive. The seasonings they used on the hibachi were different than other restaurants of this type, and in my opinion a nice change. They really pack in the chairs, so it's probably not the most intimate setting, but I would definitely visit again.

name: Jeff Deutschlander
text: Great food and fun

name: Jay Liza James
text: Phenomenal food

resp.text: Really appreciate this review, Jay! Hoping we'll see you here again soon. - The team at Fuji Steak House

name: Carolyn Barneson
text: A good place for family night out. Entertaining

name: Carlos Balderas
text: Excellent atmosphere, Chefs are fun and entertaining, food is great and all around great Customer Service.

name: Janelle Winter
text: Great sushi place with affordable prices. As a sushi feen, I would eat here again!

name: Travel Fun For Everyone
text: Always a great experience at Fuji! You must try the Hibachi grill if you go. They have generous portions even for the kids!

name: Mark Gonzales
text:
Great food and very entertaining chefs.
Friendly staff and the fact that your food is prepared and cooked in front of you is a unique experience.
Check it out and you won't be disappointed.

name: Michael J
text: Was pretty good! Authentic atmosphere with very talented chefs. Only complaint is they did mess up my order a bit. Thankfully they did fix it but thats why I took away a star. Otherwise very delicious food and fun experience!

name: Ryan Petrie
text:
Excellent restaurant with decent atmosphere and even better sushi.  The prices are reasonable with excellent staff that explained the sushi options that we were looking for.  My second favorite place for sushi in town with Shanghai as being slightly better and Ninja would rate, slightly below here.
Plenty of parking with a large waiting area before they sit you down in your spot.

name: Tami Guza
text: Love the place. Awesome food and great service.

name: j1966mg@gmail.com nonnytya8790
text: Always fun to watch the cook. Food is over the top excellent!

name: Robert Mentecki
text: Awesome food, awesome chef, awesome atmosphere. I will be back

name: Mark Parisi
text: Always a good place to eat sushi. They have amazing hibachi too.  The inside of the restaurant is pretty good looking.  They have good service.  Prices are. What you would expect from good quality sushi and hibachi.

name: Carol Risler
text: Kevin was an awesome and  entertaining chef,  as he cooked the food he entertained us with his comedy and cooking technic. Food was great,  we will definitely be going back to enjoy more!!

name: Michael Page
text: Stopped quick off of 94 for some sushi, we were very pleased with the quality!!

name: Levi Kelton
text: Good food

resp.text: Thanks so much for leaving this review, Levi! Hope to see you come back soon. - The team at Fuji Steak House

name: Chris Gilles
text: Just amazing steak and seafood. The service is very, very fast and friendly. The atmosphere is excellent as well, with comfortable seating and beautiful wood + glass partitions. Fun times in the lounge as well for after supper. A must stop for the hibachi filet mignon and scallops platter, the steak melts in your mouth man! ( or woman! ) Try out a small sake with your meal (hint: get it warm for the cheap stuff)

name: Allen Breeden
text: First time here, and first time trying sashimi. It was excellent, firm, with a nice light flavor. I also had the steak and scallop hibachi cooked dinner, and that was wonderful as well. We didn't sit at the hibachi grill, but in the booth area. It was a bit dark in the booth area, but I would highly recommend this place.

name: Holly Ahlert
text: Love it

resp.text: Holly, thanks for swinging by! Hope you come back our way. -The team at Fuji Steak House

name: Ashley Bushendorf
text: Food is always amazing, prices are a little high but you do get a soup and salad which are AWESOME and 2 complimentary shrimp no matter what meat you order. Love it!!!

name: ashley matysik
text: Love this place! Their sushi is really good and they have some fantastic appetizers! Highly reccomend!

name: Angie Haats
text:
Fuji is the perfect place for a birthday dinner, business lunch, or family meal.  They offer 2 seperate seating areas; one for live hibachi and one for casual dining.  Both styles are excellent.  The fresh sushi was amazing and the presentation was beautiful.  The hibachi was entertaining and delicious as well.

Another great perk for Fuji is that they have several different price points.  The bill for 2 foodies can be as low as $10 or as high as $200, which makes it perfectly versatile for the whole family or office!

name: Alexander F Holmes III
text: Hibachi chef was friendly and funny. The whole table loved it

name: Wicked339 wicked
text: I love it here but not cheap

name: S. Schram
text: It's pricey if you go for dinner, but the food has always been very good!  The Hibachi is a lot of fun for a group.

name: Jan Harper
text: It's typical "sit around the grill" and marvel at the ease in which the chef slices and dices, then grills the food. Very crowded on a Saturday night and not very private. But it's nice sometimes to share a meal with a group of strangers! Rather pricy but the chicken and shrimp hibachi, and the sushi appetizer plate, were really good. I would recommend.

name: chad michaelis
text: Great food. Good service. Decent pricing.

name: rebecca jennings
text: Great lunch specials!  I always get hibachi shrimp and it is delicious!

name: Lisa Marie Westman
text: Terrific food. Provides all the hibachi theatrics you might expect. Highly, highly recommend adding the calamari side to your meal.

name: Heidi Wilson
text: I had the Ocean Combo (spicy tuna rolls) and it was delicious.  Great atmosphere and they even have hibachi.  Would definitely go again.  My friend had teriyaki scallops that were also fantastic.  Reasonable prices as well.

name: Darla Lansing
text: Went with a friend. Fairly empty when we arrived. Really cold in there...most everyone had to put their jacket back on. Waited a considerable amount of time for service. Not as pleasant as past experiences.

name: Kevin Nance
text: Good food everytime we have been there

name: Mister Titus
text: Brought a friend here for mother's day, and had lunch right after the 2nd opening. As my group were the only ones on the hibachi side, we were quite happy that the chef gave us 3 the same enthusiasm and professionalism as he would an entire table. The food was excellent, and the atmosphere, although empty, was quite wonderful.

name: Easton Bertoni
text: The food is still great but the Hibachi chefs used to be a lot more enthusiastic and interactive.

name: Jeff Hotter
text: 2 visit at the Habachi Grill, keeps getting better. Great food, Great experience 👍

name: Bethany Mayer
text: Always excellent sushi and sashimi. Fresh and delicious. Beautiful atmosphere and friendly service!

name: Bev Baneck
text: Yummy food good prices excellent service and people were fantastic!!! Definitely a return for us.

name: Mike Bitney
text: Great food, good service, reasonable prices.  We'll be back!

name: Thomas Handorf
text: This place is delicious, entertaining, and did I mention delicious? It's a bit pricy but totally worth it. The live hibachi chefs are very entertaining!

name: Jacob Poppe
text: An excellent restaurant! A clean, well decorated interior with friendly staff. The food arrived in a timely manner and was delicious!

name: Ken Truax
text: Great service, good food, fair price.

name: Ken Exner
text: Great service good food and fun..

name: Anita Jevne
text: Fun atmosphere..thanx Denny for a great dinner !

name: Annabelle Bauer
text: We sat at the place were they make your food in front of you. It was amazing. Super nice staff. Great place.

name: Wayne Knuth
text: Very good place to eat , (especially birthdays)

name: Alex Judkins
text: Great sushi and some awesome noodle dishes! Haven't tried the hibachi yet, but I've had tons of different sushi as well as the ramen, miso soup, and tonkatsu and it's all been great. They've also been very understanding of my partner's food allergies and we've never had any issues with it. Highly recommend!

name: Avery Gjerseth
text: Love this place oh so much!

name: Amanda Oliver-Hoyt
text: Good food.

resp.text: We're happy you enjoyed visiting us, Amanda! Be sure to come see us in the future. -The team at Fuji Steak House

name: Dave Johns II
text: Great food and atmosphere, rarely a wait

name: Jon Standiford
text: Always fun and good food

name: Hank Zane
text: I have not been here in several years, but always had a great experience. Love the bento boxes especially. Leaving this review to affirm I will be back soon

name: Scott R
text: Beautiful restaurant, friendly staff, great sushi... unfortunately the hibachi was heavily coated in thick sauces and the steak was small and half fat and tough... never seen steak come out to a table at a hibachi restaurant untrimmed

name: themalonessbko
text: Oh my goodness! I love their food always take up the option of their hibachi grill! My favorite is their fried rice!

name: Jill Gibbon
text: The food and service was good. Great atmosphere, but we had reservations and were seated 45 minutes after our reservation.

name: Roger Lawrence
text: The experience should be experienced. Birthday for my oldest 27th. Fun funny just got to try.

name: Bonnie Fogelberg
text: Fun place!  Good food.

name: Donovan Tucker
text: Good food.   Chef that cooked in front of us was entertaining and did a really good job!

name: Brandon moe
text: Always has great sushi drink specials are pretty good good specials on Tuesday nights very authentic

name: Anita Clark
text: Great food but sat with naughty kids at the Hibachi. Not what I want to do when I paid that much for a meal. Families with children should certainly not be placed with couples who are clearly out for a nice dinner.

name: Mike Pakanich
text: Very nice fun atmosphere. The food is fantastic

name: Craig Johnson
text: Fantastic, i love this place! Always have great experiences here, though I've never sat at the hibachi so i cannot comment on that. Food is always wonderful, place is always clean and people are always very polite and helpful. I really enjoy going here whenever I'm in the mood for Japanese. I always get the hibachi chicken or teriyaki bento box, but i don't think you can make a bad choice here!!

name: kysi96
text: Always a good experience to visit here. Good food at reasonable prices. Authentic Japanese for central WI

name: Lon Zade
text: I had good fun and nice good happy food...

name: Chris Doney
text: very good and fun place

name: Brendan Davis
text: Happy hour is from 4 to 6. Buy 2 entrees and get a free appetizer. Not if you're eating a vegetarian meal though. Kinda Bs. Good service though.

name: Michael Van Dyke
text: I used to come here on special occasions for the hibachi, and the first time that I came here it was really good. The next few times though were really disappointing, and the food tasted bland. However, the experience that you get from doing the hibachi is definitely worth it, especially if you are 21 or older. That being said though, the food itself isn't good enough in my opinion to justify the price point.

name: Logan Semingson
text: Horrible service food was tasteless very expensive for amount of food

name: Kyle
text: Hibachi is always great!   Entertainment and good food.

name: Amanda Gergely

name: Jim Maaske
text:
Now that the wife and I are back to eating a "whole foods plant based" diet, we have to be a bit more careful with our menu choices.  We've found that Fuji has the most on-menu items that fit our diet (pretty closely) among the sushi joints in town.

My wife ordered two shiitake rolls, a cucumber roll, an avocado roll, and inari sushi.  I took two jade rolls, shiitake roll, and a Fuji onion soup.  We split an order of edamame.  Everything was prepared very well, and presentation was fine, but didn't have flair really.  Not a deal breaker of course, because the taste was super fresh.

We ordered a decent variety, but we only touched on about half of their whole foods plant based stuff.  Oshinko roll is also pretty good, miso soup is great, seaweed salad is pretty darn outstanding, but can be a bit of a calorie/sodium hit.  I'm not a superfan of their ginger dressing on house salads, but it's decent too.  Haven't tried the avocado salad, among a couple others.  They, of course, do hibachi meals and other Japanese dishes from a standard kitchen, but none of those really qualify, due to oil content usually... vegans that don't mind oil and sugar in things have like 2 or 3 options.

Overall there's a lot to like here.  I wish that more sit down places had these kind of things on the menu: just simple, good food, fresh ingredients, low calorie, reasonably priced.

name: Jessica Radle
text:
Because I do not have a vehicle currently, I have to cab it everywhere...a couple nights ago we wanted Taco John's for dinner, so I called and set up a cab for a prearranged time, I called Taco John's about 30 min prior and told them exactly what we wanted, and that I would be there around 5:20, my cab was set for 5:15...got to Taco John's about 5:25 or so and there was 3 gentlemen in button up dress shirts and ties, who i would presume to be owners and/or upper management. There was also 3 or 4 employees making food and taking drive thru orders...I stood there for approximately 5 min before FINALLY one of the men in a shirt and tie asked me if I had been helped yet, I said no...and he then came over himself and I told him I had called in an order prior to coming...he found my bag of food, rang me up, I paid and went on my way...well I got home, and sat down to eat my taco salad, only to find that my house dressing was no where to be found...I don't know about anyone else, but the house dressing is LITERALLY the reason I get taco salads there! And there was NONE. I called the store, and this may sound ridiculous to everyone else, but i was in tears...upset that I just spent  $15 on a cab and almost  $20 on food, just to be disappointed and not get the dinner I paid for...the gentleman on the phone apologized to me, and asked how he could make it better...HONESTLY??? Bring me a NEW salad with the correct dressing, the way i paid for it and didn't recieve! He offered a coupon for a salad, but insisted on mailing it...so now I have to wait at least a week before I can get my salad still...AAAANNNDDDD I then have to pay for a cab out of my pocket once again if i want to go get it.
REALLY EXTREMELY disappointed in all of this...and really feel like that one coupon that I have to WAIT for, doesn't cover this terrible experience AT ALL!!!

text: So kind and happy. Love the smiles they have on their faces when we come in.

name: Jonpaul Okal
text:
The polite way to put is is this is a "vintage location".  The more accurate way to describe it is "old and not updated in forever."

The walk up window is a nice touch in the summer.

name: Joseph Malachowski
text: Not the cleanest. A little run down. Staff were good

resp.text: Hi Joseph, we're disappointed to hear about this. You should always enjoy a visit to DQ restaurants. We appreciate your feedback and are always listening to our fans to improve. We hope you give us another chance and visit us again for a proper DQ experience next time. -DQ Fan Relations Team

name: Shawn Glaser
text: This was a great family night ot meal. The food was served hot and the ice cream cold. My kids loved their blizzards.

name: Donna Wendler
text: Yummy, banana split.

name: Marina Tingblad
text: Love this DQ. I've never left unsatisfied. The service is fast, even when they're busy. Never had an order wrong or any problems. Always a treat to visit!

name: Julie Markgraf
text: It was great. We.love Hudson Dairy Queen.

name: J Bayerl
text: Staff and food were amazing. The restaurant could use a major face lift though. Thats the only reason for a 4 star.

name: Samantha Price
text: Food is really good... Desserts are excellent. Long wait times tho.

name: Jason King
text: Always good food here. Fun vintage location. Dont change a thing.

name: Jody Jutta Hübnér
text: Try the $1.06 slushy in the summer

name: Brendan L
text: Everybody is always super friendly, and this is the only fast food place I'll go in Hudson because of it. Great old fashioned feel inside too!

name: good times
text: Thrilled that the Snicker blizzard is back

name: Seth B
text:
I walked in with my fiance and looked at a staff of four people frowning and staring at us. There were 2 girls and 2 guys; both the girls could obviously care less. The two guys were much more interested in the TV than their work.
I feel obligated to review this place, because every review says the staff is the best in the world and their friendliness has no comparison. Because of the amount of posts that say that, it is possible we went there on a bad day. However, this is the worst Dairy Queen experience I've had.
PS: There is no drive through.

name: Todd Paulson
text: Was greeted with a smile was served our order really quickly and very pleasantly then enjoyed the refreshing Dairy Queen treat.

name: Shannon Dorr
text: Great place for ice cream treat.

name: Mark McCorkel
text: You can never go wrong with DQ!

name: Ellen Z
text: They make good Blizzards at this location which is more than I can say for other DQs but their interior is in bad need of attention.  I would give it more stars if the bathrooms were in better shape.  It's not that the employees aren't cleaning, the fixtures need work because there bathrooms smell moldy.

name: Kim Mathis
text: Nice staff but the bathrooms were disgusting and smelled like someone peed all over. I will never go back there. PERIOD!

name: Rick DuBois
text: Consistently great service and quality Blizzards.

name: Katy Dehmlow
text:
I grew up coming here regularly as a kid.  They OVERFILL the Blizzards here.  I love that you can walk here from the riverfront or from downtown.  They have an outdoor ordering window for when you can't be bothered with shirts or shoes, or when your furry buddies tag along.
One day when I was a kid, I came here with my dog and my ice cream fell on the ground.  I went back to ask for napkins and instead they just gave me more ice cream!  I now use this as my personal standard for customer service in my coffee shop.  :-)

name: Pa Vang
text: Staffs are nice. This DQ is clean and big inside. My kids enjoy coming here.

name: Cody Ring
text: Yummy ice cream at a good price. Nice down town location

name: Mike Hiles
text: Good food and fast service. Ice cream what can you say!

name: Alison M
text: It's a nice place to stop in and get some quick food while exploring the downtown area.

name: Joe Cosmos
text: This is a great Dairy Queen in downtown Hudson, WI. You can grab a delicious ice cream cone and take a walk down by the beautiful St. Croix  River on a hot summers day.

name: xl bass
text: As usual a great experience

name: Mike Hiles
text: Good food and fast service

name: Pettynerd
text: Quick service and friendly staff, not that much seating inside.

name: Tim
text: Nice place to stop for ice cream on a hot summer day.

name: Jonathan Anderson
text: Best Ice Cream Ever!

name: Dan Curran

name: Tessa Whaley

name: Kimberlee Simones
text: Great ice cream treats and some great fast food.  Outdoor and indoor seating.

name: Mandy Gehlbach
text: Service wasn't very friendly and they don't honor nationally advertised specials.

name: Lori Brown
text: Blizzard was great and full of chunks....

name: Jonathan Milton
text: Good blizzards always end up with more ice cream than you thought

name: Vinny Holter
text: Overall, good service and food.

name: Jeremy Annunziata
text: Love the Hudson WI DQ I love the 5.00 lunch and the 6.00 lunch Manu

name: Paige Rudd
text: VERY good food and service.

name: David Cumming

name: Eric M
text: Always spot on. Salad plus brisket will always hit. Brisket is best anywhere in the area. MOIST.

name: Jon Ross
text: Super delicious, price is right! About the same as a Famous Dave's but you're supporting a smaller business. Not sure if it's because if covid or not but they don't serve beer anymore here and their drink options are bleak. Check this cool spot out for yourself and make sure to get the corn bread tops!

resp.text: Thanks for the review, Jon! We are so happy to have you in!

name: Travis Wichman
text: The food here is great! I ordered their pulled pork sandwich with their mac and cheese side, which was phenomenal. Reminded me of the BBQ places I have been to down in Kansas City, I am looking forward to eating here again for sure. The only negative I can say is I ordered my meal through door dash and applied a pick up promo code for 30% off my order. When I arrived to pick up my order the code was not applied, this is not the biggest of deals but figured I would mention it. This was also my first time using door dash so it could have been user error.

resp.text: Thanks, Travis! Super happy you loved it! Come back soon...there are so many things for you to try!!

name: Sherie Loverkamp
text: Nice clean restaurant. Staff was nice and worked quickly. The food was delicious! A little pricey, but we definitely enjoyed it. I would eat here again.

resp.text: Thanks for your review, Sherie! We appreciate you visiting us, and we’re so glad you liked it!🎉🥳

name: Ron Berg
text: We ordered online and went there to pick up our food. I was very disappointed.  I ordered a brisket burger and it was charred to the point that it was like eating ashes! It was terrible! We also ordered a couple of bowls.  They were okay but they also forgot to give us our dill potato salad.  My wife had to drive back there and get it. They never even offered to make it right in any way.  I paid close to $40 for our meal. For this price the food should have been really good! Bad food and bad customer service equals NO more of my hard earned money being spent there. I will head to Big Guys BBQ from now on.

resp.text: So sorry to hear that you had anything less than a great experience, Ron! We will make sure the team sees this and uses it to make ourselves better. Hopefully you come back so we can do better, which I know we can!

name: Greg Springer
text: Well the food is still good, but the food is now brought to your table in a  plastic bag. All the food is in to-go containers. There was 1 garbage can, with trash stacked up 2 feet high. Some display table sitting diagonally in the middle of the room funneled people exiting the place within inches of our table.

resp.text: Greg, this is great feedback for us! We are figuring out the best way to open for dining, so this will help us make it better! Glad you came in! We missed seeing our guests!

name: Brent guest
text: Not just another BBQ place, bacon was super great, good moist chicken, did I mention the bacon was great?

resp.text: Hahaha.....b-a-c-o-n!!

name: Anjola Dee
text: The food is great but I'm going to give it 3 stars because the last 2 visits more than half the tables in the eating area were not bussed. Lots of plates and trays on various tables and not a whole lot of seating options. It's not like the line was crazy busy either where they can't keep up.

resp.text: Thanks for the feedback and letting us know about your experience, Angi - we'll use this as a training opportunity. 👍

name: McDuffet Drooly
text: I had tried some of the Brisket courtesy of the employee I talked with and it was amazing! The rich full flavor of the meat and the way it melted when I bit into was fantastic! You have to come try the food here!

resp.text: Whoop! Whoop! Thanks Michael!

name: daskocina
text: Best BBQ in town!! Everything is fresh made that day and never frozen meat, plus they have a fantastic selection of BBQ sauces. Highly recommended!

resp.text: Thanks, Daskocina! We appreciate the BBQ love!

name: Dave Feitl
text: Take out service was quick and the crew was friendly.  COVID-19 protections were in place.

resp.text: Safety is very important to our team, Dave! Glad you came for some legendary BBQ!

name: Jill Lovejoy
text: Excellent food! The dill potato salad was delish! The ribs were tender & flavorful. Mac & cheese was fantastic! Love the cornbread tops!

resp.text: Jill this review and rating TICKLE OUR RIBS! Than-Q! 🔥

name: Ramon Ortiz
text: Online ordering is easy. They have great customer service. The food is always fresh and I love the custom flavor bbq sauce.

resp.text: Thanks, Ramon! We appreciate it!👍🎉

name: Tammy Waldron
text: Came well recommended but only had take out service.

resp.text: Tammy - we are hoping to open soon. We just need to do it when it is right for our team. Hope to see you soon!

name: Thaadd Powell
text: Great food, good gluten free options. Enjoyed the dry rub wings, picked up the Dixie Red sauce for home.

resp.text: We are definitely a great go-to spot for those with gluten sensitivities Thaadd! (Did you know ALL our sauces are gluten-free, not just Dixie??). We hope to see you again soon! 👍

name: Robert claerhout
text: Pretty darn tasty!What a treat! Good value!

resp.text: Robert - thank you for the 5 stars! We appreciate the opportunity to serve you our BBQ! Come back again soon!

name: Gypsy Owlz
text: As a born a raised Texan, this place took me all the way back home. Great flavors, the Southern Sun sauce was almost a match to my father's recipe I grew up on. And G, the have SWEET TEA!!!!!  Clean place and great customer service to top it off. 10/10.  Will definitely be back.

resp.text: Your review made our day, Gypsy!! THAN-QUE!! 😊😊😊

name: Arielle Prinzing
text: Great food, however our first order was missing 1 cornbread muffin top. Not a big deal though, food was delicious and service was friendly.

name: Tom Hofmeister
text: Great food.  Especially for those picky eaters in your family.  I really love their BBQ options as well.  My favorites were the brown sugar and the mustard.  Both were unique and delicious.

resp.text: Hi Tom - thanks for the Smokin' rating and review!! 🔥🔥🔥

name: Bad Hombre!!!
text: Ordered their "BRISKET" bowl.  Turns out brisket means pure fat that should have been thrown away.  Paying 13 dollars for fat is not a sustainable business model.

resp.text: I'm sorry that this was your experience, Bad! Please reach out to that location, so that they can make you a legendary bowl that they are known for!

name: Jessica Steger
text: It is a little spendy for the amount of food you get, but it is delicious!

resp.text: Thanks for the positive review, Jessica! Glad you loved the 'que!

name: Samuel Gershman
text: Great food and speedy service.

resp.text: Thanks, Samuel!

name: Gregory Bernard, D.C.
text: Good bbq, good service

resp.text: Hi Gregory - thanks for the feedback!! 👍

name: Kelly Ilavsky
text: The food is very good

resp.text: Thanks, Kelly! That's our goal each day!

name: Karina Nehrkorn
text: Was here a couple years ago when I was still in grad school at River Falls. Great BBQ and it was really tender. The seasonings were good and didn't feel overpowering, and there were various seasonings to choose from on the table. I really enjoyed the look of the inside dining area. Huge windows and a neat-looking place. The seats and tables appeared clean and the staff were friendly. I would suggest trying this place at least once if you like BBQ!

resp.text: Awesome - thanks for sharing about your Slabulous experience, Karina!! 🔥🔥🔥

name: Morgan Waste
text: Really good barbeque and love the beans! Many sauces to choose from. Will be back!

name: Marissa Petersen
text: Hands down the best BBQ joint around! The brisket is superb and the beans, OMG! They're like non other. Just try it!

name: Gregory Runk
text: Great tasting ribs. Done the right way. They have their own bbq sauces.  Make sure you have a place to seat before ordering.  It's hard to stand and eat. That is the only drawback of this place.

resp.text: Hi Gregory - thanks for the Smokin' rating and review! Seating is easier to find depending on when you come in (and how big your group is). Thanks for the feedback!

name: Ken Boyd
text: Great food.  The ribs were large, generous and juicy. Sides were good. I got coleslaw and beans. We'll be back. We love the cornbread muffin tops.

resp.text: We absolutely hope to see you again, Ken! Partycorn!! 🎉🌽

name: Marcus Borgstrom
text: Super great food. The hot links are excellent. Can take a long time to get food after ordering otherwise it'd get a full 5 stars.

resp.text: Hey thanks for the feedback Marcus. We're always striving for a shorter wait time and we agree that our Texas Hot Links are a second-to-none. Hope to see you again soon! 🔥

name: Grant Schleusner
text: Great food, better staff. The only BBQ place I go to in Hudson & Hayward, WI. Build my own bowl is my go to! Excellent flavors.

resp.text: We L❤VE this review, Grant - THAN-QUE!!

name: Lance
text:
The first time that I went there we ordered a half a pound of brisket,  2 hot link sausages, potato salad, and macaroni & cheese. The brisket was excellent but the sausage I didn't care for. My wife said the potato salad tastes  like salt, as for myself I had the macaroni and cheese and it was pretty dry. The worst thing about the whole experience was that it took 25 minutes to get this food. we were there at 11:30 on a Friday morning.
Round 2: 8/2/16
Had a good experience with a brisket the first time around so I thought why not I'll try it again I also ordered half a pound of pulled pork. The smoked meat was excellent however once again the worst part about the experience was the wait time. I showed up at 1:30 p.m. and waited another 20 minutes to get that to-go order.
I'll probably return in a few months and give it another try hopefully their employees have gained some more experience by that point and the wait time won't be so long.

resp.text:
Hi Lance,
Thank you for visiting Old Southern BBQ; we're happy to hear you enjoyed our food!  Yes wait times are a strong focus as we train in new staff.

Thanks!

name: steve sherman
text:
First time we tried it. Impressive. The misses had the brisket sandwich with mac & cheese for her side. Best mac ever she said.
I tried the brisket / smoked wings special.  Very nice. Try the "Jimmy Beans", their version of southern baked beans.
Place  was busy, clean, organized, and service was good.  A definite good idea. Menu is SLIGHTLY over priced but thw quality is there.

resp.text: Thanks for the smokin' review, Steve! We make our mac 'n' cheese from scratch so we're thrilled when our efforts are recognized! Our prices reflect the fact that we smoke our meats and handcraft our sides daily, so we're glad the quality is up-to-par. We look forward to serving you and the missus again soon! 🔥🔥

name: Joshua Meservey
text: Quick service.  The food isn't always the freshest, but that probably depends on when you come.  Decor is home towny but festive.

resp.text: Thanks for the rating and sharing your feedback, Joshua!

name: Travis Inerson
text: Really good food.. I'd suggest getting a dinner roll with your platter but the corn bread muffins are awesome

resp.text: Hey thanks for the Slabulous rating and review, Travis!!

name: samuel37666
text: I love the food here. Finger licking goodness

name: Kevin Van Horne
text: Nice BBQ, tasty with a good assortment of sauces. Portion sizes are good - but you will leave full. Atmosphere was acceptable, but not overly clean.

resp.text: We appreciate your rating and review, Kevin! Hope to see you again soon! 🔥

name: a P
text: Great food and perfect portion sizes for lunch, lots of sauce options too.

resp.text: We L❤VE this Slabulous rating and review - THAN Q!

name: John Bamberg
text: We thought that this place was a particularly good choice. The decor was appealing. The staff were friendly. The barbecue was very good, and I particularly thought the sauces were creative and tasty. OnePlus about this barbecue place is that you can buy the meat by the pound in any part of a pound that you want.

resp.text: Thanks for the Smokin' rating and review, John! We're glad you enjoyed your experience! 🔥🔥🔥

name: Kim T
text: The staff is amazing nice and helpful...I would go back again and again!

name: Justin Dahlberg
text: I love this place. It seems like it is exactly what Famous Daves used to be and is not any longer. Good, fresh food cooked to order. Great sauces to try on all your stuff (only thing missing, in my estimation, is a white sauce and/or mustard based sauce). I have enjoyed everything that I have received from this place but, the only problem I've had is not ever knowing what and how much to order. I end up with either way too much, or way too little of food, depending on how many people we are in with. We'll get it someday!! I recommend this place completely!

name: Jennie Orr Thomas
text: First visit. Reasonably good, but not great, food. Smaller portions at smaller prices than a lot of others, which can be a plus. Lots of sides choices, several that sounded interesting but not chosen by our party of three. The "bowl" I had was tasty but not much of the chosen meat and VERY messy to eat, with a mixture of several drippy sauces.

name: John Berman
text: This is an old school BBQ joint that is definitely worth the stop. We tried several different items from the menu and ALL were outstanding. Great ribs, brisket, chicken and sausage. You GOTTA try the brisket chili. Incredible flavor and just enough spice to make it interesting. Also, after dinner that comes with a muffin top, yes, JUST THE TOP, the best part of a corn bread muffin, we had to take a dozen more home with us. The best thing about this place is, there isn't one in the town we're from. We would eat there WAY too often and wouldn't have a good excuse to make a trip to Hudson on a regular basis.

name: John Hodgell
text: Great atmosphere, tasty food and a fair price

resp.text: Thanks for the Slabulous rating and review, John!! 🔥🔥🔥

name: Cherie' & Alex Dilts
text: Really good selection of BBQ!

resp.text: Thanks, Cherie & Alex!! We appreciate that!!👍🎉

name: John Richard
text:
The pulled pork has excellent smoked flavor.  A good assortment of sauces to choose from at the table.
Would've given 5 stars except I had to ask for fork to eat my pork. I ordered a platter that doesn't come with a bun.
The beans I ordered for my side were very flavorful as well. Great job "Jimmy"!

name: Steph McCormack
text: YUM!!!  This place is great!  Always clean, well lit, and has super nice employees!  I love the southern style of group eating they offer, and being able to watch food being prepared!  Build your own bowl is the best way to go in my opinion!  Oh, the lemonade is also quite tasty!  Not too sweet, just tart enough :)

resp.text:
Hi Steph!  Thanks we think you're great! Our team works very hard  to create the best experience for guests and your comments made their day.
Party Corn!

name: Tessa Whaley
text: The service was meh, my food came out barely warm, my moms my brothers and my brothers girlfriends came out hot, my roll didnt have any butter on it like theirs did, not a fan of their sauce selection.  The only good thing about my meal was the Sweet Potatos. I may give them another chance but honestly not very likely.

resp.text: Thanks for letting us know about your experience Tessa.

name: Teresa Johnson
text: Loved the meal on our first visit. Pulled pork sandwich delicious and loaded with meat.   Beans were the best I've had in a long time.  Cole slaw very tasty too...had a hint of apple flavor.   Will definitely be stopping in again when we are in the area.

name: Adam G
text: Food was pretty good. Better bbq than Famous Dave's was. Out of tea, out of the blue pop, out of ice, many tables messy. Saw a few employees that didn't seem to be busy.  Was there about an hour so they had plenty of time to brew tea, refill the blue juice, or clean tables.

resp.text: Hi Adam - thanks for letting us know about your experience. We make our tea from scratch so likely you caught us while we were replenishing. Next time you're in the restaurant ask for the manager and they will take care of you - thanks!

name: Chris Fristed
text: The food was pretty good, the staff was friendly, all around a nice joint

resp.text: Thanks for the feedback, Chris! Hope to see you again soon 👍

name: Lisa Marie
text: The soul bowl was delicious. I am very picky about my bbq and this place was good

resp.text: The Soul Bowl is one of our favorites too, Lisa! Thanks for the Smokin' rating and review!

name: Leah Rosch
text: It's so quick and easy to walk in at lunch or dinner and sit down to eat a delicious meal. I get to use the Lions share of my hour lunch break if I eat here during the work day. Not so with any of the fast food joints ironically. I timed it-ten minutes from work to Hudson, then I am usually in line for another 10 or fifteen minutes. If I eat at Old Southern by the time fifteen minutes are up I have fork to mouth. The food is delicious and I appreciate that they have sweet tea, not just regular, already made up.

resp.text: Thank 'que for the great review, Leah!  We hope to see you back again soon!!

name: Johannah Hayden
text:
Best BBQ I have had. Fun atmosphere and very friendly staff. This is one of the few places I can take the family too that EVERYONE loves! (That says a lot when you have 3 young boys)

Love their bowls and the broccoli salad is phenomenal!

resp.text: Thank 'que for your kind words!  Hope to see you and your family again, soon!!

name: fuzer909
text: Needs more meat per serving, sauces are great.

resp.text: Thanks for the feedback fuzer

name: Barry Orso
text: Yummy food you even get a bottle of sauce on your birthday

resp.text: Thanks for spending your birthday with us, Barry!!

name: Floyd Linaberry
text: Really good BBQ at this place!  Love the brisket, love the hot links, love the cole slaw...wait...I love everything I have eaten here so far.  Stop on in and give them a try, you will not regret it.

name: Travis Johnson
text:
I have eaten here twice and ordered the Memphis bowl both times. The first time the food came out hot and was very good; however, the second time I ordered the bowl my food came out cold.

It was around 8:00 PM, and I went here with my family for a late dinner.  My wife and I ordered the Memphis bowl.  Our bowls came out with the rest of the food for our kids.  While my wife and kids ate their food, I waited for my food to be reheated.  The second time my bowl came out it was still cold.  The waiter didn't believe me so he stuck his finger in my food at the table and then took it away with disgust.  Before I received my meal for the third time, my family was done eating.  It was then that my wife then realized her bowl was supposed to have meat, but with it already gone how could you say something to the waiter.  Even after the third attempt my food was not hot.  I ate it anyway in an effort to get out of the restaurant.

No compensation was received for the cold food, the delay to get my food, or for making the entire family wait on me to get my food and eat it.  As much as i enjoyed the food the first time around, we will not be returning to this restaurant.

name: shay engesether
text: Never bad bad food here and ive visited many times. The brisket sandwich was excellent

name: caroline mueller
text: This is the best food that I have had in Hudson, Wi. I got the 2 meat platter with the dry rub wings and brisket, mac and cheese for my side. I havent found bbq this good since i was in Georgia. I ordered takeout and it was ready very quickly, like 10 minutes. when I called the gentleman on the phone was so nice and very helpful, gave me a great recommendation. When I got there the girl working the front counter was great also, she also had me take a cup of her fave sauce blue and tangy. Mmmm.

resp.text: We love when folks let us know about their positive experiences so THAN-QUE, Caroline!! 🔥🔥🔥

name: Paul Johnson
text: Pretty good BBQ. I would go again.

resp.text: And we hope to see you again, Paul! 😊

name: Matt Mauer
text: Delicious! Really enjoy BBQ and this place does it well. If you are looking for your fix when it comes to good southern BBQ, this place does the trick!

resp.text: Thanks so much for the Smokin' rating and review, Matt!! Partycorn! 🎉🌽

name: Pamela Stone
text: Pretty much the same as Famous Dave's. The meat was tender and smoked to perfection. The house sauces are very good. The mustard sauce is exceptional. We had the 2 person combo platter and there was a liitle too much for my husband and me. My favorite was probably the chicken although everything was tasty.Our bill only came to around $25.

name: Charles Danner
text: Great food at a good price

resp.text: Thanks for the Smokin' rating and review, Charles! 🔥🔥🔥

name: Danika Tollefson

They then took it in a back room. I didn't think anything of it until I got home. And found bits of brisket around the edges and pressed into the food. They picket the brisket out of it rather than remake the bowl. This is completely unacceptable behavior for a restaurant. Absolutely unprofessional. I never once have seen anyone that is an obvious manager there. If they are willing to pick the meat out of an order that was specifically ordered without meat, what else would they do? I will not trust this place with making my food again. Thanks for making me go without eating today Old Southern BBQ. And I was/am starved.

name: Dale Bohnert
text:
** FOLLOW-UP, UPGRADED POST/REVIEW**
As a follow-up to my less-than-stellar review two months ago, big thanks to Dave Anderson (chain owner) and store manager Joe Seaver, for reachng out to us, and inviting us for a second try... VERY good food (we went with, a party platter... the "hot links" and the cole slaw, of all things, were actually my flavor-ites!) and much improved customer service. Looking forward to our return visits! Many thanks again, and blessings on your continued success.

(Original post, June, 2016):
Decent food, horrible customer service from the supposed "top" on down. Upon placing our order, we were informed, point blank, "We're outta ribs." (... ummm... okay..?). When our food came, there were a couple of minor. mistakes which my wife pointed out, and was told, verbatim, "Yup." (After three mistakes were cleaned up, we did not see, not hear from our waitress again 😞)

We watched the owner walk out and back from his vehicle (which occupied the closest handicap space nearest the restaurant). As we were leaving, I walked over to the table where he sat talking with another employee, and asked, "Are you the owner?"

"Well, I'm Dave.."

"Oh... well, are you the owner?" I asked.

".... well..." (looking awkwardly at the woman employee with him)... "we're ALL owners."

When I asked whether he'd like to know how it - our food, our service and experience and our first visit-  was.

"Oh.. sure..yes.."

"Well," I told him, "Then you're the first who seems to care or want to know," adding, "This is 'grand opening'.... someone, YOU, needs to be up and moving around, introducing yourself, asking if anyone needs anything."

"... We usually do.." replied Dave.

Well. You didnt. And now we're gone.

Dale Bohnert, River Falls
.

resp.text:
Hi Dale,  We're a counter service restaurant so we don't have any waitresses.  Mistakes happen, especially in the first week with a brand new staff - they're all working very hard on great food and service.  I'm happy to hear they fixed the minor mistakes in your meal.

We do sell out occasionally when we have very busy days like Memorial Day.  Our company believes in high quality fresh smoked meats, which means we don't serve reheated meats.  In order to do this we smoke fresh every day and when we run out for the evening (like we did tonight around 7:15p) we're sold out for the night.

Dave as you may not know had ankle surgery and is only able to walk/stand for short periods of time, which is why he has a handicap parking pass on his car and is sitting, not walking, around the restaurant.

to be able to go to a fast food restaurant and get a burger that is more comparable to one you would receive at a restaurant versus fast food hamburger patties and only pay five bucks and some change for a full meal is totally worth it. If you haven't had Culver's I'd strongly recommend giving it a try! My kids prefer Culver's cheeseburgers over McDonald's :-) as do I lol :-)

name: Patrick Villacorta
text:
I don't really review food, this is for the service.

I've been to Culver's twice at different locations. Both times the service has been exceptionally attentive & friendly, especially for a fast food place. I don't know if it's a Culver's or a Wisconsin thing.

Of note in this particular visit is that they informed me that my order would be a mere 3 minutes late. Totally no big deal to me. To my surprise, I was given a voucher/token for a free meal on a future date. This caused me to fill out a comment form to compliment them which I very rarely do.

I don't believe this is something that should be expected and I certainly won't expect it in the future. So I hope nobody gets any ideas to abuse this :)

Visited July 2016

As you have no doubt come to expect from Culver's, you will get fast and friendly service, hot burgers, cold custard, and a warm smile from the staff.  This location is a bit off the interstate if you're traveling down 94, and not near a gas station, so caters more to locals than travelers.  As such, if you visit during odd hours, you will usually get your food without much of a wait.  I recommend the double delux burger with no cheese.

Enjoy.

name: Mick Dutcher
text: Smashburger has become one of our favorite places for "fast food" burgers. Their burgers are delicious as are their smash fries. We have never eaten in at this particular location. We often stop on the way through Hudson on road trips and take full advantage of their website to order ahead. It's wonderful because we can order about 20-30 minutes out and have our food ready for us to take out when we get there. This particular location appears to be pretty popular, so during the peak hours (lunch, dinner) you can usually expect a wait to place your order. This is another good reason to use their website to order ahead! While we usually get their burgers and fries, I would also highly recommend their shakes. They are an excellent treat as well. This location is located very close to I-94  with a good sized parking lot. Although you can see the restaurant from Carmichael Road, there is on entrance there. You can access the parking lot by coming in the back way from Stageline Road and Center Drive. The entrance is handicap accessible, but the restaurant has fairly tight corners and is a bit on the crowded side. It might be a little challenging to navigate with a wheelchair or a stroller.

text:
No masks during a pandemic, will not be stopping in

Edit: If the heat is really why you can't wear masks, face shields exist. Theyre inexpensive starting at $7 online (possibly cheaper per unit of you go directly through vendors, our kitchen got them through the same place we get our gloves). Viable options exist, seek them out or spread the plague.

resp.text: That's really too bad.  The heat in the store almost caused a couple of workers to faint.  Although we do keep a very clean store and follow guidelines for Covid, the masks are a big point for overall health.  We are working on the cooling system and have been wearing the masks every day, other than the one extremely humid day.  Hopefully, the next time you walk by you will be able to see The Fudgery in the way we all remember it to be, Fudge & Fun.  Thanks for the suggestion about the face shields, but with cooking and fogging, they aren't a viable option.  We have had employees wear contacts to counter their glasses, but the shields are tough. We have found another option and are happily wearing masks!

It was worth walking around in below-zero weather with giant scoops of chocolate ice cream in a tasty waffle cone from this place. I recommend checking it out if you're in the area.

text: Seriously- what a fantastic dinner!  Excellent service for starters... I wish I could remember his name to give him props (from Green Bay). The chop salad was delightful and my sister got a burger which she loved.  Then, the butter cake.  There are no words.  The whole meal from top to bottom  was excellent.   I can't remember the last time I gave 5 stars... so take me seriously:)

resp.text: Amy, thank you for the wonderful review! I will pass along your warm regards to Jadin, he is really great and a valued member of our team. I completely agree about the butter cake!

text: Had a large group come in. Service was great, Lauren made sure the drinks didn't end up empty. We will certainly keep this our rotation.

name: Scott B_
text: Nice ambience but a bit generic. Service was good, but not overly friendly. A bit too polished for me. Loosen up, kid. It's only lunch!! My friend and I decided to share the calamari fries (great - extra points for the fantastic beer aioli!) and the chop chop salad (their take on a traditional Cobb) which came with a zesty smoked peppercorn ranch dressing. For an entree we split the cherry turkey which had been my friends choice. I am not a big fan of turkey but the Muenster helped drown that out! It was pretty busy for lunch so get there early!

name: Sean Bellinger
text: Good food, nice ambiance, limited wine selection, slow service, moderately noisey

resp.text: Sean, I'm sorry to hear you did not enjoy your experience with us. I thank you for bringing these issues to our attention so we can work to better serve our guests.

name: Michael Kelley
text: We came based on the good reviews.recemtly posted by others and our experience was wonderful.  We came on a Friday evening and were seated immediately.  My wife had the Mac and cheese, which had great texture, with the crunchy bread crumbs/cheese layer on top, the more creamy layer underneath, and the pasta was al dente.  I had the Friday fish fry.  The fish was the ideal that many places strive for - crunchy coating but not overdone, tender fish inside, but not watery.  The accompanying fries were a standard type, no bells and whistles, but with good crunch, no soggy parts.  Our server, Marissa, was excellent overall, and helped me pick a local brew beer to pair with it by providing recommendations and samples.  Later, the manager, Mark, also came to our table to ask for our reflections on the meal.  We had a great conversation and our overall experience compels us to highly  recommend that you try East Town Kitchen and Bar.

resp.text: Michael, thank you for the glowing review. It was great speaking with you and your wife while you were in the city for Doors Open. I'm glad we lived up to your expectations and hope you'll visit us again the next time you come to Milwaukee!

name: Dan Mueller
text: Food and service was good. Ambiance is good. Acoustics are bright and the music is cranked all the time, making business meetings nearly inadvisable for this location.

resp.text: I’m so sorry to hear this Dan! I will be sure to pass this message along to management so proper changes can be made.

text: Great atmosphere and staff. Get the cheese curds!

name: Jaime Meyer
text: Great food and atmosphere. As a vegetarian, I was a little hesitant because they focus on meat. However, there were several delicious veggie options on both the lunch and dinner menu. It also seems like a great place for a group happy hour because there is a lot of  large comfy couches with tables and a decent bar area.

text: Food was good, service was poor. Server was very in attentive. 10 minutes to place our order after he brought out two drinks. 10 more minutes to get a refill. Had to track him down to get the check. Thankfully the baby didn't flip out on me while we were waiting.

text: Met some family (from South Dakota) there for Saturday brunch and had the best time. The place was not busy, so we could be loud and laugh as much as we wanted. Our server Maria M. was very patient as we did more talking, and had to have her keep returning to take our order  The menu was very simple and straight forward, so we did not need to thing to hard about what to eat. Each of our meals was great. Would defiantly try it for dinner.

text:
While staying at the Marriott Downtown in Milwaukee, you may find yourself wanting an appetizer or burger along with drinks. Milliken is a great unique restaurant and bar adjoining the hotel. Nice option for me when I stay here!

Their burger selection includes some really great options which are out of the ordinary and really hearty. You’ll need several napkins when you work these down, chase each bite down with a frosty drink!

text: The chicken sandwich was done-deez... They cooked the juices out of that sucker.  Unfortunately, I cannot rate this place anything better than 3 stars.  The place itself is fairly nice and the service was slightly above average.  Nothing special.   If I make a trip back, I will provide a new rating, if it is warranted.

text: It's fine.  There are a few different levels of "fancy" on the menu, since it is a hotel restaurant trying to cater to various levels of clientele.  But they have good local beer selections at the bar, and they can accommodate big groups.

text:

The staff is very nice and will make you feel like home.
Pricing might be an issue but you get what you pay for.

text: Great place for business lunch or after work dinner. Very good food. Bit pricey but in line with other restaurants of this category in the area.

name: Jane Jenkins
text:
Went there for our anniversary dinner.

Probably the best fine dining restaurant in Milwaukee and one of the top 10 in the Midwest, including Chicago.

Doesn't look like much from the outside, but once you step inside you're in for a treat! Delightful menu. Impeccable service. Pricey, but well worth it.

If you're a foodie, Sanford is a "must". Add it to your bucket list.

text: One of my favorite spots in the summer, their patio is very relaxing, I usually order their steamed muscles, great taste, they never disappoint you. The staff is great and welcoming. If your looking for a patio to hangout on in the summer, this would be the spot
